title: Service Delivery Manager – Data Center Operations
description:
Salary: RM 8,000 – RM 12,000 per month

Service Delivery Manager – Data Center Operations

Location: Kulai, Johor


Summary

The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is responsible for managing and overseeing the delivery, operational performance, governance, and continuous improvement of Data Center Managed Services. The role serves as the primary point of contact between customers, service delivery teams, and internal stakeholders, ensuring that services are delivered in accordance with contractual obligations, Service Level Agreements (SLAs), security standards, and business requirements.

The SDM provides end-to-end oversight of service performance, operational governance, customer satisfaction, risk management, and service improvement initiatives. The role coordinates cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and service issues, effective communication with customers, and consistent achievement of agreed service levels.

The SDM reports to the Account Delivery Manager and drives service reviews, performance reporting, operational improvement, and governance activities to identify opportunities for increased service quality, efficiency, resilience, and customer value.


Key Responsibilities

1. Service Delivery Management

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of Data Center Managed Services.

  • Ensure compliance with contracts, SLAs, KPIs, and operational standards.

  • Monitor service performance and drive corrective actions when required.

  • Act as the primary escalation point for service and customer issues.

  • Coordinate customers, operations teams, and internal stakeholders to maintain service quality and continuity.

  • Oversee day-to-day Data Center operations, including availability, capacity, resilience, and operational readiness.

  • Ensure effective management of critical infrastructure and supporting services, including power, cooling, network, security, monitoring, and facilities, as applicable.

  • Ensure compliance with approved MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, and operational procedures.

  • Monitor critical infrastructure performance, alarms, capacity, and availability.

  • Coordinate planned maintenance, shutdowns, upgrades, and other activities to minimize service impact.

  • Ensure appropriate staffing, shift coverage, handovers, and escalation processes are maintained.



2. Operations & Service Governance

  • Ensure operational readiness, service continuity, and adherence to established governance frameworks.

  • Manage operational risks, dependencies, issues, and service performance through structured governance processes.

  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve operational procedures, documentation, and service governance standards.

  • Conduct regular operational and service governance reviews to ensure performance, compliance, and accountability.

  • Ensure appropriate controls are in place to support consistent and reliable service delivery.

3. SLA & Performance Management

  • Own and manage SLA and KPI performance across all assigned managed services.

  • Analyze service performance trends, SLA breaches, recurring issues, and areas for improvement.

  • Lead service recovery actions and performance improvement initiatives to restore and maintain agreed service levels.

  • Ensure timely, accurate, and meaningful service performance reporting.

  • Present service performance, risks, issues, and improvement plans to customers and senior management.

4. Incident, Problem, and Change Management

  • Lead major incident response and coordinate stakeholders to restore services quickly.

  • Coordinate technical and operational teams to resolve incidents and minimize service impact.

  • Oversee Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and ensure corrective actions are completed.

  • Track recurring issues and drive problem resolution.

  • Ensure lessons learned are incorporated into operational improvements.

  • Manage and govern planned changes, maintenance, upgrades, and infrastructure modifications.

  • Ensure changes are properly assessed, approved, communicated, implemented, and documented.

  • Monitor high-risk changes and ensure appropriate rollback plans are in place.

  • Ensure emergency and unauthorized changes are controlled, reviewed, and documented.

5. Workforce Management

  • Ensure appropriate staffing levels, resource allocation, and workforce readiness to support service delivery requirements.

  • Manage workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, deployment, and resource utilization.

  • Monitor employee performance, attendance, productivity, competency, and training compliance.

  • Identify skills and capability gaps and coordinate appropriate training and development activities.

  • Support employee engagement, performance evaluations, talent development, succession planning, and retention initiatives.

6. Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with vendors, subcontractors, service partners, and other third-party providers.

  • Monitor vendor performance, service quality, SLA achievement, and contractual compliance.

  • Lead regular service review meetings, operational reviews, and customer governance sessions.

  • Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution of service-related concerns.

  • Maintain effective stakeholder communication and transparency throughout the service lifecycle.

  • Build strong working relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to support service quality and customer satisfaction.

7. Transition & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead service transition, mobilization, handover, and operational stabilization activities.

  • Ensure new or transitioned services are operationally ready before entering steady-state operations.

  • Identify and implement opportunities for process improvement, automation, standardization, and service optimization.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives based on service performance trends, customer feedback, operational lessons learned, and emerging business requirements.

  • Measure and communicate the benefits and outcomes of improvement initiatives.

8. Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, security, health and safety, and organizational requirements.

  • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of identified findings.

  • Maintain operational risk registers, mitigation plans, and appropriate governance controls.

  • Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks that may impact service availability, performance, security, or customer commitments.

  • Ensure appropriate escalation and management of significant operational, compliance, and security risks.

9. Service Strategy & Account Support

  • Support the Account Delivery Manager in achieving overall account objectives and customer commitments.

  • Provide operational input into account strategy, service planning, and customer engagements.

  • Support contract renewals, service expansions, solution changes, and new business opportunities where applicable.

  • Identify opportunities for service enhancement, automation, optimization, and additional customer value.

  • Provide operational estimates, risks, resource requirements, and feasibility assessments for proposed service changes.

title: CNC Programmer
description:
At Norwood Medical, the work you do matters.

Every precision component we manufacture plays a role in helping surgeons perform procedures that improve and save lives around the world. From robotic-assisted surgery to minimally invasive medical technologies, our products are trusted in operating rooms where quality and precision make a difference.

Norwood Medical is looking for a CNC Programmer with experience in programming mill and/or lathe CNC machines.

The CNC Programmer's responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Develop programs utilizing CAM software for machines to produce customer parts and internal tooling.
  • Run programming simulations and modify as needed.
  • Interpret drawings and product models to make modifications/improvements for in-process tooling, fixtures, and gauges using computer-aided design software applications.
  • Conduct quality tests to ensure products meet quality standards and make adjustments as needed.
  • Create and maintain accurate records of programming, set-up sheets, and tooling information.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams through providing technical support and project updates.
  • Recommend design changes to the customer's parts to aid design for manufacturability.
  • Provide training support on programming and machinery operation.
  • Submit purchase requisitions for outsourced mechanical components and tooling.
  • Ensure compliance with current CAD/CAM standards to provide quality design.
  • Adhere to all safety practices, policies, and/or procedures.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Typically requires 5 years' experience in CNC programming; 10+ years is perferred.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, blueprints and schematics to develop machinery programming.
  • Basic computer skills and programming knowledge.
  • Understanding of machining properties of various raw materials.

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to walk, stand, sit, move about the facilities.
  • Ability to lift up to 35 lbs during scheduled work hours.

Norwood Medical Offers:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription Drug benefits.
  • Company paid life insurance and disability benefits.

  • Paid time off, unpaid time off, and paid holidays.
  • Tuition reimbursement.
  • 401k savings plans.
  • Career development.

All eligible candidates must pass the following pre-employment screenings:

  • Background screening
  • Drug screening

Norwood is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Norwood is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age or other legally protected status. All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

Hos Digital Psykiatri i Region Midtjylland styrker vi vores område og søger derfor en Digitaliseringskonsulent til AI- og automatiseringsprojekter til fastansættelse. Har du et stort engagement og lyst til at bidrage aktivt til den fælles digitale udvikling og transformation i psykiatrien, så læs med her.

Det kan du se frem til:

  • En fagligt udfordrende stilling tæt på den kliniske virkelighed
  • Mulighed for at præge fremtidens psykiatri gennem digital transformation
  • Et stærkt fagligt fællesskab med fokus på innovation og udvikling
  • Dygtige, engagerede og humoristiske kolleger med en uformel omgangstone
  • Fleksible arbejdstider og mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Vær med til at omsætte AI- og automatiseringsprojekter til den kliniske virkelighed

Som digitaliseringskonsulent i Digital Psykiatri får du en vigtig rolle i arbejdet med at omsætte Sundhedsreformen og 10-års planen til digitale løsninger, der kan mærkes i hverdagen. Dit arbejde bidrager til at styrke forebyggelse og tidlig indsats, skabe mere sammenhængende patientforløb og give patienter større fleksibilitet og tilgængelighed gennem digitale behandlingsformer.

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores arbejde med AI-agendaen, hvor du skal hjælpe med at omsætte AI- og automatiseringsprojekter til den kliniske virkelighed. Sammen med klinikere, ledere og andre specialister er du med hele vejen – fra udvikling og modning til implementering af både eksisterende og nye projekter. Samarbejdet er tæt, dialogen er vigtig og relationerne er afgørende for, at løsningerne giver mening i praksis.

Hos os får du ikke bare en rolle, men også rum, ansvar og tillid. Du får stor indflydelse på dine opgaver og din arbejdsdag, en grundig introduktion og løbende sparring i et stærkt fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi deler viden, udfordrer hinanden og løfter opgaven sammen.

Hvem er du?

For at klare dig godt i jobbet, skal du have en uddannelse indenfor Informationsvidenskab, Kognitiv Science eller lignende uddannelser på kandidatniveau. Du skal have dokumenteret erfaring med kliniknær AI og/eller automatisering, enten fra et tidligere job eller din uddannelse med teoretiske metoder til at omsætte AI-løsninger til virkelighed.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har en faglig nysgerrighed til at lære nyt
  • Har erfaring med komplekse projekter med mange interessenter
  • Er en stærk formidler, der kan bygge bro mellem psykiatrisk faglighed og digitale muligheder
  • Trives i en politisk styret organisation med strategiske rammer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og ser samtidig samarbejde på tværs som en forudsætning
    for succes.

Vi arbejder i en politisk styret organisation med klare strategiske rammer, og vi håber, at du har lyst til at udforske dette landskab sammen med os. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har lyst til at bidrage, stille spørgsmål og være en aktiv del af vores gode, kollegiale og faglige fællesskab.

Dét fællesskab deler du med 13 digitaliseringskonsulent-kolleger i området Digital Psykiatri, som hører under Digitalisering og It i Region Midtjylland. Vi sparrer med hinanden, deler viden og hjælper hinanden godt i mål med opgaverne. For os handler et godt kollegaskab også om at være tilgængelige for hinanden og bidrage til en hverdag, hvor det både er rart og sjovt at gå på arbejde. Derfor sætter vi pris på højt humør, god stemning og højt til loftet – og kort vej til både grin og high-fives.

Er det dig, vi hører fra?

Hvis du tænker, at den her mulighed er en, du er nødt til at gribe, så skal du senest den 1. november 2026 sende os din ansøgning og CV. Vi forventer at afholde 1. samtale den. 13. november 2026 og 2. samtale den 20. november 2026. Du må i forbindelse med en eventuel 2. samtale forvente at udfylde en personprofil.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdeleder Morten Juul på tlf. 30 68 17 58.

Fleksibelt arbejdsliv, løbende udvikling og gode rammer

Du vil opleve, at der er fokus på dig som medarbejder og som menneske. Vi arbejder med løbende MUS og jævnlige 1:1-samtaler med din nærmeste leder, så I hele tiden har et fokus på din trivsel og udvikling. Et godt arbejdsliv betyder også tid til et liv ved siden af arbejdet. Derfor er det hybride og fleksible arbejdsliv vigtigt hos os; du har gode muligheder for selv at tilrettelægge din arbejdsdag og du kan arbejde hjemme, når opgaverne tillader det.

Som ny medarbejder i vores store organisation sørger vi for et nøje tilrettelagt onboarding-forløb, hvor du bl.a. deltager i vores interne akademi, hvor du lærer hele organisationen bedre at kende. Vi arbejder for at skabe de bedste rammer, så du kan udvikle dig og styrke dine færdigheder yderligere.

Arbejdsugen er på 37 timer med betalt frokostpause og gode rammer.

Digitalisering og It. Sammen om den digitale transformation - vi gør det nemmere at være ansat og bedre at være borger i Region Midtjylland.

Vi er én af landets største, selvstændige afdelinger, som arbejder med digitalisering og it. Vi er over 600 ansatte, som hver dag går på arbejde for at understøtte vores 36.000 brugere med innovative teknologiske løsninger, stabil drift og kvalificeret support på alle årets dage - døgnet rundt.

Vi er ikke en traditionel it-afdeling. Vores mål er at være en proaktiv samskaber af brugernære digitale løsninger, som går forrest i den digitale udvikling. Vi stræber efter at fremme meningsfuld innovation og sammenhængende digitale sundhedsoplevelser, der styrker, udvikler og understøtter fremtidens sundhedsvæsen på tværs af sektorer - samtidig med at vi sikrer robust drift og god support til alle vores brugere. Digitalisering og It er hvor innovation og service mødes for at skabe en bedre og mere sammenhængende fremtid for et sundhedsvæsen i verdensklasse.

Læs mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på vores karriereside eller få et indblik i vores hverdag på LinkedIn. Du kan også læse regionens digitaliseringsstrategi, som bygger på udvikling af digitale løsninger på patienternes og borgernes præmisser.

Da Region Midtjylland løbende gennemfører besparelser og omorganiseringer, vil medarbejdere i omplacering, der søger stillingen, have fortrinsret til samtale.

Region Midtjylland er jf. EU’s løngennemsigtighedsdirektiv, der trådte i kraft 7. juni 2026 forpligtet til at oplyse dig om startløn eller et interval for startløn for en stilling inden du tilbydes ansættelse.

Her finder du Region Midtjyllands lønkatalog for de fleste faggrupper og stillinger, som findes i Region Midtjylland: Gennemsigtighed forud for ansættelse - Medarbejder.rm.dk

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer_Linguistics and Speech
description:

title: Postdoctoral Associate - Earth Environmental Planetary Sciences
description:
Postdoctoral Research Associate – Multimodal & Graph AI for Earth Systems

Position Summary

The MUSE (Multimodal AI for Earth System Discovery) research cluster at Rice University—led by a cross-departmental faculty team (Drs. Noemi Vergopolan, Arlei Silva, Ian McBrearty and Andrew Hoffman) and associates (Sylvia Dee, Avantika Gori, Jonathan Ajo-Franklin, and Guha Balakrishnan)—is seeking a Postdoctoral Research Associate to pioneer multi-domain Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) and Foundation Models for Earth system modeling, state estimation, and forecasting.

Earth observations are inherently irregular, multi-scale, and heterogeneous—ranging from river networks and seismic stations to InSAR satellite data and subglacial sensors. The goal of this position is to develop reusable, scale-adaptive, graph-based foundation architectures capable of learning unified representations across diverse Earth science testbeds, including hydrology, flood dynamics, ice-sheet/aquifer mechanics, and earthquake processes. Rather than treating AI as a black box, this role focuses on developing transferable, physics-informed models that infer hidden Earth states, discover governing relationships, and quantify predictive uncertainties across interconnected Earth domains.

The position is for an initial one-year term, renewable for up to two to three years, subject to performance and funding availability.

Workplace Requirements:

On campus position: This position is exclusively on-site, necessitating all duties to be performed in-person in Houston, Texas. Per Rice policy 440, work arrangements may be subject to change.

*Exempt (salaried) positions under FLSA are not eligible for overtime.

This position is funded by a grant, soft and/or restricted funds. Continued employment is contingent on the renewal of funding.

Essential Functions

  • GNN & Foundation Model Architecture Development: Design, build, and benchmark multi-domain graph neural network architectures and neural surrogates tailored for complex spatial networks, irregular geometries, and spatio-temporal prediction tasks.

  • Cross-Domain Transfer Learning: Integrate multimodal, heterogeneous Earth observations (e.g., seismic networks, river graphs, satellite altimetry, Distributed Acoustic Sensing) to evaluate model transferability across distinct Earth system domains (Water, Floods, Cryosphere, Earthquakes).

  • Physics-Aware Machine Learning & UQ: Incorporate physical constraints (e.g., PDEs, mass/momentum conservation laws) into graph architectures and uncertainty quantification (UQ) frameworks.

  • Proposal Development & Cluster Collaboration: Assist cluster faculty with interdisciplinary research proposals (e.g., NSF, DOE, NASA) and work closely with collaborators across Computer Science, Electrical & Computer Engineering, and Earth, Environmental and Planetary Sciences (EEPS) at Rice.

  • Dissemination: Publish high-impact research in top-tier machine learning venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and geoscientific journals (e.g., AGU, Nature Geoscience) and present at national and international conferences.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Geophysics / Earth Sciences, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong background in deep learning on graphs (GNNs), geometric deep learning, or large-scale foundation model architectures, with an interest or background in applying these methods to physical or geoscientific systems.

  • High proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric / DGL).

  • Demonstrated track record of peer-reviewed publications in high-impact computational or geoscience journals and conferences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with spatial-temporal or irregularly sampled physical data (e.g., remote sensing, streamflow networks, seismic arrays, InSAR, terrain data).

  • Experience with Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), neural operators (e.g., FNO, DeepONet), or neural surrogate modeling for physical processes.

  • Background in Uncertainty Quantification (UQ) or hybrid machine learning frameworks combining data-driven models with physical priors.

  • High-performance computing (HPC) and/or cloud computing with expertise in distributed training (e.g., CUDA, multi-GPU training).

What We Offer

  • Interdisciplinary Mentorship: Co-mentorship from a collaborative faculty team spanning ML, GNN theory, remote sensing, and geophysics.

  • World-Class Computing: Full access to Rice’s High-Performance Computing (HPC) clusters and specialized GPU acceleration nodes.

  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and full Rice University benefits package.

  • Career Development: Dedicated mentorship and career guidance tailored toward pathways in academia or industry research labs.

To Apply

Please submit the following application materials via the Rice University Application Portal. Combine all required materials into a single PDF file and upload it under the section labeled “CV/Resume.”

  1. Cover Letter (highlighting relevant research experience with GNNs, foundation models, or Earth science data)
  2. Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  3. Research Statement (1–2 pages detailing research accomplishments and future interests)
  4. Contact Information for 3 Professional References

Review of applications begins on December 1st, 2026, and will continue until the position is filled. Informal inquiries can be sent to Rice EEPS (esci-postdocs@rice.edu) or cluster faculty members.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:

You will be responsible for developing software applications used to manage and operate advanced rack-scale computing systems. These applications form a key part of the platform used across multiple products within the Embedded Computing Systems Business Line.

We are Prodrive Technologies - Embedded Computing Systems

Our computing systems are the backbone of cutting-edge applications, delivering performance and reliability where it matters most. Leveraging the latest x86, ARM, and FPGA technologies, we design advanced solutions that power image-processing inspection systems with AI acceleration and real-time computation. Our expertise extends into industrial IoT and automation, driving innovation across semiconductor equipment, medical devices, smart agriculture, and maritime applications.

We offer a complete product range to meet diverse needs: single-board computers for embedded control, standalone industrial PCs for edge computing, and rack-level integration including GPU servers, high-speed, low-latency networking and storage for high-performance environments. Our solutions enable scalability and flexibility for any application.

About

About the role

Working closely with software architects, engineers, and multidisciplinary project teams, you will design, implement, and validate application software based on functional requirements and architectural specifications. You will work across the full software stack, developing user-facing functionality in Elm and reliable, high-performance backend services in Rust.

Responsibilities

This setup provides short communication lines, broad responsibilities, and significant ownership, allowing you to influence technical decisions and see the direct impact of your work on the management and operation of high-end computing systems. You will operate in a challenging, high-tech environment where software, electronics, and mechanics come together to create innovative products and systems. The other responsibilities are:

  • Free access to the company gym

What You Bring

Wij werken aan een van de meest bedrijfs-kritische systemen van Nederland, waarbij vele applicaties door de IV IBS Inkomensheffing tot één werkende oplossing worden voortgebracht en geïntegreerd. Kwaliteit staat voorop bij het realiseren van de producten en diensten voor burgers, bedrijven en belastingdienstmedewerkers. Om ook in de toekomst snel en wendbaar te kunnen inspelen op de wensen van onze stakeholders, investeren we continu in de vernieuwing van onze producten en richten onze werkwijzen zo in dat we in de samenwerking met veel partijen de gewenste resultaten leveren. We zijn bezig met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van grootschalige aanpassingen in het applicatielandschap van de Inkomensheffing. Dat doen we meerjarig en op een beheerste manier, zodat de processen van de Belastingdienst die we ondersteunen ongehinderd door kunnen draaien, maar tegelijkertijd worden vernieuwd. Dat vraagt veel van ons als IV-organisatie. Alle gewenste wijzigingen op het gebied van wet- en regelgeving, maar ook businessvernieuwing en modernisering van het applicatielandschap moeten tijdig en door de juiste partijen worden doorgevoerd. en cultuur De Belastingdienst draagt bij aan een financieel gezond Nederland. Dat doen we door eerlijk en zorgvuldig belasting te heffen en te innen. Met deze missie zorgen we ervoor dat er in Nederland geld is voor onder meer zorg, onderwijs en openbaar vervoer. Onze visie helpt ons om onze taken uit te voeren in een steeds veranderende samenleving. De IV- organisatie van de Belastingdienst is verantwoordelijk voor en verzorgt de ICT- voorzieningen. Dit gebeurt deels door gebruik te maken van de expertise die intern aanwezig is, maar ook door het aantrekken van (kant-en-klaar) oplossingen en expertise uit de markt.

title: Erfaren Projektleder til Grøn Trepart og naturprojekt i Halkær Bredning
description:
Vi søger en erfaren Projektleder til Projekter og Koordinering i Teknik og Miljø Aalborg Kommune.

I Teknik og Miljø arbejder vi hver dag for at udvikle en harmonisk kommune. Vi er drivkraften i udviklingen af de fysiske rammer, der gør Aalborg til en attraktiv, dynamisk og bæredygtig kommune.

Her får du muligheden for at være med til realisering af Grøn Trepart med ekstensivering af arealanvendelsen og fokus på naturudvikling i oplandet til Halkær Bredning, hvor der skal ske en markant reduktion i kvælstofudledningen. Du skal være med til at omsætte omlægningsplanen og miljømålene i oplandet til Halkær Bredning, gennem etablering af et stort sammenhængende natur- og rekreationsområde.


Vi tilbyder
En attraktiv arbejdsplads med et stærkt og spændende fagligt miljø, hvor arbejdsmiljøet er uformelt og udviklingsorienteret. Som medarbejder i Aalborg Kommune er der plads til at sætte dit aftryk og være med til at udvikle og forme din dagligdag. Dertil får du rige muligheder for at dygtiggøre og udvikle dig, både i det daglige og gennem kurser og efter- og videreuddannelse.

Specifikt for området Teknik og Miljø kan du se frem til at blive en del af en kultur kendetegnet ved frihed under ansvar, høj faglighed, stor indflydelse og en smittende passion for at omsætte de politiske beslutninger. Man tager fælles ansvar, sparrer på tværs og spiller hinanden gode.

Du bliver en del af et team med 15 kolleger, der arbejder med en bred vifte af naturgenopretningsprojekter indenfor natur, vandløb, klima, skovrejsning samt formidling og rekreation. Du vil arbejde i et team med stor politisk bevågenhed på realisering af indsatserne i Grøn Trepart, og du kan forvente en stor berøringsflade såvel internt som eksternt.


Om jobbet
Som projektleder skal du blandt andet varetage følgende opgaver:

  • Projektledelse og tværgående koordinering
  • Ansvar for opstart og gennemførelse af naturprojektet i Halkær Bredning, herunder de forskellige faser med bl.a. forundersøgelse, realisering, udbud, detailprojektering og myndighedsansøgninger samt tilsyn med anlægsarbejdet
  • Tæt dialog, inddragelse og samarbejde med lodsejere, rådgivere, myndighed og entreprenører samt andre interessenter i området - herunder afholdelse af borgermøder og lodsejersamtaler.
  • Ansvar for at indarbejde naturhensyn, plejeindsatser samt rekreative indsatser i projekterne
  • Deltage i teamets øvrige opgaver med gennemførelse af natur-, lavbunds- og vådområdeprojekter m.m. i tæt samarbejde med teamet og andre aktører

Jobbet har mange relationer såvel internt som eksternt, så mulighedsrummet er stort i forhold til at skabe en spændende stilling med brede samarbejdsflader i Aalborg.


Om dig
Dine kommende kolleger vil rose dig for din strukturerede, proaktive og ansvarsfulde tilgang. Du arbejder målrettet og kan balancere de tekniske og menneskelige aspekter af projektledelse – altid med blik for helheden og projektets overordnede formål.

Du er kommunikativ og tillidsskabende og formår at skabe følgeskab hos kollegaer, rådgivere, og de forskellige interessenter. Du ser tingene fra flere perspektiver, faciliterer dialog på tværs af fagligheder og bidrager aktivt til udvikling af helhedsorienterede løsninger.

Vi ser gerne, at du har flere af nedenstående kompetencer:

  • Erfaring med projektledelse og koordinering, gerne indenfor naturgenopretning
  • Stærke kommunikative evner på dansk – både skriftligt og mundtligt, og du skal trives i at stå over for en større forsamling og formidle
  • God biologisk og hydrologisk forståelse fra praksis
  • Trives i en omskiftelig hverdag med mange aktører
  • Erfaring med GIS (vi anvender QGIS)
  • Er holdspiller – vi lykkes, når vi samarbejder
  • Naturvidenskabelig uddannelse f.eks. biologi, geograf, ingeniør, agronom eller tilsvarende

Det er vigtigt, at du naturligt indgår i og bliver en del af fællesskabet, hjælper og sparrer med dine kolleger og bidrager til at sikre arbejdsglæde og trivsel i hverdagen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig


Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er fast med en arbejdsuge på 37 timer og ønskes besat 1. januar 2027. Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.
Arbejdsstedets adresse er Stigsborg Brygge 105, 9400 Nørresundby.


Kontakt
Hvis du er interesseret i stillingen og har behov for yderligere uddybning af opgaverne, stillingens indhold eller andre oplysninger, opfordrer vi dig til at kontakte afdelingsleder Anne Marie Overgaard på tlf. 2520 2270 eller teamkoordinator Roar Skovlund Poulsen på tlf. 2520 2276.


Ansøgningsfrist
Ansøgningsfristen er 1. november 2026, og der vil blive afholdt samtaler i uge 46 2026.


Send ansøgning
Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Send ansøgning" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis i begrænset omfang.


Forud for ansættelse, indhenter vi reference.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Neonatal Milk Technician (6856)
description:
A Brief Overview
The Neonatal Milk Technician is responsible for the safe receipt, storage, preparation, delivery and management of human milk and specialized enteral formulas as ordered in the electronic medical record (EMR). The Milk Technician adheres to preparation techniques in accordance with all sanitation regulations and standards established by regulating agencies and the medical center, including all policies and procedures.

What you will do

  • Retrieves, reviews and verifies patient, human milk and/or formula orders via electronic medical record (EMR). These include and are not limited to fresh/frozen mom's own human milk, donor human milk and neonatal formulas. Clarifies orders with the patient care team as necessary.
  • Accurately calculates human milk/formula additives and mixes ingredients according to provider orders using aseptic technique.
  • Ensures labeling of milk is complete and up-to-date per policy using electronic scanning system. Provides patients with labels for milk deposits and after the parent places the label on the bottle, the technician ensures that the milk is collected and properly placed in the appropriate refrigerator or freezer bin.
  • Delivers prepared human milk and/or formula to the designated location in an accurate and timely manner.
  • Monitors inventory of patient specific milk deposits. Reviews milk daily for expiration and discards according to an established protocol.
  • Ensures that refrigerators are functioning within appropriate temperature ranges. Monitors temperature and function of each freezer and refrigerator in the neonatal intensive care unit for correct range and notify clinical staff if temperature falls outside of specified range.
  • Maintains a clean, sanitary, safe, and orderly formula/human milk lab. Ensures department standards are met and all cleaning, sanitizing, and disinfecting activities of storage areas, preparation areas and equipment are conducted.
  • Maintains an organized milk prep area with proper supplies to include the ordering, receiving and stocking of all related items, ensuring that products are compliant with all current codes and are acceptable for use.
  • Performs documentation in accordance with policies and procedures and in compliance with federal, state, and local health regulations. • Prepares and maintains required records, reports and files for administrative and compliance purposes. • Maintains patient medical records and logs. • Utilizes computer systems to enter and retrieve data.
  • Interacts and communicates with patients and colleagues in a customer responsive and courteous manner in compliance with Brand Promise promoting patient/customer satisfaction. Collaborates with patient care team as well as the dietitians to coordinate and implement daily activities and regarding concerns related to human milk and/or formula orders, mixing ingredients, storage, and administration.
  • Adheres to established departmental and organizational policies, compliance/quality improvement, safety, environment and infection control standards.
  • Assists in care and maintenance of department equipment and supplies.
  • Provides coverage for relief and absences as required covering various shifts, weekends, and holidays.

title: Overdose Prevention Educator
company: Community Health Action of Staten Island
description:
Community Health Action of Staten Island (CHASI) drives dramatic improvements in the health of New Yorkers by feeding people who are hungry, healing families broken apart by violence, and bridging the gaps between people and the compassionate health care they deserve. CHASI serves the most vulnerable individuals, families, and communities with critical services and programs. CHASI provides outreach, education, prevention, and direct support services for populations most affected by health disparities – the poor and working poor, low income people with chronic illnesses, persons with criminal justice involvement, substance users, domestic violence survivors, people of color, and the LGBTQ community.

POSITION SUMMARY: The Overdose Prevention Educator is a member of CHASI’s Harm Reduction Services team and supports individuals, families, and communities impacted by substance use through a harm reduction, trauma-informed, and participant-centered approach. The Educator is responsible for providing overdose prevention education, naloxone training and distribution, harm reduction counseling, community outreach, HIV/HCV testing and referral, and linkage to supportive services. This position helps expand access to lifesaving education and supplies through site-based, community-based, car-based, and partner-based service delivery models, with a focus on reaching individuals at elevated risk of overdose and their personal and community networks.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Deliver overdose prevention education and naloxone administration training to participants, staff, peers, family members, community members, commercial establishments, and partner organizations.
  • Schedule and facilitate train-the-trainer sessions to increase CHASI’s internal capacity to provide naloxone education and distribution on demand.
  • Provide education on overdose risk reduction, signs of overdose, overdose response, rescue breathing, naloxone use, fentanyl and xylazine-related risks, and post-overdose support.
  • Provide individualized harm reduction education and counseling on safer substance use, safer injection practices, stimulant use risk reduction, wound care awareness, HIV/HCV/STI prevention, safer sex practices, and safer disposal of syringes and other supplies.
  • Support participants in developing personalized overdose prevention and safety plans that reflect their goals, needs, risks, and readiness for services.
  • Distribute naloxone, safer use supplies, syringe exchange supplies, fentanyl test strips, xylazine test strips when available, sharps containers, condoms, and other harm reduction and prevention supplies in accordance with program protocols.
  • Conduct car-based and community-based service delivery, including outreach, education, harm reduction counseling, naloxone training, supply distribution, service linkage, and navigation support.
  • Engage individuals in high-risk areas, shelters, encampments, commercial establishments, community events, and other settings where people who use drugs and their networks may be reached.
  • Collaborate with the Harm Reduction Program Director and Vice President of Behavioral Health on periodic updates to program policies, procedures, training materials, naloxone distribution practices, quality assurance processes, and service delivery workflows.
  • Continue and strengthen partnerships with Staten Island Partnership for Community Wellness and other community partners to provide overdose risk education, naloxone access, and harm reduction information to staff, patrons, and community members.

title: Brewed for You – Cuppa, Chat & Laughs! Community Social Volunteer Visitor, Central Coast NSW
description:
Cuppa & a Chat – A Friendly Visit Could Brighten Someone’s Day


Sometimes the best medicine is simply a friendly face and a good chat.

We’re offering warm, relaxed social visits for members of our community across The Beautiful Central Coast from Woy Woy, Gosford, Wyong, Lake Haven and Wyee.


What it’s about:

A simple visit to an elderly client living at home for a cuppa, a chat, and some companionship.

No rush, no pressure—just a friendly conversation and a little company.

Visits include:

  • Sharing a cuppa together
  • A friendly chat and a listening ear
  • Light activities, stories, or reminiscing
  • A chance to connect and feel less alone
  • When: Weekly or fortnightly visits
  • Between 9am – 5pm
  • About 1 hour

Sometimes an hour of kindness can mean the world to someone who may be feeling lonely. A small visit can bring comfort, laughter, and connection.

If you or someone you know would enjoy a regular friendly visit and a cuppa, we’d love to hear from you.



Your impact

Volunteering as a social visitor can be a rewarding experience, both for the person you visit as well as yourself. Regular visits from volunteers can help to improve quality of life and help older people feel less isolated. Your visits will bring great joy to the client you are matched with.




HammondCare

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity, supporting people to live in their homes and maintain their independence. We're passionate about improving the quality of life for people in need and we have a wonderful group of volunteers that partner with us to enhance the lives of clients who are living at home.

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.


Further information

Thank you for expressing an interest in volunteering with HammondCare.


We truly love connecting with people who want to volunteer with us. Our team will reach out with a phone call or text as soon as we can, and if we’re unable to get through, we’ll follow up with an email. Please take a moment to check your spam or junk folder as well, as some email providers don’t always recognise our messages right away.


More information on volunteering with HammondCare can be found at




If you have any questions, you can call Dani, our friendly Volunteer Recruitment Coordinator on 1800 79 33 99.



Requirements

18 years or older • National Volunteer Police Check arranged and paid for by HammondCare •

One hour visits for 6 months or longer. We'd be happy to discuss a suitable time Between Monday to Sunday 9am to 5pm for an hour or so visit.

Coach. Mentor. Support. Inspire.

Are you passionate about helping young people overcome challenges, build confidence, and discover their potential? Do you enjoy working with others, being a positive role model, and making a meaningful impact every day?

Four Oaks is looking for compassionate, energetic, and dedicated Youth Counselors to join our team!

As a Youth Counselor, you'll play an important role in creating a safe, supportive, and structured environment where youth can learn, grow, and develop the skills they need for a brighter future.

Whether you're helping a young person navigate a difficult situation, celebrating their progress, or simply being someone they can count on, your work has the power to make a lasting difference!

5400 Kirkwood Blvd SW

title: Vi søger engagerede og fagligt stærke sygeplejersker til nye aftenvagtsstillinger som udekørende i Sygepleje Vest med primær tilknytning til plejecentrene
description:
Er du klar til at tage næste skridt i din karriere?

Du bliver en central del af en ny arbejdstilrettelæggelse, som skal være med til at forme og bane vejen for at sikre en sammenhængende, fleksibel og fagligt stærk sygeplejefaglig dækning på områdets plejecentre i aftentimerne. Du får ansvar for områdets plejecentre, som er plejecenter i Stenstrup, Ollerup, Aldersro, Demensbyen, Tåsinge og Vindeby, hvor du bidrager med sygeplejefaglig sparring, vejledning og støtte til medarbejderne i vagten. Du indgår i teamet af udekørende sygeplejersker

Stillingerne er oprettet for at få et større fællesskab og at styrke samarbejdet mellem plejecentre, hjemmepleje og sygeplejen, så borgerne oplever høj faglig kvalitet og sammenhæng i deres forløb.

Om stillingen
I den nye aftenvagtstilling har du en central rolle i den sygeplejefaglige indsats på plejecentrene og i samarbejdet med de udekørende sygeplejersker. Dit mødested vil være i sygeplejen i Hjemmepleje Vest, hvor dine sygeplejefaglige kollegaer også møder ind.

Du vil være på vagt med to andre kollegaer, som vil køre ude i Hjemmepleje Vest.

Du arbejder selvstændigt og koordinerer løbende med medarbejdere og sygeplejefaglige kolleger og ledere. På plejecentrene er der i dagtimerne i hverdagene tilknyttet faste sygeplejersker, som du også vil have et tæt samarbejde med.

Du er ansvarlig for, at:

  • vægte samarbejdet med borgere og pårørende højt
  • være en vigtig faglig støtte for medarbejderne og bidrage til tryghed, kvalitet og udvikling i den daglige opgaveløsning
  • varetage planlagte, akutte og opsøgende opgaver
  • foretage sygeplejefaglige vurderinger og prioriteringer
  • koordinere egne opgaver i samarbejde med plejecentrene
  • dokumentere udførte indsatser efter gældende retningslinjer
  • bidrage til et tværfagligt og tværgående samarbejde mellem plejecentre og de udekørende sygeplejersker
  • oplære og vejlede medarbejdere i vagten
  • forholde dig til indkomne plejeforløbsplaner og udskrivningsrapporter.

Et stærkt samarbejde på tværs
Vi ønsker at styrke samarbejdet mellem plejecentrene og de udekørende aftenvagter for at sikre sammenhængende borgerforløb, høj faglig kvalitet og en hensigtsmæssig udnyttelse af de sygeplejefaglige ressourcer.

Vi har et tæt tværfagligt samarbejde med pårørende, farmakonomer, demenskonsulenter, specialister mv.

Sygepleje i Hjemmepleje Vest består af 35 sygeplejersker, som er en god blanding af alder, erfaring og faglige kompetencer. Vi er et velfungerende team, der har en bred og høj faglighed, hvor samarbejde, sparring og fællesskab er i højsædet.

Vi har ugentlig tværfaglige møder, hvor vi er en naturlig del af den samlede vurdering af borgernes behov.

Vi har fagligt og professionelt fokus på opgaveløsningen hos borgerne og de mange samarbejdspartnere omkring os. Vi arbejder ud fra et borgerperspektiv og med rehabiliterende tilgang med henblik på at forebygge indlæggelser.

Vi arbejder med struktureret kompetenceudvikling, som er tilpasset den enkelte medarbejders ønsker og faglige interesse. Samtidigt er det en fast del af ansættelsen, at man skal gennemføre diplommodul i rehabilitering og demens.

I sygeplejen er der forskellige specialistfunktioner inden for blandt andet sår, palliation, Nexus, kontinents, klinisk vejledning og mentor for nyansatte kolleger samt forskellige nøglefunktioner.

Vi tilbyder:

  • en nyoprettet og spændende opgave med stor betydning for den sygeplejefaglige kvalitet på plejecentrene
  • et individuelt tilrettelagt onboarding program
  • en arbejdsdag med høj faglighed, selvstændighed og ansvar
  • faglig sparring og individuel kompetenceudviklingsplan
  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på relationer, arbejdsglæde og trivsel.

Vi ønsker os en kollega, der:

  • er autoriseret sygeplejerske og har kørekort
  • har stærke kliniske kompetencer, kan prioritere opgaver og trives med at arbejde selvstændigt
  • kan vejlede, oplære og udvikle medarbejderes faglighed
  • har erfaring med eller interesse for komplekse og akutte sygeplejeopgaver
  • kan skabe gode relationer og samarbejde på tværs af faggrupper
  • er fleksibel, handlekraftig og bevarer overblikket i en travl hverdag
  • bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og ser værdien i, at vi lykkes sammen

Vil du være med til at udvikle og styrke den sygeplejefaglige indsats på tværs af plejecentre og sygeplejen i kommunen? - så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig.

Om Ældreområdet
Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkelt dør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd.
Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældreliv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed.
Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for.
Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kolleger at dele hverdagen med.

Om Svendborg Kommune
Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordner. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

Vores værdier findes ikke kun på papiret, vi bruger dem faktisk som kompas hver dag. Vi møder hinanden i øjenhøjde, i dialog og med tillid, og sammen skaber vi en tryg ramme, hvor vi alle kan løse vores opgaver selvstændigt, fleksibelt og ansvarligt.

Løn og ansættelse
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

Vi forventer at vores nye kollega kan starte hurtigst muligt, eller senest 01.01.2027. Stillingen er i ren aftenvagt med weekendarbejde hver 2. weekend.

Stillingen er på 37 timer, men vi er fleksible og vil så vidt muligt gerne imødekomme dine ønsker til timetal.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 37.534 og 54.773 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Der skal kunne forevises en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte områdeleder Nina Nourani på mail nina.nourani@svendborg.dk eller mobil 2488 6990

Ansøgningsfrist den 22.oktober. 2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 26. oktober 2026

Hvis det ønskes, er du velkommen til at rekvirere arbejdsbeskrivelsen.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience with incentive plan administration, including calculation and payout validation, data reconciliation, issue resolution, and adherence to plan governance and controls.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends and discrepancies, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large or complex data sets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience partnering across Finance, HR, Risk, Compliance, and business leadership.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. title: Billings - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Schedule

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

  • Contract

title: Appian Architect
description:
Why Sabel Systems

Sabel Systems designs and delivers digital engineering ecosystems for DoD programs, enabling teams to connect data, systems, and personnel within secure, scalable environments. Our solutions empower programs to make faster decisions, close sustainment gaps, and meet the digital acquisition requirements.

Rather than simply proposing transformation, we implement and operate it at scale. Our method is clear: we orchestrate existing tools into a governing system of record, ensuring government ownership of infrastructure and traceable decisions. There’s no vendor lock, no proprietary baselines, and no need for ATO rebuilds during transitions.

Sabel Systems is redefining modern defense acquisition. If you seek to solve complex challenges at scale and want your work to directly accelerate military capability while reshaping the DoD’s approach to digital engineering, this is the place for you.

Complexity Simplified. Mission Amplified.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the overall design, architecture, and target-state definition of enterprise-grade Appian solutions — including process models, rules, CDTs (Custom Data Types), portals, and interfaces — ensuring scalability, maintainability, and alignment with DoD business objectives across multiple applications
  • Define target-state architecture for new environments and platform migrations, including environment setup, configuration strategy, and integration patterns across the Appian application portfolio
  • Gather, analyze, and translate complex requirements from DoD stakeholders into enterprise technical specifications and solution architectures, partnering closely with business analysts and product owners
  • Architect and guide the design of API integrations (REST, SOAP, JDBC) connecting Appian applications with legacy systems, cloud platforms, and third-party services; establish integration standards and reusable patterns for the development team to follow
  • Define and oversee ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) and data migration strategy from legacy systems to new Appian-based environments, ensuring data integrity and compliance throughout
  • Establish SQL and data architecture standards and oversee relational database design across Appian applications; guide developers on performance optimization and schema design best practices
  • Own the security architecture for Appian solutions, including authentication/authorization design, cybersecurity requirements, and Authority to Operate (ATO) activities — partnering with ISSOs/ISSMs on security control implementation and system security documentation to achieve and maintain system accreditation
  • Establish and enforce coding standards, architectural governance, and implementation best practices across projects and teams; lead code reviews and technical design reviews
  • Participate in and help shape Agile/Scrum processes at the program level; guide sprint planning, technical backlog prioritization, and cross-team coordination using Jira
  • Serve as the final escalation point for complex technical issues; lead root cause analysis on system-wide or cross-application problems and define preventive architectural changes
  • Lead technical demonstrations and architecture reviews with clients and senior stakeholders; translate technical tradeoffs into business terms for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Mentor and develop Sr. Developers and Lead Developers; establish Appian best practices, technical governance, and growth pathways across the development organization
  • Define strategy for leveraging Appian AI/ML capabilities across the application portfolio, including document processing, chatbots, and predictive workflows

title: Pastry - Milwaukee Maggiano's
description:
Our Pastry Cooks are responsible for following our recipes to prepare and execute all pastry items. What do you think? Sound like your cup of espresso? Around here we say our purpose is to bring people together to celebrate the love of family and friends. If it sounds like we have our own way of looking at the world, you're right! We call it The Maggiano's Way, and it means odds are you get us and we want to meet you...now!

We're The Original Originator

Once upon a long time ago, going out to eat meant either a fancy, pricey, fussy restaurant, or a fast food drive-thru meal handed to you in a greasy paper sack. Our namesake, Norman Brinker, changed all that by pioneering the idea of casual dining. And he knew an original when he found it. Guests in Chicago knew Maggiano's Little Italy was special when we opened our doors on the corner of Clark and Grand. Today, thousands of restaurants later, Brinker International is the name behind good food, good times and great places to work. And Maggiano's is our own little slice of Italian American tradition come to life! Tony Soprano would be so proud.

Working With Us Comes With An Extra Helping Of Helping Out

Half the fun of making it in life is being able to share it. So part of our way of life is helping make the dreams of others come true, through the special events we host and special memories we help create. We've hosted our fair share of weddings, bar/bat mitzvahs, birthdays and baby showers. There's nothing better than helping create lasting memories in our restaurants and in our community. It's one of the reasons we support the Make-A-Wish Foundation, making wishes come true for kids with life threatening medical conditions. On the local level, we support the North Texas Food Bank, and because we also have a heart for our own, making small contributions to the Brinker Family Fund adds up in a big way and helps out our own in times of need.

Biscotti Is Just A Hard Cookie, Until You Dip It In Espresso

There's nothing better than enjoying life to the fullest, and every now again, we need a little indulgence for working so hard in this fast-paced world. We know we ask a lot of our people. Long days, lots of energetic service, staying upbeat, putting everyone else ahead of ourselves, hoisting heavy plates of Mom's Lasagna! So what's in it for you? We're glad you asked -

  • Highly competitive earning opportunities
  • Healthcare plans, including domestic partner benefits (based on length of service and number of hours worked per week)
  • Career Opportunities and Development, including the potential of Global Training roles
  • Tuition assistance (based on length of service and number of hours worked per week)
  • Market Leading 401(k) Savings Plans with company match (based on age, length of service and number of hours worked per week)
  • Rewards and recognition programs
  • Discounts on items like mobile phones, travel, computers, and even autos!
  • Dining discounts at Brinker owned brands
Our Kitchen team is the culinary equivalent of a great bottle of Cabernet it just gets better with time.

These Executive Chefs, Sous Chefs, Pastry Cooks, Line Cooks, Prep Cooks and Dishwashers, run our scratch kitchens with the fast pace and professionalism of any celebrity chef restaurant. But rather than those fly-by-night, flash in the pan restaurant hipsters that come and go every season, this team consistently delivers works of art to the tables of every Guest. They are true foodies to the core, energized by the creative inspiration of the dishes developed by our masterful culinary team in Dallas. It is a fast-paced environment that requires dedication and commitment to excellence, whether prepared for the special couple on Valentine's Day, or for the 250 friends and family attending the wedding of the year. This team is all in.

Brinker International is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to workplace diversity, workplace working and workplace fun. The way we see it, life is short, so you might as well work happy.

  • Prepares instrumentation for the decontamination process, including flushing lumens, exposing all surfaces and properly loading washers. Operates washer/decontaminates, cart washers, sonic washer, and all other equipment in the decontamination area. Utilizes instrument tracking computer software to document all functions in the decontamination area. Decontaminates instruments in a safe and appropriate manner.

  • 39 vrije dagen, hybride werken en volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden

Wat ga je doen

Als Industrial Data Engineer werk je aan een technische uitdaging waarin industriële automatisering en moderne datatechnologie samenkomen. Je ontwikkelt de infrastructuur waarmee grote hoeveelheden machine- en sensordata betrouwbaar beschikbaar worden voor analyses, AI-toepassingen en procesoptimalisatie. Daarbij kijk je verder dan de techniek van vandaag. Je maakt architectuurkeuzes die bepalen hoe het dataplatform zich de komende jaren kan ontwikkelen. Je beweegt tussen de wereld van machines en die van cloudtechnologie. Met Python, SQL en Microsoft Azure bouw je schaalbare datapijplijnen en werk je aan een centrale data-architectuur. Via industriële protocollen zoals OPC UA en MQTT ontsluit je informatie uit PLC-systemen en edge-devices. Je zorgt dat deze data wordt gevalideerd, gestructureerd en gecombineerd met andere databronnen. Zo ontstaat een betrouwbaar fundament waarop engineers en dataspecialisten verder kunnen bouwen. Je werkt samen met specialisten uit software, industriële automatisering en AI. Samen vertalen jullie technische vraagstukken naar oplossingen die inzicht geven in machineprestaties, afwijkingen en onderhoudsbehoeften. Omdat het Data & AI team nog wordt opgebouwd, krijg je veel invloed op de technische standaarden en manier van werken. Je krijgt ruimte om ideeën te toetsen, keuzes te onderbouwen en oplossingen te ontwikkelen die niet alleen vandaag werken, maar ook op grotere schaal toepasbaar zijn.

Dit breng je mee

  • Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, software engineering, Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Ervaring met Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure en het ontwikkelen van schaalbare datapijplijnen en data-architecturen
  • Kennis van industriële data, OPC UA, MQTT en tijdreeksdata, aangevuld met affiniteit met AI-tooling
  • Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, en voldoende beheersing van het Engels voor internationale samenwerking

Wat je ervoor terugkrijgt

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €5.000 en €6.600 op fulltime basis, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • 26 vakantiedagen en 13 ADV-dagen per jaar
  • 8% vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse winstuitkering
  • Hybride werken met ruimte voor zelfstandigheid en eigen technische keuzes
  • Ruime ontwikkel- en doorgroeimogelijkheden, ondersteund door interne opleidingen en trainingen
  • CAO Metaal Techniek en goede pensioenregeling via PMT
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van woon-werkverkeer met het OV (2e klas), plus een betaalbaar bedrijfsrestaurant

Over de opdrachtgever

De opdrachtgever is een internationaal actieve machinebouwer waar engineering, productie en technologische innovatie samenkomen. Binnen de organisatie wordt volop geïnvesteerd in digitalisering en de ontwikkeling van slimme, datagedreven machines. De cultuur is technisch, betrokken en gericht op samenwerking, met korte lijnen tussen verschillende disciplines. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nieuwe ideeën de ruimte krijgen en waar je daadwerkelijk invloed hebt op de verdere ontwikkeling van technologie.Pluspunt: Je krijgt de vrijheid om een nieuw dataplatform technisch vorm te geven, in plaats van alleen bestaande systemen te beheren. Pluspunt: Je ziet hoe jouw oplossingen worden toegepast in echte industriële processen en bijdragen aan slimmere machines.

Waarom engineers kiezen voor Comaen

Wij reverse engineeren loopbanen. Niet het cv als beginpunt, maar jouw toekomst als vertrekpunt. We kijken naar hoe je wilt werken, waar je energie van krijgt en hoe je wilt groeien.Benieuwd hoe andere engineers dit ervaren? Lees de reviews of ontdek hun verhalen. Voor meer informatie over de vacature Industrial Data Engineer kun je contact opnemen met Maikel Henckens via mobiel of WhatsApp op 06-11856120 of per e-mail via maikel.henckens@comaen.nl.

title: Research Assistant (1/2)
description:
The Research Assistant (Staff Research Associate I) position is in a highly dynamic research lab focused on understanding the molecular and immunological mechanisms that establish maternal–fetal immune tolerance and how these mechanisms are altered in pregnancy complications.

The incumbent at the entry level (SRA 1) will perform research experiments under the direction and training of the Principal Investigator and senior laboratory members. Research in the laboratory combines biochemistry, protein engineering, immunology, and experimental models to investigate antibody–antigen interactions and mechanisms of immune tolerance. Approaches may include programmable protein display, molecular cloning, recombinant protein and antibody expression and purification, biochemical and cell-based assays, next-generation sequencing, flow cytometry, and mouse models of pregnancy and immunity. These approaches reflect the lab's broader experimental program, which combines antigen discovery with molecular characterization of antibody–antigen recognition.

The incumbent will initially receive training in relevant laboratory techniques and, with increasing proficiency, will take on greater responsibility for independent experiments and research projects. Responsibilities will include experimental planning and execution, data collection and analysis, maintenance of detailed laboratory records, and presentation of research progress at laboratory meetings. The incumbent will be responsible for presenting the research progress every 3 months.

The incumbent shall be flexible and conform to irregular work hours that may be needed of Lab for work 24/7 (weekends, holidays and so on). If needed, the incumbent will act as liaison between the research team and the clinical staff. If needed, he/she will collect placenta tissue from various sites in San Francisco and to prepare the tissue for experiments.

Additional duties include preparation of buffers and reagents, maintenance of laboratory stocks and experimental animals, assistance with laboratory equipment and organization, and other research-related duties as assigned by the PI and senior laboratory personnel.

DEPARTMENT INFORMATION:

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mount Zion, and Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the new Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $150 million. The Department has 134 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 22 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff.

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
Robotics Software Engineer

Job Responsibilities

  • Develop, debug, and maintain ROS C++ programs for core functional modules of intelligent construction robots (e.g., AI-driven tower cranes)
  • Develop, maintain, and validate robot simulation environments using tools such as Unity and Matlab
  • Integrate, test, and troubleshoot industrial communication protocols in robotic systems, including Modbus and CANBus
  • Develop, integrate, and test sensor drivers
  • Build Docker images, implement containerized deployment, and manage the robotic software system to ensure consistency between development and deployment environments
  • Lead or assist in on-site deployment, integration testing, data logging, and report writing for the software system at construction sites
  • Develop a deep understanding of fundamental robotic principles (perception, planning, and control) and apply theoretical knowledge to practical problem-solving and performance optimization

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Robotics Engineering, Automation, Computer Science, Electronic Information Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field
  • Proficiency in C++ programming, with strong software design skills and a solid programming foundation; familiar with the Linux development environment
  • Extensive hands-on experience in ROS1/ROS2 project development, with a solid understanding of its communication mechanisms, common tools, and ecosystem
  • Familiar with at least one robot simulation tool (e.g., Unity, Gazebo, Matlab/Simulink), with experience in simulation environment setup and model development
  • Familiar with Docker container technology, with practical experience in image building and deployment
  • Proficient in Git version control, with good code management and collaborative development practices
  • Familiar with at least one industrial communication protocol (e.g., Modbus, CANBus, Ethernet/IP); experience in hardware-software integration is a plus
  • Basic understanding of core robotic modules such as perception, path planning, and motion control; experience in robotics competitions or related projects is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent teamwork and communication abilities, and the willingness to occasionally provide on-site support

title: Program Manager - Essential Worker Health Trust
description:
About RISE Partnership

At RISE Partnership, we partner with unions, responsible employers, and public agencies to support caregivers and public service workers. We give workers the resources they need to make the most of their union-negotiated training and benefits.

Our work is grounded in our core values: respect, integrity, service, and equity. These values guide how we deliver workforce solutions, like training, benefits navigation, job matching, and career development. We address the unique challenges Oregon workers face to ensure all workers have access to services and support that help them grow, thrive, and feel confident in their work and communities.

About This Role

Reporting to the Director of the Essential Worker Healthcare Trust, the EWHT Program Manager is part of a team of professionals to help deliver healthcare benefits to workers in Oregon’s long-term care facilities. This is a first-of-its-kind partnership between EWHT, SEIU 503, and responsible long-term care employers to provide quality, low-cost healthcare benefits to Oregon’s essential long-term care workforce.

In partnership with the Trust Director, the Program Manager leads the development, implementation, and ongoing improvement of EWHT’s program operations. This role translates Trust goals into clear processes and procedures that support effective benefits delivery. The Program Manager oversees day-to-day operations and identifies opportunities to strengthen services and access to care for current and future long-term care workers.

While each RISE employee is assigned to a specific team, we operate within a collaborative shared services model that encourages cross-departmental support. Some employees contribute to multiple teams, allowing us to leverage resources more efficiently. This structure enables our staff to focus on delivering high-impact programs that advance our mission, ensuring every resource is used strategically to drive meaningful change.

Essential Functions

Program Strategy & Improvement:

  • Establishes and maintains EWHT operational processes and procedures to support consistent daily, weekly, and monthly program performance;
  • Identifies, implements, and documents best practices for internal systems and workflows to advance Trust goals;
  • Exercises independent judgment to make decisions on program operations, including how to resolve escalated member and/or employer issues, when to escalate exceptions to standard procedures, and how to set priorities for open enrollment, benefits education, and employer onboarding within Trust policies and plan rules;
  • Interprets and applies the Summary Plan Description, Trust policies, and vendor agreements to resolve complex member and employer issues, and determines which matters carry significant financial, legal, or member impact and require Director or Board review;
  • Assesses operational needs for new and existing program components and coordinates implementation of improvements;
  • Assists in the development of program goals, strategies, and implementation plans, as approved by the Board, and oversees program evaluation using qualitative and quantitative benchmarks;
  • Operationalizes RISE Partnership’s REDI framework by integrating equity considerations into program design, operations, and evaluation.

Team Supervision:

  • Supervises and supports assigned team members, which include member engagement and operations staff, providing oversight of their core work areas such as member issue resolution, open enrollment, benefits education, employer onboarding, and enrollment data accuracy;
  • Sets clear priorities and expectations, and monitors workload and performance to keep team operations running smoothly;
  • Provides clear direction, coaching, and regular feedback, modeling a growth mindset as well as collaborative and accountable leadership;
  • Manages confidential personnel and leadership matters with discretion and professionalism.

Team and Partnership Collaboration:

  • Partners with internal teams, including communications, technical, and program staff, to plan and deliver clear, timely communications and to support data analysis and reporting;
  • Collaborates with EWHT's Third Party Administrator (TPA) and other vendors on day-to-day operations, issue resolution, and system improvements;
  • Works with EWHT employers and union partners to support open enrollment, resolve benefits issues, gather worker feedback, and develop metrics tied to program goals;
  • Represents EWHT in partner meetings and recommends process or program changes based on partner and member input.
  • All other duties as assigned

This position description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required for this position. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.
