title: Ansøgning til "Sekretariatschef - Dansk Psykoterapeutforening"
description:
Vil du lede et engageret og fagligt stærkt sekretariat i udviklingen af en forening med voksende medlemstal, høje ambitioner og en vigtig samfundsmæssig dagsorden i arbejdet for mental sundhed og trivsel i Danmark?

Dansk Psykoterapeutforening har gennem de senere år oplevet en jævn medlemsvækst, som giver os endnu bedre muligheder for at styrke psykoterapeuters synlighed og anerkendelse. Som sekretariatschef får du en vigtig rolle i at omsætte mulighederne til konkrete resultater og større værdi for medlemmerne. Du bliver samtidig leder for et velfungerende sekretariat med dygtige og selvstændige medarbejdere, høj faglighed og et stort engagement, hvor vi oprigtigt vil hinanden og lægger vægt på nærvær og en uformel omgangstone.

Opgaverne - det du skal hos os
Som sekretariatschef får du det overordnede ansvar for ledelse, drift og udvikling af sekretariatet. Du skal sætte retning, prioritere på tværs og skabe fremdrift i drift og udvikling. I takt med foreningens vækst skal du samtidig videreudvikle arbejdsgangene, så organisationen bevarer en enkel og velfungerende struktur. Du bliver tæt sparringspartner for formanden og skal sikre professionel betjening af bestyrelsen, forretningsudvalget og foreningens frivilligudvalg. Du omsætter bestyrelsens ambitioner og beslutninger til realistiske indsatser og understøtter et velfungerende samspil mellem bestyrelsen, medlemmerne og sekretariatet.

Sammen med bestyrelsen og medarbejderne skal du styrke professionens synlighed og anerkendelse, udvikle medlemsværdien og skabe sammenhæng i arbejdet med uddannelser og faglig kvalitet. Du skal samle og udvikle professionen, styrke kvaliteten af de psykoterapeutiske uddannelser og øge kendskabet til psykoterapeuters kompetencer og samfundsmæssige bidrag. Du skal desuden understøtte ambitionen om en mere fremtrædende og anerkendt rolle for psykoterapi i sundheds- og velfærdssystemet gennem samarbejde med myndigheder, uddannelsesinstitutioner, faglige organisationer og internationale partnere.

Profilen - dét vi forventer af dig
Vi forventer, at du har ledelseserfaring og gerne økonomisk og organisatorisk forståelse for en medlemsforening. Du har politisk tæft, og erfaring med betjening af bestyrelser og frivilligudvalg er en fordel. Det samme gælder kendskab til psykoterapi og mental sundhed. Vigtigst er det, at du kan lede dygtige specialister, sætte dig ind i komplekse faglige områder og inddrage relevant viden med respekt for den psykoterapeutiske faglighed.

Du kan omsætte bestyrelsens visioner og beslutninger til klare prioriteringer og konkrete resultater. Du arbejder struktureret og dataorienteret, skaber overblik og fremdrift blandt mange aktiviteter og interessenter og kan professionalisere organisationen uden at skabe unødig kompleksitet. Du er relationsstærk og har dømmekraft til at navigere mellem forskellige interesser i en medlemsstyret organisation. Du skaber tillidsfulde samarbejder mellem bestyrelsen, medlemmerne, de frivillige og sekretariatet. Samtidig kommunikerer du klart og troværdigt og skaber forståelse og opbakning til foreningens dagsordener blandt medlemmer, samarbejdspartnere og centrale beslutningstagere.

Andet
Du kan læse mere om Dansk Psykoterapeutforening og stillingen i den uddybende stillings- og kompetenceprofil.

title: Sr. Project Manager

title: Lab Technologist II - MRD
location: Salt Lake City, UT, United States
description:
Overview

The Lab Technologist II is responsible for conducting laboratory processes that support specimen processing and testing. This position works with department management and quality team members to ensure that laboratory activities are defined, documented, and completed to support inspection readiness and that compliance is maintained through procedures, training, documentation, and continuous improvement projects.

Shift: Thursday-Sunday 8:00am-6:30pm

Pay: Starting between $23-$25/hr, plus $3/hr on Saturday and Sunday

Responsibility

Each employee’s specific job responsibilities are uniquely defined by their individual training plan and assigned duties, but are generally defined as follows:

  1. Complying with the laboratory’s technical, administrative, and safety policies and procedures.
  2. Operating high complexity testing.
  3. Participating in the laboratory’s quality assurance plan, adhering to quality control and preventive maintenance policies, and appropriately documenting these activities.
  4. Working as part of a team to produce repeatable quality results.
  5. Maintaining a clean and organized laboratory space.
  6. Participating in proficiency testing in the same manner as routine samples.
  7. Participating in continuing education according to accepted laboratory standards.
  8. Actively participating in successful and timely completion of training and competency assessment as outlined in the laboratory and departmental training programs.
  9. Following the laboratory’s policies and procedures whenever test systems are not within acceptable limits and documenting the problem and any corrective action.
  10. Troubleshooting and identifying problems that may adversely affect test performance and/or reporting of test results by initiating corrective action and using the defined electronic system to make the required management notification.
  11. Participates within the departmental team to resolve problems or implement projects.
  12. Serves as a trainer on technical processes within the group.

Qualifications

  1. Doctoral, bachelor’s, or master’s degree in medical technology or a chemical, physical, biological, or clinical laboratory science.
  2. 6 months of clinical lab experience or equivalent required.
  3. California only: CLS trainee license or a CLS or CGMBS license issued by California.
  4. Familiarity with range of molecular biology techniques (qPCR, DNA extraction, DNA sequencing) and proficiency with molecular biology calculations (dilutions, DNA and protein concentration measurements, enzyme activity measurements).
  5. Ability to adapt to changes in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.
  6. Some schedule flexibility- occasional overtime hours may be required.
  7. Basic proficiency with computers (Excel, other Office tools) and statistics.
  8. Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  9. Extensive documentation skills and attention to detail skills including the ability to develop and follow written procedures, the ability to organize information, ensures that data is recorded correctly and can be easily understood by others.
  10. Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Physical Requirements

Lifting Requirements – medium work or exerting up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, 20 pounds of force frequently, and 10 pounds of force consistently. Physical Requirements – stationary positioning, moving, operating, ascending/descending, communicating, observing, reaching, and repetitive motion. Use of equipment and tools necessary to perform essential job functions. Hazards and Atmospheric Conditions – exposure to fumes, dust, extreme temperatures, wet and/or humid, noise, vibration, mists or gases, mechanical hazards, chemical hazards, electrical hazards, and radiant energy hazards. OSHA Category I – duties performed routinely requires exposure to blood, body fluid, and tissue.

description:
We take great strides to ensure our employees have the resources to live well, be healthy, continue learning, develop skills, grow professionally and serve our local communities. We invite you to apply for a career with us.


Residency in or relocation to Louisiana is preferred for all positions.


Applicants must be authorized to work for Louisiana Blue in the United States without employer-sponsored immigration support. Applicants who would require such sponsorship or employer support during their employment should not pursue this opportunity.

POSITION PURPOSE


The Board-Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA), Utilization Reviewer role is responsible for evaluating the medical necessity and clinical appropriateness of Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services for LA Blue members. Working under the guidance of a BCBA Utilization Reviewer, this role conducts preliminary clinical reviews, analyzes treatment documentation, evaluates service utilization trends, and collaborates with providers to obtain and clarify clinical information to ensure compliance with payer guidelines while maintaining clinical integrity and promoting cost-effective care.


How You Contribute to the Company’s Mission In This Role

  • Evaluate treatment goals, progress metrics, and data collection methods to ensure clinical effectiveness and appropriateness.
  • Oversee and direct work activities of unlicensed clinical staff involved in the utilization management process.
  • Communicate with ABA providers to gather additional clinical information and provide feedback on documentation and treatment planning.

  • Participate in the development and refinement of utilization management protocols and clinical review tools.
  • Collaborate with internal departments such as claims, provider relations, and member services to resolve clinical and administrative issues.
  • Support the appeals and grievance process by preparing clinical rationales and participating in case reviews.
  • Stay current with developments in ABA research, clinical guidelines, and payer policy changes through continuing education and professional development.
  • Represent the organization in external audits, accreditation reviews, and inter-agency meetings as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience working in ABA services, autism services, behavioral health, utilization management, or a related healthcare setting.

title: Tilbudschef
description:
Vil du stå i spidsen for tilbudsarbejdet på anlægs-, kloak- og grønne projekter - og være med til at udvikle de processer og værktøjer, der skal sikre vores fremtidige projekter?

Hos Anlægsgartner Gottlieb A/S søger vi en erfaren tilbudsprofil med stærk forretningsforståelse og motivation for at tage ledelsesansvar. Du får ansvar for tilbudsprocessen fra den første gennemgang af udbudsmaterialet til aflevering af et gennemarbejdet og konkurrencedygtigt tilbud. Samtidig bliver du leder for tilbudsteamet og en central sparringspartner for projekt- og driftsorganisationen.

Din rolle

Du får det overordnede ansvar for vores tilbuds- og udbudsarbejde på tværs af virksomheden. Projekterne spænder blandt andet over trafiksanering, byggemodning, kloak, gårdrum samt anlæg og drift af grønne områder.

Rollen kombinerer selvstændig kalkulation med koordinering og ledelse af de øvrige beregnere. Du skaber struktur og fremdrift i tilbudsprocessen og sikrer et tæt samarbejde med projekt- og driftsledere, landmåler, KMA, leverandører og underentreprenører.

Dine vigtigste opgaver

  • Lede og koordinere tilbudsteamets opgaver, prioriteringer og deadlines.
  • Gennemgå og analysere udbuds- og tilbuds materiale samt bidrage til vurderingen af, hvilke udbud der skal prioriteres.
  • Kalkulere materialer, arbejdskraft, maskiner, underentreprenører og øvrige ressourcer.
  • Udarbejde præcise, realistiske og konkurrencedygtige tilbud.
  • Indhente og forhandle priser med leverandører og underentreprenører i tilbudsfasen.
  • Udarbejde og kvalitetssikre tilbudsbeskrivelser om blandt andet kvalitet, miljø, bæredygtighed, organisation og projektstyring.
  • Sikre, at krav, tidsfrister og udbudsbetingelser bliver håndteret og overholdt af alle i teamet.
  • Sikre en god overdragelse fra tilbud til projektorganisation, når en opgave er vundet.
  • Bidrage til budgetlægning, økonomistyring og løbende udvikling af vores tilbudsprocesser.
  • Være med til at afprøve og implementere digitale værktøjer, herunder AI, der kan styrke kalkulation, kvalitetssikring og tilbuds materiale.

Det er vigtigt, at du

  • Har erfaring fra anlægs-, kloak-, entreprenør- eller den grønne branche og forstår, hvordan projekter prissættes og gennemføres.
  • Har en solid forståelse for kalkulation, prissætning og projektøkonomi.
  • Har erfaring med at læse og omsætte udbuds materiale til konkrete tilbud.
  • Har stærke ledelses- og samarbejdsevner og kan skabe retning, overblik og fremdrift.
  • Arbejder analytisk, struktureret og detalje orienteret uden at miste helhedsbilledet.
  • Er selvkørende, ansvarsbevidst og tydelig i din kommunikation.
  • Har gode forhandlingskompetencer og trives i samarbejdet på tværs af faggrupper.
  • Har stærke it-kompetencer, særligt i Excel.

Det er en fordel, hvis du

  • Har arbejdet som tilbudsberegner, entrepriseleder, projektleder eller i en tilsvarende rolle.
  • Har erfaring med Sigma, Bluebeam, CAD, GIS eller lignende værktøjer.
  • Har kendskab til AB 18, udbudsloven og relevante branchestandarder.
  • Har siddet med egenproduktion

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle med reel indflydelse på, hvordan vi arbejder med tilbud og udbud.
  • Mulighed for at udvikle både tilbudsteamet, arbejdsgangene og brugen af digitale værktøjer.
  • En varieret projektportefølje inden for anlæg, kloak og grøn drift.
  • Et tæt fagligt samarbejde med projekt- og driftsorganisationen samt virksomhedens øvrige specialister.
  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, trivsel, udvikling, fællesskab og socialt ansvar.

Om Anlægsgartner Gottlieb A/S

Hos Anlægsgartner Gottlieb A/S skaber vi bæredygtige og grønne løsninger med fokus på kvalitet, biodiversitet og miljøhensyn. Vi udfører alt fra anlægs- og kloakprojekter til skræddersyede serviceaftaler for virksomheder, kommuner, boligforeninger og private.

Med ca. 200 dygtige medarbejdere og en stærk faglighed leverer vi løsninger til tiden og inden for budgettet. Vi værner om langvarige relationer med vores kunder og stræber efter at være deres foretrukne samarbejdspartner.

Vi tror på det bedste i mennesker og arbejder aktivt for trivsel og udvikling blandt vores medarbejdere. Samtidig tager vi socialt ansvar ved at hjælpe unge og udsatte ind på arbejdsmarkedet – noget vi mener skaber stærke fællesskaber og gode resultater.

title: eCommerce Product Owner
description:
**Lokation: Herlev eller Kolding

**Vil du være med til at udvikle digitale eCommerce-løsninger, hvor backoffice, web og app hænger sammen i én samlet kunde- og forretningsoplevelse?

Og motiveres du af at omsætte komplekse forretningsbehov, processer og tekniske afhængigheder til løsninger, der skaber konkret værdi for både kunder og forretning?

Så er du måske vores nye eCommerce Product Owner hos Lemvigh-Müller.

Rollen er for dig, der kan lide at gå i detaljen, stille de rigtige spørgsmål og sikre, at gode idéer bliver til klare krav og løsninger, der forbedrer oplevelsen og øger digitaliseringen hos vores kunder.

**Din rolle

**Som eCommerce Product Owner omsætter du roadmap, forretningsbehov og brugerindsigter til konkrete features og tydelige krav, som teamet kan bygge og sætte i drift. Du er med til at udvikle eCommerce-løsninger, der gør det lettere for kunderne at finde de rigtige produkter, møde relevant indhold og betjene sig selv effektivt – blandt andet gennem søgning, personalisering, data og AI-understøttede funktioner.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med Product Managers, udviklere, QA, Product Design og andre centrale stakeholders og sikrer, at løsninger fungerer på tværs af backoffice, web og app. Du trives med at gå i detaljen, afklare afhængigheder og edge cases – og du har altid fokus på, at det, vi bygger, forbedrer brugeroplevelsen og skaber målbar effekt i vores eCommerce-kanaler.

_”Vi søger en eCommerce Product Owner, der både kan forstå forretningen, teknologien og brugeroplevelsen – og som kan få komplekse behov omsat til løsninger, der skaber værdi for kunder og forretning.”

_**Thomas René Sidor, Head of eCommerce

****Dine vigtigste opgaver

**

  • Omsætte forretningsbehov og roadmap til klare epics, features og user stories i tæt samarbejde med teamet og forretningen.
  • Udvikle og forbedre eCommerce-flows på tværs af backoffice, web og app.
  • Blive forretningsekspert på systemer som søgemotor, personaliseringsmoter, backend, ERP og andre nøglesystemer.
  • Sikre at vi får mest mulig forretningsværdi ud af det systemlandskab (SAP ERP, SAP CC, Umbraco, Vercel, native apps).
  • Drive afklaringer, refinement, test og releases samt sikre dokumentation og løbende forbedringer baseret på data og brugerfeedback.

**Din profil

**Du er en struktureret og teknisk stærk eCommerce Product Owner, Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Forretningsarkitekt eller lignende, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem forretning, teknologi og brugeroplevelse – og som kan skabe klarhed i komplekse problemstillinger. Det er et krav, at du behersker dansk på et højt niveau, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

**Vi Forestiller Os, At Du

**

  • Har erfaring med digitale produkter, eCommerce eller andre komplekse digitale løsninger – gerne i et eCommerce-landskab med ERP, CMS, frontend-platforme og native apps.
  • Er stærk i at omsætte forretnings- og brugerbehov til krav, user stories, acceptkriterier og tydelig dokumentation.
  • Arbejder tæt med udviklingsteams i agile processer og kan indgå i dialog om systemlandskaber, integrationer, API'er, dataflows og tekniske afhængigheder.
  • Har interesse for AI, søgning, personalisering og automatisering og kan omsætte mulighederne til konkrete løsninger, der skaber værdi.
  • Forstår UX, produktdesign, brugerflows og data og kan balancere forretningsværdi, teknisk realiserbarhed og kundeoplevelse.

**Bliv en del af en digital B2B-forretning i udvikling

**Du bliver en del af Lemvigh-Müller – Danmarks største stål- og teknikgrossist og en fondsejet virksomhed med ca. 1.300 ansatte. Vi udvikler digitale eCommerce-løsninger, der bruges af professionelle kunder hver dag.

Vi tilbyder gode rammer for faglig udvikling, fleksibilitet og balance – herunder:

  • Overskudsdeling – gælder alle medarbejdere og fordeles efter anciennitet.
  • Sundhedsforsikring.
  • Attraktiv barselsordning.
  • Fleksible arbejdsformer med mulighed for hjemmearbejde.
  • Fondsstøtte ved blandt andet familieforøgelse, ægteskab og børns uddannelse.

**Søg allerede i dag

**Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig – så søg jobbet nu. Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Ønsker du at vide mere om jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Thomas René Sidor, Head of Digital Commerce, på thsi@lemu.dk.

I Lemvigh-Müller ser vi mangfoldighed som en styrke og arbejder aktivt med diversitet, blandt andet som en del af DI's Diversitetsløftet. Vi opfordrer alle kvalificerede kandidater til at søge – uanset baggrund.

Du behøver kun at sende os dit CV. Undlad gerne billede, alder og lignende oplysninger.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

The overnight hours may be quieter but they are just as important.

For the children and teens in our care, feeling safe and supported doesn't stop at the end of the day. They need someone they can count on through the night. Someone who provides consistency. Someone who stays calm when a difficult night happens. Someone who makes sure they wake up to a safe, structured environment and are ready for a new day.

Our Psychiatric Medical Institution for Children (PMIC) program provides residential treatment and support for children and teens who need a higher level of care.

Be the Person Who Keeps the Night Safe and the Next Day Moving Forward!

title: Backend Software Engineer
description:
You build the backend services that collect, process and expose heat pump data for monitoring, optimisation and product development. Your APIs and data models turn field data into better performance and reliability for heat pumps in people's homes.

What you'll do

  • You build and maintain backend services that collect, process and expose data from our heat pumps.
  • You design robust APIs and data models for monitoring, optimisation and product development.
  • You analyse field data to improve the performance and reliability of our heat pumps.
  • You work with embedded, control and product engineers, close to the hardware in Duizel.
  • You help shape the backend architecture and make deliberate technical choices for a platform that grows with Weheat.

About Weheat

Heating is one of the largest remaining sources of CO₂ emissions in our homes. To tackle that, we want Weheat to become Europe's leading player in residential heat pumps. We develop, test and build our own heat pumps, from first design to production at scale in the Brainport Eindhoven region. What sets us apart: we develop hardware and software together. That makes the heat pump easier to install, and it steers itself smartly on comfort and energy prices. In Utrecht, we drive our commercial growth and build our digital products.

What you bring

This is you

  • Experience with backend development, preferably with C#/.NET, or you are confident you can pick it up quickly
  • A solid understanding of scalable backend architectures, APIs and data flows
  • Experience working with databases. Our stack includes SQL, MongoDB and TimescaleDB
  • You care about writing clean, maintainable and well-tested code
  • You communicate well in English or Dutch
  • You enjoy working in a dynamic environment that's always on the move and growing every day
  • Familiarity with cloud environments

How we work

A mission bigger than you

Going off gas should be the obvious choice for everyone, not a compromise. The better we do as a company, the faster that switch happens. You'll see what you contribute in the product and in people's homes.

If a topic is yours, so is the decision, whatever your job title. You gather input, weigh it up and see it through. Got a question or feedback? Go straight to the colleague who can help. We work without layers or approval rounds: you get trust up front, not after you've earned it.

AI is part of the job

We work AI-first. AI is built into many of the tools we use every day, and we use it wherever it makes our work easier or better.

We grow together

Weheat is a young company. A lot is still being built, and you help build it. Our growth in the Netherlands and the move into Europe create new roles and markets. You get responsibility from day one and work closely with the people who design and build our heat pumps in the Brainport Eindhoven region.

What we offer

  • A laptop and phone, with a plan you can also use privately
  • Travel allowance
  • We cover your full pension contribution
  • Worked extra hours? Take them back as time off, or get them paid out
  • Fresh lunch every day
  • A summer and a winter party
  • A key role in the backend architecture of our heat pump platform

description:

Job Summary:

The Travel Analyst coordinates and makes travel and lodging arrangements for Field Safety Specialists under the project assigned. The Travel Analyst is responsible for evaluating flight travel time and for selecting the most efficient and cost-effective travel with the goal of minimizing staff travel time. The Travel Analyst is responsible for flight bookings, itineraries, car rentals, etc. for Field Safety Specialists as well as entering travel requests into the company’s scheduling system.

  • Coordinate travel for Field Safety Specialists once site visits are confirmed with the Sponsor, ensuring all arrangements comply with requirements and company procedures.

  • Work closely and in conjunction with the corporate travel contractor to book flights, lodging and ground transportation.

  • Responsible for entering travel requests into the company’s Scheduling System and creating work orders for each order.

  • Ability to take technical direction and feedback from various sources.

  • Committed to providing outstanding customer service and representation of MVM in a professional manner.

  • Requires the ability to prioritize work, meet stringent deadlines, balance multiple tasks and work in a team environment.

  • Strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to deliver the highest quality of work under extreme pressure.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

title: Production Tech 1 (61369)
description:
The Production Technician supports the safe, efficient, and consistent production of Tofurky products. This role includes tasks across sealing, peeling, mixing/cooking, packaging, and general production support. Responsibilities include operating and monitoring equipment, handling materials, ensuring food safety and quality, maintaining accurate documentation, and keeping work areas clean and safe.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operate, monitor, start up, and shut down production equipment (mixers, ovens, forming equipment, packaging machines, conveyors, etc.).
  • Perform production activities include:
  • Seal: Remove casing, slicing, move racks, set up Multivac, handle intermediate products.
  • Peel/seal: Remove casings, move racks, wash totes, handle intermediate products.
  • Mix/Cook: Weigh ingredients, mix and form raw materials, bake/cook products.
  • Packaging: Handle, sleeve/bag, carton, pack, palletize, and X-ray products.
  • Attach appropriate labels, tags, and lot/batch numbers to products and packages.
  • Perform quality checks and complete all required processing and quality documentation.
  • Load/unload raw materials and finished goods.
  • Follow all safety rules, including PPE use, chemical handling, and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Maintain compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Maintain a clean and sanitary work environment (sweeping, mopping, cleaning machinery, scraping waste, washing equipment).
  • Assist with general production and support tasks as directed by the Production Supervisor.

description:
6-month contract with a path to permanent or a Learning Advisor role · Sydney CBD, Hybrid · $60K base, $75K OTE pro rata + super

Every week, hundreds of parents reach out to Cluey because they’re worried about their child. Maybe a maths mark has slipped, the HSC is looming, a selective exam is coming up, or their kid has just stopped believing they’re good at school. You’ll be the first person they speak to.

This is a phone-based role with no cold calling and no closing. Every parent you call has already asked us for help. Your job is to have a genuine conversation: understand what’s going on with their child, find out what they’re hoping will change, and connect them with one of our Learning Advisors for a deeper consultation.

What you’ll do

  • Call parents who’ve enquired about tutoring and get to know their situation, including year level, subjects, how things are going, and what they’ve already tried

  • Build rapport quickly with parents who are often stressed, unsure, or comparing options

  • Ask good questions to understand what’s really driving the enquiry, not just the surface answer

  • Transfer parents live to a Learning Advisor, or book them in for a consultation

  • Write clear handover notes so the Learning Advisor can pick up where you left off

  • Keep our CRM accurate and up to date

  • Work toward weekly call and booking targets, supported by our sales and operations teams

What you’ll bring

  • Experience in a phone-based or customer-facing role. Appointment setting, call centre, customer service, retail, hospitality, or teaching all count.

  • A warm, natural way of talking to people, and the ability to put a worried parent at ease

  • Curiosity: you like asking questions and actually listen to the answers

  • Organisation and attention to detail

  • Full working rights in Australia

  • A current Working with Children Check, or willingness to get one

  • A bonus, not a must: familiarity with the NSW school system or the education sector

The details

  • $75,000 OTE pro rata ($60,000 base + commission) + super

  • 6-month fixed-term contract, with the option to move into a permanent role or step up to a Learning Advisor position

  • Monday to Friday, 9am–5pm. During peak periods, we may ask for some later shifts, finishing no later than 7pm.

  • Hybrid: Monday and Tuesday from home, Wednesday to Friday in our Sydney CBD office

  • You’ll work closely with our sales and operations teams, with full training on our process, systems, and programs

Why Cluey

Cluey provides live online tutoring to students across Australia, mapped to the Australian Curriculum and tailored to each child. We’ve delivered over 1,000,000 learning sessions to more than 33,000 students, with 2,500+ expert tutors. You’ll be part of a team of 80–100 people helping kids get their confidence back.

title: Market Analyst, Sports
description:
Hacksaw Markets is a B2B prediction-market platform that operators can use to offer prediction markets under their own brands. Most markets are listed and settled automatically. As a Market Analyst, Sports you will handle the exceptions the machines cannot such as ambiguous events, conflicting sources, unusual outcomes and anything that could reach a customer before it is right.

What you will own

  • Work the match-day exceptions queue, including unmapped teams, moved events, duplicate listings and feed failures.
  • Monitor live markets so they open and close on time and do not remain open after an event starts.
  • Draft outcomes for approval when a result requires human interpretation, attaching clear reasoning and sources.
  • Review shipped markets from a user’s perspective and flag errors before they become incidents.
  • Turn recurring exceptions into clear tooling tickets for operations engineers.

What you bring

  • Exceptional attention to detail and comfort making precise decisions under time pressure.
  • Experience in trading, sportsbook or exchange operations during evenings and weekends.
  • Strong knowledge of football and tennis calendars; expertise in another major sport is an advantage.
  • Confidence in queue-driven tools and concise operational writing.
  • Fluent English; additional languages or strong knowledge of major US sports are advantages.

Why Hacksaw Markets

  • A genuine build-stage mandate with direct influence over product, operating model and culture.
  • An ambitious team supported by established technology, operating experience and long-term capital.
  • The opportunity to help create trusted infrastructure for a category moving rapidly into the mainstream.

Ready to apply?

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant market, system, product or operational challenge you have owned.

*By applying for this position, you consent to the collection and processing of your information for recruitment purposes*

title: Senior Buyer
description:
Job Title: Sr. Buyer

Department: Purchasing

Reports To: Purchasing Manager

Position Summary
The Senior Buyer supports production continuity by executing direct-material purchasing requirements in a fast-paced aerospace and defense manufacturing environment. This hands-on position converts material demand into accurate purchase orders, monitors supplier commitments, expedites critical materials, resolves shortages and delivery issues, and supports supplier performance and purchasing compliance. The role works closely with planning, manufacturing, engineering, quality, and strategic sourcing to keep materials available and production moving. The position is primarily focused on purchasing execution rather than independent strategic sourcing or ownership of complex commercial negotiations.


Key Responsibilities
Purchasing Execution & Production Support
• Execute purchase orders and blanket purchase orders against approved requirements; maintain accurate order data, pricing, lead times, delivery schedules, and terms and conditions.
• Interpret ERP/MRP demand signals, track supplier acknowledgments, manage exceptions, and proactively expedite or reschedule materials to prevent production disruption.
• Resolve shortages, supplier pushouts, discrepancies, and material availability concerns through timely cross-functional coordination and data-driven problem-solving.
• Purchase direct materials to engineering specifications and drawings; communicate applicable quality codes, technical requirements, and customer flow-down requirements to suppliers.
• Maintain complete and accurate procurement documentation in accordance with purchasing policies and applicable government-contract requirements.


Supplier Performance & Coordination
• Monitor supplier scorecards, on-time delivery, risks, and corrective actions; coordinate recovery plans and follow through on commitments.
• Support supplier onboarding, qualification, transitions, and basic capability assessments in partnership with appropriate stakeholders.
• Plan and facilitate supplier meetings and business reviews, including agendas, appropriate participants, action logs, and follow-up.
• Facilitate discussions concerning pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and commercial terms, escalating complex negotiations and approval decisions to management or strategic sourcing.
• Identify potential supplier and material lifecycle risks, including obsolescence, and recommend practical mitigation actions.


Operational Excellence & Collaboration
• Analyze purchasing and supplier data using Excel and ERP/MRP reporting to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and support fact-based decisions.
• Coordinate with planning, production, engineering, quality, and other teams to resolve changing priorities and meet customer requirements.
• Participate in continuous improvement and standard-work activities using Lean, Six Sigma, or Ralliant Business Systems principles as applicable.
• Support cross-training and onboarding of other buyers as experience develops; this is an individual-contributor role with no direct reports.
• Manage assigned commodities and adapt to changing commodity assignments and business priorities as needed.


Required Qualifications
• At least three years of purchasing experience supporting manufacturing or production, including direct-material procurement and purchase-order execution.
• At least three years of experience working in an ERP/MRP purchasing environment; no particular platform is required.
• Working knowledge of purchase-order terms, payment terms, delivery schedules, supplier follow-up, and purchasing documentation.
• Experience managing supplier delivery issues, material shortages, and competing production priorities.
• Ability to interpret technical specifications and engineering drawings for purchasing purposes and communicate supplier quality requirements.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Excel, including creating and using pivot tables and analyzing purchasing data.
• Ability to work independently, communicate effectively with suppliers and internal stakeholders, and develop practical, evidence-based solutions.
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, or five or more years of closely related experience in lieu of a degree.


Preferred Qualifications
• Aerospace and defense manufacturing purchasing experience, including familiarity with government procurement compliance, FAR/DFARS, cost or price justification, and supplier flow-down requirements.
• Experience buying technically complex commodities in regulated manufacturing environments.
• Experience with supplier onboarding, supplier scorecards, supplier corrective actions (SCARs), and supplier risk mitigation.
• Oracle ERP experience or participation in an ERP implementation or transition.
• Familiarity with Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement programs and an interest in actively driving improvements.
• APICS, CPSM, CPM, or comparable supply chain/procurement certification.
• Experience independently organizing and facilitating supplier business reviews.


Work Arrangement & Travel
This position is based in Chandler, Arizona. The first 90 days require full-time on-site attendance for onboarding and cross-training. After onboarding, the role may be eligible for a hybrid schedule of three days on-site (including Monday and Friday) and two days remote, subject to operational needs and management approval. Additional on-site attendance, including month-end coverage, may be required. Employees must reside within commuting distance and be available to report on-site when business needs require. Work hours are flexible around core coverage of 8:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m., subject to team and operational requirements.
Travel is expected to be less than 10%, primarily to other company facilities (including Hollister, California) or supplier locations.


Employment Eligibility
Due to U.S. Government contract requirements applicable to this position, only U.S. citizens are eligible for employment in this role.


Benefits & Culture
Eligible associates have access to company benefit programs, which may include paid time off, retirement savings, medical/dental/vision coverage, tuition reimbursement, parental leave, and company performance-based incentive opportunities, subject to applicable plan terms. PacSci EMC offers opportunities for growth, cross-functional collaboration, continuous improvement, and career development.

title: Director of Thrift Store Operations (8882)
description:
JOB SUMMARY:

Manages and directs the Salvage/Thrift Stores in it’s work of reconditioning donated materials and merchandise into saleable form. Provides supervision and control of collecting and transporting donated materials, segregating, classifying, storing and dispensing of such materials and pricing. Provides maintenance of facilities and equipment and satisfies the transportation requirements of the organization.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: This job description should not be interpreted as all-inclusive. It is intended to identify the essential functions and requirements of this position. The incumbents may be requested to perform job-related responsibilities and tasks other than those stated in this job description.

Plans, schedules, supervises, coordinates, monitors, and evaluates the work performed by Thrift Store supervisors and their staff; trains and instructs staff in the proper methods and procedures for performing work; inspects work in progress and upon completion in order to ensure compliance with established policies and procedures; makes hiring and firing recommendations; conducts performance evaluations of supervisory personnel.

Prepares long range plans for the Salvage/Thrift Stores based on guidance received through the Officer(s)-In-Charge; develops and maintains improved conditions and procedures with the organization in general and within the department in order to meet workload requirements.

Prepares and provides information for the operations portion of the budget based on guidance and instruction received; utilizes the approved budget to govern the operations of the department.

Reviews and analyzes the performance continually to determine effectiveness and take corrective action where necessary; develops performance standards and keeps the Officer(s)-In-Charge informed of significant facts concerning department operations.

Maintains statistical information and records sufficient to maintain awareness of the productive capacity available and to make sales projects and assist in short and long range planning.

Performs public relations functions; seeks increased support from the general public and works to increase awareness and understanding of The Salvation Army; participates in public appearances in order to promote The Salvation Army; stimulates materials procurement through improved solicitation methods.

Receives, segregates, classifies, prices, stores or otherwise disposes of material received from contributors.

Supervises all transportation operations including pick-up of material, deliver to stores, transportation between stores, and all special transportation requirements.

Services and otherwise maintains transportation equipment; maintains all equipment, either directly with maintenance staff available, or through regular commercial facilities; makes alterations to premises as authorized by the Officer(s)-In-Charge(s)-In-Charge.

Receives salvage and scrap material; sorts and classifies the same according to type and market; prepares for sale into bales or lots; negotiates for sales and makes arrangements for shipping when necessary.

Maintains inventory records on all materials covering store shipments, etc.; compiles all production statistics and reports and maintains an organized filing system of the same.

Ensures that job descriptions for employees are current and applicable; schedules in-service training for department supervisors and employees.

Ensures knowledge, enforcement, documentation, and compliance with OSHA and wage and hour regulations.

Conducts transportation training and ensures that Corps requirements for Truck Drivers are met.

Collects and files daily production sheets; develops weekly and monthly production goals for each department in workshop including the store.

title: Banker I Westford Branch
description:
Rockland Trust is a full-service commercial bank and financial services company committed to helping our neighbors reach their financial goals. Founded in 1907 and headquartered in Massachusetts, we proudly serve individuals, families, and businesses throughout New England with a strong emphasis on personal relationships, local decision-making, and community impact.

With a broad range of banking, wealth management, and investment solutions, Rockland Trust combines the resources of a growing financial institution with the personalized service of a community bank. Our long-standing philosophy—Where Each Relationship Matters®—guides how we work with our customers, colleagues, and communities every day.

At Rockland Trust, our employees are at the heart of our success. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture that encourages professional growth, innovation, and work-life balance. We are deeply committed to community involvement, financial education, and creating a workplace where individuals can build meaningful, long-term careers.

As a Banker at Rockland Trust, you are a key player in the Retail Branch setting, providing exceptional customer service and expert financial guidance to our clients. Each day, you will use your broad range of financial knowledge and communication skills to address customer needs, ensuring that each customer leaves satisfied not only today, but for years to come.

With a positive can-do attitude and a genuine desire to work with customers in a caring and empathetic way, you are responsible for executing the bank’s promises by proactively identifying opportunities to deepen customer relationships, create a positive work environment, and establish meaningful roots in the community.

The Banker position offers exceptional growth opportunity within the banking industry, and provides a solid foundation for developing your banking and customer service skills. If you are a “people person” looking to make a positive impact on the financial well-being of those in your community, then this is the job for you!

What You’ll Experience:
  • Meaningful relationships: We believe that Each Relationship Matters, and are fully committed to creating a respectful and inclusive environment where everyone is given the chance to succeed.
  • Commitment to community: We believe supporting our communities is essential, and are committed to helping those in need.
  • Recognition & reward: We believe all colleagues should be recognized for their contributions.
  • Training & development: We believe all colleagues are critical to our future, and we will invest in their success by providing educational experiences and resources to manage and navigate their careers.
  • Comprehensive benefits: Our goal is to offer our colleagues a generous benefits package, and an environment that supports a healthy work-life balance. Our benefits include: competitive compensation with performance incentive awards, Health Insurance, Dental Insurance, Vision and Pet Insurance, 401K retirement plan, Long Term Disability & Life Insurance, Child Care Reimbursement, Tuition Assistance for graduate and undergraduate programs, an award winning wellness program and much more.
Who We Are:

At Rockland Trust, we believe that being a great place to bank starts with being a great place to work. When our colleagues are valued and cared for, they’re empowered to make a difference for our customers and communities.

As one of The Boston Globe’s “Top Places to Work” since 2008, we know that finding the right people is just the beginning. Through competitive benefits, enriching development opportunities, and a respectful and collaborative culture, we’ve built a workplace that enhances our colleagues’ lifestyle and inspires them to reach their full potential.

For over 116 years, we have been dedicated to strengthening the neighborhoods we live in and serve. Rockland Trust offers a wide range of banking, investment, and insurance services to help individuals and businesses work toward their financial goals with more than 120 branches located throughout Massachusetts and New Hampshire, as well as commercial banking, investment management offices, and residential lending centers across Massachusetts, New Hampshire and Rhode Island.

What You’ll Do:
  • Support customer relationship development and transaction processing to assist the bank in meeting its sales and service goals.
  • Accurately and efficiently execute the day-to-day transactional needs of the bank’s client base, including opening and processing all types of accounts (including deposit and loan products), check cashing, balancing cash drawer, performing settlement procedures, and processing withdrawals and deposits for both consumer and business customers within established guidelines and authority.
  • Proactively cross-sell bank products and services to existing and new customers by utilizing the current tools and tracking systems provided.
  • Make qualified referrals to business partners in the areas of investments, mortgage, cash management, etc.
  • Complete the Home Equity application process with customers, communicate and follow up on application requirements and complete the closing process.
  • Achieve individual and team sales and service goals; actively participate in sales promotions.
  • Use a needs-based consultative approach to recommend products or services that will enhance and complement the customer’s relationship.
  • Answer both routine and complex questions concerning customer accounts, products, services, policies, and procedure; troubleshoot customer issues and provide follow-through to ensure resolution.
  • Maintain a solid foundation of product knowledge by taking advantage of trainings as they are offered and completing required trainings within the timeframes provided.
  • Use knowledge, experience, and ability to demonstrate self-service channels to customers, including ATM, Online Banking, and Mobile Banking.
  • Utilize the Salesforce platform for customer interactions, conversations, and follow-up.
  • Create and foster a fun, respectful work environment, in collaboration with Branch Manager.
  • Represent Rockland Trust by establishing meaningful roots in the communities it serves.
  • Adhere to operational, regulatory, and security policies and procedures while balancing customer relationships and risk of loss to the Bank.
  • Assume responsibility for additional reporting duties and responsibilities as required.
Required Qualifications:
  • Two year degree or equivalent job experience.
  • Minimum 1 year sales experience in a financial or retail environment.
  • Must be or become a Notary Public and NMLS certified.
  • Successfully pass the Level I Business Certification.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel with ability to operate a variety of office equipment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong sales orientation with ability to balance multiple priorities, adapt, and work in a team environment.
  • Ability to work intuitively and find creative solutions should any problems arise.
  • High degree of professionalism and ability to demonstrate tact and diplomacy when needed.
  • Positive approach to interactions with customers and team members.
  • Ability to work within normal office requirements, with long periods of standing and continuous customer support.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.
  • Willingness and ability to work within a flexible work week, which may include weekends, as customer needs dictate.
  • Ability to successfully complete all required onboarding, job-specific, compliance, regulatory, operational, and continuing education training programs within established timeframes.
Preferred Skills/Experience:
  • Two to four years of teller experience preferred.

Rockland Trust is the Bank Where Each Relationship Matters®. In pursuit of that promise, we foster a respectful and inclusive work environment where everyone is given the chance and resources to succeed.

Benefits & Culture

Our goal is to offer our colleagues the most generous benefits package possible. We provide a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to support your health, financial security, and overall, well-being. Benefits include: competitive compensation with performance-based incentive awards, health and dental insurance, a 401(k) and DC retirement plan, LTD and life insurance, paid vacation, day care reimbursement, tuition assistance for undergraduate and graduate programs, an award-winning wellness program, and much more!

At Rockland Trust, you’ll find a respectful and inclusive environment where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We are an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Pay Transparency

Compensation for this role will be based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, and internal equity. The salary range posted reflects the company’s good-faith estimate of the range for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary. In addition to base salary, certain positions may be eligible for additional compensation, including commissions, incentive awards or stipends.

Accessibility & Accommodations

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their roles.


Now that you’ve heard a little bit about us, we’d love to hear more about you. Submit your application and come help us strengthen our communities- one relationship a time.

title: Director of Donor Engagement
description:
About Operation Food Search:

Founded in 1981, Operation Food Search is a hunger relief organization that provides food, nutrition education and innovative programs in order to reduce food insecurity and increase equitable access to food. We serve 200,000 people every month through a network of 330 partners in 27 counties in Missouri and Illinois. We use a combination of immediate food assistance and supportive services, while also working on long-term solutions and systemic changes to help solve the problem of hunger.

Our Mission is to heal hunger with innovative and collaborative solutions that provide food today and help create a hunger-free tomorrow.

Our Vision is a region where everyone has equitable access to the food they need to lead healthy lives.

Our Goals are to:

  1. Meet the immediate need for food for children, individuals and families by providing high-quality nutrition through our distribution network.
  2. Empower long-term skills through nutrition education and by teaching how to shop and prepare healthy food on a budget.
  3. Champion change through advocacy, innovative programs and by addressing systemic inequities.

Position Summary:

Operation Food Search is looking for a passionate and experienced fundraiser who is ready to engage with a community of dedicated supporters who care about solving hunger. Reporting to the Chief Development Officer, the Director of Donor Engagement will play a key leadership role in annual, legacy, and special project fundraising efforts. With a particular focus on working with individual donors throughout the giving cycle, the Donor Engagement Officer will learn the individual passions and motivations of donors and create a customized, personal approach to every donor interaction. The Director of Donor Engagement will have one direct report, a Donor Engagement Manager, to be hired mid-2027.

Salary: 83,673.00 - $104,702.00


Essential Functions:

  • Grow a portfolio of donors through identification, qualification, cultivation and stewardship. Approach donor strategy with the longevity of the organization as well as the donor’s immediate intent in mind, integrating planned, endowment, and long-term stewardship plans as part of the solicitation and cultivation process.
  • Maintain a comprehensive knowledge of OFS’s programs and funding priorities.
  • Record donor interactions, relationships, and other relevant information in CRM.
  • Conduct and/or coordinate prospect research to create strategies for engaging individual donors.
  • Lead donor cultivation and stewardship events as needed.
  • Create donor affinity groups and engage those groups in OFS’s mission.
  • Leads engagement with third parties doing fundraising on behalf of OFS.
  • Partner with CDO on expanding legacy giving through creative stewardship strategies, marketing and resulting data findings.

To Apply: Please submit your application and include your resume and cover letter at https://www.operationfoodsearch.org/careers/

title: University Admissions Counselor, CGA
description:
About the Role

Crimson Global Academy (CGA) is hiring a part-time, fully remote University Admissions Counselor for its US Diploma campus. You will guide a caseload of about 200 students in Grades 9 to 12 (Years 10 to 13), from choosing high school courses through applying to universities anywhere in the world.

CGA students live across many countries and time zones, so this role suits a counselor who is confident advising on US, UK and international pathways and who enjoys working flexibly with a global team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Meet regularly one on one with students on your caseload to plan their academic path, activities and university goals.

  • Teach the Future Ready curriculum, CGA's college and career readiness lessons delivered online.

  • Help students choose courses each year that shape a strong high school record and support their university plans.

  • Guide students in choosing clubs and activities that match their interests and goals.

  • Help students research universities and build balanced college lists.

  • Support students through the full application process for universities worldwide, including the Common App, the University of California application and UCAS.

  • Track application deadlines and requirements for every student and keep them on schedule.

  • Write counselor recommendation letters and submit school documents for your students.

  • Communicate with families about their student's progress, plans and deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (minimum).

  • At least 5 years of experience supporting students with college counseling and advising.

  • At least 3 years of experience with the UK curriculum and A Levels, including how A Level choices and results support students' university goals.

  • Strong organization and the ability to manage deadlines for a caseload of about 200 students.

  • Comfortable working remotely and communicating clearly with students, families and colleagues across time zones.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with NCAA advising for student athletes, including eligibility and college placement.

  • Knowledge of the University of California (UC) application, requirements and deadlines.

  • Experience supporting UCAS applications to UK universities.

Schedule and Work Details

  • Position Type: Part-time

  • Location: Fully Remote

  • Working Hours: 25 hours per week (Flexible)

  • Hourly Rate: USD $35-$45

  • Start Date: 1 December 2026

  • Reports To: Lead Academic and Enrichment Counselor

  • Additional Requirements: As CGA students are based across multiple time zones, some early morning or evening availability will be required for student meetings and classes.

title: Clinical Research Supervisor I
description:
Job Function Summary

Involves the development of and ensures compliance with clinical study protocols that involve human subjects. Oversees and resolves operational aspects of clinical studies or trials in conjunction with project teams and in accordance with standard operating procedures and good clinical practice and regulations. May be responsible for finances, clinical operations, and site and vendor selection.

Generic Scope

Provides immediate supervision to a unit or group of operational or technical employees. A portion of time may be spent performing individual tasks related to the unit; however, supervisory activities must constitute a primary part of the job. Supervises unit operations to ensure compliance with departmental or organizational policies, procedures, and defined internal controls. Ensures accountability and stewardship of department resources (operational, financial, and human) in compliance with departmental standards and procedures.

Custom Scope

Supervises staff involved in routine research study coordination. Receives predetermined work assignments that are subject to a moderate level of control and review. Oversees staff in execution of assignments; trains and mentors staff to improve quality and quantity of work.

Staff Supervision and Work Management

  • Distributes work.
  • Monitors the progress of work of assigned staff.
  • Researches and resolves issues and discrepancies.
  • Manages subordinates' quality and quantity of work to ensure unit meets its objectives.
  • Reports performance evaluation to management.
  • Follows internal policies and processes.
  • Supervises assigned staff to ensure compliance.
  • Trains employees on research regulatory processes, database entry, and working with participant families.
  • Implements and maintains defined research study processes.
  • Serves as a liaison between staff and program leaders.
  • Reports work effort to the department.
  • Cultivates communication and teamwork between cross-functional teams working on research.

Clinical Trial and Study Coordination

  • Initiates a clinical trial study.
  • Oversees and reviews study and helps create systems and forms to ensure research billing, packets for recruitment and calendars are developed.
  • Reviews accrual and eligibility for each patient placed on a clinical trial to ensure human subject protection regulations are in compliance and quality recruitment.
  • Multi-tasks and prioritizes to smoothly coordinate studies and ensure patient safety.

Data Collection, Regulatory Compliance and Auditing

  • Supervises the timeliness and quality of data collection, submission and completion.
  • Trains new study coordinators in collecting and understanding source documentation, creating forms for ensuring proper reporting of adverse events and protocol adherence to federal regulations.
  • Monitors and audits visits.
  • Monitors preparation in order to oversee and assist study coordinators in preparing for audits.
  • Ensures data is sufficient and updated, including all regulatory documentation.
  • Uses computer applications to generate reports and quality assurance of required data entry.
  • Attends all meetings with auditors.
  • Assists staff assigned with monitoring site compliance.

Research Billing and Financial Coordination

  • Tracks patient charges and alerts the department on billable triggers to collect money.
  • Understands budget preparation for clinical trials; interprets and trains the study coordinators on how to proceed in proper data research billing.
  • Coordinates with billing to resolve disputed charges.

Research Data and Sample Management

  • Oversees the incoming data interpreted from samples and ensures that it is correctly entered into respective databases, and reviewed.
  • Ensures integrity and security of samples.

Human Resources and Staff Development

  • Recommends salary actions, promotions, and terminations.
  • Recommends personnel-related actions.
  • Participates in the recruitment and orientation of new employees.
  • Evaluates assigned staff performance and reports to management.
  • Provides guidance and excellent judgement.
  • Seen as a role model by assigned staff.

Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of clinical or laboratory research, clinical trial recruitment, eligibility, protocol adherence, quality data submission and adverse event reporting.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities, prioritize projects and meet the demands of a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Adaptable to quickly changing priorities.
  • Demonstrated skills in employee supervision and HR administration.
  • Demonstrated experience in training others, particularly in the field of research.
  • Critical thinking skills to evaluate issues and identify a potential solution.
  • Clear and concise communicator; good verbal and written communication skills; both.
  • Good interpersonal skills, including but not limited to: problem-solving, teamwork development, leadership, mentorship.
  • Interpersonal skills to effectively motivate others.
  • Works well with others to achieve common goals.
  • Ability to cultivate relationships with multiple stakeholders at various levels of administration.
  • Ability to perform all commonly applicable functions in word processing and spreadsheet software.
  • Effectively uses campus' clinical information and documentation application programs.
  • Proven ability utilizing clinical trial management systems.

  • Provide guidance and training to employees on using software, devices, and systems.

  • Prepare and set up equipment for new employees (onboarding) and retrieve/wipe data upon employee (offboarding).

2. Maintain Network & Infrastructure

  • Install, configure, and maintain internal network systems (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi) settings.

  • Maintain printers, scanners, and peripheral devices to keep them operational.

  • Support meeting room systems, video conferencing equipment, and VoIP phone systems.

  • Perform basic server monitoring and maintenance (Windows/Linux), backups, and system status checks.

3. Manage User Accounts & Access

  • Create, modify, and deactivate user accounts, email accounts, and system access via Active Directory / Microsoft 365.

  • Manage file and system access permission groups according to company policy.

4. Support Information Security

  • Keep operating systems and software up to date through patch management.

  • Install and maintain antivirus / anti-malware (endpoint protection) software.

  • Monitor for and report basic security incidents to the relevant team.

5. Manage IT Assets

  • Create and maintain the IT asset register (hardware, software, and license inventory).

  • Track equipment stock levels and plan procurement/replacement of devices.

  • Coordinate equipment repairs or warranty claims with external vendors.

6. Maintain Documentation & Coordination

  • Create user manuals and troubleshooting procedures (knowledge base/SOPs) for internal reference.

  • Prepare periodic reports summarizing issues and service statistics (ticket reports) for management.

  • Coordinate with the central IT team, external vendors, or related teams when issues require escalation.

  • Perform other duties as assigned by supervisor.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field

  • 1–3 years of experience in IT Support or Help Desk roles

  • Basic knowledge of Windows/Mac OS, Active Directory, networking, and Microsoft Office

  • Strong problem-solving skills, good communication, and a service-minded attitude

  • Willing to work occasional overtime when urgent issues arise

  • Preferred: relevant certifications such as CompTIA A+, Network+


Fundamental Skills are a MUST

  • End-User Computing Support & Troubleshooting

  • Windows / Mac OS Administration

  • Network Fundamentals (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi, Router, Switch, Firewall)

  • Active Directory / Microsoft 365 User & Access Management

  • Basic Cybersecurity Awareness & Patch Management

  • IT Asset Management

  • Ticketing / ITSM Platform Usage

  • Documentation & SOP Writing
