title: Técnico de Reparo e Manutenção 4 - Intervention Services
description:
DOCUMENT NUMBER: D001217226

TITLE: RM.RMTECH.OPTR.IV

POSITION TITLE: R&M Technician IV

POSITION CATEGORY: Repair & Maintenance

REPORTS TO (JOB TITLE):

DUAL REPORT

Job Purpose

The R&M Technician role undertakes hands-on tasks and utilizes Weatherford's facilities, equipment, machinery, and systems. The role applies techniques and practices to complete the scope of tasks covering inspection, repair, and maintenance of field tools, preparing them for their next assignment. Tasks will span the entire process from receiving the tools, dismantling, repairing, and refurbishing using technical manuals, procedures, and technical work instructions. While this is a generic job description covering the different levels of the R&M Technician position, all aspects of the roles and responsibilities are relevant. More senior roles lead and oversee tasks carried out by other R&M employees.

Roles & Responsibilities

SAFETY, SECURITY & COMPLIANCE

· Maintains the highest standards of corporate governance, ensuring that all activities are carried out ethically and in compliance with Company’s Security, Compliance & HSE policies, Management System, relevant laws, regulations, standards, and industry practices and complies with the Company’s Rules to Live By

· Places Quality, Health & Safety, Security and protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers or the communities in which we live and work at risk

· Seeks continual improvement in Health, Safety, Security & protection of the Environment, taking into account responsible care, process vulnerabilities, public, customer and employee inputs, knowledge and technology and best business practices to exceed customer expectations

· Supervisors & Managers should demonstrate effective safety leadership for the health and safety arrangements of all subordinates and for any persons visiting them while on the Company premises

QUALITY

· Responsible for being familiar with the Company's Quality policies and takes an active role in the compliance and improvement of Weatherford’s Management System

· Maintains service quality as immediate priorities when working across all areas of the business and continually seeks areas for improvement

OPERATIONS

· Participates in all daily operations & safety meetings, toolbox, Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) and reports any issues promptly using the appropriate tools

· Maintains equipment, facilities, and work area in a presentable and safe working condition

· Repairs machines, equipment, or structures, using tools such as hammers, hoists, cranes, drills, wrenches, or equipment such as precision measuring instruments or electrical or electronic testing devices

· Inspects used parts to determine changes in dimensional requirements, using rules, callipers, micrometres, or other measuring instruments.

· Follows maintenance processes & procedures to undertake the following: unloading, disassembly, cleaning, pressure testing, visual checking, painting, assembly, loading, and storage of tools, completing all necessary documentation as required against their level of training & competence

· Initiates, updates, closes out AIRTs, PFTs, forms, checklists, and work orders during maintenance of equipment and assets, following the necessary maintenance processes and procedures against their level of training & competence

· Complies with the WO labor time log by accurately clocking in/Out of the WO (Work Order) Time tracking system

· Utilizes all tools and lifting equipment for opening and closing crates & containers and uses pallet and forklift trucks for the safe movement of equipment to and from vehicles, storage areas, racks, shelves, and bins against their level of training & competence. Must be certified for the use of lifting equipment, including forklift trucks and cranes

· Accepts incoming shipments and prepares shipments for dispatch, validating quantities and ensuring all necessary documentation is accurate and complies with all Company procedures against their level of training & competence

· In senior positions, the employee will often lead the team in undertaking all the assignments detailed above. This includes troubleshooting equipment issues, implementing corrective actions, and providing access to all relative R&M documented policies, procedures, work instructions, and technical manuals allowing the R&M team to complete their work effectively and efficiently

· Senior roles will ensure all field and workshop personnel follow the corrective and preventative maintenance procedures, ensuring all failures are followed up to closure with a proper root cause analysis and with the implementation of predetermined corrective action(s)

· Senior roles might lead the workshop, defining and distributing the work assignment schedules while evaluating the quality, proficiency, and efficiency of the works being carried out through performing regular inspections to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures

· Order parts, supplies, or equipment from catalogs or approved suppliers according to Weatherford’s guidelines and procedures

· Supports and complies with the LEAN initiatives and participates in the continuous efficiency improvement program of the facility.

· Performs other duties and activities safely as assigned by supervisor within physical constraints of the job

COMMUNICATION

· Where required, will report all equipment failures and troubleshooting requirements to the R&M Management

· Maintains effective communications with all key stakeholders both internal and where appropriate external

· Supervisors & Managers should clearly communicate expectations, roles and responsibilities to their reports

FINANCIAL

· All employees have an accountability to the organisation to be financially responsible whether they are in charge of a function budget or simply their own expenses

· Costs incurred should be within approved budget, processed within agreed time frames & following the relevant financial policy and procedure

PEOPLE & DEVELOPMENT

· Shows social orientation, working and being personally connected with others on the job

· Employees have a responsibility for developing their own careers within the Company including completing all necessary function, compliance & business standards training to enhance their knowledge, skills and experience

· Employees should engage on a regular basis with their line manager to discuss their personal performance, objectives and opportunities to enhance their skills and experience to support their career potential

· Supervisors are expected to actively engaging their employees to support talent management through Weatherford’s performance management process, including but not limited to talent assessments, succession planning & regular coaching opportunities

· Supervisors should collaborate with Human Resources & Training Development to drive strategies for the recruitment & retention of key personal & to foster an environment that supports the attraction & retention of a high performing talented workforce

VISION & LEADERSHIP

· Demonstrates leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times

Experience & Education

REQUIRED

· 6-8+ years of experience in Oil & Gas industry.

· High School Diploma

· Basic Computer Skills

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

REQUIRED

· Basic Mathematics

· Working with hazardous materials, radioactive elements & explosives. Awareness of NDT, NDE and ATEX policies & principles

· More senior roles require the ability to diagnose issues and problems with tools/equipment

· Perform maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, monitoring of equipment

· Critical thinking, active learning & listening, complex problem solving

· Good reading and writing skills, strong judgement and decision-making to be in line with policies & procedures

· Time management

· Quality Control Analysis to ensure product meets required standards

· Capable to meet the physical demands that the role requires

· Information & task ordering & ability to identify when a problem may occur and where possible to understand solution

· Ability to react effectively and efficiently in operating tools and machinery

· Ability to imagine how tools and products will look when preparing for assembly, repair or modifications



Travel Requirement: This role may require domestic and potentially international travel of up to: <10%

JOB DESCRIPTION SCOPE

This job description’s purpose is to offer some details on the scope and depth of the role and its interaction with other roles with the organisation, through a focus on key criteria. It cannot capture the entire scope of the role. The document is generic in nature and offers consistency in role content from the early career level to more senior levels. The Company’s expectation is that the holder of the role understands and accepts that its expectations will be potentially greater from those in more senior roles than those at an early stage of their career. Responsibilities may well be greater and their decisions will have greater impact on the function and organisations performance. The Company reserves the right to amend the content of the job description to better reflect the changing scope of the role with or without notice.

HUMAN RESOURCES ADMINISTRATION

CAREER PATH LEVEL

EXECUTIVE I - V Make Selection

Holds management accountability for a business, division, major geography, corporate function or major corporate sub-function. Develops, establishes & approves long terms strategy for the area managed

MANAGEMENT I – V Make Selection

Achieves goals through the work of others. Responsibilities inc; performance management, merit review, training & development. Focus is on managing others and applying operational or strategic management skills

PROFESSIONAL I - VII Make Selection

Applies a theoretical knowledge-base to work in order to achieve goals through own work. Characterised by specific functional expertise, typically gained through formal education. May provide guidance to others using technical expertise

TECHNICAL I – V Make Selection

Performs technical work, often in support of professional roles. Requires vocational training or the equivalent experience. Performs duties according to established procedures

SUPPORT I – V Make Selection

Performs clerical or administrative work, requires vocational training or the equivalent experience and performs duties according to established procedures

OPERATIONS I – V Level IV

Performs operational, craft or manual tasks. Typically requires vocational training, apprenticeship or equivalent experience. Performs task according to established procedures.

GEOZONE ADDENDUMS

The job description template is a generic document designed to improve the quality, consistency and accuracy of the information regarding the Company’s expectations for the position. Individual countries may have some regulatory requirements that are required to be included in the job description. Any specific country requirements are captured in their specific Geozone addendum, which should be issued to the employee with the job description document.

title: Embedded Software Developer
description:
Fortinet is looking for Embedded Software Developers who are passionate about enhancing and expanding the rich feature set of our FortiGate firewall. You will join a dedicated team developing innovative SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network) solutions, including routing protocols, policy-based routing, link quality measurement, Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), and AI-based routing algorithms.

You enjoy tackling complex technical challenges and take pride in writing clean, efficient, and well-structured code. You leverage existing tools and develop new ones to streamline development processes, allowing you to focus on delivering impactful solutions. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, grow, and continuously improve, contributing to the ongoing innovation and excellence of FortiGate products.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, implement, and maintain software components that support our TCP/IP stack and SD-WAN feature set.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies, application-layer protocols, and software development best practices, and proactively recommend improvements.
  • Promote and uphold high standards of software design, coding quality, and maintainability.
  • Identify opportunities for product enhancements through hands-on experience with Fortinet products.
  • Research and explore emerging technologies to enhance existing and future AI-based SD-WAN routing algorithms.
  • Evaluate and refine existing software designs and implementations to improve performance, reliability, and efficiency.

Requirements:

  • Proficiency in C/C++ programming and software development.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience developing software in Linux or UNIX-like environments.
  • Solid understanding of Operating System, TCP/IP networking, POSIX APIs, and socket programming.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and development methodologies.

Assets:

  • Understanding of networking and cybersecurity concepts, particularly RIP/OSPF/BGP protocols and their implementation.
  • Familiarity with machine learning (ML) and deep learning concepts, including supervised and unsupervised learning, reinforcement learning, neural networks, and AI/ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Hugging Face.
  • Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Small Language Models (SLMs), and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), including prompt engineering, embeddings, fine-tuning, model inference, and resource-efficient AI deployment in Linux or embedded environments.
  • Basic knowledge of Linux/UNIX system administration and server management.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. A Master's degree or Ph.D. is considered an asset.

The Canada base salary range for this full-time position is expected to be between $94,000- $115,000 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.

Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee & Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. We offer competitive Paid Time Off and flexible leave policies, including paid health days, to help you take care of yourself and your family members.

All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
Key Responsibilities:
Business Analysis & Solution Design
  • You will engage stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational requirements and customer needs, and translate them into clear business, functional and technical requirements.
  • You will perform impact assessments, analyse business processes, document user stories and acceptance criteria, and review solution designs to ensure proposed solutions meet business, operational and technical objectives.
  • You will work closely with technical teams and vendors to ensure requirements are accurately interpreted and effectively implemented.
Data Replication & Integration Services
  • You will support enterprise data replication and data exchange services that facilitate the movement of data across multiple source and consuming systems.
  • You will analyse replication requirements, review source and target data structures, identify dependencies and assess the impact of system, application and database changes on existing data flows.
  • You will work closely with database administrators and vendors to support replication technologies such as Oracle GoldenGate, troubleshoot replication issues, investigate data discrepancies and ensure data consistency across systems.
  • You will also support the onboarding of new data integrations, review interface specifications, validate data mappings and facilitate end-to-end testing of data exchange services.
Platform Enhancement & Modernisation
  • You will contribute to the enhancement and modernisation of enterprise platforms and digital services by identifying opportunities to improve system capabilities, scalability, resilience and operational efficiency.
  • You will evaluate solution options, support technical assessments and participate in initiatives involving application modernisation, integration improvements, cloud adoption and service optimisation.
Testing & Release Management
  • You will coordinate SIT, UAT, integration testing and production verification activities.
  • You will develop test scenarios, validate business requirements and ensure solutions are thoroughly assessed before implementation.
  • You will support deployment planning, implementation activities and post-deployment validation.
Production Support & Operational Excellence
  • You will support production operations across enterprise applications, integration services and data platforms.
  • You will investigate incidents, perform impact assessments, facilitate root cause analysis and coordinate resolution efforts across technical teams and vendors.
  • You will identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities to strengthen service reliability, operational resilience and data quality.
Security, Compliance & Governance
  • You will support audits, security reviews, vulnerability remediation activities and compliance assessments.
  • You will work with application, infrastructure and security teams to ensure systems comply with applicable ICT policies, security standards and operational requirements.
Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  • You will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, vendors and technical teams.
  • You will facilitate discussions, coordinate delivery activities, manage risks and issues, and ensure successful implementation of technology solutions.
Documentation & Knowledge Management
  • You will maintain business requirements, solution specifications, integration documentation, operational procedures and support guides.
  • You will ensure documentation remains complete, accurate and current to support ongoing support and maintenance activities.
Additional:
  • The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex business and technical problems across interconnected enterprise systems. You are comfortable analysing system dependencies, understanding data flows and integrations, and investigating issues spanning applications, databases, APIs and infrastructure layers.
  • You possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills and are able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are confident working with database administrators, developers, infrastructure engineers and vendors to drive issues to resolution.
  • Experience supporting enterprise data platforms, Oracle databases, Oracle GoldenGate replication environments, data exchanges, system integrations or large-scale production support environments will be highly advantageous.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing digital services or working within a government technology environment will be an added advantage.
Requirements
  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, Application Support, Integration Services or Enterprise Data Platforms.
  • Strong experience in requirements gathering, stakeholder engagement and solution analysis.
  • Good understanding of Oracle databases, data structures, SQL queries and database concepts.
  • Experience supporting enterprise applications, system integrations, data exchange platforms or customer-facing digital services.
  • Experience coordinating SIT, UAT, deployment activities and production support.
  • Understanding of RESTful APIs, web services, API authentication methods and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Familiarity with Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), data replication technologies or change data capture solutions.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Git or similar collaboration and delivery tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevOps and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with AWS, Government Commercial Cloud (GCC), monitoring platforms or integration middleware will be advantageous.
  • Experience supporting technology audits and penetration tests, including gathering evidence, responding to audit queries, and coordinating with relevant technical teams.
  • Experience with data migration, reconciliation, validation and data quality management.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity principles, vulnerability management and secure application delivery practices.
  • Understanding of the container lifecycle and Kubernetes-based application environments, including image management, deployment, configuration, release, and promotion across environments.
  • Understanding of network and infrastructure components, including servers, firewalls, reverse proxies, load balancers, DNS, ports, protocols, and connectivity.
  • Understanding of RHEL-based operating systems, including basic system administration, configuration, log analysis, file management, and troubleshooting.

title: Principal R&D Engineer - Fire Hazards, Investigations, and Failure Analyses
description:
The UL Solutions Research and Development team is seeking an experienced Principal Engineer to lead activities in advanced fire and explosion engineering analyses, failure analyses, and post-incident fact-finding investigations. Many of these initiatives will focus on solving client problems related to fire and explosion hazards in energy industries, including energy storage and renewables. The abilities to initiate, scope and execute complex client projects, to guide and mentor team members and colleagues in completing these projects, and to provide professional review of official deliverable documents are central to this role. A successful candidate will be creative, curious, adaptable to a fast-paced and multi-disciplined environment and willing to work collaboratively with a team of other engineers, scientists and technicians to solve complex problems.

  • Initiate, plan and execute client projects primarily in the areas of fire and explosion protection engineering analysis including failure analysis, cause-and-origin analysis, and fact-finding investigations.
  • Carry out engineering analyses using combinations of numerical simulation, field data, and test data inputs.
  • Mentor and guide team members and colleagues for larger client project initiatives.
  • Complete formal technical reports of work completed, including all information and details about strategy, approach and outcome.
  • Provide professional engineering review and, where appropriate, signature for key client deliverables.
  • Work across industries / segments, collaborate with key stakeholders, and provide timeline communications to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Stay ahead of changing technologies in the field by reading journals and scientific publications, attending academic conferences, writing, and collaborating on original publications, and delivering presentations.
  • Interprets internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services.
  • Where appropriate, present project results and findings at academic and industry conferences.
  • Degree in mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, fire protection engineering, explosion protection engineering or other relevant discipline is required. MS or PhD preferred.
  • MS or PhD requires additional 12+ years of relevant work experience. BS requires additional 15+ years of relevant work experience.
  • Certified fire and explosion investigator (CFEI) certification and experience in field evaluations of fires and failure events is required.
  • Professional engineering licensure in the state of Illinois is required. Licensure in additional states is preferred.
  • Preferred professional experience includes:
    • Professional engineering consulting experience in fire protection engineering, explosion protection engineering, process safety engineering, or industrial engineering
    • Familiarity with laboratory and physical testing environments
    • Familiarity with power generation and distribution systems - including generators, power electronics, transformers, and high-voltage breakers
    • Familiarity with building and fire codes
    • General familiarity with computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis and finite-element analysis (FEA) techniques.
  • Excellent communication and technical writing skills are required.
  • Ability to work independently but also having a team player mindset, giving priority to team goals and maintaining good team relationships, is required.

What you’ll experience working for ULS

UL Solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. From day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. Our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. We break things, burn things and blow things up. All in the name of safety science.

That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. It takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. It takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.

This is more than a job. It’s a calling. A passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. As a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.

Everyone here is unique. But we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. Join UL Solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.

Empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. It means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. At UL Solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.

Join UL Solutions to be at the center of safety. To learn more about us and the work we do, visit

title: Sanitation Worker (Yuma, AZ) Seasonal

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this position. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

title: Make a Real Difference with a Simple Walk – Walking companion, North Turramurra
description:
Do you have an hour to spare each week and enjoy being outdoors?

We are looking for a caring and reliable volunteer to accompany one of our residents on walks in her wheelchair around the local area.


For this resident, spending time outside is one of life's greatest pleasures. Being outside in the fresh air and sunshine brings her enormous joy and make a significant difference to her wellbeing.

Following a stroke, her communication has become more limited, but she still enjoys company and connection. A friendly smile, shared observations, and simply being present can help build a meaningful relationship.


No experience is necessary. Full training, support, and orientation will be provided.


What you'll do:

  • Take a resident for regular wheelchair walks in the local community

  • Provide companionship and social connection

  • Help bring enjoyment, stimulation, and a sense of freedom to her day

  • Make a genuine difference


What we're looking for:

  • A friendly and compassionate person

  • Someone comfortable engaging with older people

  • Reliability and a positive attitude


This is a simple role that will have a big impact. Your time and companionship could become the highlight of someone's week.



Your impact

Volunteering as a social visitor can be a rewarding experience, both for the person you visit as well as yourself. Regular visits from volunteers can help to improve quality of life and help people feel less isolated.




HammondCare

HammondCare is an independent Christian charity and we're passionate about improving the quality of life for people in need. We have a wonderful group of volunteers that partner with us to enhance the lives of people cared for by HammondCare.

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.



Further information

Thank you for expressing an interest in volunteering with HammondCare.


We truly love connecting with people who want to volunteer with us. Our team will reach out with a phone call or text as soon as we can, and if we’re unable to get through, we’ll follow up with an email. Please take a moment to check your spam or junk folder as well, as some email providers don’t always recognise our messages right away.


More information on volunteering with HammondCare can be found at




If you have any questions, you can call Dani, our friendly Volunteer Recruitment Coordinator on 1800 79 33 99.



Requirements

Monday or Wednesday between 10:30-11:30am (weekly or fortnightly visits welcome).

Role and cottage placement suited to applicants aged 18 years and over.

NDIS Worker Screening Check (if you do not currently hold a valid clearance, we will arrange and cover the cost of obtaining one as part of the onboarding process).

title: Senior BI Analyst — Finance, AI Enabled
description:
Primary Function of Position

We are seeking an experienced Senior BI Analyst to support the design and delivery of Finance reporting, analytics, data products, and process-improvement solutions. Working closely with the Finance Product Owner, this role will serve as an onsite analytical partner to Finance stakeholders and a key link between business, application, data engineering, and reporting teams.

The ideal candidate combines Finance and ERP process knowledge with strong SQL, data analysis, and business intelligence capabilities. Operating at the intersection of business logic and data engineering, you will understand complex business processes, trace data lineage across systems, investigate discrepancies, and translate business needs into clear reporting models and technical requirements. You will design and deliver trusted dashboards, BI data models, operational monitoring, and self-service analytics while evaluating practical automation and AI-assisted analytics opportunities (deep AI/ML engineering experience is not required).

Essential Job Duties

  • Technical Translation & Requirements Gathering: Partner with the Finance Product Owner and Finance stakeholders to understand business processes, controls, and reporting needs. Translate business needs into functional and data requirements, business rules, report specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • BI Design & Solution Delivery: Design, build, and maintain Finance dashboards, published data sources, BI data models, operational reports, and self-service analytics solutions using Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms.
  • Lineage, Reconciliation & Root-Cause Analysis: Analyze end-to-end processes and data flows across ERP (SAP), CRM, billing, data warehouse, and reporting platforms. Use advanced SQL and analytical tools to reconcile data, validate business rules, investigate discrepancies, and identify root causes.
  • Performance Tuning & Reporting Reliability: Optimize dashboard usability, query performance, data refresh schedules, metric consistency, and overall reporting reliability.
  • Delivery Leadership & Governance: Lead assigned workstreams through requirements, solution design, UAT, regression testing, reconciliation, implementation readiness, and stakeholder sign-off. Maintain data definitions, reporting specifications, test evidence, user guides, and governance documentation.
  • Internal Controls & Quality Monitoring: Support automated monitoring, exception management, data-quality controls, and financially significant/SOX-governed reporting processes.
  • Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration: Collaborate with application, Data Engineering, Data Science, AI, and platform teams while coordinating and reviewing deliverables across distributed onsite and offshore resources.
  • Applied AI & Automation Evaluation: Evaluate and support opportunities to implement intelligent alerts, natural-language analytics, AI-assisted analysis, and workflow automation within core Finance processes.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, Finance analytics, reporting, business systems analysis, or enterprise data solutions.
  • ERP & Finance Domain: Experience with SAP or another enterprise ERP platform, including strong understanding of Finance-related processes and cross-system data flows.
  • Advanced SQL Mastery: Expert-level SQL skills for complex querying, source-to-target reconciliation, data troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and query performance optimization.
  • Enterprise BI Platforms: Strong hands-on experience designing dashboards, BI data models, calculated metrics, published data sources, and self-service solutions in Tableau, Power BI, or a comparable enterprise analytics platform.
  • Data Architecture Fundamentals: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, semantic layers, data quality, lineage, and visualization best practices.
  • Delivery & Testing Leadership: Demonstrated experience translating business needs into technical specifications and leading UAT, regression testing, issue resolution, and business-readiness activities.
  • Communication & Influence: Proven ability to communicate complex business, system, and data topics to technical teams, Finance stakeholders, and senior leadership without direct authority.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with SAP Finance, Salesforce, CPQ/CLM, billing, or revenue-management platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or another modern cloud data platform.
  • Experience supporting financially significant applications, internal controls, or SOX-governed reporting.
  • Familiarity with data governance, master data management (MDM), metadata, lineage, and data-quality frameworks.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted analytics, natural-language querying, intelligent monitoring, Snowflake Cortex, or comparable emerging technologies.
  • Experience coordinating and reviewing work with distributed onsite and offshore analysts or consultants.

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Business Analytics, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.

What Success Looks Like

  • Develops a strong understanding of Finance processes, ERP applications, system integrations, critical data models, and reporting dependencies.
  • Establishes effective translation and validation practices between Finance stakeholders and technical delivery teams, serving as a trusted onsite partner.
  • Delivers accurate, intuitive, and performant dashboards and BI solutions that stakeholders trust for day-to-day decision-making and operational reviews.
  • Independently uses SQL and analytical tools to reconcile data across systems, trace transformations, validate business rules, and identify root causes.
  • Improves reporting reliability and governance, expanding exception monitoring, data-quality controls, metric consistency, and self-service analytics adoption.
  • Helps Finance teams adopt automation and AI-assisted analytics where they provide measurable business value and practical process improvements.

Why This Role Matters

Staff Product Managers, AI are the bridge between what enterprise AI can actually do and what we actually ship at Robots and Pencils. On the engagements you lead, you set the direction, frame the right problems, and make the multi-model architecture and evals trade-off calls that decide whether the AI product is production-grade or just a demo. We ship production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days; that pace holds only when someone keeps the customer in the room, sweats the details that decide whether agents survive contact with real users, and refuses to let demo-grade speed beat production-grade clarity.

What You’ll Do

Craft & Delivery

  • Define and drive the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for GenAI and agentic AI solutions, connecting AI capabilities to enterprise business outcomes with explicit invest vs. defer tradeoffs
  • Research how enterprise users interact with AI agents and where they lose trust — frame the riskiest assumptions as testable hypotheses and de-risk them first
  • Drive multi-model architecture tradeoffs with engineering — define the quality, cost, and latency targets that determine which model serves each step in the agent workflow
  • Define and own agent behavior end-to-end — system prompts, tool schemas, context management (summarization, working memory, information flow across multi-step tasks), human-in-the-loop boundaries, guardrails, and failure recovery patterns — partnering with engineering on the design decisions that shape how agents actually behave in production
  • Build AI prototypes to validate hypotheses and de-risk product decisions before engineering commits to full build
  • Own backlog management and sprint execution day-to-day across the engagement — prioritizing across multiple AI workstreams, refining agent behavior and requirements with engineering, and keeping the team moving at production pace.
  • Establish and own agent evaluation frameworks covering task completion, reasoning quality, tool selection, failure recovery, safety, and responsible AI — and partner with engineering on production readiness, including observability, drift detection, and prompt versioning
  • Define agent-level success metrics spanning quality, cost, and trust — such as task completion rate, cost per task (not per inference), and escalation rate
  • Define the metrics framework including north star, input, and guardrail metrics at the initiative level and report product impact to leadership
  • Create deployment playbooks, reference architectures, and knowledge transfer materials so teams can sustain solutions independently after engagement
  • Balance near-term deployment milestones with long-term platform scalability and sustainability
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot — and agentic frameworks as a core part of how product strategy gets built and validated (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, AWS Strands)

Collaboration & Communication

  • Build trusted relationships with client executives and serve as the go-to product advisor and primary contact for AI product direction and deployment strategy
  • Partner with AWS solution architects and account teams to align on technical approach, service selection, and go-to-market for GenAI solutions
  • Manage expectations on scope, timelines, and tradeoffs — facilitate decisions across competing priorities using data, alternatives, and clear rationale
  • Frame AI capabilities and limitations for non-technical stakeholders, manage hype cycles, and set realistic expectations at the executive level

Leadership & Influence

  • Establish AI product delivery standards, evals practices, and agent design patterns on the engagements you support
  • Mentor senior and mid-level AI PMs, helping them grow their technical depth, product judgment, and client advisory skills
  • Own the most difficult AI product decisions on your engagement, serving as the senior decision-maker on scope, prioritization, HITL boundaries, and what's good enough to ship
  • Monitor the competitive GenAI landscape and emerging agentic patterns to continuously inform roadmap and technology decisions
  • Contribute to business development, proposals, and the growth of R&P's AI product practice

What You’ll Bring

  • 8+ years in product management, forward deployment, or solutions engineering — must have shipped AI products from prototype through production at enterprise scale
  • Strong product sense — ability to identify what matters to users and the business, make prioritization calls with incomplete information, and shape products that deliver real outcomes.
  • Ability to read and engage deeply with code (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript), evaluate architectures, and make product tradeoffs on complex technical constraints
  • Deep GenAI fluency across LLMs, RAG, fine-tuning, prompt engineering, context engineering, and evals — with hands-on experience building or shipping agentic systems including planning, tool use, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails
  • Proven ability to prototype AI solutions using AI tools to validate hypotheses and de-risk product decisions (e.g., Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot)
  • PM-level fluency across the AWS AI ecosystem (e.g., Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker, Strands, Kendra, OpenSearch, Lambda, Step Functions)
  • Expert experience designing and owning evals frameworks for production AI systems
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills including clear PRDs, technical specs, and decision logs
  • Track record of driving alignment with Directors, VPs, and C-level stakeholders on AI product direction
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where the AI landscape evolves weekly
  • Software engineering background (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript), agency or consulting delivery experience, or experience in Financial Services, Healthcare, or Life Sciences is a plus
  • Experience contributing to business development, proposals, or AI practice growth is a plus

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Production experience with open-source LLMs and the trade-offs that shape enterprise model selection.
  • Exposure to multi-modal AI (vision, voice, or document AI) in addition to text-based agents.
  • Emerging voice in the AI product community (writing, speaking, or open-source contributions) that builds external pull for the firm.
  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing.

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.
  • Built for AI's messy reality. You expect non-determinism, you know the gap between a demo and a deployable system, and you'd rather kill a beautiful prototype than ship something that won't survive contact with real users.

title: Microsoft 365 Engineer
description:
WHAT'S THE ROLE

Microsoft 365 is more than a set of tools. It’s where people collaborate, share knowledge, automate work and increasingly use AI to get things done.

You’ll take ownership of the administration and continuous improvement of our Microsoft 365 environment, with a focus on SharePoint Online, Microsoft Copilot, Intune, Entra ID, collaboration services and automation.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

You’re an experienced Microsoft 365 professional who enjoys being hands-on with the technology while thinking beyond configuration to security, governance, user experience and business impact. You’re comfortable solving complex problems, working independently and explaining technical concepts to both technical and business audiences.

  • A degree or diploma in IT, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

title: Sr. Real Estate Risk Reviewer
description:
Perform independent commercial real estate appraisal reviews on high complexity/risk properties. The Senior Risk Reviewer will be assigned to larger exposure, more complex collateral typically resulting in greater risk to Citizens, whereby the reliance on experience is critical to identify major issues to protect the bank’s collateral position. Ascertain compliance of appraisal reports with the applicable Citizens scope of work and federal regulatory requirements and guidance including, but not limited to:

  • Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989 (FIRREA; 12 USC §3331, et seq.) and the implementing regulations promulgated thereunder by the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) at 12 CFR Part 34 (“Real Estate Lending and Appraisals”)

  • “Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal Practice” (USPAP);

  • “Interagency Appraisal and Evaluation Guidelines” (“Interagency Guidelines”), dated December 2010, issued by OCC as periodically supplemented by Financial Institution Letters; and,

  • “OCC Comptroller’s Handbook: Commercial Real Estate Lending,” by the OCC, dated August 2013 (OCC Bulletin 2013-19).

Responsibilities

  • Manage risks associated with the commercial real estate appraisal and evaluation process for a given geographic market and/or assigned lending groups
  • Supervisory responsibilities may include administrative supervision and required process oversight, including adherence to internal policies and procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and appraisal industry requirements for assignments
  • Real estate risk identification, quantification and consulting (including discounted cash flow (DCF) analysis) for the various commercial lending and credit functions throughout Citizens

title: Product Manager, Digital Tech Support
description:
Primary Function of Position

The Product Manager, Digital Technical Support will play a role in Global Service innovation by defining service capability and service software solution strategy for our Digital Technical Support (DTS) team. To do so, they will work closely with the DTS team, Services Product Management counterparts, Global Services and Commercial Leadership, Product Support Engineering, Technical Solutions Consultants, Digital Implementation leadership, Technical Support Engineering, cross-functional software development teams, Intuitive Distributor Service leadership, and other critical global stakeholders. They will conduct market research, gather internal feedback, identify unmet customer and DTS needs, and design new or incremental improvements to Intuitive’s DTS capabilities, delivery mechanisms, and processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to both the Global Services’ goals and the goals of the product teams.

Essential Job Duties

  • Operate as the Product Manager for DTS, partnering with critical business partners and stakeholders, to drive DTS innovation and ensure efficient, scalable, and customer-centric methods for supporting Intuitive’s digital product portfolio
  • Maintain deep expertise regarding current methods for DTS service delivery to build a clear picture of the pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities to evolve aligned support capabilities
  • Translate DTS feedback, customer insights, and market research into roadmaps that align customer outcomes, the desired DTS experience, and business goals
  • Develop user/product requirements for existing and planned service solutions/software
  • Partner with software engineering, interaction design engineering, human factors engineering, and other internal partners to drive improvements to software used for service delivery, improving efficiency and the customer experience.
  • Develop business cases for developing new features, capabilities, and service technology that demonstrate desirability, viability, feasibility, and ROI for the proposed solution. Partner with leadership to secure support and funding from relevant stakeholders and leadership.
  • Support Global Services and product development as a DTS subject matter expert
  • Engage with the DTS team during product launches to gather, prioritize, and action feedback for DTS service solutions/software
  • Engage in conferences, customer visits, job shadowing, and other relevant activities to build and maintain subject matter expertise and familiarity with DTS, customer needs, and strategic opportunities
  • Partner with leadership to conduct market research, as needed, to test hypotheses and support DTS needs with customer experience data
  • Develop and track goals for identified priorities. Partner with leadership to ensure goals are aligned to business unit goals and corporate objectives.
  • Perform other aligned duties as specified by Global Services Leadership

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years professional experience in product management, digital product support, digital product/software engineering, software quality engineering, or equivalent role
  • Experience with product management, continuous improvement initiatives, Lean/Six Sigma, or equivalent
  • Critical thinking skills, attention to detail, and experience with data-driven decision making
  • Formal or informal leadership of cross-functional teams to implement/launch key initiatives
  • Experience building business cases, using qualitative and quantitative data, to secure funding, resources, project/program support, and contribute to budget planning/negotiations
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to develop and present impactful presentations on complex topics for cross-functional audiences (internal and external), director/VP-level leadership, and global stakeholders
  • Strong results orientation, organizational skills, and project management skills; able to prioritize and manage multiple initiatives and deadlines with attention to detail
  • Experience investigating and defining complex problems prior to solution development
  • Experience with market research, voice of customer feedback, voice of service feedback, or equivalent
  • Self-directed with awareness to proactively seek advice when needed
  • Strong knowledge of the MS Office product suite

title: IT Network Administrator
description:
About the role

An IT Network Administrator designs, implements, manages, configures, secures and maintains an organization's IT infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, and servers and data communications systems. They are crucial for maintaining connectivity and data sharing within an organization by installing, configuring, monitoring, and upgrading network infrastructure.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, WLAN and VPN infrastructure, including routers, switches, and VLANs

  • Plan and establish network infrastructure, including physical setup, hardware, and software

  • Routinely check network performance, conduct maintenance, and perform upgrades for hardware and software

  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve network issues to ensure minimal downtime and efficient operation

  • Monitor network performance and traffic for suspicious activity, ensuring proactive threat mitigation

  • Implement and maintain security protocols, configure firewalls, manage content filtering, and adjust security permissions to protect against cyber threats

  • Install, configure, and manage network components like routers, switches, servers, and various network software applications

  • Provide technical assistance to users and deliver training on network systems and security protocols

  • Maintain accurate records of network documentation and configurations

About you

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field

  • At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in network administration, IT infrastructure, or systems administration

  • Proven experience designing, implementing, and maintaining LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN, and VLAN environments

  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing network devices, including routers, switches, firewalls, wireless access points, and network appliances

  • Experience with network monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting using industry-standard monitoring tools

  • Knowledge of network security best practices, including firewall management, VPN configuration, intrusion prevention, endpoint security, and access control

  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to provide technical support and collaborate with cross-functional teams

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment

  • Must have experience in Fortigate and POS

title: Hackers wanted – Software Engineers (m/f/d) (Anwendungsprogrammierer/in)
description:
ABOUT THE JOB

- Your responsibility: From day one, you’ll own your stories and take end-to-end responsibility for your tasks.
- Your team: You'll work in a small team of no more than five full-stack engineers. Like this, our teams are more efficient and can move fast.
- Your work: You’ll be involved in the entire software engineering lifecycle of your project - from product requirements and design to testing, deployment and operations. You’ll see how people actually use what you build and continuously improve it based on user feedback and real usage data.
- Your projects: We partner with clients across all industries who trust us with their most challenging software problems. We take full ownership from the first idea to the final roll-out. You’re not joining a client team as an extra pair of hands - you’re part of the team responsible for solving the problem. We don’t do body leasing.
- Your impact: You will contribute to some of the largest, business-critical and most demanding software projects in Europe.
- Your perspective: No matter your experience, everyone starts as a newbie and passes through all of our engineering levels. From owning small to medium feature sets to being responsible for the whole codebase. Here you can learn how to build and run large-scale software systems – and grow into a full-stack software engineer.
- Your community: You’ll work with smart, like-minded people who care about what they do and the people around them. With over 300 people across our Hamburg and Lisbon hubs, we work hard, support each other, and make sure to create a work environment where you can become the best version of yourself.

We are a company for engineers by engineers. Most of your time is spent solving problems with like-minded people, writing software and working together with your team in our beautiful offices in the heart of Hamburg & Lisbon.

We expect a lot. It's not easy. But we guarantee you it will be fun.

ABOUT YOU

Qualifications:

- A degree: Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a closely related field.
- Problem solving: We hire our members for their problem-solving abilities, not specific programming languages. We value strong engineering fundamentals, analytical thinking, and the ability to turn complex ideas into working code. We believe: if you know how to code, debug, and solve complex problems, you can learn any language. We hire smart engineers, not language specialists.
- A genuine curiosity for programming: Whether through interesting pet projects, hackathons, competitive programming.
- A habit of stepping outside your comfort zone: Whether through competitive tutoring, scholarships, or even competitive sports, anything else where you pushed yourself and grew from it.

Bonus skills or interests:

- Algorithms and data structures, understanding time & space complexity
- Experience in Go, Kotlin, TypeScript or JavaScript
- Experience in front end development, like ReactJS, Angular, Vue or Flutter/Dart
- Functional programming with Common Lisp, Clojure or Haskell
- Experience working with distributed systems in the Cloud
- Experience in Machine Learning and Data Science

title: Claims Director
description:
This is a role focused on technical claim handling for Chubb’s Commercial Direct Handle Claims Team. In this role you will manage auto and general liability claims, both litigated and non-litigated, under both primary and excess policies. This role requires an individual to be accountable for the handling and disposition of claims including investigation, coverage determination, reserving, negotiation and settlement or trial strategies. This position will require some travel, as well as coordinating with and servicing both internal and external business partners. You will represent the company at meetings with management and business partners, as well as at mediations, arbitrations, settlement conferences and trials.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage an inventory of claims involving moderate severity exposures and coverage issues.

  • Conduct, coordinate, and direct investigation into loss facts, damages and risk transfer opportunities.

  • Evaluate coverage, liability, and damages to determine the exposure to the insured and the policy.

  • Analyze coverage and communicate coverage positions, as warranted, within assigned authority.

  • Demonstrate and implement effective defense, resolution and claim strategies.

  • Provide superior customer service to insureds, agents, and internal business partners.

  • Adhere to Best Practices Guidelines.

  • Adhere to individual authority grants, all statutory and regulatory requirements, fair claim practices and local compliance requirements, including examiner licensing.

  • Travels to conferences, mediations, and trials as necessary.

  • Seven or more years of experience as a casualty claim professional with a high degree of specialized and technical competence in the handling of high exposure construction claims with emphasis on hands-on file and litigation management.

  • Experience with primary and excess bodily injury, property damage, and personal injury claims.

  • Strong background and demonstrated ability in dealing with significant coverage matters.

  • Working knowledge of industry best practices and procedures.

  • An ability to work independently and assimilate learning materials on many different subjects from various sources.

  • Excellent interpersonal communications and negotiation skills; and an ability to deal with customers and business partners in a professional manner.

  • Ability to make prompt, intelligent decisions based upon detailed analyses of complex issues.

  • Demonstrated strong relational skills particularly in adverse or high-pressure situations.

  • A law degree is not necessary but helpful.

Who are we looking for?

Successful professionals at Chubb come from many backgrounds with experiences rich in diversity that they bring with them to our company along with:

  • an inclusive mindset which allows differences to be leveraged for better business results;

  • open, transparent communication;

  • teamwork and inclusion which draws on diverse ideas and perspectives; and

  • new ideas, innovation, and ways of thinking which support diversity.

title: EPM Analyst
description:
Hyperion Finance Analyst (EPM) Position Summary

The EPM Analyst is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and maintaining Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions that enable budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, workforce planning, and management reporting. This role partners closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, and IT teams to ensure EPM applications are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise, financial process knowledge, analytical rigor, and a continuous improvement mindset. This individual is expected to demonstrate GEM behaviors by identifying opportunities that improve business performance, taking ownership of outcomes, and elevating the effectiveness of teams through collaboration, knowledge sharing, and problem-solving.

Key Responsibilities

Application Support & Administration

  • Provide day-to-day support for EPM applications and business users, ensuring reliable system performance and timely issue resolution.
  • Monitor application health and proactively identify risks, root causes, and corrective actions.
  • Manage application metadata, dimensions, security, and user provisioning with a high degree of accuracy and accountability.
  • Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual planning cycles while ensuring business commitments and deadlines are met.
  • Act as a trusted owner of assigned EPM processes, continuously seeking opportunities to improve reliability and user experience. Business Process Support

Business Process Support

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and financial close processes that enable data-driven business decisions.
  • Partner with Finance and FP&A stakeholders to understand evolving business needs and identify opportunities to improve planning effectiveness.
  • Analyze business processes and recommend automation, standardization, and efficiency improvements.
  • Utilize financial and operational insights to support better resource allocation, forecasting accuracy, and business performance.
  • Document business requirements and functional specifications that align technology solutions with business outcomes.

Development & Configuration

  • Configure planning forms, dashboards, business rules, and reports to meet business requirements.
  • Develop and maintain calculation scripts, automation routines, and workflow improvements.
  • Support integrations between EPM, ERP, Data Warehouse, and reporting environments.
  • Perform impact analysis, testing, and validation for system enhancements, upgrades, and patches.
  • Make sound decisions using data and business judgment while balancing short-term needs and long-term sustainability.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain financial reports, Smart View templates, and management dashboards that provide actionable business insights.
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of financial reporting across platforms.
  • Support ad hoc analysis for Finance leadership and business partners.
  • Translate complex financial and system data into clear recommendations that improve decision-making and business outcomes.
  • Challenge existing processes and identify innovative ways to improve reporting efficiency and stakeholder value

Data Management & Integration

  • Manage data loads, data validation, and reconciliation processes.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and collaborate across teams to resolve root causes.
  • Ensure data integrity across interconnected systems and reporting environments.
  • Develop sustainable solutions that improve data quality, transparency, and operational efficiency.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Perform unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Validate system enhancements, bug fixes, and process improvements before deployment.
  • Document test plans, outcomes, and lessons learned.
  • Share knowledge, best practices, and expertise with business users and team members to improve organizational capability.
  • Foster strong cross-functional partnerships by collaborating effectively and supporting successful adoption of new solutions.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 3-7 years of experience supporting Enterprise Performance Management solutions.
  • Experience with:
    • Oracle EPM Cloud (EPBCS/PBCS)
    • Hyperion Planning
    • Smart View
    • Financial Reporting
    • Data Management / Data Integration
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Budgeting and Forecasting
    • Financial Statements
    • Financial Planning Processes
    • Management Reporting
  • Experience collaborating with Finance and Accounting organizations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes through collaboration rather than authority.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation).

title: Training Experience Supervisor
description:
The Training Experience Supervisor (TES) works under the direction of the Training & Onboarding Specialist and serves as a leader in staff development, Behavioral Skills Training (BST), compliance monitoring, workforce development, employee relations support, and training operations at Essential Behavioral Support, Inc. (EBSI).

This position requires active certification as a Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst (BCaBA) in good standing with the Behavior Analyst Certification Board (BACB), or BCBA Trainee

The TES is responsible for overseeing the daily training experience of employees from onboarding through ongoing professional development. This position supervises trainees during office-based onboarding, facilitates agency-required trainings, evaluates employee competency, maintains regulatory compliance, and provides behavioral coaching and training support within residential programs as needed.

The TES also assists with agency audits and quality assurance reviews, including evaluations of client care environments, client-related documentation, residential home upkeep, employee records, training compliance, and operational practices. This position may assist leadership with employee relations matters, workplace investigations, performance concerns, and workers’ compensation matters while maintaining professionalism, objectivity, and confidentiality.

The TES supports employee performance through competency-based instruction, performance feedback, and data-driven staff development. The TES works collaboratively with Program Administrators, supervising BCBAs, consultants, and agency leadership to ensure employees are trained, supported, and equipped to provide high-quality, person-centered services.

In addition, the TES serves as the primary on-site coordinator for the training office, ensuring a professional, organized, and welcoming environment while supporting EBSI’s mission of developing a highly competent workforce.

EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND WORKPLACE SUPPORT

  • Assist agency leadership with employee relations matters, including workplace concerns, performance issues, policy compliance, and corrective action processes.
  • Participate in fact-finding meetings and workplace investigations as assigned.
  • Gather, organize, and maintain relevant records, statements, training documentation, and supporting materials related to employee matters.
  • Provide objective information and documentation to agency leadership while maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
  • Assist with employee coaching, performance improvement plans, retraining, and follow-up competency assessments.
  • Support employees and supervisors in understanding agency expectations, policies, procedures, and professional standards.
  • Identify recurring employee performance concerns and recommend appropriate training or workforce-development interventions.
  • Maintain professional boundaries and avoid making independent employment decisions unless specifically authorized by agency leadership.

WORKERS’ COMPENSATION SUPPORT

  • Assist agency leadership with workers’ compensation matters and return-to-work processes.
  • Support timely reporting and documentation of workplace injuries, illnesses, and occupational incidents.
  • Gather incident reports, witness statements, training records, schedules, and other documentation related to workers’ compensation claims.
  • Assist with communication and coordination involving injured employees, supervisors, medical providers, and workers’ compensation representatives, as authorized.
  • Support the development, documentation, and monitoring of temporary modified-duty assignments.
  • Assist in reviewing workplace incidents to identify training needs, environmental risks, and opportunities for injury prevention.
  • Maintain the confidentiality of medical, personnel, and workers’ compensation information.
  • Ensure all workers’ compensation support activities are completed in accordance with EBSI procedures and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

AUDITS, CLIENT UPKEEP, AND QUALITY ASSURANCE

  • Assist with internal audits, regulatory reviews, and quality assurance inspections involving residential programs, employee records, training compliance, and client services.
  • Conduct routine reviews of residential homes and client environments to ensure cleanliness, organization, safety, and appropriate upkeep.
  • Review client bedrooms, common areas, kitchens, bathrooms, outdoor spaces, vehicles, and other service environments for health, safety, and maintenance concerns.
  • Verify that client belongings, clothing, hygiene supplies, adaptive equipment, and personal-care items are appropriately maintained and available.
  • Review client records and program documentation for completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with agency and regulatory requirements.
  • Identify missing, expired, incomplete, or inconsistent documentation and communicate corrective-action needs to the appropriate Program Administrator or agency leader.
  • Assist with reviewing medication areas, emergency supplies, food storage, sanitation practices, and other operational systems within the scope of the position.
  • Document audit findings and assist Program Administrators with developing and monitoring corrective-action plans.
  • Conduct follow-up reviews to verify that identified concerns have been corrected within required timeframes.
  • Assist with preparation for Community Care Licensing, Regional Center, DDS, and other regulatory inspections.
  • Monitor client environments for evidence of person-centered care, dignity, privacy, safety, and appropriate access to personal belongings and preferred activities.
  • Immediately report health, safety, abuse, neglect, exploitation, or regulatory concerns in accordance with mandated-reporting requirements and EBSI policies.
  • Analyze audit findings, incident trends, and program data to identify opportunities for retraining, risk reduction, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Collaborate with Program Administrators, consultants, Human Resources, and agency leadership to address identified compliance and operational concerns.
  • Step into a Direct Support Professional (DSP), Lead Staff, or in another assigned support capacity when needed to maintain client health, safety, supervision, and continuity of services. Provide emergency, short-term, or scheduled staffing coverage based on client needs and EBSI’s operational requirements.

ADDITIONS TO KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of employee relations practices, workplace investigations, and performance-management processes.
  • General knowledge of workers’ compensation reporting, documentation, modified-duty coordination, and return-to-work processes.
  • Ability to conduct objective audits, environmental reviews, and program observations.
  • Ability to review client and employee documentation for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to identify health, safety, maintenance, training, and operational concerns.
  • Ability to prepare clear audit findings, corrective-action recommendations, and follow-up documentation.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality regarding personnel, medical, client, and workers’ compensation information.
  • Ability to remain neutral, professional, and objective when assisting with employee relations or workplace investigations.
  • Ability to communicate sensitive concerns professionally and appropriately to employees, supervisors, Human Resources, and agency leadership.

ADDITIONS TO EXPERIENCE

  • Experience participating in internal audits, residential program reviews, quality assurance activities, or regulatory inspections preferred.
  • Experience reviewing client-care environments, client documentation, employee records, or regulatory compliance preferred.
  • Experience supporting employee relations, workplace investigations, performance improvement, or corrective-action processes preferred.
  • Experience assisting with workplace injury documentation, modified-duty assignments, workers’ compensation matters, or return-to-work coordination preferred.

title: Production Scheduler (4049)
description:
Power a Sustainable Future with Us

At Sunlight Batteries USA, we are driven by a shared purpose: to deliver innovative energy solutions that improve lives and protect the environment. Our team is passionate about advancing battery technology and energy storage systems that power industries and communities around the world.

Your Impact

As Sunlight Batteries USA continues to strengthen and develop its Planning organization, the Production Scheduler will play an important role in improving production visibility, execution, and coordination across our manufacturing operations.

In this role, you will serve as a key extension of the Planning team by supporting the day-to-day execution and maintenance of production schedules, analyzing operational data, monitoring schedule performance, and helping ensure production priorities remain aligned with customer and business requirements.

Your work will allow Site Planners to focus on broader planning, capacity, and strategic priorities while providing Operations with timely and accurate information needed to execute production plans effectively.

This is a tactical and developmental role that provides exposure to production planning, manufacturing operations, ERP systems, capacity management, data analytics, and cross-functional supply chain activities. The position can provide a foundation for continued growth within the Planning organization, including potential progression into future Planner opportunities.

What You’ll Do

Production Scheduling & Execution

  • Create, maintain, and adjust daily and weekly production schedules based on customer demand, material availability, production capacity, and operational priorities.
  • Support Site Planners by maintaining schedules and communicating changes and priorities to Production and other stakeholders.
  • Monitor schedule attainment and identify potential risks that could affect production output or customer commitments.
  • Coordinate scheduling adjustments resulting from material shortages, labor constraints, equipment availability, and changing customer priorities.
  • Support the release and sequencing of production orders to maximize efficiency and throughput.
  • Escalate scheduling conflicts and execution risks to the appropriate Planning and Operations partners.

Data Analytics & Reporting

  • Collect, organize, and analyze operational data from SAP, production systems, and site reporting tools.
  • Develop and maintain scheduling, backlog, capacity, production output, and delivery-performance reports.
  • Track key performance indicators including schedule attainment, on-time delivery, backlog, capacity utilization, and production output.
  • Identify trends, exceptions, and potential areas for improvement and provide actionable information to Planners and Operations leadership.
  • Support the standardization and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling reporting.

Planner & Site Support

  • Provide day-to-day scheduling support to Site Planners and manufacturing operations.
  • Assist with demand reviews, capacity-planning activities, and production prioritization.
  • Support recovery plans for past-due orders and backlog reduction.
  • Partner closely with Production, Materials, Customer Service, Planning, and Operations to maintain alignment on manufacturing priorities.
  • Develop knowledge and capabilities across the broader Planning function in support of continued professional development.

ERP & Systems Support

  • Maintain accurate scheduling information within SAP and other applicable ERP/planning systems.
  • Ensure production dates, work-order statuses, scheduling information, and applicable planning parameters remain accurate and current.
  • Identify and help resolve data-integrity issues affecting scheduling and production execution.
  • Support ongoing improvements to ERP processes, planning tools, reporting, and scheduling practices.
