title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Maak als DevOps Engineer impact op de internationale verzekeringswereld

Hoi, wij zijn InShared: een online verzekeraar die alles nét even anders doet. We maken met slimme technologie verzekeren simpel, snel en eerlijk. Ook hebben we de JaarBalans: Blijft er geld over in de schadepot? Dan geven we dat terug aan onze klanten.

Ooit zijn we gestart als de rebel in de verzekeringswereld. Nu staan we aan de vooravond van een internationale doorbraak. Vandaag nog met 300 mensen, straks misschien wel met 500. Om (internationaal) verder te groeien zoeken we ondernemende en energieke mensen die samen met ons verzekeringen willen blijven opschudden. Wat we nodig hebben? Een Devops Engineer (Azure) die wil bijdragen om ons platform schaalbaar en futureproof te maken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als DevOps Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in onze weg van legacy naar innovatie. Jij helpt met de transformatie naar InShared 2.0 en brengt ons naar de cloud. Als pionier in ons team van techneuten omarm je een hybride scenario. Je bouwt namelijk aan gecontaineriseerde delen in de nieuwe wereld, terwijl de huidige wereld geleidelijk meegenomen wordt.

Samen met het team creëer je een schaalbare en flexibele infrastructuur in Azure Cloud, waarbij je altijd een goede balans weet te vinden tussen schaalbaarheid en pragmatiek en gericht blijft op het leveren van directe waarde. Je faciliteert de transitie van de oude naar nieuwe services en zorgt dat oplossingen toekomstbestendig én beheersbaar blijven.

Je werkt nauw samen met onze architecten en developmentteams en neemt hierin eigenaarschap. Je helpt teams zelfstandiger te worden door te coachen op developer experience, automation en het effectief inzetten van DevOps-principes.

Je bent continu nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe technologie, maar maakt daarbij bewuste keuzes op basis van stabiliteit, veiligheid en beheerbaarheid. Daarnaast ben je verantwoordelijk voor het inrichten van de DevOps-tools en CI/CD-processen, draai je mee met verschillende teams en analyseer je technische problemen om deployments soepel te laten verlopen.

We all benefit. Dus jij ook

Naast de kans om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van verzekeren bieden wij je in de rol van Azure Devops Engineer een salaris tussen € 75.000 en € 85.000 per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld). Maar werken bij InShared heeft nog veel meer voordelen, we bieden ook:

  • 31 vakantiedagen (bij fulltime dienstverband) en de mogelijkheid om extra verlof te ruilen
  • Een werkplek in onze kantoorvilla midden in de bossen
  • Een ingerichte thuiswerkplek
  • Maandelijkse internet- en thuiswerkvergoeding
  • Goed pensioen met een net zo goed partner- en nabestaandenpensioen
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer of OV-vergoeding
  • Persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van € 750 per jaar - opsparen mag!
  • Een mini-sabbatical: eens per 5 jaar 5 dagen extra vrij
  • Welzijnsbudget van € 200 per jaar
  • En nog veel meer….

Wat breng je mee?

  • Ervaring met Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform)
  • Ervaring met GitHub Enterprise en GitHub Actions voor CI/CD
  • Ervaring met container platforms zoals Kubernetes (AKS)
  • Ervaring met Azure cloudplatformen, inclusief networking, identity en securityprincipes
  • Ervaring met Azure Monitor / Application Insights of Prometheus en Grafana
  • Bekend met DevSecOps practices (SAST, dependency scanning, secrets management)
  • Ervaring met het standaardiseren en herbruikbaar maken van pipelines, templates en deployment patterns
  • Affiniteit met event-driven architecturen, API's en moderne integratiepatronen
  • Platform mindset en ervaring met platform engineering en het bouwen van self-service CI/CD pipelines

Sollicitatieproces

Zie je het zitten?

We spreken je graag, natuurlijk met een kopje koffie of thee erbij. Eerst nog wat vragen? Stel ze gerust aan Steven via s.dusoswa@inshared.nl.

  • Anvendelse af Copilot Studio AI agenter og proces understøttelse
  • Data modellering i Dataverse
  • Power Fx
  • Governance, sikkerhed, CI/CD og ALM processer
  • God bred forståelse for Microsoft økosystemet: Dynamics, Azure, M365, Power Platform

Du har muligvis en eller flere af nedenstående Microsoft certificeringer:

  • Power Platform Developer Associate (PL-400)
  • Power Platform Solution Architect (PL-600)
  • Power Automate RPA Developer (PL-500)

Om dig

Du er måske i dag i en lignende position som udvikler og løsningsarkitekt med mindst 4 års erfaring og lyst til mere ansvar. Du kan også sagtens være ansat som intern udvikler med tilsvarende erfaring fra Power Platform udvikling med lyst og mod på at skifte over i en konsulentrolle.

Du kan genkende dig selv i følgende:

  • Højt drive og initiativtager
  • Selvstændig og struktureret
  • Tydelig og proaktiv i kundedialogen
  • Nysgerrig og læringsorienteret
  • Tør udfordre eksisterende løsninger
  • Samarbejder stærkt med både kunder og kolleger
  • Deler viden og løfter teamet

Du skal være indstillet på både at være i en udvikler rolle samt agere løsningsarkitekt og sparringspartner for dine kolleger.

Vi tilbyder

Gode kolleger samt alsidig arbejdsdag i en ambitiøs vækst virksomhed, der har været i IT-branchen i 30 år. Du får mulighed for at præge din egen hverdag, blive udfordret og samtidig udvikle dig. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, og er gode til at fastholde vores medarbejdere som vi behandler med respekt gennem ærlighed og kommunikation. Der tilbydes en attraktiv lønpakke, som modsvarer dine kvalifikationer.

Du bliver en del af et fællesskab med et højt fagligt niveau, hvor vi udfordrer og støtter hinanden med fokus på at lære og bliver dygtigere. Vi er også bevidste om, at vi har områder hvor vi kan og skal gøre det bedre, hvilket den rette kandidat kan bidrage til.

Flere oplysninger

Ønsker du flere oplysninger omkring stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Senior Business Solutions Developer Søren Holm Sørensen på shs@itf.dk

Har du fået mod på at søge stillingen, så ser vi frem til at høre fra dig. Vi afholder samtaler løbende så send din ansøgning og CV snarest muligt.

Om IT Forum Gruppen A/S

IT Forum Gruppen har over 30 års erfaring med solide it-løsninger til danske virksomheder i alle størrelser. På de tre årtier har teknologien ændret sig radikalt, men vores grundlæggende filosofi er den samme: gode relationer og et nært samarbejde skaber de bedste vilkår for et velfungerende, effektivt og sikkert it-setup. Vi beskæftiger 160 medarbejdere, som fra vores afdelinger i Aarhus, Herning, Odense og Ballerup altid står klar til at hjælpe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: R&M TECHNICIAN II
description:
DOCUMENT NUMBER: D001217226

TITLE: RM.RMTECH.OPTR.II

POSITION TITLE: R&M Technician II

POSITION CATEGORY: Repair & Maintenance

REPORTS TO (JOB TITLE):

DUAL REPORT

Job Purpose

The R&M Technician role undertakes hands-on tasks and utilizes Weatherford's facilities, equipment, machinery, and systems. The role applies techniques and practices to complete the scope of tasks covering inspection, repair, and maintenance of field tools, preparing them for their next assignment. Tasks will span the entire process from receiving the tools, dismantling, repairing, and refurbishing using technical manuals, procedures, and technical work instructions. While this is a generic job description covering the different levels of the R&M Technician position, all aspects of the roles and responsibilities are relevant. More senior roles lead and oversee tasks carried out by other R&M employees.

Roles & Responsibilities

SAFETY, SECURITY & COMPLIANCE

· Maintains the highest standards of corporate governance, ensuring that all activities are carried out ethically and in compliance with Company’s Security, Compliance & HSE policies, Management System, relevant laws, regulations, standards, and industry practices and complies with the Company’s Rules to Live By

· Places Quality, Health & Safety, Security and protection of the Environment as core values while never intentionally placing employees, our processes, customers or the communities in which we live and work at risk

· Seeks continual improvement in Health, Safety, Security & protection of the Environment, taking into account responsible care, process vulnerabilities, public, customer and employee inputs, knowledge and technology and best business practices to exceed customer expectations

· Supervisors & Managers should demonstrate effective safety leadership for the health and safety arrangements of all subordinates and for any persons visiting them while on the Company premises

QUALITY

· Responsible for being familiar with the Company's Quality policies and takes an active role in the compliance and improvement of Weatherford’s Management System

· Maintains service quality as immediate priorities when working across all areas of the business and continually seeks areas for improvement

OPERATIONS

· Participates in all daily operations & safety meetings, toolbox, Job Hazard Analysis (JHA) and reports any issues promptly using the appropriate tools

· Maintains equipment, facilities, and work area in a presentable and safe working condition

· Repairs machines, equipment, or structures, using tools such as hammers, hoists, cranes, drills, wrenches, or equipment such as precision measuring instruments or electrical or electronic testing devices

· Inspects used parts to determine changes in dimensional requirements, using rules, callipers, micrometres, or other measuring instruments.

· Follows maintenance processes & procedures to undertake the following: unloading, disassembly, cleaning, pressure testing, visual checking, painting, assembly, loading, and storage of tools, completing all necessary documentation as required against their level of training & competence

· Initiates, updates, closes out AIRTs, PFTs, forms, checklists, and work orders during maintenance of equipment and assets, following the necessary maintenance processes and procedures against their level of training & competence

· Complies with the WO labor time log by accurately clocking in/Out of the WO (Work Order) Time tracking system

· Utilizes all tools and lifting equipment for opening and closing crates & containers and uses pallet and forklift trucks for the safe movement of equipment to and from vehicles, storage areas, racks, shelves, and bins against their level of training & competence. Must be certified for the use of lifting equipment, including forklift trucks and cranes

· Accepts incoming shipments and prepares shipments for dispatch, validating quantities and ensuring all necessary documentation is accurate and complies with all Company procedures against their level of training & competence

· In senior positions, the employee will often lead the team in undertaking all the assignments detailed above. This includes troubleshooting equipment issues, implementing corrective actions, and providing access to all relative R&M documented policies, procedures, work instructions, and technical manuals allowing the R&M team to complete their work effectively and efficiently

· Senior roles will ensure all field and workshop personnel follow the corrective and preventative maintenance procedures, ensuring all failures are followed up to closure with a proper root cause analysis and with the implementation of predetermined corrective action(s)

· Senior roles might lead the workshop, defining and distributing the work assignment schedules while evaluating the quality, proficiency, and efficiency of the works being carried out through performing regular inspections to ensure compliance with standard operating procedures

· Order parts, supplies, or equipment from catalogs or approved suppliers according to Weatherford’s guidelines and procedures

· Supports and complies with the LEAN initiatives and participates in the continuous efficiency improvement program of the facility.

· Performs other duties and activities safely as assigned by supervisor within physical constraints of the job

COMMUNICATION

· Where required, will report all equipment failures and troubleshooting requirements to the R&M Management

· Maintains effective communications with all key stakeholders both internal and where appropriate external

· Supervisors & Managers should clearly communicate expectations, roles and responsibilities to their reports

FINANCIAL

· All employees have an accountability to the organisation to be financially responsible whether they are in charge of a function budget or simply their own expenses

· Costs incurred should be within approved budget, processed within agreed time frames & following the relevant financial policy and procedure

PEOPLE & DEVELOPMENT

· Shows social orientation, working and being personally connected with others on the job

· Employees have a responsibility for developing their own careers within the Company including completing all necessary function, compliance & business standards training to enhance their knowledge, skills and experience

· Employees should engage on a regular basis with their line manager to discuss their personal performance, objectives and opportunities to enhance their skills and experience to support their career potential

· Supervisors are expected to actively engaging their employees to support talent management through Weatherford’s performance management process, including but not limited to talent assessments, succession planning & regular coaching opportunities

· Supervisors should collaborate with Human Resources & Training Development to drive strategies for the recruitment & retention of key personal & to foster an environment that supports the attraction & retention of a high performing talented workforce

VISION & LEADERSHIP

· Demonstrates leadership, ethical behaviour and adherence to Weatherford standards at all times

Experience & Education

REQUIRED

· 2-4+ years of experience in Oil & Gas industry.

· High School Diploma

· Basic Computer Skills

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

REQUIRED

· Basic Mathematics

· Working with hazardous materials, radioactive elements & explosives. Awareness of NDT, NDE and ATEX policies & principles

· More senior roles require the ability to diagnose issues and problems with tools/equipment

· Perform maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, monitoring of equipment

· Critical thinking, active learning & listening, complex problem solving

· Good reading and writing skills, strong judgement and decision-making to be in line with policies & procedures

· Time management

· Quality Control Analysis to ensure product meets required standards

· Capable to meet the physical demands that the role requires

· Information & task ordering & ability to identify when a problem may occur and where possible to understand solution

· Ability to react effectively and efficiently in operating tools and machinery

· Ability to imagine how tools and products will look when preparing for assembly, repair or modifications



Travel Requirement: This role may require domestic and potentially international travel of up to: <10%

JOB DESCRIPTION SCOPE

This job description’s purpose is to offer some details on the scope and depth of the role and its interaction with other roles with the organisation, through a focus on key criteria. It cannot capture the entire scope of the role. The document is generic in nature and offers consistency in role content from the early career level to more senior levels. The Company’s expectation is that the holder of the role understands and accepts that its expectations will be potentially greater from those in more senior roles than those at an early stage of their career. Responsibilities may well be greater and their decisions will have greater impact on the function and organisations performance. The Company reserves the right to amend the content of the job description to better reflect the changing scope of the role with or without notice.

HUMAN RESOURCES ADMINISTRATION

CAREER PATH LEVEL

EXECUTIVE I - V Make Selection

Holds management accountability for a business, division, major geography, corporate function or major corporate sub-function. Develops, establishes & approves long terms strategy for the area managed

MANAGEMENT I – V Make Selection

Achieves goals through the work of others. Responsibilities inc; performance management, merit review, training & development. Focus is on managing others and applying operational or strategic management skills

PROFESSIONAL I - VII Make Selection

Applies a theoretical knowledge-base to work in order to achieve goals through own work. Characterised by specific functional expertise, typically gained through formal education. May provide guidance to others using technical expertise

TECHNICAL I – V Make Selection

Performs technical work, often in support of professional roles. Requires vocational training or the equivalent experience. Performs duties according to established procedures

SUPPORT I – V Make Selection

Performs clerical or administrative work, requires vocational training or the equivalent experience and performs duties according to established procedures

OPERATIONS I – V Level II

Performs operational, craft or manual tasks. Typically requires vocational training, apprenticeship or equivalent experience. Performs task according to established procedures.

GEOZONE ADDENDUMS

The job description template is a generic document designed to improve the quality, consistency and accuracy of the information regarding the Company’s expectations for the position. Individual countries may have some regulatory requirements that are required to be included in the job description. Any specific country requirements are captured in their specific Geozone addendum, which should be issued to the employee with the job description document.

title: 2027 Digital & IT Graduate Trainee Programme (HK & GBA)
description:
About the Programme

Digital & IT Graduate Trainee Programme is designed to provide trainees with a concrete professional foundation through rotations across core Information Technology (IT) and Digital disciplines in our Hong Kong headquarters and the Greater Bay Area (GBA).

Through a well-defined development framework, trainees will gain hands-on experience, build industry knowledge, and develop the skills needed to deliver innovative solutions that drive competitive advantage.

Programme Tracks and Career Path
The programme offers two distinct tracks:

Hong Kong – Based in Cathay’s Hong Kong headquarters, with graduates continuing their long‑term careers in Hong Kong during and upon programme completion. The employment relationship will be with Cathay Pacific Airways Hong Kong.

GBA – Based in the Greater Bay Area office, with graduates developing their long‑term careers in the GBA during and after the programme. The employment relationship will be established with our GBA office.

During the programme, trainees in both tracks will still have opportunities to rotate across offices in Hong Kong and the GBA to gain broader exposure and experience. Candidates should apply with a clear preference, and final placement will be aligned with business needs and confirmed during the recruitment process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop an understanding of the Cathay’s Digital & IT Department and the organisation – purpose, structure, strategy, values and drivers

  • Acquire in-depth knowledge and accomplish learning objectives across diverse teams in IT and Digital, including Solution Centre, Infrastructure & Security, Business Digitalisation, Data Analytics, and Strategy & Planning

  • Build broad exposure to core airline systems and applications development, infrastructure, digital initiatives and analytics, and gain practical experience through frontline operations at the IT Service Centre

  • Apply technical best practices, standards, and governance frameworks to support digital initiatives and contribute to the success of Cathay’s digital leadership

  • Contribute innovative ideas and leverage emerging technologies to create competitive advantages for the airline

  • Take full ownership of organising the Cathay Hackathon - our flagship annual corporate event open to the public - including end-to-end planning, internal and external communications, stakeholder and logistics management, as well as leading a junior team in the second year throughout the preparation cycle.

Qualifications / Experience

  • Final year students or recent graduates (within 2 years of graduation) with a bachelor's degree or higher in any discipline. Digital / IT-related degree would be an advantage.

  • Right to Work Requirements by Location

    -Hong Kong: Must have the right to work in Hong Kong. Eligible visa holders are also welcome, including via the Top Talent Pass Scheme (TTPS) and Immigration Arrangements for Non-Local Graduates (IANG)

    -GBA: Must meet local work authorisation requirements and be open to occasional travel to Hong Kong headquarters and other GBA offices

  • Strong academic performance

  • Excellent command of written and spoken English is required for Hong Kong. For the Greater Bay Area, fluency in both English and Putonghua is required

  • Excellent problem-solving and influencing skills, with business acumen

  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to collaborate and work as a team

  • Goal-oriented, high learning agility and self-driver for career progression

  • Passion for aviation and a career in the Digital / IT field

Personal & Application Information

Cathay Pacific is an Equal Opportunities Employer. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly in accordance with our Applicant Personal Information Collection Statement and for recruitment purposes only. Candidates not notified within eight weeks may consider their application unsuccessful. We keep records of your data for no longer than is necessary for the purpose for which we obtained them and any other permitted linked purposes. If your application is unsuccessful, we will keep your details on file for as long as is necessary to process your application or for the purposes of further job opportunities if you agree to such longer periods.

title: PARTS CLERK
description:
Lexus of Bellevue, a dealership part of the O’Brien Auto Group, is looking for a Full-Time Entry Level Parts Clerk individual for our Parts Department. This position is responsible for providing excellent customer service keeping in mind that our customer’s perspective comes first. A successful candidate will maintain accurate parts inventory and assist the Parts department with routine audits, parts organization, and tracking as well as ship, deliver, and receive parts orders.

This position pays $20.00 per hour. All employees subject to eligibility requirements, we offer the following benefits:

  • Paid holidays pursuant to the annual holiday calendar (typically five holidays)
  • Vacation – based on hire date and paid based on position.
  • Medical/Dental/Vision/RX
  • Ancillary Benefits such as Short/Long Term Disability, Accident, Critical Illness, Life Insurance, Spousal/Child coverages, Flexible Spending
  • 401(k) plus company match



Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To:

  • Establish and maintain good working relationship with wholesale and retail customers.
  • Assist all customers promptly and professionally including retail and service. Communication must be clear and concise.
  • Maintain parts inventory, including stocking shelves, organizing bins, binning new parts and recording the location, conducting perpetual bin audits, and maintain special order bins.
  • Assist in Physical Parts Inventory.
  • Deliver parts to technicians or part recipient; pull orders for counter persons when necessary.
  • Maintain clean and organized work area; all materials stored below the counter area.
  • Immediately notify Parts Manager of damaged parts or shortages.
  • Sweep floors, empty trash containers daily, and maintain a clean parts department.
  • Maintain clean delivery vehicle. Drive cautiously and safely staying within the laws of the road.
  • Organizes parts within the department by part number and bin location, and reconciles the information in the computer inventory system; updating locations as necessary to provide accurate locations and optimum space utilization.
  • Labels all bin locations, as well as each part location in the inventory; updating labels as necessary as bin locations change.
  • Manages warranty parts area by filing warranty parts and shipping and/or disposing of warranty parts as instructed by manufacturer.
  • Picks parts to be returned to manufacturer on return orders, verifies condition of each part to be acceptable for return, ships all return parts and updates the bin location of the removal of each part.
  • Picks cores to be returned and ships them according to factory guidelines.
  • Performs daily bin counts and reports to the department manager any discrepancies in the inventory. The number of bin counts performed each day to be determined by the department manager.
  • Stock shelves with incoming orders and supplies, notifying parts manager of damaged or missing parts.
  • Performs daily housekeeping duties to insure overall cleanliness of department, including but not limited to; floors, garbage, counters and displays.
  • Completes other miscellaneous tasks and/or errands relevant to the parts department operations as instructed by the department manager.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.
  • Regular attendance is essential.
  • Work in cooperative, positive, & professional manner with all personnel in the company.
  • Treat members of the public and customers in a courteous and non-discriminatory manner. Maintain professional demeanor while at work.
  • Must conform to company policy regarding non-discrimination and harassment.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: IT Operations & Support Analyst
description:
About Us

The Accounting and Financial Reporting Council (AFRC) is the independent regulator of the accounting profession in Hong Kong established under the AFRC Ordinance (Cap. 588). As an independent regulator, we spearhead and lead the accounting profession to constantly raise the level of quality of professional accountants, and thus protect the public interest. This pivotal role not only enhances the quality of financial reporting but in turn reinforces our pursuit of promoting the healthy development of the profession and Hong Kong’s position as a competitive international financial centre.


Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line (Tier 1) application support for the organisation's enterprise systems, triaging and resolving common issues and escalating to the System Analyst or vendors where deeper investigation is required.

  • Perform user and device lifecycle administration in on-premises Active Directory and Microsoft 365 / Entra ID — account joiner/mover/leaver, group and permission management, mailbox and shared-mailbox setup, and device enrolment via Intune / MDM.

  • Support day-to-day Microsoft 365 operations — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online and on-premises, OneDrive, Teams and Teams Phone — including SharePoint site, permission and external-sharing administration.

  • Assist with data centre and infrastructure operations, supporting servers, storage, networking, Wi-Fi, firewall and backup, restore and archiving tasks, and helping with disaster-recovery (DR) and business-continuity (BCP) drills under the guidance of the infrastructure team.

  • Perform endpoint security and compliance tasks, including endpoint-protection agents, MFA, patching and device-compliance checks, in line with internal IT and security policies.

  • Provide first-line (Tier 1) desktop and end-user support across hardware, software, networking, mobile devices and peripherals, logging and resolving requests through the IT Service Desk and escalating complex cases to the appropriate team or vendor.

  • Set up and maintain end-user equipment and IT assets, including laptops, mobile devices and meeting-room / video-conferencing equipment, and keep the asset inventory accurate and up to date.

  • Handle data import, export and validation across systems, ensuring accuracy, completeness and consistency of data.

  • Prepare and maintain IT documentation, including standard operating procedures (SOPs), user guides, asset records, support logs and knowledge-base articles.

  • Support IT operational and project tasks, such as equipment rollouts, migrations, system upgrades and audits, ensuring minimal disruption to business users.

  • Fulfil other responsibilities as assigned.


Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or other related discipline.

  • At least 5 years' experience in application and desktop support, IT infrastructure or IT operations.

  • Familiarity with first-line application support and the discipline of logging, triaging and escalating issues within an IT Service Desk / ticketing environment.

  • Solid hands-on knowledge of Windows desktop and Windows Server environments, Active Directory (DNS / DHCP / Group Policy) and Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Intune).

  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN) and of server, storage, backup / restore and data-centre operations.

  • Exposure to endpoint security (MFA, endpoint protection, patching, MDM/Intune) and IT security best practices.

  • Competent in data handling — data import/export, validation and strong Excel skills.

  • Strong documentation skills, able to produce clear, accurate SOPs, user guides and asset records.

  • Well-organised and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple priorities effectively.

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a service-oriented, proactive and collaborative attitude — comfortable working directly with users, not solely behind a screen.

  • Experience in a regulator, public-sector or financial-services environment is an advantage.

This is a renewable contract role. A competitive package will be offered to the successful candidate.

To submit your application, please click Quick Apply.

Data held by the AFRC relating to employment applications will be kept confidential and used for recruitment purposes only. Applicants who are not contacted within six weeks may consider their applications unsuccessful. The AFRC will retain their applications for a maximum of one year.

title: R&D Laboratory Technician - Fire Safety
description:
The UL Solutions Research and Development team is seeking a driven and team-oriented laboratory technician to work with us on research and testing of emerging fire and explosion safety problems. Many of these problems will focus on the energy and fire protection industries, including lithium-ion battery thermal runaway and fires in the built environment. This role will focus on laboratory testing, logistics, and the design, realization and commissioning of novel test programs, fixtures and apparatus. Day-to-day projects will involve working with R&D engineers and senior lab staff to design and execute custom test programs and services for internal and external clients. Successful candidate will be creative, curious, adaptable to a fast-paced and multi-disciplined environment and able to work collaboratively with a team of other technicians, engineers and scientists to solve complex problems.

  • Provides technical support in the design and construction of test fixtures, test rooms or systems and other testing programs.
  • Designs, adapts and builds test setups and equipment for new test situations, based on analysis of test specifications and discussions with engineers.
  • Examines test samples and interprets measuring instruments, blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and operational instructions.
  • Develops test procedures based on laboratory procedures, standards and safety policies.
  • Engages in firefighting and fire extinguishing activities in live fire tests under supervision of more senior technician staff.
  • Sets and operates data acquisition suites for custom test scenarios.
  • Assists in scheduling, assigning, reviewing and coordinating workflow to assure proper utilization of laboratory time and space.
  • Can operate with minimal supervision within defined limits of responsibility.
  • Attends meetings and uses multiple forms of communication, as needed, to complete tasks, projects, and initiatives
  • Prepares purchase and material requisitions.
  • Takes stewardship over laboratory spaces to ensure they remain clean, organized, operational, and up-to-date.
  • Integrates continuous improvement concepts and techniques into all aspects of the job.
  • Highschool diploma or GED required
  • At least 2-year university degree in engineering or a related discipline is preferred
  • Prior experience in hands-on laboratory work and mechanical design/assembly work is required
  • Qualifications to operate a forklift, boom lift, and scissor lift.
  • Willingness to be trained in and to engage in active firefighting in full turn-out gear. This requires the ability to maintain composure and make clear and rapid decisions in an Immediately Dangerous to Life or Health (IDLH) fire environment.
  • Ability to obtain self-container breathing apparatus (SCBA) certification. Existing certification is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining high quality and exceptional customer service.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using and safely operating a variety of hand tools and power tools.
  • Highly effective communication skills and ability to interact with customers
  • Demonstrated project experience involving creative problem solving.
  • Desire to work in a team-oriented environment

What you’ll experience working for ULS

UL Solutions has been pioneering change since 1894 and we’re still leading the way. From day one, we’ve blazed a trail protecting the planet and everyone on it. Our teams have influenced billions of products, plus services, software offerings and more. We break things, burn things and blow things up. All in the name of safety science.

That’s where you come in — because none of it could happen without you. It takes passion to protect people, problem-solving to safeguard personal data and conviction to make the world a more sustainable place. It takes bold ideas and brilliant minds to build a better world for future generations across the globe.

This is more than a job. It’s a calling. A passion to use our expertise and play our part in creating a more secure, sustainable world today — and tomorrow. As a member of our safety science community, you’ll use your ideas, your energy and your ambition to innovate, challenge and ultimately, help create a safer world.

Everyone here is unique. But we’re also a global community, working together to help create a safer world. Join UL Solutions and you can connect with the brightest minds in the business, all bringing their distinct perspectives and diverse backgrounds together to deliver real change.

Empowering our customers to keep the world safe means thinking ahead. It means investing in training and empowering our people to learn and innovate. At UL Solutions, we help build a better future — one where everyone benefits.

Join UL Solutions to be at the center of safety. To learn more about us and the work we do, visit

The Senior Data Engineer - API & AI Gateway Platform Engineer will design, develop, and support enterprise API and AI gateway platforms leveraging technologies such as Apigee (Edge, X, Hybrid), Palo Alto Prisma AIRS (Portkey), Akamai API Security and related integration frameworks. This role requires a combination of API & AI Gateway architecture, integration, platform engineering, and data enablement skills. The ideal candidate will have experience building scalable API & AI gateway platforms, managing API lifecycle processes, and implementing secure, high-performing API & AI gateway solutions across cloud and hybrid environments. The Senior Data Engineer will partner with application teams, architects, and platform teams to enable consistent API & AI gateway delivery, governance, and operational excellence.


This role is part of the enterprise Information Security Modernization (ISM) program, supporting the evolution of secure, scalable API, AI gateway and API security platform capabilities. Participation in a rotating on-call support schedule is required.

Key responsibilities include:
• Lead design and architecture of enterprise API & AI gateway platform capabilities ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, scalability, and long-term maintainability.
• Build and manage scalable API proxies and services supporting REST and SOAP-based integrations.
• Implement API security frameworks including OAuth, JWT, API key management, mTLS, and secure communication protocols.
Implement and maintain enterprise AI gateway services.
• Develop and enforce API governance standards including versioning, lifecycle management, and API design best practices.
• Support API & AI gateway platform deployments across multi-cloud environments (GCP, Azure, on-prem) and hybrid architectures.
• Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to enable consistent API & AI gateway deployments and lifecycle management.
• Configure and manage API traffic policies including rate limiting, caching, throttling, and load balancing to optimize performance and reliability.
• Monitor and analyze API performance using analytics, logging, and observability tools; identify and resolve performance or reliability issues.
• Integrate APIs with backend systems, microservices, and enterprise platforms to enable seamless data exchange.
• Participate in migration and modernization efforts including transition from legacy API platforms to cloud-native or hybrid API solutions.
• Ensure compliance with enterprise security, regulatory, and data privacy requirements including secure logging and data masking practices.
• Collaborate with developers, architects, and platform teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable API solutions.
• Provide operational support including troubleshooting, incident response, and continuous improvement of API platform capabilities.
• Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for internal users and developers.
• Support proof-of-concepts and innovation initiatives to evaluate new API and integration technologies.

A Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of five years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engineering, analytical modeling techniques; OR an Associate’s degree in a relevant field such as engineering, mathematics, computer science, information technology, health science, or other analytical/quantitative field and a minimum of seven years of professional or research experience in data visualization, data engineering, analytical modeling techniques. Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and recommend solutions and a commitment to customer service. The position requires excellent verbal and written communication skills, attention to detail, and a high capacity for learning and problem resolution.


Advanced experience in SQL is required. Strong Experience in scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, PHP, C++ or Java & API integration is required. Experience in hybrid data processing methods (batch and streaming) such as Apache Spark, Hive, Pig, Kafka is required. Experience with big data, statistics, and machine learning is required. The ability to navigate linux and windows operating systems is required. Knowledge of workflow scheduling (Apache Airflow Google Composer), Infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Docker) CI/CD (Jenkins, Github Actions) is preferred. Experience in DataOps/DevOps and agile methodologies is preferred. Experience with hybrid data virtualization such as Denodo is preferred. Working knowledge of Tableau, Power BI, SAS, ThoughtSpot, DASH, d3, React, Snowflake, SSIS, and Google Big Query is preferred.
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) certification is preferred.

The preferred candidate will possess:

  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating API management platforms or gateways (Apigee X experience preferred), including API proxy development, policy enforcement, and integration patterns.
  • Strong experience with cloud-native infrastructure and container platforms (Google Cloud Platform, Kubernetes, Docker), including building and supporting scalable, highly available distributed systems.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and CI/CD pipeline development (Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable automated platform provisioning and deployment.
  • Experience with networking concepts in cloud and hybrid environments, including DNS, load balancing, ingress/egress patterns, firewall rules, and private connectivity.

The Neurodiagnostic Technologist II can perform test set up, electrode application, and maintain patient safety during clinically significant events and other related duties. title: Wholepage Optimization Software Engineer, Google Ads
description:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

As Search experience rapidly evolves with AI Overviews and AI Mode, the commercial engine that powers it must co-evolve. Our team sits at the intersection of user intent and monetization on search. We leverage cutting-edge machine learning and LLMs to reimagine the commercial journey across Google Search and Lens, ensuring we deliver value to users, advertisers, and Google’s long-term revenue. As part of the team, you will lead this effort and work on foundational, open-ended problems to build 10x better ads experiences, in partnership with teams across Ads, Search and GDM.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Leverage state-of-the-art AI/ML advancements, including LLMs & Agentic AI, to solve critical optimization problems across search ads, from product innovation to agentic automation.

  • Identify gaps in existing engineering processes and solve using AI-driven automation.
  • Design, build, and maintain self-service tools and platform features that embed these advanced AI/ML quality evaluation methods.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience developing accessible technologies.
  • Experience in Seach/Ads or general quality systems.
  • Familiarity with the latest research and trends in AI/ML, particularly as applicable to data quality and assessment.

title: YOUTH RESIDENTIAL TREATMEANT-1st & 2nd SHIFT
company: FOUR OAKS FAMILY AND CHILDRENS SERVICES
description:
Be the Steady Person in a Young Person's Toughest Moments.

Sometimes making an impact looks like helping a child calm down after a difficult day. Sometimes it's celebrating progress that no one else may notice. And sometimes it's simply showing up, being consistent, and reminding a young person that tomorrow is another opportunity to try again.

As a Youth Counselor with Four Oaks' Mason City PMIC program, you'll work directly with boys and girls ages 7–17 in a residential treatment setting. These young people need caring, dependable adults who can provide structure, encouragement, accountability, and support while they work toward their treatment goals.

You don't have to have all the answers. You do need to be willing to show up, build relationships, and make a difference.

What is PMIC?

Our Psychiatric Medical Institution for Children (PMIC) program provides residential treatment and support for children and teens who need a higher level of care. Our team creates a safe, structured, therapeutic environment where youth can develop coping skills, build healthier behaviors, strengthen relationships, and work toward successfully transitioning to their next step.

As a Youth Counselor, you'll be part of the everyday moments that help our youth grow. You'll build relationships, provide consistency and structure, and help young people practice the skills they're learning in treatment.

At Four Oaks, we believe every child deserves the opportunity to succeed. Our Youth Counselors are a huge part of making that possible.

This isn't a job where every day looks the same. You'll have challenging moments, rewarding moments, and moments when you realize something you said or did truly made a difference.

And while you're helping our youth grow, we want you to grow too!

Your Presence Can Make a Difference!

title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud-Native & Networking)
description:
This is a remote position.

Senior Software Engineer (Cloud-Native & Networking)

Salary: 150-165k + bonus/benefits, etc.

Location:Remote (U.S. Based)

Experience:10+ Years

Are you a Software Engineer who speaks "Network"?

We aren't looking for a traditional Network Engineer to configure routers all day. We are looking for a high-caliber Software Engineer who understands how to build the cloud-native systems that control them.

At our core, we provide a seamless "at-home" Wi-Fi experience for tens of millions of people in hotels, campgrounds, and student housing globally. We are currently in the middle of a major evolution, transitioning our central authentication platform to an AWS cloud-native environment. We need a senior developer who can bridge the gap between sophisticated cloud architecture and the hardware at the edge.

The Role: Build the "Brains" of the Network

In this role, you won't just be writing code; you will be architecting the software that caters to network devices. You will work within an Agile/Scrum environment to build scalable, security-hardened services that manage device lifecycles and authentication workflows.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect & Implement:Build software systems that interact with or control global network infrastructure.
  • Cloud Evolution:Drive our transition to AWS Serverless—we want to solve problems using modern cloud-native patterns, not just managing servers and containers.
  • Protocol Integration:Deep dive into RADIUS, 802.1X, and AAA technologies to ensure secure, effortless connectivity for millions of users.
  • Automation:Develop the tools and APIs that streamline configuration and authentication across a diverse portfolio of devices (routers, switches, firewalls).

Requirements

What We’re Looking For:

  • 10+ Years of Engineering:You have a proven track record of shipping complex, scalable products.
  • The "Network Intuition":While you are a developer first, you understand routing, switching, VLANs, and firewalling. You know how software and hardware need to "talk" to each other.
  • AWS Expertise:Deep experience in AWS systems, with a strong emphasis on Serverless architecture.
  • Protocol Knowledge:Familiarity with RADIUS and certificate-based authentication is a major plus.
  • Tooling:Experience with MikroTik devices and RouterOS is highly desirable (but if you have a strong background in other networking hardware/APIs, we still want to talk to you).
  • Tech Stack:Linux (CLI), Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure-as-Code (CloudFormation).

Benefits

Why Join Us?

  • Massive Impact:Your code will directly impact the daily lives of tens of millions of users worldwide.
  • Modern Engineering:We are committed to staying on the cutting edge of AWS Serverless technology.
  • Remote-First:Work from wherever you are most productive in the U.S.
  • Stable & Growing:We are a successful, scaling company with the agility of a startup and the stability of an established leader.

Note:We are only able to consider Green Card holders and U.S. Citizens at this time. We cannot provide H-1B sponsorship.

Ready to build the future of connectivity? Apply today.

This role requires a combination of API & AI Gateway architecture, integration, platform engineering, and data enablement skills.

The Data Engineer will partner with application teams, architects, and platform teams to enable consistent API & AI Gateway delivery, governance, and operational excellence.

This role is part of the enterprise Information Security Modernization (ISM) program, supporting the evolution of secure, scalable API & AI Gateway platform capabilities. Participation in a rotating on-call support schedule is required.

Key responsibilities include:
• Design, develop, and implement enterprise API & AI Gateway platform capabilities using API & AI Gateway management solutions (e.g., Apigee, API Connect, or similar).
• Build and manage scalable API & AI Gateway proxies and services supporting REST and SOAP-based integrations.
• Implement API & AI Gateway security frameworks including OAuth, JWT, API key management, mTLS, and secure communication protocols.
• Develop and enforce API & AI Gateway governance standards including versioning, lifecycle management, and API design best practices.
• Support API & AI Gateway platform deployments across multi-cloud environments (GCP, Azure, on-prem) and hybrid architectures.
• Develop CI/CD pipelines and automation frameworks to enable consistent API & AI Gateway deployments and lifecycle management.
• Configure and manage API & AI Gateway traffic policies including rate limiting, caching, throttling, and load balancing to optimize performance and reliability.
• Monitor and analyze API & AI Gateway performance using analytics, logging, and observability tools; identify and resolve performance or reliability issues.
• Integrate APIs with backend systems, microservices, and enterprise platforms to enable seamless data exchange.
• Participate in migration and modernization efforts including transition from legacy API & AI Gateway platforms to cloud-native or hybrid API & AI Gateway solutions.
• Ensure compliance with enterprise security, regulatory, and data privacy requirements including secure logging and data masking practices.
• Collaborate with developers, architects, and platform teams to translate business and technical requirements into scalable API & AI Gateway solutions.
• Provide operational support including troubleshooting, incident response, and continuous improvement of API & AI Gateway platform capabilities.
• Develop and maintain platform documentation, runbooks, and onboarding materials for internal users and developers.
• Support proof-of-concepts and innovation initiatives to evaluate new API & AI Gateway and integration technologies.

This vacancy is not eligible for sponsorship/ we will not sponsor or transfer visas for this position. Also, Mayo Clinic DOES NOT participate in the F-1 STEM OPT extension program.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field from an accredited University or College; OR an Associate’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field from an accredited University or College with 2 years of experience. Demonstrated ability to analyze and profile data as a means to address various business problems through leveraging advanced data modeling, source system databases, or data mining techniques, is required. May provide consultative services to departments/divisions and committees. Demonstrated application of several problem-solving methodologies, planning techniques, continuous improvement methods, and analytical tools and methodologies (e.g. data analysis, data profiling, modeling, etc.) required. Incumbent must have ability to manage a varied workload of projects with multiple priorities and stay current on healthcare trends and enterprise changes. Interpersonal skills and time management skills are required. Requires strong analytical skills and the ability to identify and recommend solutions, advanced computer application skills and a commitment to customer service. Experience with data analysis, quality, and profiling; including data exploration tools including but not limited to Rapid SQL, AQT, Information Analyzer, and Informatics.

The preferred candidate will possess:

  • Experience designing, deploying, or operating API management platforms or gateways (Apigee X experience preferred), including API proxy development, policy enforcement, and integration patterns.

Under the general direction of the Vice President for Quality and Patient Safety, and in collaboration with the HEIP Medical Directors, the Director provides expertise, strategic direction, leadership, planning, organization and general management for all aspects of HEIP at UCSF Health. This includes but is not limited to:

  • Developing, directing, and prioritizing activities related to the institutional Infection Prevention program for adult and pediatric populations at Parnassus, Mount Zion, Mission Bay, Oakland, Langley Porter Psychiatric Institute, Stanyan, Hyde, and UCSF Health-licensed ambulatory services in collaboration with the Medical Directors

  • Responsibility for creating a structure for daily, twenty-four (24) hour planning, organizing, directing, controlling, and consultation of daily operations in order to support an environment that optimizes the mission and priorities of the HEIP department

  • Ensuring prompt responses, information exchanges, and issue resolution in response to questions relevant to UCSF Health infection prevention policies and practices

  • Directing activities for institutional compliance with The Joint Commission (TJC) accreditation Infection Prevention and associated standards for the hospital and laboratory programs and other certifications, California Department of Public Health (CDPH) reporting regulations, Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Conditions of Participation (CoP) for Hospitals, Transplant Services, and ESRD

  • Providing direction for the managers of the Field Unit and Surveillance and Clinical Analytics Unit who oversee operational management of Field Unit and Surveillance and Clinical Analytics Unit HEIP personnel

  • Ensuring institutional infection prevention-related preparedness for epidemic and pandemic responses including emerging and high consequence pathogens

  • Developing partnership with and Interfacing with all levels of the organization

  • Publicly representing HEIP in institutional and public forums

  • Liaison to the local Department of Public Health and the state Healthcare Associated Infections program

title: Project Manager, Growth Marketing
description:

title: Supervisor, Network Construction
description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

The Supervisor of Network Construction will be responsible for the day-to-day activities of an assigned team of fiber construction managers. This team has a dedicated focus on vendor management, work order execution, construction, and restoration of Zayo fiber networks and services that are consistent with all defined standard operating processes and procedures. The position will support the Manager of Network Construction and work across other fiber construction teams within the area, as well as provide support to Zayo cross-functional teams to improve the quality of processes, deliverables and the end-to-end customer experience. The fiber construction team is expected to maintain open communication across all areas of the business and work as a unit with consistency while building, implementing, and restoring or maintaining services; cognizant of fostering the vision and values of Zayo. This position is accountable for their assigned team and area for delivering KPIs including but not limited to CapEx spend, fiber complete for small cell, and installed enterprise revenue.


Responsibilities

  • Supervise a team of Construction Managers in support of the assigned area of responsibility for construction demands, Cap and OpEx management, as well as KPIs.
  • Provide support to the Manager of Network Construction for communication with the NOC, Engineering, Field Operations, Permitting and Change management teams.
  • Provide support to the Manager of Network Construction to monitor and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of deliverables and supporting workflows in order to measure operational performance, as well as identify and assess areas of opportunity for improved process efficiencies and performance
  • Maintain knowledge of technology in use, and/or under development for its impact or potential impact on the operational business process
  • Provide support to the Manager of Network Construction for the assigned areas respective CAPEX and OPEX spend and budgets
  • Maintain quality service by understanding and enforcing organization standards
  • Develop and coach the team. Identify training gaps and create a career path for team members.
  • Schedule and prioritize the workload of the fiber construction, and external vendor resources within an assigned area

    • Management of external vendors necessary for timely completion and within budget
    • Initial construction reviews in accordance with project specifications.
    • Oversee site construction, managing schedule, and resources on all projects
    • Ensure that all jobs are maintained in a project tracking system with complete accuracy.
    • Coordination of all engineering, permitting and licensing activities.
    • Development of permit and construction plans.
  • Participate in the Vendor evaluation and selection process.

Qualifications

Education/Certifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent, required
  • B.S in Architecture, Engineering, or Construction related field or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • A valid driver’s license, required

Experience/Minimum Requirements

  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience (or equivalent work experience) with ​​direct supervision/management of employees and Fiber engineering design, splicing and/or construction implementation experience
  • Experience with optical test equipment including OTDR, PMD, Optical Spectrum Analyzer
  • Working knowledge of fiber construction standards (aerial and underground)
  • Working knowledge of NESC, NEC and OSHA standards

Other Skills/Abilities

  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Proven people and project management skills
  • Candidate has a strong background in and a good working knowledge of fiber optic infrastructure engineering, construction, and restoration methods
  • Familiarity with Outside Plant (OSP) and Inside Plant (ISP) installation standards and practices
  • Ability to diagnose workflow problems and institute remedies
  • The individual must possess and employ the highest ethical and business standards and always conduct himself/herself with the greatest degree of professional integrity.
  • Position needs to be able to operate in a fast-paced customer focused environment handling multiple priorities at a time, delivering quality service to diverse user groups and customers
  • A positive attitude and desire to deliver exceptional results for our customers.
  • Personal commitment to safety, integrity, and continual professional development
  • Strong Microsoft Office (Excel, Visio, Word and PowerPoint) skills

description:
Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited

Hong Kong Interbank Clearing Limited (hereinafter referred to as “the Company”) is a private organization jointly owned by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and The Hong Kong Association of Banks. The Company’s key objective is to develop and operate a safe and efficient multi-currency and multi-dimensional financial infrastructure in Hong Kong for:

  • large-value interbank fund transfers denominated in HKD, USD, Euro and RMB;

  • interbank money settlement of equity and debt securities transactions in Hong Kong via the linkages with the Hong Kong Securities Clearing Company Limited and the HKMA’s Central Moneymarkets Unit (CMU) system;

  • small-value interbank fund transfers denominated in HKD and RMB via the HKD and RMB Faster Payment System; and

  • interbank clearing and/or money settlement of paper cheques and various types of electronic payments in Hong Kong.

The Company is also the operator of the HKMA’s CMU system.

Apart from interbank clearing-and-settlement services, the Company and its subsidiaries also support the HKMA and the financial industry to foster the development of the financial technology (“FinTech”) ecosystem in Hong Kong.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to take up the following job position.

Specialist I / Specialist II / Analyst (Services Management)

Major Responsibilities

A member of the Services Management team to deliver service excellence and provide service support to banks and business partners primarily with respect to their usage of the SWIFT messaging systems, Faster Payment System and other application systems for operation of the highly secure and mission-critical interbank clearing and settlement applications. Duties include:

  • Attending to the services support hotline and providing high quality support to the users relating to the system operations and performing problem solving

  • Assisting in formulating and running the service operation processes including but not limited to client on-boarding, service maintenance, contingency measures and drill activities, fulfilling relevant service agreements and/or regulatory requirements

  • Communicating with banks and business partners in relation to the Company’s services and projects mainly through preparation and issuance of circulars and technical notes, detailing system enhancements and major system releases for users to make the necessary preparatory arrangements

  • Assisting in managing development and maintenance works for the company’s website, collaborating with vendor, technology teams and business stakeholders

  • Assisting in administrative and documentation works including preparation of working instructions and procedures

  • Performing shift duty on a roster basis

Requirements

  • University education preferably in business administration or information technology related disciplines

  • At least 5 years’ experience for Specialist I (or 3 years’ experience for Specialist II) in the areas of: (i) coordinating implementation and roll-out of systems preferably financial/banking applications, (ii) supporting help-desk for providing system support to users, or (iii) operations of payment systems or banking/financial applications.

  • Experience in back-office operation or service with coordination and supporting roles interfacing with internal/external users, stakeholders, and service providers would also be considered

  • Knowledge of operating and supporting SWIFT messaging systems is an advantage

  • Knowledge of credit data operation, web technology and ITIL processes is a plus

  • Fluency in both written and spoken English and Chinese, and fluency in Putonghua is an advantage

  • Able to work independently with good communication skill and customer-oriented mindset

  • Candidates with less experience or fresh graduates may also be considered for the position of Analyst (Services Management)

title: Would you like to build data platforms that make a difference across Europe?
description:
Shape the future of data in an international organization

Do you enjoy building scalable data platforms, designing robust data pipelines, and transforming complex business requirements into reliable data solutions?

At Daka and SARIA, we're strengthening our international data landscape and are looking for a Data Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing the data platform that supports business decisions across Europe.

Working with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Power BI, you will help build the foundation for data-driven decision-making across multiple countries, business units, and operational sites. This is an opportunity to join a growing data organization where you can influence both technical solutions and future architecture while working with modern cloud technologies.

The Role

As our new Data Engineer, you will join the international Data Solutions team and become a key contributor to the development of our next-generation data platform.

You will work across multiple systems, countries, and business areas, ensuring reliable, scalable, and high-quality data flows that support analytics, reporting, and business operations.

This role combines data engineering, architecture, and business understanding. You'll collaborate closely with eight colleagues across Europe, with one colleague based in Hedensted. The BI-team works according to Scrum principles, with stand-ups twice a week to stay aligned, share progress, and address challenges. Just as importantly, you will join a team with an open feedback culture, where colleagues actively help and challenge each other with the shared ambition of making each other better.

The position reports to Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, based in Germany.

Your primary workplace will be our headquarters in Hedensted, Denmark, where you will also be part of our local IT organization consisting of eight colleagues. While your daily home base is Denmark, your projects, stakeholders, and impact will span across Europe.

What You'll Be Working On

You will play a central role in both maintaining and further developing our data platform. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Designing and developing scalable data solutions in Azure Databricks
  • Building, optimizing, and maintaining modern data pipelines
  • Integrating data from ERP systems, operational applications, APIs, databases and cloud platforms
  • Developing and maintaining semantic models in Power BI
  • Ensuring data quality, reliability, and accessibility across business-critical solutions
  • Supporting data architecture decisions and platform improvements
  • Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Contributing to documentation, governance, and best practices across the data landscape

Your Technical Toolbox

We expect you to bring experience within several of the following areas:

  • Azure Databricks
  • PySpark
  • SQL
  • Data modelling and semantic layers
  • Power BI
  • APIs and system integrations
  • Cloud-based data platforms
  • Data architecture and platform design
  • ETL/ELT development
  • Data quality and governance

You don't need to tick every box, but we expect you to have strong experience within modern data engineering and a genuine interest in building scalable data solutions.

Who You Are

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You take a proactive approach, ask questions, and are comfortable challenging the status quo when you see opportunities to improve the way we work.

You enjoy taking ownership and balancing deep technical work with collaboration across different parts of the business. Working in an international environment with multiple stakeholders energizes you, and you're comfortable communicating technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

You bring an open-minded, curious, and constructive approach to collaboration. As a senior member of the team, you are also passionate about sharing your knowledge and supporting the development of more junior colleagues.

Additionally, we imagine that you:

  • Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
  • Have several years of experience working with data engineering and data platforms
  • Communicate fluently in English, both written and spoken
  • Take a structured and quality-oriented approach to your work
  • Thrive in environments where you can influence solutions, challenge existing ways of working, and contribute to continuous improvement

Why Join Daka and SARIA?

This is not a maintenance role. You will join a business where data and digitalization are strategic priorities, and where there is a genuine ambition to strengthen the data platform across the entire organization.

In return, we offer:

  • A key position in an international organization with significant growth ambitions
  • Opportunity to influence architecture, tools, and future data platform development
  • Modern technologies and a cloud-first data environment
  • Collaboration with skilled colleagues across Denmark and Europe
  • A high degree of autonomy and responsibility
  • Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development
  • Flexible working arrangements, including the option to work from home up to two days a week
  • An attractive pension scheme with an 11% employer contribution
  • 23 weeks of fully paid parental leave
  • Lunch programme and attractive employment conditions

Beyond the professional opportunities, you'll become part of a collaborative and down-to-earth culture where people genuinely enjoy working together. From social events and staff association activities to an informal coffee break with colleagues, community is an important part of everyday life at our headquarters in Hedensted.

Interested in joining us?

We look forward to hearing from you. Please submit your CV with a motivated profile summary through the "Apply" link.

The recruitment process consists of two interviews at our headquarters in Hedensted, with Mirco joining online. The first interview focuses on your experience, motivation, and technical skills. The second includes feedback on a personality profile and cognitive assessment.

Due to scheduled holidays, we will begin conducting interviews in November. We look forward to getting to know you then.

If you have questions regarding the role, please contact Mirco Grösch, Team Lead Business Intelligence, phone: +49 151 729 33 576.

If you have questions about the Danish team or daily work life, please contact Thorbjørn Kloster, Head of CIO Office, phone: +45 2947 1215.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Gallagher

Our purpose at Gallagher is ‘Protect what matters most’ and we live it every day, whether that's protecting the world's highest security environments or agricultural businesses, we care deeply about our people, their families, and our wider communities.

Gallagher Security is on a mission to unlock more value for our customers through the power of our people and solutions, and right now is a pivotal moment in our evolution. We're scaling with intent, driving an incredible growth trajectory with innovation and customer impact at the heart of everything we do. With operations across New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, Canada, and Europe and exports to over 140 countries, we're building globally focused career pathways right here in New Zealand.

As we expand our Hamilton-based teams, this is your chance to be part of a true Kiwi tech success story making a global impact. If you're driven by passion and purpose to protect what matters most, come help shape the future of what's possible with us.

About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Security team and contribute to the development of the software that powers Gallagher's globally recognised security solutions.

This is a hands-on software engineering role with a strong customer focus. You'll develop and enhance software solutions that help resolve complex customer challenges, improve system performance, and support the ongoing success of Gallagher's security platforms. You'll work closely with technical support, product, and engineering teams to deliver high-quality outcomes for customers around the world.

As part of #TeamGallagher you will:

  • Enjoy developing software that helps protect some of the world's most secure environments

  • Enjoy solving technical challenges as part of a collaborative agile team

  • Enjoy a culture focused on quality, learning, and continuous improvement

  • Enjoy working alongside talented engineers on globally recognised products

  • Enjoy opportunities to develop your technical skills and grow your career

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software components and features

  • Break down, estimate, and deliver development tasks within an agile environment

  • Support existing products through troubleshooting, debugging, and problem resolution

  • Contribute to technical design discussions and recommend solutions to complex challenges

  • Ensure software quality through testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices

  • Analyse system performance and identify opportunities for improvement

  • Collaborate effectively with engineers, testers, and product stakeholders

  • Continuously develop your technical knowledge and contribute to team improvement initiatives

You'll Bring

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys hands-on development, takes pride in writing quality code, and thrives in a collaborative environment where continuous learning and improvement are encouraged.

  • A relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent experience

  • At least 3 years' commercial software development experience

  • Strong C# and/or C++ development skills

  • Experience working with SQL databases

  • Experience using source control and modern development tools

  • Knowledge of testing practices including automated and unit testing

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills

  • Experience working collaboratively within a software development team

  • A proactive approach to learning, improvement, and delivering quality outcomes

Working at Gallagher

You'll be part of a global, future-focused organisation where engineering talent is valued and supported. You'll work with smart, passionate people, build products used worldwide, and have room to grow your skills and career.

We also offer:

  • Competitive salary and annual bonus scheme

  • Hybrid flexibility, typically 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home

  • Life and disability insurance and KiwiSaver

  • Mentorship and professional development opportunities

  • A supportive team culture with team-building events, lunches, and a fun environment

Applications may be considered and appointments made prior to the closing date.

title: Quality Assurance Manager
