title: Manchester - American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor/ Instructor Trainer
description:
About Us

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.
  • Work may be performed primarily during weekends.

Salary and Benefits

Salary: $30.00 - $40.00 per teaching hour, commensurate with experience and length of working relationship with ALLCPR.

Additional Compensation: $10.00 per enrolled student. (Only for instructor trainer role)

Job Classification: 1099 Contractor or Part-Time Employee (Certain States).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedule.

Schedule

  • Day shift.
  • Weekend/Weekday availability.

Ability to Commute / Relocate

Location: Local area as per job post

Reliably commute or plan to relocate before starting work (Required).

Experience

  • Teaching: 2+ years (Preferred).

Job Type

  • Part-time
  • Contract

Work Location: In person

title: Sygeplejersker til nattevagten i den udekørende sygepleje, Svendborg Kommune
description:
Bliv en del af en sygepleje i udvikling, hvor du får ansvar, faglig frihed og et stærkt fællesskab om ryggen.

Vi søger flere natsygeplejersker til den kommunale hjemmepleje i Svendborg Kommune. Er du klar til at tage ansvar for borgerne, mens resten af byen sover? Så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Kort om stillingerne

  • 37 timer om ugen i nattevagt med arbejde hver 2. weekend
  • Vi er fleksible i forhold til timetal og forsøger så vidt muligt at imødekomme dine ønsker
  • Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller senest 1. januar 2027.

Vær med til at forme fremtidens kommunale sygepleje.

Som led i Sundhedsreformen overgår nogle af de sygeplejefaglige opgaver til regionen. Hvilket gør, at vi skal udvide vores sygeplejefaglige dækning om natten, det giver nye og spændende opgaver. Du får indflydelse på en sygepleje, hvor faglighed, klinisk lederskab, tværfagligt samarbejde og borgerens behov står i centrum.

Om os

Den kommunale sygepleje i består af 35 sygeplejersker med forskellig alder, erfaring og kompetencer. Vi er et velfungerende team med bred og høj faglighed, hvor samarbejde, sparring og fællesskab fylder meget.

Vi tager udgangspunkt i det hele menneske og har altid borgerens behov, ønsker og muligheder for øje. Værdierne er ikke bare ord for os. Du kan mærke dem i, hvordan vi arbejder sammen, og vi møder borgere og kolleger med respekt, åbenhed og tillid. Hos os er der plads til at tage ansvar, arbejde selvstændigt og tilpasse opgaveløsningen til situationen. Du står aldrig alene, for vi bruger hinanden til faglig sparring, refleksion og udvikling.

Din hverdag i nattevagten:

Du får et tæt samarbejde med kolleger i hjemmeplejen og på plejecentrene: social- og sundhedsassistenter, social- og sundhedshjælpere og ufaglærte kolleger.

I nattevagten er vi to kommunale sygeplejersker på vagt sammen med et udekørende nathold på fem medarbejdere. Derudover er der to nattevagter på hvert af kommunens plejecentre.

Hver nat mødes vi med det udekørende nathold og har telefonisk sparring med plejecentrene. Vi triagerer borgerne for at opspore begyndende sygdom tidligt. Her spiller du en vigtig rolle i at styrke kollegernes faglighed gennem en reflekterende, vejledende og faciliterende tilgang.

Vi tilbyder

  • Selvstændigt ansvar og faglige udfordringer, hvor du gør en forskel for den enkelte borger
  • En kommunal sygepleje i udvikling med fokus på klinisk lederskab, tidlig opsporing, forebyggelse og ældreloven
  • Struktureret kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse tilpasset dine ønsker og faglige interesser. Diplommodul i rehabilitering og demens er en fast del af ansættelsen
  • Løbende undervisning i sektionen ved egne specialister og tværfaglige samarbejdspartnere
  • Mulighed for at blive en del af vores specialistfunktioner inden for blandt andet sår, palliation, Nexus og kontinens samt klinisk vejledning, mentorfunktion for nyansatte og forskellige nøglefunktioner
  • Tværfaglige møder med kolleger og samarbejdspartnere
  • Et udviklende arbejdsmiljø med indflydelse, sparring og faglig refleksion
  • Et stærkt socialt fællesskab og høj trivsel

Vi søger en kollega, der

  • Kan være tovholder for borgere med kroniske og psykiske sygdomme, aktive behandlingsforløb og terminale forløb, også når ressourcerne er sparsomme
  • Har rutine i akutte, komplekse forløb og arbejder struktureret med afsæt i klinisk lederskab
  • Har viden om tidlig opsporing, ISBAR og TOBS
  • Opbygger relationer baseret på tillid og åbenhed til borgere, pårørende og kolleger
  • Samarbejder godt internt og på tværs af kommunens aktører
  • Har pædagogiske og kommunikative evner og en positiv tilgang til nye opgaver
  • Kan lede sygeplejen selvstændigt og facilitere sundhedsfremme med fokus på rehabilitering
  • Har autorisation som sygeplejerske og kørekort

Har du lyst til at være med på rejsen? Send din ansøgning og dit CV, så fortæller vi gerne mere.

Ældreområdet – faglig kernefortælling

Når du arbejder på ældreområdet, møder du bag hver enkeltdør et unikt menneske. Et menneske, du gør en forskel for. Hos os har du frihed til at møde netop dét menneske – måske i en lille snak, i en svær stund eller med en hjælpende hånd. Vi har ikke én færdig opskrift på det gode ældre liv, fordi vi hylder forskelligheden. Men vi gør os altid umage med at møde det enkelte menneske med værdighed. Vi insisterer på at skabe de bedste rammer for, at du kan udføre dit arbejde godt og meningsfuldt. Vi har også høje forventninger til dig og til din faglighed. Du får lov at bruge det, du kan, og arbejde med det, du brænder mest for. Du vil få en synlig leder, du kan sparre med, og dejlige kollegerat dele hverdagen med.

Om Svendborg Kommune

Svendborg Kommune er i vores øjne en arbejdsplads af en helt perfekt størrelse: Vi er små nok til at være tæt på hinanden i et varmt, uhøjtideligt fællesskab med korte kommandoveje og uden skjulte dagsordener. Og vi er store nok til at have god plads til ambitioner, høj faglighed og rige muligheder for udvikling.

Vi holder af hverdagen og insisterer på, at det skal være rart at gå på arbejde. Vi har travlt, men ikke for travlt til at hjælpe hinanden.

Løn og ansættelse

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst.

I Svendborg Kommune ligger lønnen for denne type stilling typisk mellem 37.534 og 54.773 kr. pr. måned ved fuldtidsansættelse. Lønnen er inklusive pension, særlig feriegodtgørelse og faste tillæg. Der kan desuden være arbejdstidsbestemte tillæg og andre særydelser. Det er vigtigt at bemærke, at din konkrete løn fastsættes ud fra din erfaring, anciennitet og kompetencer og aftales ved forhandling med den relevante faglige organisation.

Der skal kunne forevises en privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i stillingen.

Svendborg Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid. Vi ønsker, at røgfri arbejdstid skal bidrage til et sundt arbejdsmiljø for alle medarbejdere.

Ansøgningsfrist 29. oktober 2026

Samtaler forventes afholdt den 4. november 2026.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen eller vil vide mere, er du velkomment il at kontakte områdeleder Nina Nourani på telefon 24886990 eller via mail nina.nourani@svendborg.dk.

Velkommen til Svendborg - Øhavets hovedstad!
Svendborg har en suveræn beliggenhed midt i den skønneste natur, på kanten af det Sydfynske Øhav og med en mini-metropol, der byder på det hele. Vi tøver ikke, når vi med stolthed kalder Svendborg for Fyns kulturhovedstad. Vi har en charmerende bymidte og livlig handelsby med teatre og museer samt et rigt foreningsliv. Vores dagtilbud og folkeskoler er i top og med særligt fokus på bevægelse og sport, og vi har flere videregående uddannelser, som snart samles i et attraktivt uddannelsesmiljø ved havnen. Svendborg er placeret midt i landet med en halv time til Odense og under to timer til København og Århus. Svendborg er med sine ca. 60.000 indbyggere Fyns andenstørste kommune.

title: Senior Java Backend Engineer — DevOps & Azure
description:
ABN AMRO Bank N.V. zoekt een Java Backend Engineer voor Detecting Financial Crime (DFC) in Amsterdam. Je bouwt veilige en schaalbare KYC-applicaties, werkt in een DevOps-omgeving en gebruikt Java backend development met Spring Boot, JPA en RESTful API’s.

Je werkt samen met multidisciplinaire teams en maakt waar relevant gebruik van Azure-cloudservices. We benadrukken Agile- en Lean-methodologieën, samenwerking en continue verbetering, met een focus op kwaliteit en beveiliging.

title: Backend developer BVID
description:
Over de functie

Je gaat aan de slag als ervaren back-end developer binnen de doorontwikkeling van de Basis Voorziening Identiteit Vaststelling (BVID). Je werkt aan een maatschappelijk kritische applicatie waarmee persoonsgegevens van verdachten en vreemdelingen worden geregistreerd en geverifieerd via identificatiezuilen. Binnen een DevOps-team draag je bij aan het implementeren van nieuwe wet- en regelgeving en het verbeteren van kwaliteit, stabiliteit en performance. Je werkt in een dynamische omgeving met veel technische diepgang, waarin samenwerking, eigenaarschap en continue verbetering centraal staan.

Wat ga je doen

  • Je bent als teamlid medeverantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van de doelen van het team.
  • Je draagt bij aan het volledige software delivery proces: van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot testen, deployment, monitoring en operationeel beheer.
  • Je werkt onder architectuur en stemt technische keuzes af met collega’s en de Tech Lead.
  • Je neemt eigenaarschap over de kwaliteit, stabiliteit en performance van de systemen die je bouwt.
  • Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen in processen, tooling en samenwerking.
  • Je draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van teammetrics zoals deployment frequency en lead time for changes.
  • Je werkt effectief samen met andere teams via duidelijke interactiepatronen.
  • Je helpt de cognitieve belasting binnen het team beheersbaar te houden.
  • Je deelt kennis, geeft feedback en ondersteunt collega’s in hun groei.
  • Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan onder meer de migratie van BVID-2 naar BVID-3 en andere noodzakelijke wettelijke wijzigingen.
  • Je bent in overleg ook buiten reguliere kantoortijden beschikbaar voor piketdienst.

Over jou

  • Je beschikt over hbo-werk- en -denkniveau.
  • Je bent een brede T-shaped professional met diepgaande expertise in backend development en brede kennis van DevOps-tooling, containerization, CI/CD, testautomatisering en security.
  • Je houdt van aanpakken, denkt mee over technische en functionele verbeteringen en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving met maatschappelijke impact.
  • Je bent transparant in je keuzes, neemt initiatief en draagt bij aan een cultuur van eigenaarschap, technische excellentie en continue verbetering.
  • Je werkt goed samen, hebt oog voor het groepsbelang en draagt actief bij aan een positieve werksfeer.
  • Je maakt feiten, meningen en ideeën in begrijpelijke Nederlandse taal mondeling en schriftelijk duidelijk.

Eisen

  • Je hebt een diploma op hbo-niveau (bachelor) of je bent daaraan gelijkgesteld via EVC. Of je hebt minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 6 jaar minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring met .NET Development.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met REST API Development.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met Containerization.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring opgedaan in versiebeheer (GIT).
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met microservices en messaging-technieken.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in een DevOps-omgeving en daarmee een DevOps-mindset.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring met RabbitMQ of soortgelijke messaging-technieken.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Entity Framework en MSSQL.

Wensen

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met domain driven design.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Kubernetes en/of OpenShift.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Jenkins of soortgelijke CI/CD-tooling, zoals GitLab of ArgoCD.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met monitoring en logging tooling zoals Elastic/Kibana.
  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met testautomatisering, waaronder unittests, integratietests en apitests.

Competenties

  • Je signaleert problemen, zoekt en herkent belangrijke informatie, rafelt vraagstukken uiteen en legt verbanden tussen gegevens.

description:
After School - Youth Program Instructor

About Brains and Motion Education

Are you ready to join Brains & Motion Education (BAM!) and unleash the potential within every student?

At BAM!, we bring together top-notch instructors and exciting content to local schools and communities, offering students year-round opportunities to grow and explore their interests. Learning isn't just about gaining knowledge—it's about having fun, staying active, and making lasting memories!

Our on-campus programs are located at local schools, providing a safe, engaging environment where students can thrive alongside their peers. We specialize in innovative STEM, Arts, and Sports enrichment programs that have inspired over 100,000 students across more than 1,000 schools. Whether through multi-sport programs or guided recess, our mission is simple: to equip kids with the physical and social tools to thrive.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact in youth sports, join us in shaping the future of active learning!

Job Description

We are looking for a high-energy After School - Youth Program Instructor to facilitate engaging after-school experiences, including hands-on STEAM projects, creative art, active physical games, and homework support. In this role, you will cultivate an encouraging space where K–8 students stay active, curious, and supported throughout the afternoon.

  • Activity Leadership: Lead structured STEAM experiments, hands-on creative art projects, and active sports/recreational games.

  • Structured Recess & Play: Direct outdoor recreational play and guided recess activities to keep students energized and engaged.

  • Classroom Management: Proven ability to manage groups of K–8 students and foster positive behavior.

  • Clearance: Ability to pass a mandatory Live Scan / background check process.
  • Physical Demands: Ability to occasionally lift and move program materials weighing 20–50 lbs (with or without reasonable accommodations).
  • Availability: Available Monday through Friday afternoons between 1:00 PM and 6:00 PM.

Position Details

  • Pay Rate: $25/hour
  • Job Type: Part Time
  • Schedule: Mon, Tues, Thurs, Fri 2:00 PM to 6:00 PM - Wed 12:30 PM to 6:00 PM

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal or state or local law. title: AI Operations Head
description:
Lazard is one of the world’s preeminent financial advisory and asset management firms. Our people and culture make the difference. While global in presence and reach, ours is a close, collaborative community of just over 3,000 professionals. Lazard is a place of continuous knowledge sharing, skill development and relationship building, where professionals grow and succeed together. Our entrepreneurial culture, flat structure and embrace of individual differences, allow creative ideas, original concepts, and unique perspectives to drive our business forward — and for careers to take flight.

AI is the central pillar of Lazard’s 2030 Growth Strategy. Our ambition is to become the leading AI-enabled independent Financial Services firm. This is to say we are interested in AI beyond the scope of operational efficiency. We see AI and Contextual Alpha as two primary factors underpinning our future success and better outcomes for our clients.

In light of this focus, we are looking for a Head of AI Operations to establish and drive the operating framework that enables the effective, scalable, and responsible deployment of artificial intelligence across the firm. This role will be responsible for translating AI strategy into durable operating capabilities, ensuring that AI models and tools are developed, tested, deployed, monitored, catalogued, supported and governed to the highest institutional standards.

AI is the central pillar of Lazard’s 2030 Growth Strategy. Our ambition is to become the leading AI-enabled independent Financial Services firm. This is to say we are interested in AI beyond the scope of operational efficiency. We see AI and Contextual Alpha as two primary factors underpinning our future success and better outcomes for our clients.

In light of this focus, we are looking for an AI Operations Head to establish and drive the operating framework that enables the effective, scalable, and responsible deployment of artificial intelligence across the firm. This role will be responsible for translating AI strategy into durable operating capabilities, ensuring that AI models and tools are developed, tested, deployed, monitored, catalogued, supported and governed to the highest institutional standards.

We’ll trust you to

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end AI operational model, from development and evaluation through deployment, monitoring, lifecycle management, and retirement. Establish consistent operational standards across multiple AI initiatives, agents, teams, and business lines
  • Oversee production readiness for AI models, agents and applications, including testing, documentation, validation coordination, access control, documentation standards, deployment controls, and performance monitoring
  • Establish evaluation practices for generative AI applications, including measures for accuracy, relevance, and alignment with source material, harmful or inappropriate outputs, and performance against business requirements.
  • Partner with engineering, data science, and security teams to threat-model and harden generative AI systems, including RAG applications and agents that use external tools or connect to firm data. Address risks such as prompt injection, jailbreaks, sensitive data exposure, unsafe outputs, and unauthorized access.
  • Monitor the performance, data quality, usage, and security of AI systems in production; identify changes in behavior and coordinate remediation when needed.
  • Implement governance practices for explainability, documentation, human oversight, and accountability, and support internal and external reviews of AI systems and processes.

  • Build strong working relationships with advisory teams, investment professionals, and senior leaders to ensure solutions are fit for purpose

You’ll need to have

  • 10 or more years of experience leading technology operations, platform operations, or data/analytics operations
  • Direct experience supporting AI, machine learning, or advanced analytics systems in production environments and the corresponding operational risk, controls, and governance principles
  • Proven ability to lead cross‑functional teams and operate effectively in complex organizational settings
  • Exceptional communication skills and influencing abilities to build consensus and drive collegial cross-functional collaboration
  • Experience designing or leading AI or analytics operating models at scale strongly preferred
  • Background in engineering, data science, or technology risk earlier in career

What we offer

We strive to enhance the total health and well-being of our employees through comprehensive, competitive benefits. Our goal is to offer a highly individualized employee experience that enables you to balance your commitments to career, family, and community. When you work for Lazard, you are working for an organization that cares about your unique talents and passions, and will continue to invest in the development of your career.

We expect the base salary range for this role to be approximately $175,000 - $200,000 USD. Various factors contribute to determining the actual base compensation offered, including but not limited to the applicant’s years of relevant experience, career tenure, qualifications, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and relevant skills for the role. Base salary is one component of Lazard’s compensation package, which also includes comprehensive benefits and may include incentive compensation.

Representation at Lazard

Lazard is an intellectual capital business committed to delivering the best advice and solutions to clients. To achieve these objectives, we focus on attracting, developing and retaining the best talent. We believe that a workforce comprised of people who represent a wide array of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives creates a rich variety of thought that empowers us to challenge conventional wisdom, solve problems creatively and make better decisions.

Lazard was built on the premise that a multicultural firm can best serve a global clientele. As a global firm that has grown organically from local roots in different countries, we have a deep tradition of respecting and appreciating individual differences. Doing so has been core to our success for over 175 years. We are committed to sustaining an environment where every colleague is supported in their professional pursuits, can maximize their individual potential and contribute to our collective success.

title: Behaviorist
company: FOUR OAKS FAMILY AND CHILDRENS SERVICES
description:
Behaviorist

Understand Behavior. Inspire Change. Make a Lasting Impact.

Are you passionate about understanding behavior, helping individuals overcome challenges, and creating meaningful, lasting change?

At Four Oaks, we believe everyone deserves the opportunity to grow, develop new skills, and reach their fullest potential. We're looking for a compassionate, knowledgeable, and motivated Behaviorist who is ready to turn that belief into action!

As a Behaviorist, you'll play an important role in helping individuals navigate social, emotional, and behavioral challenges. Through individualized assessments, creative interventions, and collaboration with families and professionals, you'll help develop practical strategies that encourage positive behaviors and long-term success.

This isn't just about managing behaviors. It's about understanding the person behind them and helping create a path toward a brighter future!

What You'll Do

Every individual is unique, and so is the approach you'll take to helping them succeed! In this role, you will:

Understand the Whole Person: Conduct initial consultations, behavioral observations, and appropriate assessments to better understand each individual's needs, strengths, and challenges.

Create Individualized Solutions: Develop, implement, and adjust treatment plans using evidence-based approaches tailored to each client's cognitive, social, emotional, and sensory needs.

Turn Challenges into Progress: Identify behavioral patterns, develop effective interventions, and help individuals build healthier coping skills and positive behaviors.

Observe, Assess, and Adapt: Evaluate behaviors in individual, group, and structured settings to gain valuable insight and guide treatment strategies.

Empower Those Around You: Provide coaching, training, and ongoing support to staff, families, and other caregivers to promote consistent and effective behavioral interventions.

Collaborate for Success: Work closely with multidisciplinary teams, families, educators, and community professionals to create a coordinated approach to care.

Build Strong Connections: Communicate with families and other support systems to better understand each client's challenges, available resources, and opportunities for growth.

Track Progress and Celebrate Success: Maintain accurate treatment notes, assessments, and reports while regularly reviewing goals and adjusting interventions to support continued progress.

Make a Lasting Difference: Help individuals and their support systems develop practical strategies that encourage positive change beyond the treatment setting.

Why You'll Love Working at Four Oaks

We know that making a difference in the lives of others starts with feeling supported, valued, and empowered in your own career.

At Four Oaks, you'll join a team that believes in collaboration, professional growth, and creating meaningful opportunities for the individuals and families we serve.

Here's what you can look forward to:

Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance – Supporting your health and well-being.

401(k) Retirement Plan – Helping you invest in your future.

Competitive Wages – Compensation that recognizes your skills and dedication.

Growth & Advancement Opportunities – Continue developing your professional skills and career.

Excellent Paid Leave Package – Because work/life balance matters.

7 Paid Holidays – Additional time to recharge.

Educational Discounts – Opportunities to support continued learning.

Fitness Center Discounts – Resources to support your wellness.

Business Casual Work Environment – A professional and welcoming workplace.

Supportive Team Culture – Collaborate with individuals who share your passion for making a difference.

Your Expertise. Their Progress. A Brighter Future.

Sometimes, the smallest breakthroughs lead to the biggest changes.

Whether you're helping someone develop a new coping skill, supporting a family through a challenging situation, or giving staff the tools they need to make a difference, your knowledge, compassion, and dedication can create a lasting impact.

At Four Oaks, you'll have the opportunity to turn your passion for behavioral health into meaningful progress for the individuals and families we serve.

If you're ready to use your expertise to inspire growth, empower others, and help change lives, we want to hear from you!

Be the Difference. Inspire Positive Change. Join Four Oaks!

Apply today and help build brighter futures, one breakthrough at a time!

title: Founding AI R&D Engineer — AI Infrastructure & Model Routing
description:
Location: Hong Kong / flexible hybrid arrangementCompany: A-Field Tech LimitedType: Founding-team, full-time role

Help build the intelligence layer for AI infrastructure in Asia

A-Field Tech Limited is a Hong Kong-based AI and network infrastructure company. We are building a stable regional AI gateway (www.nexllm.ai) to leading AI models. Our live platform gives developers one interface for accessing 51 models across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, and other providers.

We are now developing the next layer: intelligent routing, model evaluation, reliability tooling, and developer infrastructure that helps applications choose and operate the right model for each task.

We are looking for a Founding AI R&D Engineer to help turn research ideas into working systems.

What you will work on

  • Research and prototype intelligent model-routing strategies
  • Build evaluation and benchmarking tools for quality, cost, latency, and reliability
  • Develop fallback, retry, caching, observability, and quota-management systems
  • Investigate how prompts and task requirements can be matched to suitable models
  • Build experiments, simulations, datasets, and reproducible test harnesses
  • Integrate new model providers and standardise different APIs and capabilities
  • Turn validated research into reliable production features
  • Document findings, limitations, and technical recommendations clearly

The role combines applied AI research, software engineering, distributed systems, and product development. You will work on real technical problems affecting a live platform, not a purely theoretical research project.

What we are looking for

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with applied research, experimentation, data analysis, AI systems, or complex technical products
  • Familiarity with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or a similar language
  • Understanding of APIs, databases, asynchronous systems, cloud infrastructure, or distributed services
  • Ability to turn an unclear problem into a hypothesis, experiment, measurable result, and practical implementation
  • Strong analytical thinking and attention to reliability and reproducibility
  • Curiosity about large language models, model evaluation, routing, and AI infrastructure
  • Ownership mindset and comfort working in an early-stage company

A degree in computer science, AI, machine learning, software engineering, data science, or a related field is helpful. Strong projects, research experience, publications, open-source work, or equivalent practical experience are also welcome.

You do not need prior experience building an AI gateway. We care about your ability to learn unfamiliar systems, investigate difficult questions, and build useful solutions.

Why join A-Field Tech/NexLLM

  • Join while the core R&D direction is still being shaped
  • Work directly with the founder and have visible technical ownership
  • Build systems used by developers and AI teams across Asia
  • Work at the intersection of AI models, routing, evaluation, reliability, and developer tools
  • Help establish a regional technical capability in AI infrastructure
  • Receive a competitive salary and share-option opportunity, subject to formal scheme terms

How to apply

Please send the following to info@a-fieldtech.com:

  • CV, LinkedIn, GitHub, portfolio, or examples of technical work
  • A short note explaining your interest in NexLLM and AI infrastructure research
  • One example of a technical or research problem you investigated and what you learned

Subject: Founding AI R&D Engineer / Developer application — [Your Name]

A-Field Tech/NexLLM welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds who are excited to help build the next generation of AI infrastructure in Asia.

title: Tug Master til Danmarks største erhvervshavn
description:
Har du lyst til at være skibsfører på Aarhus Havns bugserbåde, hvor du skal bugsere alt fra forskellige fragtskibe til nogle af verdens største containerskibe? Har du gode samarbejdsevner og formår at bevare overblikket med en solid situationsfornemmelse? Udviser du initiativ i en hverdag præget af frihed under ansvar? Så er du måske den nye kollega, som Aarhus Havn står og mangler.

Aarhus Havn er en central del af den kritiske nationale infrastruktur og forbinder dansk erhvervsliv med hele verden. Sammen med de mange virksomheder og mennesker på havnen arbejder vi hver dag for at sikre dansk forsyning, arbejdspladser og udvikling – både lokalt og nationalt.

Vi søger en Tug Master (skibsfører), der kan indgå i vores dygtige hold, der er med til at drive og sejle Aarhus Havns to ASD bugserbåde, Aros og Hermes.

Som Tug Master er du skibsføreren på bugserbåden i bugserbådsoperationer. Derudover deltager du i arbejdet ombord på bugserbåden sammen med vores Chief Engineers.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil derfor primært være:

  • Sejlads med vores bugserbåde
  • Test og vedligeholdelse af udstyr ombord på bugserbådene

Du bliver en del af vores Maritime Operations, hvor vi har samlet alle vores maritime kompetencer, der er en helt central del af driften på Aarhus Havn. Du vil referere til Head of Maritime Operations, Jens Vejse Møller.

**Hvem er du?
**Vi søger en kollega med gode samarbejdsevner, som formår at bevare overblikket og en har god situationsfornemmelse. Vi søger desuden en kollega der, er er engageret og kan arbejde selvstændigt og udviser initiativ i en hverdag præget af frihed under ansvar.

Derudover er det et krav, at du opfylder følgende:

  • Minimum sønæringsbevis som sætteskipper
  • Gyldigt sundhedsbevis
  • ROC certifikat
  • Sygdomsbehandler STCW A-VI/4
  • Gyldigt bevis for brandledelse STCW A-VI/3
  • Gyldigt bevis for søsikkerhed og brandbekæmpelse i skibe. STCW A-VI/1-1 og A-VI/1-2 og STCW A-VI/2-1
  • Du har kørekort B
  • Du behersker engelsk i skrift og tale
  • Du skal kunne møde på arbejde med 1,5 times varsel, da vagtordningen for skibsførere delvis består af tilkaldetjeneste

Erfaring med Azimut foretrækkes.

I oplæringsperioden skal du være indstillet på et cirka tre måneders intensivt oplæringsforløb, som vi tilpasser til dig alt efter din erfaring.

**En arbejdsplads med en stolt kultur og høje ambitioner
**Du bliver en del af Danmarks største erhvervshavn, der arbejder for at skabe fremtidens bæredygtige havn, hvor erhvervslivet kan udvikle sig i en foranderlig verden.

Vi er en arbejdsplads med en stolt kultur, hvor 120 engagerede kollegaer hver dag arbejder for at udvikle havnen og styrke Danmarks forsyningssikkerhed og konkurrenceevne. Kollegaer, der står for alt fra skibsanløb, infrastruktur og ejendomsudvikling til IT-sikkerhed, kommunikation, økonomi og kommercielle aktiviteter. Vidt forskellige opgaver, men fælles om en høj faglighed, stærke ambitioner og et ønske om at gøre en forskel.

**Løn og ansættelsesvilkår
**Du ansættes som Tug Master, hvor løn, pensions- og ansættelsesvilkår er efter gældende KL-overenskomst.

Dine arbejdsdage vil som udgangspunkt være hos Aarhus Havn A/S, Vandvejen 7, 8000 Aarhus C.

title: Senior Appian Developer
description:
Why Sabel Systems

Sabel Systems designs and delivers digital engineering ecosystems for DoD programs, enabling teams to connect data, systems, and personnel within secure, scalable environments. Our solutions empower programs to make faster decisions, close sustainment gaps, and meet the digital acquisition requirements.

Rather than simply proposing transformation, we implement and operate it at scale. Our method is clear: we orchestrate existing tools into a governing system of record, ensuring government ownership of infrastructure and traceable decisions. There’s no vendor lock, no proprietary baselines, and no need for ATO rebuilds during transitions.

Sabel Systems is redefining modern defense acquisition. If you seek to solve complex challenges at scale and want your work to directly accelerate military capability while reshaping the DoD’s approach to digital engineering, this is the place for you.

Complexity Simplified. Mission Amplified.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and architect enterprise-grade Appian solutions including process models, rules, CDTs (Custom Data Types), portals, and interfaces that address complex business process automation requirements
  • Gather, analyze, and document functional and technical requirements from DoD stakeholders; translate business needs into detailed technical specifications and solution designs
  • Develop and implement API integrations (REST, SOAP, JDBC) to connect Appian applications with legacy systems, cloud platforms, and third-party services in enterprise environments
  • Design and execute ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes and data migrations from legacy systems to new Appian-based environments; ensure data integrity and compliance throughout migrations

  • Conduct code reviews, peer programming sessions, and technical documentation; establish and maintain coding standards and implementation best practices across projects
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives; manage tasks and deliverables using Jira and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues; perform root cause analysis and implement preventive solutions to ensure system stability and performance
  • Provide technical demonstrations and presentations to clients; interface with stakeholders to gather feedback and communicate technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Mentor and develop junior developers and consultants; share knowledge of Appian best practices and support team member growth through guidance and technical mentorship

Under direct supervision, coordinates all aspects of the game and technical program elements for the middle school services. Serves as an on-stage host and assists the Middle School Pastor with various aspects of the middle school engagement group ministry at NewSpring Church.

description:
Summary:

Operates a forklift to stack and retrieve supplies and materials. Responsibilities also include documenting and maintaining inventory and ensuring production area organization and cleanliness.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Adheres to all safety policies and procedures
  • Obeys all Cal/OSHA guidelines and regulations
  • Ensures equipment is in safe operating condition
  • Moves pallets from one area to another
  • Ensures that pallets and boxes are properly accounted for
  • Ensures that daily inspections of equipment are completed before utilization
  • Maintains clear and open communication with management
  • General warehouse duties as needed
  • Perform a combination of the following duties including but not limited to:
  • Must follow product rotation procedures, and organization while using internal day code system
    Inspect all trailers before loading for any issues (ie damage, torn chute, foul smell…)
  • Verify order number and truck name with line truck driver prior to loading
  • Learn and understand the various loading configurations, and patterns of product / commodities
  • Load transport vehicles, making sure loads are evenly and securely placed
  • Load trailers safely and properly while using standard loading procedures / patterns without damaging produce, boxes, or trailer equip
  • Must understand weight distribution on long haul trailers and demonstrate loading capabilities (ie loading and stacking techniques, including separating wet and dry goods)
  • Document on loading manifest the exact quantities of all commodities loaded into trailer, as well as any additional services performed (ie stacking, bagging, and corner boarding)
  • Must be able to read and follow loading instructions, and communicate with line truck drivers any weight restrictions / limits
  • Assist dispatch office with product availability to help schedule truck loading
  • Follow safe operating procedures
  • Maintain a clean work area, and material handling
  • Keep a record of daily operations
  • Service and make minor adjustments to the forklift
  • Must be able to work flexible hours in a cold environment (33 Deg F / 1 Deg C)
  • Practice the “honor system” – be forthright and honest under all circumstances
  • Suggest opportunities for improvement
  • Fill out pre-start up forklift inspection form- Report any issues to your immediate supervisor
  • Inspect the inside of the trailer before loading, and fill out the trailer inspection section on the pick ticket (loading manifest). Contact a supervisor if the walls or air chute are damaged; mark the number of pallets already on board of trailer, if any.
  • Read the loading manifest and read the loading instructions before loading
  • Load on a FIFO (Fist in, First out) basis unless stated otherwise on pick ticket (manifest)
  • Load by lot specified on the loading manifest
  • Only pull daughter tags for product that are the forks of the forklift. Do Not pull more daughter tags from pallets that are not being handled. Load pallets that have daughter tags pulled off and report it on the loading schematics
  • Verify that the amount ordered on the pick ticket (manifest) matches the amount reported on the loading schematics
  • Report placement of the recorder on the loading schematics with a “R” on orders that call for a recorder
    Verify that the recorder is started and place it in the trailer. Please place it on dry cartons and not on top of any iced product
    Verify that the truck driver secures the pallets loaded with load locks
  • Fold the dock leveler (ramp) and close the roll up door

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees in this position. This is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.

description:
Staples is business to business. You're what binds us together.

At Staples, our merchandising and supply chain teams play a critical role in delivering the products and solutions our customers need to keep their businesses running. As a Sr. Buyer (NSP), you will serve as a key partner between customers, vendors, and internal teams, ensuring non-stock and special-order products are sourced, purchased, and delivered accurately and on time. This role is ideal for a highly organized purchasing professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges, and is passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.

What you'll be doing:

  • Source and purchase non-stock products, including office supplies, furniture, specialty print jobs, and urgent customer requests.
  • Manage daily purchasing activities for drop ship, special order, Staples Direct, and wholesaler-sourced products.
  • Review customer orders to identify effective sourcing solutions while balancing cost, service, and delivery expectations.
  • Process high volumes of purchase orders accurately and on schedule, resolving rejections, pricing discrepancies, vendor exceptions, and fulfillment issues to save sales whenever possible.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Care, Accounts Payable, and vendor partners to resolve order issues and support customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate complex shipments, logistics requirements, and large-scale customer orders requiring specialized transportation solutions.
  • Monitor vendor performance and partner with suppliers to improve service levels and operational execution.
  • Provide guidance and training to buyers and new team members while supporting process improvements, workload balancing, and operational excellence.

What you bring to the table:

  • Strong purchasing and procurement expertise, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and sound business judgment when addressing complex order, sourcing, and logistics challenges.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across internal teams and external vendor partners.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, evaluating sourcing options, and influencing supplier performance improvements.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when managing high-volume transactions.
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, or training team members on purchasing best practices.
  • Working knowledge of office products and supply chain operations is highly valued.

What's needed - Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of purchasing or procurement experience.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.

The Senior Product Manager, Global Service Offerings will play a role in Global Services innovation by defining and executing Global Service offering strategy, pricing, portfolio alignment, market research, performance analytics, and commercialization. title: AI R&D Engineering Intern — AI Infrastructure, Model Routing & Applied Research
description:
Help build the intelligence layer for Asia’s AI infrastructure

A-Field Tech Limited is a Hong Kong-based AI and network infrastructure company. NexLLM is a Hong Kong-based AI infrastructure company building a stable and secure regional gateway for developers who need reliable access to leading AI models.

Our live platform provides developers with OpenAI-compatible APIs across a growing catalogue of models, including Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, and DeepSeek. We are now developing the next layer: intelligent model routing, model evaluation, reliability tooling, and developer infrastructure that helps applications choose and operate the right model for each task.

We are looking for a full-time AI R&D Engineering Intern to join our engineering team. This internship is designed for a university student who wants practical experience working on real AI infrastructure, applied research, and software engineering problems.

You will work closely with the founder and engineering team on projects that affect a live platform. This is not a purely observational internship or a role limited to administrative tasks. You will be expected to learn quickly, build working prototypes, measure results, and contribute to production improvements with appropriate guidance.

Internship details

  • Role: AI R&D Engineering Intern
  • Commitment: Full-time internship
  • Location: Hong Kong / flexible hybrid arrangement
  • Company: NexLLM
  • Team: AI infrastructure, model routing, evaluation, and platform engineering
  • Duration: To be agreed based on the university programme and candidate’s availability
  • Start date: Flexible, subject to mutual agreement

What you may work on

Your projects will be selected according to your skills, learning goals, and NexLLM’s current priorities. Possible areas include:

  • Researching and prototyping model-routing strategies
  • Comparing models across quality, cost, latency, availability, and reliability
  • Building benchmark datasets and reproducible evaluation tools
  • Developing fallback, retry, timeout, caching, and quota-management features
  • Investigating provider errors, rate limits, response formats, and performance changes
  • Integrating new model providers and standardising their APIs and capabilities
  • Building scripts, dashboards, data pipelines, and internal developer tools
  • Reviewing relevant papers, technical documentation, and open-source projects
  • Turning validated experiments into well-tested product features
  • Writing clear technical notes explaining methods, results, limitations, and recommendations

The work may involve Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, HTTP APIs, databases, asynchronous systems, cloud services, data analysis, and AI model APIs. You will not be expected to know everything before joining; we care about your ability to learn and make steady, evidence-based progress.

What you will learn

During the internship, you may gain practical experience in:

  • Building and debugging software used by real developers
  • Working with multiple commercial and open-source AI model providers
  • Designing experiments and evaluating model behaviour
  • Measuring latency, cost, quality, failure rates, and recovery performance
  • Building reliable API integrations and distributed services
  • Understanding how AI gateways, routing systems, and token usage work
  • Translating research ideas into practical engineering decisions
  • Communicating technical findings clearly
  • Working in an early-stage company where priorities evolve quickly

How the internship will work

You will normally work through a complete project cycle:

  1. Understand a technical problem and the user or product context.
  2. Review existing approaches, documentation, and relevant research.
  3. Form a hypothesis and define how success will be measured.
  4. Build a small experiment, prototype, or test harness.
  5. Analyse the results and identify limitations.
  6. Discuss the findings with the engineering team.
  7. Improve the solution and, where appropriate, help move it into production.
  8. Document what was learned and what should happen next.

The level of independence will increase as you become familiar with the platform. We provide direction and review, but you should be comfortable asking questions, investigating problems, and taking ownership of agreed tasks.

What we are looking for

We are looking for a university student who is curious, technically capable, and motivated to build real systems.

You should have:

  • Current university enrolment in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, mathematics, or a related field
  • Strong interest in AI models, software engineering, or developer infrastructure
  • Basic programming experience in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, C++, or a similar language
  • Familiarity with APIs, Git, databases, or cloud services, through coursework or personal projects
  • Ability to break an unclear problem into smaller steps
  • Willingness to test assumptions and measure results rather than rely on guesses
  • Care with details, reproducibility, and technical documentation
  • Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively
  • Availability for a full-time internship during the agreed internship period

Prior professional experience is not required. Strong coursework, personal projects, research projects, hackathon work, open-source contributions, GitHub repositories, or technical writing are welcome.

You do not need prior experience with AI gateways, large language model infrastructure, or distributed systems. We value learning ability and practical curiosity more than a long list of tools.

Helpful but not required

What makes someone a strong fit

You may be a strong fit if you:

  • Like understanding how things work rather than only using them
  • Enjoy both reading and building
  • Can turn a question into a small experiment
  • Are willing to start with an imperfect prototype and improve it
  • Care about whether your results are reliable and reproducible
  • Take responsibility for finishing work and communicating blockers early
  • Want to see your work used in a real product
  • Are excited by the fast-moving AI infrastructure landscape in Asia

This internship may not be the right fit if you are looking only for a passive learning experience, do not want to write or debug software, or prefer a fixed task list with no ambiguity. Early-stage engineering work requires curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn unfamiliar systems.

Why join NexLLM

  • Work on a live AI platform used by developers
  • Gain practical experience with multiple leading AI models and providers
  • Work directly with the founder and engineering team
  • Learn about model routing, evaluation, reliability, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
  • Build projects that can become real product capabilities
  • Receive feedback and guidance from experienced team members
  • Explore the intersection of applied AI research and product engineering
  • Help build a regional AI infrastructure capability from Hong Kong
  • Potentially be considered for future engineering opportunities based on performance and business needs

Compensation and university coordination

This is a full-time internship. Internship compensation, working arrangement, duration, start date, and any university documentation will be discussed with shortlisted candidates and confirmed before the internship begins.

Candidates who need an internship agreement, supervisor information, learning objectives, progress reviews, or other university documentation should mention this when applying.

How to apply

Please send the following to info@nexllm.ai:

  • CV or résumé
  • University, degree programme, year of study, and expected graduation date
  • Internship availability, including preferred start date and duration
  • GitHub, LinkedIn, portfolio, coursework, research, or examples of technical work
  • A short note explaining why you are interested in NexLLM and AI infrastructure
  • One example of a technical problem, project, or experiment you worked on and what you learned

Subject: AI R&D Engineering Intern application — [Your Name]

NexLLM welcomes students from diverse backgrounds who are excited to learn, build, and contribute to the next generation of AI infrastructure in Asia.

title: Senior Director of Compliance
description:
Sr. Director of Compliance

Job Type: Full-Time

Schedule: Monday–Friday

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Director of Compliance to lead and strengthen compliance operations across our affordable housing portfolio. This is a senior leadership opportunity for an experienced affordable housing professional who brings strong regulatory knowledge, sound judgment, and a passion for building effective compliance practices.

The ideal candidate will have extensive hands-on experience with HUD, LIHTC, Rural Development (RD), and local Housing Authority programs, including the processing and management of rent increases.

You will serve as a key resource to senior leadership and property operations, helping ensure regulatory compliance while developing practical solutions that support strong property performance.

What We're Looking For

  • 7–10+ years of progressively responsible affordable housing compliance experience, including at least 3 years in a senior-level compliance leadership role (such as Director of Compliance, Senior Compliance Manager, or equivalent), with responsibility for portfolio-wide compliance oversight, regulatory interpretation, and compliance program administration.
  • At least 3 years of direct supervisory experience managing compliance employees, including assigning responsibilities, evaluating performance, providing training and professional development, and holding staff accountable. Indirect oversight or guidance of onsite or regional teams does not satisfy this requirement.
  • Proven responsibility for overseeing compliance across a multi-property affordable housing portfolio, rather than managing compliance for a single property or performing compliance functions solely for an assigned region.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and supporting company-wide initiatives involving policy and procedure standardization, implementing procedures and process’, regulatory documentation, leases and forms, compliance systems, staff training, quality assurance, process improvement, and operational efficiency.
  • Experience must extend beyond onsite compliance, file reviews, certification approvals, or HAP submissions and include senior-level responsibility for compliance strategy, program administration, and portfolio-wide oversight.
  • Direct, hands-on experience processing and managing rent increases.
  • Strong working knowledge of HUD, LIHTC, USDA Rural Development (RD), and local Housing Authority programs, with experience in additional affordable housing programs preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with California affordable housing regulations and compliance requirements, including applicable state and local housing laws, rent restrictions, and program-specific requirements.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining compliance policies, procedures, internal controls, quality assurance standards, and regulatory monitoring processes.
  • Demonstrated experience managing compliance audits, regulatory reviews, monitoring activities, and corrective action plans.
  • Strong knowledge of income certifications and recertifications, income limits, rent restrictions, utility allowances, and occupancy requirements.
  • Proven ability to identify compliance risks, resolve complex regulatory issues, interpret requirements, and provide leadership-level guidance to operational teams.
  • Strong leadership, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work strategically while remaining engaged in complex, hands-on compliance matters.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Affordable housing certifications such as HCCP, SHCM, COS, CPO, or equivalent preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • In addition to leading the Compliance Department, strengthen the company’s compliance infrastructure, drive portfolio-wide consistency, and lead initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead compliance strategy and provide senior-level guidance on HUD, LIHTC, USDA Rural Development (RD), local Housing Authority, and other affordable housing program requirements.
  • Oversee hands-on rent increase processing, including documentation, submissions, approvals, and coordination with applicable agencies and program administrators.
  • Establish and maintain compliance policies, procedures, internal controls, and quality assurance standards. Ensure leases, addenda, forms, notices, and other compliance documents remain current and accurate, and continuously improve compliance systems, workflows, and reporting to promote standardization, automation, and efficiency.
  • Oversee portfolio-wide compliance monitoring, risk assessment, and audit readiness. Identify trends and potential deficiencies, assess regulatory changes, lead corrective actions, and ensure audit findings are appropriately resolved.
  • Partner with Property Operations and senior leadership to address complex compliance matters and ensure regulatory requirements are consistently implemented at the property level through clear guidance, practical procedures, and effective training.
  • Lead, develop, and hold the Compliance Department accountable through coaching, training, performance oversight, and continuous development, while promoting compliance knowledge and accountability across operational teams.
  • Provide compliance oversight for acquisitions, management transitions, refinancing, rehabilitation, and expansion into additional states, and maintain effective relationships with regulatory agencies, Housing Authorities, investors, owners, and other key partners.

Why Join Us?

Arrowhead Housing is a boutique property management company managing affordable and market-rate communities throughout California and Oregon. We are committed to exceptional service, operational excellence, and creating communities where residents feel at home.

This is an opportunity to have a meaningful impact on the Company's compliance program and help shape how affordable housing compliance is managed across the organization. The Senior Director will work closely with leadership and operational teams and will have the opportunity to build, improve, and lead compliance practices across a growing portfolio.

If you are an experienced affordable housing compliance professional ready to take on a highly visible leadership role, we would like to hear from you.

Work Environment

Equal Employment Opportunity

We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

title: Quality Inspector - Phoenix 2nd Shift
description:
Location

On-site, Full-time, 1st Shift: Monday-Thursday, 10.00 hour shifts, 02:30PM-01:00AM, with potential for additional hours pending business needs.

English Comprehension

Each individual will be required to take and pass a short English comprehension test which follows CEFR A1 level guidelines in understanding. This test is in English and includes a five sentence statement, followed by five questions related to the statement. A passing score is 3 of 5 or more questions answered correctly. Answers can be written in primary language as the intent of the test is only to show a base understanding level is known. If unable to pass this test, we will not move forward with an interview, but strongly encourage each individual to work on improving their understanding and re-applying in the future.

As our business continues to evolve and meet higher standards in quality, safety, efficiency, and customer expectation, it has become increasingly important that all team members are able to show at minimum, a base comprehension in English. Everyday paperwork such as work orders, blueprints, inspection forms, are all in English. Our job status system and other programs are also in English. It is vital that everyone can understand in full, the expectations set by these items to meet business expectations.

We do our best as a team to lend assistance when translations might be needed but this is not always available. Phones are not permitted on the production floor for safety reasons, so base comprehension is necessary to remain effective in production efficiencies.

Position Description

Quality Inspector's primary role within the organization is to have a keen eye for identifying defects and ensuring products meet quality standards. This position is on-site, full-time, and reports directly to Quality Supervisors for our Arizona-based operations.

  • Professionally, positively, and clearly communicate and interact with fellow peers, departments, and leadership.
  • Perform assigned job tasks which meet or exceed company expectations.
    • If further training is needed, must show clear evidence of improvement on specified duty.
  • Read and understand drawings, blueprints, and other task related documents.

THIS IS AN INDUSTRIAL MANUFACTURING ENVIRONMENT WHICH REQUIRES PHYSCIAL CAPABILITIES.

Required

  • Strong positive work ethic.
    • Have a good history of safe work practices, focus on quality, and steady efficiency.

  • Must pass medical pre-screen with physical and background check.
  • Must be authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred

    • We strive to have leaders continue strengthening their language foundation over time.
  • Experience working in a mid-size company where gap-filling is routine.

Maintenance A Mechanic

Pay Rate:

$32.80 per hour

Category/Shift:

12 hour shifts. Maintenance runs 24/7. Schedule is 2-2-3, with every other weekend off. Must be willing to work overtime and weekends as needed; overtime may be needed during busy periods.

Physical Location:

Orlando Container Plant

711 E. Lancaster Road

Orlando, FL 32809

The Job You Will Perform:

Specific responsibilities include maintaining production equipment to optimize runnability through preventative maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of machines. Candidates for consideration should have troubleshooting skills in industrial, electrical,

hydraulic, pneumatic and mechanical failures and the aptitude to correct those failures. Accurately completing administrative documents and following directions are important work traits. Candidates must demonstrate technical experience, reliability and the

ability to work independently, as well as in a Team Based environment.

  • Following all safety rules and practices
  • Performing preventive maintenance activities such as lubricating, measuring ear, measuring positions, repositioning components; and observing operations, vibrations, and noise levels
  • Performing emergency / break down maintenance as necessary to support plant operations
  • Accurately using measurement and test equipment
  • Performing electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, steam system, and other repairs and installations as needed
  • Installing wire and conduit for newly installed and existing equipment such as conveyors, programmable controllers, converting and corrugating machinery
  • Replacing faulty electrical components of machine such as relays, switches, and motors, and position sensing devices such as proximity switch, timers, scanners and photo electric devices
  • Diagnosing and repair/replace faulty electronic components such as printed circuit boards
  • Troubleshooting and repair pneumatic and hydraulic systems
  • Troubleshooting drives, i.e. AC and DC
  • Reading electrical block diagrams, schematics as well as PLC ladder logic
  • Maintaining clean and organized work areas, and cleaning up work areas as part of completing assigned tasks
  • Accurately and completely preparing and maintaining maintenance records and other paperwork
  • Trouble-shooting and solving problems
  • Self Motivated, able to follow through to completion with assigned responsibilities
  • Maintaining teamwork with other associates
  • Performing other duties as assigned by supervision

The Skills You Will Bring:

Key Competencies

  • Electrical aptitude
  • Troubleshooting expertise
  • Mechanical knowledge

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • Certification in Industrial Electrical/ Instrumentation preferred.
  • Highly-qualified candidates would possess a technical degree or maintenance experience in the corrugated
  • industry or similar manufacturing environment.

Experience

  • Minimum of two years of industrial maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment

title: Maskinførerfaglærer søges til Mercantec Ulfborg Kjærgaard (genopslag)
description:
Vil du være med til at forme fremtidens maskinførere?

Har du solid erfaring fra entreprenørbranchen, og kunne du tænke dig videregive din viden til andre? Vi søger en kompetent maskinfører, der vil være med til at forme fremtidens maskinførere gennem kurser og uddannelse.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt team af faglærere, der brænder for deres fag, hjælper hinanden i hverdagen og arbejder sammen om at finde løsninger.

Vi lover dig, at du hver dag mødes af kursister, lærlinge og kolleger, som deler din interesse for entreprenørarbejde og -maskiner, og sammen med dine kolleger sørger du for, at kursisterne og lærlingene går herfra med ny viden, som ruster dem til de opgaver, de møder i branchen.

Om jobbet
Som faglærer og en del af maskinførerteamet på Mercantec Ulfborg Kjærgaard, underviser du på både AMU-kurser og den 2-årige maskinføreruddannelse. Din hverdag består af en blanding af:

  • Praktisk undervisning i maskinerne
  • Undervisning på værkstedet
  • Teori i klasselokalet
  • Udvikling af undervisningsmaterialer

Ingen dage er helt ens, og hverdagen minder på mange måder om entreprenørbranchen:

  • Vi har en plan, indtil vejret ændrer den.
  • Vi finder løsninger sammen og hjælper hinanden, når noget skal lykkes

Hos os får du

  • Gode, faste arbejdstider, som giver dig en fornuftig balance mellem arbejde og fritid
  • En familiær og humoristisk tone på en arbejdsplads, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af fagområder
  • En enestående mulighed for at nørde entreprenørarbejde og -maskiner, sammen med dine kollegaer og samarbejdspartnere.
  • Mulighed for at udvide dine kompetencer, og holde dig up to date med nye tiltag i branchen

Hvem er du?
Vi søger en kollega, som har solid erfaring fra entreprenørbranchen, og gerne med særligt kendskab til større anlægsarbejder og entreprenørmaskiner.

Du skal have lyst til at undervise og omgås mennesker i alle aldre.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med både store og små maskiner, gerne med 3D maskinstyring
  • Er en udadvendt personlighed, et naturligt gå-på-mod og humørfyldt
  • Har lyst til at bruge din faglige viden på en ny og spændende måde
  • Har lyst til at arbejde med mennesker, og skabe gode relationer til både unge og voksne

Det er et plus, hvis du har erfaring med hovedkloak.

Mercantec danner bro mellem uddannelse og erhvervsliv og er kendt for et højt fagligt niveau. Vores uddannelser er relevante for både den enkelte, erhvervslivet og samfundet. Vi skaber værdi ved at motivere elever og kursister til at være opfindsomme og finde de løsninger, der virker bedst i praksis. Vi bygger bro mellem hjerne og hænder, mellem viden og virkelighed.

Vi er oprigtigt nysgerrige på vores omverdens behov for kompetencer. Når nye behov opstår, matcher vi dem med nye fag, kurser og uddannelser.

På Mercantec giver vi plads til forskellighed: Forskellige baggrunde, forudsætninger og ambitioner, men vi kræver af vores elever og kursister, at de oparbejder en faglig stolthed. Læring, udvikling, mestring og stolthed går hånd i hånd på Mercantec. Vores gennemgående værdier er professionalisme, at være rollemodeller, omsorg og at være frontløbere.

Mercantec er Viborgs største uddannelsesinstitution med ca. 500 medarbejdere. Hvert år går ca. 20.000 personer gennem vores døre for at gennemføre et kursus eller uddannelsesforløb på vores adresser i Viborg og Ulfborg.

Mercantec

Lystlundvej 18

6990 Ulfborg

Holstebro Kommune

Danmark

Sådan ansøger du

Yderligere information
Hvis du er blevet nysgerrig på stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at komme forbi og høre mere om stillingen. Kontakt uddannelseschef John Hansen på telefon 2949 0449.

Stillingen er en fast stilling på fuld tid. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger af aftalen mellem Finansministeriet og Uddannelsesforbundet, hvor der blandt andet er en attraktiv pensionsordning.

Vi håber at høre fra dig senest den 28. oktober 2026, hvor der er ansøgningsfrist. Samtalerne bliver holdt umiddelbart derefter.

Vi har fokus på at være en mangfoldig arbejdsplads og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede ansøgere til at søge uanset personlig baggrund. Du kan se mere om Mercantec som arbejdsplads her.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Senior Data Engineering Consultant
description:
Je zit met het datateam van een provincie aan tafel. Jarenlang haalde iedereen cijfers uit losse Excelbestanden en eigen queries. Elk rapport vertelde net een ander verhaal. De afgelopen weken heb jij een nieuw dataplatform neergezet: één bron, heldere afspraken, geautomatiseerde pipelines.

Vandaag draait de eerste release live. Je laat zien hoe de data dagelijks binnenkomt, wordt getest en klaarstaat voor analyse. Een analist opent het dashboard en vergelijkt de cijfers met haar oude spreadsheet. Ze kijkt op. “Dus dit klopt nu gewoon, elke ochtend weer?”

En precies dat maakt jouw werk waardevol

Bij InIn werk je als Senior Data Engineering Consultant aan het fundament onder goede besluitvorming. Je ontwerpt en bouwt datalandschappen waar (semi-)publieke organisaties echt op kunnen bouwen. Zo zie je direct wat jouw werk oplevert, voor de klant én voor de maatschappij.

Wie ben jij?

Je herkent jezelf in onze kernwaarden: maatschappelijk betrokken, vooruitstrevend, professioneel en daadkrachtig.

Je bent een ervaren data engineer die soepel schakelt tussen techniek en business. Je vertaalt een vraag van een beleidsmaker naar een robuuste data-architectuur, en legt die architectuur net zo makkelijk weer in gewone taal uit. Je neemt eigenaarschap, werkt zelfstandig en communiceert helder.

Daarnaast begeleid je graag collega’s en draag je actief bij aan hun ontwikkeling. Dat doe je door een veilige, stimulerende omgeving te creëren waarin iedereen kan leren en groeien.

Wat vragen wij?

  • Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in een adviesrol in de (semi-)publieke sector.
  • Minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in data science, informatica of een vergelijkbaar vakgebied, én hands-on ervaring met SQL, Python of R.
  • Minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen, bouwen en beheren van dataproducten.
  • Ervaring met werken volgens CI/CD-principes en version control (Git) binnen data- en analyticsomgevingen, bij voorkeur met Azure DevOps en/of GitHub.
  • Ervaring met het opzetten of herinrichten van een rapportage- of datalandschap, inclusief het definiëren van templates, standaarden en governanceafspraken.
  • Ervaring met cloudplatforms (bijvoorbeeld Azure) is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?

Een senior positie in een klein, hecht team waarin jij het verschil maakt. De lijnen zijn kort: je werkt direct samen met opdrachtgevers en collega’s. Je krijgt ruimte om je rol zelf vorm te geven en verder uit te bouwen, bijvoorbeeld richting thought leadership, product- of teamontwikkeling. De datafundamenten die jij bouwt, dragen direct bij aan betere besluitvorming binnen maatschappelijke organisaties.

Daarnaast bieden wij je:

  • Een aantrekkelijk salaris dat past bij jouw ervaring en expertise.
  • 30,5 vakantiedagen per jaar bij een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur).
  • Een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
  • NS Business Card, kilometervergoeding of leaseauto van de zaak.
  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden op maat.
  • Samenwerken
  • Verantwoordelijkheid

Wij zijn een boutique adviesbureau gevestigd in ’s-Hertogenbosch. Ons team bestaat uit 10 consultants die werken aan uiteenlopende opdrachten op het snijvlak van data en organisatieontwikkeling. Denk aan BI-oplossingen (zoals dashboards), data science-analyses, AI-tools en verander- en projectmanagementopdrachten.

Als Senior Data Engineering Consultant ben je onderdeel van een betrokken en professioneel team dat samen met klanten werkt aan maatschappelijke impact. Gemiddeld werk je 1 tot 2 dagen per week op locatie bij de klant, en daarnaast deels vanuit huis. Op vrijdag werken we samen op kantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch: hét moment om te sparren, kennis te delen en successen te vieren. Denk aan lunchsessies, masterclasses met (gast)sprekers en natuurlijk onze gezellige vrijmibo.

Klanten kiezen voor ons omdat we ondernemend, praktisch en hands-on zijn. We blijven niet hangen in advies, maar komen met concrete, toepasbare oplossingen en ondersteunen ook in de uitvoering.

Key Responsibilities
