title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
About Us

No Isolation is an award-winning scale-up in EdTech with offices in Oslo, London, and Munich building human-centered technology that turns absence into real-time participation, connection, and belonging.

Our flagship solution, the AV1 robot, is deployed in 19 countries with 5,000+ units, supporting schools to sustain attendance, belonging, and continuity of learning for children who cannot be physically present. Families consistently describe AV1 as life-changing - it rebuilds connection and continuity, bringing back everyday happiness and helping students stay on track to pass their grades.


The Opportunity — Backend Engineering

Join us to build the core systems that enable thousands of children through the AV1 robot. As a Backend Engineer proficient in Golang, you will be at the intersection of complex, real-time technical challenges.

Our solutions are scaling across continents, and we need your expertise to improve existing services and implement novel features. The backend you will co-own and further develop supports real-time communication between our fleet of robots, mobile apps, and web clients. You will be engineering high-performance systems to handle live video, audio, events, and last but not least, massive data collection to enable new customer value through our growing unique proprietary dataset.

You will design, build, and evolve the APIs, services, modules and system integrations that are vital to our ecosystem. You will be entrusted to make critical architectural decisions, model data for correctness and scale, and engineer for resilience. You will enjoy the focus on writing well-instrumented code and will get the chance to further raise the bar for how we design and operate our systems to deliver reliable, life-changing experiences for the children and schools we serve.


What You’ll Do — Scope & Responsibilities

Backend systems design & implementation

  • Design and implement backend APIs and shared modules, primarily in Golang, that connect robots, mobile apps, web clients, and cloud services

  • Select and configure the right paradigms for the job, including WebRTC, gRPC, web sockets, REST, and newer technologies

  • Develop data models, schemas, and safe up/down migrations across relational, NoSQL, and analytical stores

  • Design container-based, event-driven services and asynchronous processing pipelines that handle real-world usage patterns

  • Align on system design and architecture in collaboration with peers, and maintain clear troubleshooting runbooks

  • Embrace both unit and end-to-end testing so we ship confidently

  • Collaborate closely with frontend/mobile, platform, and embedded teams to shape APIs, contracts, and integration patterns

Team collaboration & enablement

  • Role-model AI tooling adoption (e.g., Claude Code, custom agents) to accelerate backend engineering in a safe, deliberate way

  • Contribute to developer experience by refining tooling, local dev environments, and shared libraries for backend work

  • Document key flows, patterns, and decisions so others can self-serve and move faster with confidence

  • Support internal stakeholders with data and internal tools that reduce 3rd-line support load and improve incident handling

  • Help evolve our data pipelines and assets for analytics, user insights, and future predictive modelling

Operational security and reliability

  • Instrument backend services with top observability standards

  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering on container deployment and orchestration (Kubernetes, Terraform)

  • Build for correctness, durability, resilience, and performance by design, not as an afterthought

  • Participate in incident response, debugging, and post-incident reviews

  • Embed secure coding practices throughout the development lifecycle, from design reviews to code reviews and rollout

  • Apply robust AuthN/AuthZ patterns, encryption, data-integrity controls, and secure service-to-service communication


What You Bring — Experience & Capabilities

  • Backend engineering: Deep experience in Golang, API design, backend architecture, and distributed systems. You have implemented services using e.g. WebRTC, gRPC, sockets, REST, and other web protocols. You can strike trade-offs between cost and performance

  • Operational familiarity: Proven experience with AWS services. You have been hands-on with the likes of Sentry and Grafana. You are comfortable with some exposure to Terraform and Kubernetes

  • Data & storage competence: Solid experience with relational, NoSQL, OLAP databases and caches (e.g. MySQL, MongoDB, ClickHouse, Redis). You know how to model data, optimize queries, tune performance, and design for failover and recovery

  • Security & quality mindset: You build systems that are correct, predictable, secure, and maintainable. You inform key security aspects such as proper secrets handling, encryption standards, rate limiting and vulnerability management

  • Technical collaboration: Clear, direct communication, with empathy when working with frontend/mobile, embedded, platform, and non-technical peers. You are comfortable leading technical discussions, and are able to change your mind in light of new evidence

  • Technical education and experience: Higher education in a STEM field (BSc/MSc). Practical experience in backend engineering. You have worked at product companies before, ideally across multiple stacks or domains


Why You'll Love it Here

  • Purpose with scale: Your work keeps thousands of children connected, learning, and included every single day

  • Real systems, real impact: From fleets of robots to real-time apps, you will tackle backend and reliability challenges that matter in the physical world, not just on a dashboard

  • Autonomous ownership: As a key Backend Engineer in a tight-knit cross-functional engineering team, you will shape our backend domain

  • Work with exceptional leaders: Build, learn, and grow alongside our Director of Engineering (Jerome Ginss) to shape a high-trust, learning-driven engineering culture, and impact KPIs valued by the executive team

  • Grow your craft: Elevate your skills in a lean, fast environment, with freedom to pitch in what you assess to be best practices


Our Tech Stack

Think container services, mobile apps, multiple web apps, and fleets of connected robots. It’s a rapidly growing ecosystem, wired by WebRTC, web sockets, Rest APIs and more. We pride ourselves with a choice of modern and exciting, yet battle-tested technologies. We balance hosting versus buying core systems pragmatically.

title: Backend developer BVID
description:
Voor onze eindklant de Politie is Harvey Nash op zoek naar back end developer

Verwachte startdatum: 01-01-2027 (starten kan na afronding van screening)

Duur van de opdracht: 24 maanden

Aantal uren per week: 36

Locatie van de werkzaamheden: Odijk

Op locatie of vanuit huis: 2 dagen op kantoor

ZZP mogelijk: nee alleen detachering

Deadline voor het voorstellen van kandidaten: Maandag 19 oktober voor 09:00

Functieschaal en trede: Bedrijfsvoeringspecialist B schaal 10

Apleidingsniveau: HBO

Je hebt een diploma op hbo-niveau (bachelor) of je bent daaraan gelijkgesteld via EVC. Of je hebt minimaal twee jaar aantoonbare ervaring op het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau. Dit moet je aantonen met je cv, aangevuld met een officiële functiebeschrijving, vacaturetekst of ander document waarin het gevraagde werk- en denkniveau duidelijk staat vermeld.

Richttarief: 102.50 all-in ex btw

Opdracht omschrijving

Voor het registreren en verifiëren van persoonsgegevens van verdachten en vreemdelingen met behulp van documenten, vingerafdrukken, foto's en handtekeningen gebruikt de Nationale Politie identificatiezuilen. Via het achterliggende systeem, de Basis Voorziening Identiteit vaststelling (BVID), kan ook worden bepaald of de eigenaar van een vingerafdruk al bij de politie of bij een ketenpartner bekend is. Bijvoorbeeld omdat de betreffende persoon al eerder is aangehouden of omdat deze persoon als vreemdeling Nederland of een ander Europees land is binnengekomen.

De politie zoekt een ervaren .NET Developer (back-end) voor het door ontwikkelen van de BVID en het implementeren van nieuwe wet- en regelgeving. Als jij van aanpakken houdt, goede ideeën hebt, uitstekend ideeën van anderen kan adopteren, de positieve sfeer in het DevOps-team verhoogt en houdt van een dynamische omgeving? Dan zit je bij ons goed.

De Nationale Politie zoekt een ervaren .NET Developer (back-end) voor de doorontwikkeling van de Basis Voorziening Identiteit Vaststelling (BVID), een cruciale applicatie waarmee via identificatiezuilen persoonsgegevens van verdachten en vreemdelingen worden geregistreerd en geverifieerd aan de hand van documenten, vingerafdrukken, foto's en handtekeningen. Je werkt in een DevOps-team aan het implementeren van nieuwe wet- en regelgeving, draagt actief bij aan een positieve werksfeer en denkt mee over technische en functionele verbeteringen. Je houdt van een dynamische omgeving met maatschappelijke impact en bent bereid om in overleg ook buiten reguliere kantoortijden beschikbaar te zijn (piketdienst).

Werkzaamheden

Je bent als teamlid medeverantwoordelijk voor het realiseren van de doelen van het team. Je draagt bij aan het volledige software delivery proces: van ontwerp en ontwikkeling tot testen, deployment, monitoring en operationeel beheer. Je werkt onder architectuur en stemt af met collega's en de Tech Lead om technische keuzes te laten aansluiten op bredere kaders.

Je neemt eigenaarschap over de kwaliteit, stabiliteit en performance van de systemen die je bouwt. Je denkt actief mee over verbeteringen in processen, tooling en samenwerking, en draagt bij aan het optimaliseren van teammetrics zoals deployment frequency en lead time for changes. Je hebt diepgaande expertise in backend development (.NET), maar ook brede kennis van DevOps tooling, containerization, CI/CD, testautomatisering en security; je herkent je dan ook in een profiel van een brede T‑shaped professional.

Je werkt effectief samen met andere teams via duidelijke interactiepatronen en helpt de cognitieve belasting binnen het team beheersbaar te houden. Je deelt kennis, geeft feedback en ondersteunt collega's in hun groei. Je bent transparant in je keuzes, neemt initiatief en draagt bij aan een cultuur van eigenaarschap, technische excellentie en continue verbetering.

Eisen

  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 6 jaar minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring met .NET Development.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met REST API Development.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring met Containerization.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring opgedaan in versiebeheer (GIT).
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring microservices en messaging-technieken.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in een DEVops omgeving en daarmee een DevOPS mindset.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 2 werkervaring met RabbitMQ of soort gelijke messaging technieken.
  • De kandidaat heeft in de afgelopen 5 jaar minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Entity Framework en MSSQL.

Wensen

  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met domain driven design.
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Kubernetes en/of OpenShift.
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met Jenkins of soort gelijke CI/CD tooling (GitLab, ArgoCD).
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring met monitoring en logging tooling zoals Elastic/Kibana.
  • De kandidaat heeft minimaal 3 jaar aantoonbare werkervaring testautomatisering (unittests, integratietest, apitests).

Competenties

Je levert een belangrijke bijdrage in de teams met betrekking tot bijvoorbeeld de migratie van de BVID-2 naar de BVID-3, en andere grote noodzakelijke wettelijke wijzigingen. Je zet hierbij je vaardigheden in om de kwaliteit van de applicatie(s) te verbeteren. Dit betreft zowel het aanbrengen van technische verbeteringen als nieuwe functionele behoeften, deels vanuit veranderende (Europese) wetgeving.

Probleemanalyse

Signaleert problemen, zoekt en herkent belangrijke informatie, rafelt vraagstukken uiteen en legt verbanden tussen gegevens.

Initiatief

Signaleert kansen. Handelt ernaar en durft daarbij risico's te nemen om uiteindelijk een bepaald herkenbaar voordeel voor de organisatie te behalen. Begint liever uit zichzelf dan passief af te wachten.

Leervermogen

Is alert op nieuwe informatie. Maakt zich actief meester van nieuwe kennis en past deze effectief toe voor de eigen functie.

Samenwerken

Heeft oog voor het groepsbelang en draagt actief bij aan het gemeenschappelijke resultaat.

Mondelinge- en schriftelijke uitdrukkingsvaardigheid

Maakt feiten, meningen en ideeën aan anderen in begrijpelijk Nederlandse taal mondeling en schriftelijk duidelijk.

Werktijden en dagen

2 dagen in de week op locatie

4 keer per jaar piketdienst

De politie werkt in een veranderende samenleving waarin uiteenlopende perspectieven essentieel zijn voor goed politiewerk. Daarom is diversiteit voor ons van groot beland. Hoe kunnen we jouw kennis en achtergrond hiervoor inzetten?

Voor deze opdracht is een screening type BO+ van toepassing. Voor meer informatie over de screening: Politie selectie - Screening | Kombijdepolitie

title: Family Navigator - One Door OKC
description:
Who We Are
At City Rescue Mission, we believe everyone deserves hope, healing, and a home. As a housing-focused shelter, we provide compassionate care, innovative programs, and practical tools to help individuals and families experiencing homelessness achieve long-term stability and independence.

We’re driven by a deep belief in the value of every person we serve and a commitment to creating brighter futures through community partnerships and life-changing programs.

Position Summary: The Family Navigator is an integral part of City Rescue Mission's One Door OKC Project and is responsible for providing rapid rehousing placements and case management for an assigned small caseload, building community partnerships, and engaging landlords to identify housing units for families. This position works with CRM staff and community partners to provide timely, compassionate, housing-focused services, maintain accurate documentation, and help families move toward safe and sustainable housing. The Family Navigator follows established CRM procedures, maintains professional boundaries, and coordinates clear handoffs, so families receive consistent services. The assigned schedule is 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., Monday–Friday.

Essential Functions:

  • Engage families referred for housing navigation and establish a respectful, compassionate, and non-judgmental working relationship.
  • Explain rapid rehousing services, eligibility, family participation, housing-search steps, client rights and responsibilities, and anticipate next actions.
  • Manage an assigned small rapid rehousing caseload, coordinate appointments and housing-search activities, and maintain communication with CRM housing and service teams.
  • Provide rapid rehousing placement and case management while maintaining community partnerships and landlord relationships that expand access to available housing units.
  • Review assessments, confirm assigned program eligibility, and complete required housing and service-planning tools under current CoC and CRM procedures.
  • Gather accurate information regarding each family’s immediate situation, recent housing history, current risks, natural supports, available resources, barriers, and reason for seeking services.
  • Identify urgent medical, behavioral health, safety, exploitation, domestic violence, trafficking, suicide or self-harm, intoxication, or other crisis indicators and immediately follow established escalation and emergency-response procedures.
  • Develop individualized housing plans with families, identify suitable units, and address barriers involving applications, income, identification, rental history, and transportation.
  • Engage property owners and managers, identify available units, explain program supports, and mediate housing-related concerns within delegated authority.
  • Assist families with housing applications, verifications, subsidy coordination, inspections, lease signing, and move-in arrangements under applicable program requirements.
  • Coordinate community resources for employment, benefits, healthcare, childcare, school enrollment, transportation, legal services, and other needs affecting housing stability.

  • Use warm handoffs whenever possible by contacting the receiving provider, confirming eligibility or next steps, and reducing barriers to successful connection.

  • Coordinate rapid rehousing placements and support the transition from temporary shelter or other locations into permanent housing, including a clear stabilization and follow-up plan.

  • Provide transportation to families as needed to facilitate access to appointments, resources, and services, in accordance with agency policy.

  • Use de-escalation skills, maintain professional boundaries, and follow all safety, incident-reporting, mandatory-reporting, emergency, and workplace-violence procedures.

  • Perform other duties as assigned that are consistent with the purpose and general scope of the position.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Ensure accurate and timely HMIS housing program enrollments, services, placement dates, and exits based on eligibility and established procedures.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation, including but not limited to telephone calls, emails, attempted contacts, face-to-face interactions, screenings, referrals, outcomes, and agreed-upon next actions. Ensure all relevant information is detailed and documented in the family’s record within HMIS or other required systems.

  • Complete required intake forms, releases of information, consents, assessments, referrals, and supporting documentation while avoiding unnecessary duplication or requiring families to restart their story at each handoff.

  • Maintain strict client confidentiality and follow HMIS privacy, informed-consent, release-of-information, record-retention, and data-quality requirements.

  • Assist with reports, housing placement and retention tracking, landlord engagement records, data-quality reviews, and correction of incomplete or inaccurate records.

  • Adhere to the most up-to-date version of Coordinated Entry Policies, Continuum of Care (CoC) Standards of Care, funder requirements, and City Rescue Mission policies and procedures.

Collaboration and Community Engagement:

  • Collaborate closely with CRM assessment and diversion staff, shelter teams, housing staff, and other departments to coordinate family housing plans and avoid duplicated services.

  • Collaborate with service providers and community partners to enhance families' access to supportive resources and promote housing stability and overall well-being.

  • Serve as a point of contact for assigned landlords and community partners; maintain current unit availability, eligibility requirements, contacts, and referral processes.

  • Participate in case consultation, shift handoffs, team meetings, training, supervision, and continuous improvement activities.

  • Participate in Continuum of Care (CoC) or other relevant community meetings and workgroups as requested.

  • Demonstrate a compassionate, non-judgmental approach that promotes client empowerment, self-determination, cultural sensitivity, dignity, and individual choice in all interactions.

title: Technical Lead

description:

Location: El Paso, TX

Employment Type: Full-Time | In-Person

Compensation: $25.00 - $30.00

About the Role

The Patient Navigator (Patient Support & Phlebotomy) plays a critical role in guiding patients through key stages of their genetic testing and diagnostic journey. This position provides patient education, care coordination, and phlebotomy support while working closely with a multidisciplinary clinical team to deliver a seamless, compassionate, and high-quality patient experience.

In addition to competitive compensation, this position offers a comprehensive benefits package and stock options within a fast-growing healthcare technology organization.

-

Position Overview

The Patient Navigator supports patients undergoing hereditary cancer genetic testing through a combination of patient navigation, clinical coordination, partner site support, and specimen collection. This role serves as a primary point of contact for patients and partner sites, helping guide individuals through education, scheduling, specimen collection, and follow-up while ensuring an exceptional patient experience.

You will work closely with clinicians and operational teams to ensure high-quality care and efficient workflows across all partner locations. This role is built on HALO Dx's Navigator Pillars, which guide how we care for patients, support partners, and execute daily work.

-

Key Responsibilities

Patient Navigation & Communication

  • Guide patients through the hereditary cancer genetic testing process from start to finish.
  • Provide clear, compassionate education on testing, procedures, and next steps.
  • Serve as the primary patient contact to ensure a supportive and informed experience.
  • Conduct structured patient consultations to ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency.

Clinic Integration & Partner Relationships

  • Adapt to changing clinic needs, schedules, and priorities while maintaining service quality.

Workflow Ownership & Follow-Up

  • Own patient cases, scheduling, follow-ups, and workflow coordination.
  • Proactively identify and resolve barriers to patient testing or completion.
  • Ensure timely callbacks and consistent communication with patients and partners.

Clinical Support & Operational Execution

  • Perform venipuncture and collect blood specimens for genetic testing.
  • Ensure proper patient identification, labeling, handling, and transport of specimens.
  • Follow all clinical protocols, safety standards, and compliance requirements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation in EMR/EHR systems.

Knowledge & Compliance

  • Build expertise in genetic testing workflows, insurance processes, and patient eligibility.
  • Support insurance verification and authorization processes as needed.
  • Ensure HIPAA compliance and accurate data entry.
  • Confidently answer patient questions regarding testing and next steps.

Patient Experience & Problem Solving

  • Respond to patient concerns with empathy and clarity.
  • Identify and help resolve barriers such as scheduling, insurance, or workflow issues.
  • Support creative solutions to improve patient completion and outcomes.

title: Lead - Inpatient Clinical Documentation Integrity (ICDI)

At Xebia, we work as a team and are always ready to help you solve your problems. When you're working on-site with a client and come across a challenging problem, everybody at Xebia is just a quick message away, ready to assist at any time.

Having said that, we like to be amazed: so if you have done something outstanding during your studies or previous job, like contributing to open source projects or starting your own company, we encourage you to apply no matter what the level of your experience is.

If you like working with modern data processing tools, like Databricks, Spark, Airflow, Cloud, and Terraform.

If you like to challenge yourself and become an authority.

If you like working for different clients and enjoy the excitement of regularly getting to learn new environments and getting to know new people.

If you deliver quality without comprise, which is one of our core values.

You speak Dutch fluently.

If you do not like working under (time) pressure to get things done in the best possible way.

If you do not like explaining your work and sharing your knowledge with peers.

If you do not like coding, scripting, and templating.

If you do not live in North Brabant, Limburg, or Gelderland.

WHAT IT IS LIKE TO BE A CONSULTANT AT XEBIA DATA

As a consultant at Xebia Data, you will have projects of varying lengths: some take 2 months, some take 2 years, most sit inbetween. Every project is different, as is every client. However, we always deliver high-quality work. It is not always easy, but it is always rewarding. You will be exposed to different companies, problems, systems, and solutions. Join our dynamic team and collaborate with industry leaders such as DSM-Firmenich, Sligro, UMC Utrecht, ASML, and Rituals! Explore the exciting projects we've undertaken by diving into our inspiring customer stories.

You will be surrounded by experts in different fields, and you will learn many new things in a short time. Xebia Data offers the perfect environment to shine as a data professional. You will never be alone on this journey. We have all experienced imposter syndrome, had a difficult project, or felt down at times. We know what it takes, we know it is difficult sometimes, and we will be there for you when you need it. We say People First, and we mean it.

Xebia Data offers you great benefits too, of course!

We follow a hybrid work model – we work at client sites, in our own office in Eindhoven (Willemstraat 1K – just around the corner of de Kleine Berg!), and from home. While flexibility is important, coming to the office is essential for building the close‑knit team we are. We value team cohesion, knowledge, personal development, innovation, and fun. We strive for authority in everything we do. At most companies, you'll see similar statements, but at Xebia Data, we back this up with concrete benefits:

  • A generous salary, mobility, and tech budget

We offer an above average compensation. The monthly mobility budget can be spent on leasing a car, leasing the e‑bike of your dreams, or on travelling by train. The tech budget includes taking over your work items for a small contribution after a certain time, and the choice of the laptop and phone is all yours.

This budget includes €5,000 per year and 6 days of dedicated development time – it's your job to spend it on anything that will make you a better data professional. Some of us are going to the AI engineering conference in London this year (https://www.ai.engineer/europe).

Every month we spend a full day on innovation (on company time). You can choose to work on whatever and with whomever. Want to invite a friend from outside? No problem. These days mostly take place in our Amsterdam Oostenburg office, but some will be in Eindhoven as well.

  • Conferences and Speaking

Attending and speaking at relevant conferences doesn't come out of your vacation time. Speaking at conferences also does not come out of your development budget.

  • Unlimited Book Budget

Feed your curiosity and keep learning – order any work‑related books you want, on our dime.

  • Great Community

We're heavily involved in our community by sponsoring, hosting, and organizing events. We are proud to sponsor PyData Eindhoven every year. Next to that we organize and sponsor the Eindhoven Data Community Meetups, which take place on a regular basis. (https://www.meetup.com/nl-nl/eindhoven-data-community/)

  • Knowledge Sharing

We organize knowledge sharing events with your Xebia colleagues twice a month, on Tuesdays in the Eindhoven office, including dinner.

Fridays are office days, meant for innovation or working from the office for your client. This always includes good coffee and a free tasty lunch that you enjoy together with your colleagues.

  • A spacious office at a great location in the city centre of Eindhoven. Just an 8-minute walk from Eindhoven Central Station.

Build, test, and experiment with anything you want in our Azure, GCP and AWS sandbox environments.

  • Free lunch

Free healthy lunches and not‑so‑healthy drinks/snacks at our offices.

  • Fun events and activities like ski trips, our yearly Christmas bingo, carnival, BBQs, cooking workshops and more!

Our core values are people first, quality without compromise, knowledge sharing, and customer intimacy. At Xebia Data, you will find like‑minded colleagues who are at the forefront of their field and have the courage to go off the beaten track; they are the people who make organizations move.

  • Please note that we are only considering applications from people living in: North Brabant, Limburg, and Gelderland.

title: Microsoft 365 Konsulent med interesse for Modern Workplace og security
description:
Vil du udvikle dig inden for Microsoft 365, Security og Cloud?

Hos IT Forum søger vi en Microsoft 365 Konsulent, som har lyst til at lære, udvikle sig og arbejde med moderne cloud-løsninger hos vores kunder.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt på forhånd, men vi forventer, at du allerede har opbygget en solid forståelse for Microsoft 365-platformen og er motiveret for at videreudvikle dine kompetencer gennem certificeringer og praktisk erfaring.

Du bliver en del af vores Security & Cloud-team, hvor vi hjælper kunder med at få mest muligt ud af Microsofts platforme inden for collaboration, identitet, endpoint management og sikkerhed.

Din rolle

Som konsulent bliver du en nøglespiller i vores sikkerhedsteam.

Du får ansvar for at:

  • Implementere sikkerhedsløsninger hos vores kunder
  • Rådgive om best practices og Zero Trust-arkitektur/principper
  • Deltage i udviklingen af vores sikkerhedstilbud og interne kompetencer

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kolleger i Herning og på tværs af landet – og du får mulighed for at præge både din egen og kundernes hverdag.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har minimum 3 års erfaring som konsulent – eller som intern IT administrator
  • Har erfaring med Microsoft 365 administration
  • Har godt kendskab til Exchange Online, Teams og SharePoint
  • Har arbejdet med Entra ID og identitetsstyring
  • Har kendskab til Intune og klient enheder
  • Har interesse for IT-sikkerhed og Microsoft Defender
  • Er i gang med eller planlægger Microsoft-certificeringer
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for egne opgaver
  • Taler og skriver dansk og engelsk

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer blandt andet til at arbejde med:

  • Microsoft 365 administration
  • Exchange Online
  • Microsoft Teams
  • SharePoint Online og OneDrive
  • Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Intune og endpoint management
  • Microsoft Defender-platformen
  • Bruger- og adgangsstyring
  • Implementering og drift af sikkerhedsløsninger
  • Rådgivning af kunder omkring best practice

Vi tilbyder

  • En hverdag med stor variation og faglige udfordringer
  • Et stærkt team og en uformel kultur med respekt og ærlighed
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig som konsulent og stor mulighed for at påvirke beslutninger
  • Fokus på videreuddannelse og deltagelse i faglige konferencer
  • Attraktiv lønpakke og vilkår fx Sundheds- og Pensionsordning
  • Gode kollegaer med stærkt fællesskab i vores aktive personaleforening

Klar til næste skridt?

Send din ansøgning via vores karrieresite:

Har du spørgsmål? Kontakt Martin M. Christensen på mac@itf.dk

Om IT Forum Gruppen A/S

IT Forum Gruppen, er blandt de førende konsulenthuse inden for Microsoft 365 og Azure. Vi hjælper virksomheder med at sikre deres data, brugere og infrastruktur – og vi gør det med høj faglighed, ansvarlighed og passion.

IT Forum Gruppen har over 30 års erfaring med solide it-løsninger til danske virksomheder i alle størrelser. På de tre årtier har teknologien ændret sig radikalt, men vores grundlæggende filosofi er den samme: gode relationer og et nært samarbejde skaber de bedste vilkår for et velfungerende, effektivt og sikkert it-setup. Vi beskæftiger knap 160 medarbejdere, som fra vores afdelinger i Aarhus, Herning, Odense og Ballerup altid står klar til at hjælpe.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Join Wolk: Accelerate sustainable innovation with Data and AI

Please keep in mind that we require applicants to live in the Netherlands.

About Wolk

At Wolk, we're on an exciting mission to create meaningful change through the power of data and AI. We are a young, growing company aiming to accelerate sustainable innovation with modern data solutions. We partner with forward-thinking companies that contribute to a more sustainable future. With data driven insights, we help them make informed decisions and optimize operations. For more info, you can check out our website: https://www.wolk.work/.

We're currently also building Databaas, our own sovereign data & AI platform. It is built on open source tooling and runs on any EU cloud. We want this platform to compete with Databricks and Snowflake, which are not available on EU clouds, and we need you to take it to the next level. More info about the product here: https://www.databaas.eu/

Role overview:

In this role, you will partly build custom data & AI solutions for our customers, and partly develop Databaas. In detail, you will:

  • Design and shape data and AI solutions that help solve societal problems
  • Collaborate with a team of experienced data & AI specialists
  • Work on a diverse set of projects, ranging from building data platforms to custom software solutions
  • Help clients understand how data and AI can solve their problems and scale their business
  • Be a key player in our growing, impact-driven organization
  • Contribute to the development of Databaas: building features, improving the platform, and making it production-ready for customers

This role is for you if:

  • You're passionate about using technology for positive change
  • You've spent 4+ years working in the data and AI space
  • You have programming experience with languages like SQL, Python or other.
  • You have experience with tools like dbt, Trino, Iceberg or similar data stack components
  • You are comfortable with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu on e.g. Scaleway, OVHcloud, Azure)
  • You have experience working with Docker and/or Kubernetes, and understand CI/CD concepts
  • You understand how to utilise coding agents in your work, without losing quality.
  • You have an entrepreneurial spirit
  • You have experience and desire to work in a client facing role
  • You are a good communicator and fluent in English
  • You are willing to commute to our office in Utrecht and to client locations (in the Netherlands) a few times each week

Our approach:

  • We work on projects from start to end. This often starts with a design sprint, then we build an MVP, and after that we take care of full scale implementation
  • We work with the latest technologies and are always open to try new ideas and experiment
  • We are a small team with a flat organisational structure, you will be working directly with the founders
  • We always work in teams, lead by an experienced engineer. This keeps our quality high, and ensures that we can learn from each other.
  • We encourage you to share your work and learnings by means of writing or (internal) demos
  • We are a diverse team in which everybody can be who they are

Check out our team and values here: https://www.wolk.work/about

We believe that confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can deter talented people from applying. Even if you don't tick all the boxes but are excited about our mission - we'd love to hear from you!

What we offer:

  • Genuine impact: your work directly contributes to sustainability, social change and digital sovereignity
  • Work-life balance: 35 vacation days because we believe in recharging. In addition, you also have the ability to work from abroad a few weeks a year
  • Modern setup: latest MacBook Pro and tools you need to succeed
  • Unlimited access to LLM tokens for work related purposes (pick your weapon of choice)
  • Flexible working: mix of in-office and remote work
  • Location: office in the beautiful Werkspoorfabriek in Utrecht
  • Travel: your own NS business card
  • Learning culture: work on R&D projects that spark your curiosity and help develop a new product
  • Team spirit: regular team trips, borrels, events, and yes - amazing havercappu’s

Starting date: 1st of December 2026 or 1st of January 2027

title: Sr Incentive Consultant
description:
As the Senior Incentive Consultant, you will be responsible for the administration of applicable LOB variable compensation plans. Including the maintenance of a sound governance structure to ensure well-founded decision-making & administration.

Primary responsibilities include

  • Senior role in the administration of the plans including the day-to-day processes required to administer all plans, looking for ways to improve the quality and productivity of the administration process to gain efficiencies, the disposition of all credit requests/disputes within plan guidelines, monitoring all control and governance of the plans and assisting in the development of incentive modeling to assist with forecasting/budgeting.
  • Senior role in the maintenance of a sound governance structure to ensure well-founded decision-making & administration.
  • Governance and control points in the incentive administration process are critical and acting as 1st level decision authority for credit requests provides transparency into how the governance structure is performing.
  • Additionally, evaluating credit request data and trends while recommending remedial action can help to mitigate risks.
  • Senior role in the delivery of the Incentive Performance Management Framework (targets, measurements, assessments) for the applicable LOB organization.
  • Assist in the development of sales and incentive related analysis for the applicable LOB organization, including ongoing performance analysis for the applicable LOB Contribution to LOB Sales/Revenue and a Total Compensation view for all positions.
  • Act as a senior team member on immediate team and the larger Sales Performance Management team. Help to foster a strong team and improve skills of colleagues.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in sales incentive compensation, sales performance management, compensation administration, business analytics, or a related field, including experience supporting complex incentive programs.
  • Demonstrated experience with incentive plan administration, including calculation and payout validation, data reconciliation, issue resolution, and adherence to plan governance and controls.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex data, identify trends and discrepancies, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large or complex data sets.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a high-volume environment while maintaining strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex incentive concepts and effectively partner with business stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements and develop more efficient, streamlined, or automated approaches.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Finance, Human Resources, Analytics, or a related field.
  • Experience in financial services, banking, or another highly regulated industry.
  • Experience with incentive compensation management platforms, such as Varicent or similar ICM systems.
  • Experience with incentive plan design, modeling, forecasting, and plan-effectiveness analysis.
  • Experience partnering across Finance, HR, Risk, Compliance, and business leadership.
  • Experience supporting training, change management, or implementation of new or revised incentive programs.

Pay Transparency

The salary range for this position is $92,000 - $119,000 per year, plus an opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. Actual pay is based on various factors including but not limited to the budget, work location, and relevant skills and experience.

We offer competitive pay, comprehensive medical, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, maternity/paternity leave, flexible work arrangements, education reimbursement, wellness programs and more. Note, Citizens’ paid time off policy exceeds the mandatory, paid sick or paid time-away policy of every local and state jurisdiction in the United States. For an overview of our benefits, visit .

title: Director, Technical Learning & Capability Development
description:
Primary Function of Position

The Director, Technical Learning & Capability Development reports to senior operations leadership and is responsible for the global strategy, governance, and execution of technical capability development programs supporting manufacturing, maintenance repair and overhaul (MRO), logistics, and other technical operations across the enterprise.

This leader will establish and continuously improve standardized technical training, certification, competency management, and workforce development programs that ensure employee readiness, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and organizational scalability. The role is accountable for developing enterprise-wide learning frameworks, skills matrices, qualification standards, and certification pathways that enable a highly capable technical workforce.

As a member of the Operations Leadership Team, this individual will partner with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Service Operations, Supply Chain, Planning, Regulatory Affairs, Human Resources, and business leaders to ensure workforce capability aligns with strategic priorities, operational capacity, new product introductions (NPI), and evolving technology requirements.

The Director will drive continuous improvement of technical learning systems, optimize training resources, and leverage data and performance metrics to accelerate workforce readiness, improve productivity, reduce quality risk, and support global operational growth.

Essential Job Duties

  • Lead the design and execution of training programs and learning strategies aligned with the Operations business priorities and global strategy.
  • Design and oversee technical training programs for technicians and material handlers and establish a framework to monitor training delivery quality via the use of standardized processes for onboarding, competency checks and training assessment tools.
  • Drive innovation in learning delivery through blended, digital, and experiential approaches, enabling scale.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of training professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Establish a framework for measuring and evaluating learning effectiveness and impact, using data to improve training programs and demonstrate business impact.
  • Manage budgets, resources, and equipment to ensure cost-effective and high-quality learning solutions.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in: Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, Biomedical) or Manufacturing Engineering Technology or Operations Management or Supply Chain / Industrial Technology or equivalent technical experience

  • 12+ years of experience leading technical training, workforce development, learning programs, manufacturing operations, service operations, engineering organizations, or related technical environments

  • 5+ years leading managers and technical training organizations supporting large-scale operational or technical workforces

  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling workforce capability programs in complex technical environments

  • Experience developing competency frameworks, certification programs, qualification systems, and skills matrices

  • Experience partnering with operational, engineering, quality, and business leaders to translate technical requirements into effective workforce development programs

  • Experience implementing and scaling learning management systems (LMS), certification tracking systems, or workforce development platforms

  • Strong understanding of adult learning principles, instructional design methodologies, and organizational capability development

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting organizations operating in regulated, quality-driven, or highly controlled environments

  • Experience driving organizational change, workforce readiness, and capability development during periods of growth and transformation

  • Demonstrated ability to align workforce capability initiatives with business objectives, operational performance, quality outcomes, and productivity goals

  • Strong program management, organizational leadership, and change management skills

  • Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills

  • Experience supporting manufacturing, service operations, logistics, distribution, healthcare, medical device, aerospace, defense, semiconductor, or other highly technical industries

  • Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI) or operational readiness initiatives

  • Knowledge of regulated environments including FDA, ISO 13485, GMP, or similar quality systems

title: Therapist
description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

The Therapist provides trauma-informed, evidence-based mental health services to children in foster care and their parents and families. This position conducts behavioral health assessments, develops individualized treatment plans, and provides individual, family, and group therapy, including Trauma-Focused Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (TF-CBT) and Seeking Safety. The Therapist also facilitates the Nurturing Parenting Program and therapeutic visitation to strengthen parent-child relationships and support safe reunification and permanency, working with child welfare, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners to deliver coordinated, culturally responsive care.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral health and trauma assessments and develop individualized treatment plans with children, parents, and caregivers.
  • Provide individual, family, and group therapy using TF-CBT and other trauma-informed interventions.
  • Provide Seeking Safety, individually or in groups, for adolescents and parents affected by trauma and substance use.
  • Provide therapeutic visitation, using family time to strengthen parent-child relationships and support safe reunification.
  • Facilitate the Nurturing Parenting Program and other caregiver education activities.
  • Provide psychoeducation to children, parents, and caregivers on trauma and its effects.
  • Provide crisis intervention and safety planning as needed.
  • Monitor progress toward treatment goals and complete clinical measures at required intervals.
  • Coordinate care with child welfare case managers, the Case Manager/Referral Specialist, schools, healthcare providers, and community partners.
  • Participate in clinical supervision, case staffings, and team meetings, and provide clinical updates as requested.
  • Document all services in CDS and/or CCWIS within required timeframes.
  • Collect data for grant reporting and program evaluation.
  • Report suspected abuse or neglect and maintain confidentiality in accordance with HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

title: Software Development Manager
description:
Salary: ₱120,000 – ₱140,000 per month

Job Summary

The Software Development Manager is responsible for leading and managing software development teams, overseeing the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and ensuring the successful delivery of scalable, reliable, secure, and high-performance software solutions. This role drives the adoption of industry-recognized software development practices and Agile methodologies, manages project timelines and technical resources, and ensures that software products meet business requirements and operational standards. The position requires strong leadership in managing development teams, optimizing software lifecycle processes, and delivering real-time data systems that support business operations and mission-critical applications.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Development

  • Leadership Lead, mentor, and manage software developers, technical leads, and other development personnel.

  • Establish team objectives, assign responsibilities, monitor performance, and promote continuous professional development.

  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing engineering culture.

  • Coordinate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA, IT Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives.

2. Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) Management

  • Oversee all phases of the SDLC, including requirements analysis, system design, development, testing, deployment, maintenance, and continuous improvement.

  • Establish and enforce software development standards, coding guidelines, documentation practices, and quality assurance processes.

  • Implement effective version control, code review, testing, release management, and change management procedures.

  • Ensure software solutions meet performance, security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability requirements.

3. Agile Methodology and Project Delivery

  • Implement and optimize Agile frameworks and practices, including Scrum, Kanban, sprint planning, backlog management, and retrospectives.

  • Monitor project progress, resource allocation, delivery schedules, and development milestones.

  • Identify project risks, remove delivery bottlenecks, and implement corrective actions.

  • Promote continuous improvement through measurable engineering metrics and regular team reviews.

4. Real-Time Data Systems and Technical Oversight

  • Oversee the design, development, integration, and maintenance of real-time data processing systems and event-driven applications.

  • Ensure timely, accurate, and reliable data processing, transmission, monitoring, and system integration.

  • Guide the team in addressing system performance, latency, availability, data integrity, and scalability challenges.

  • Collaborate with architecture, infrastructure, and operations teams to improve system reliability and troubleshoot complex technical issues.

  • Evaluate emerging technologies, development tools, and architectural approaches to improve system performance and operational efficiency.

5. Quality Assurance, Security, and Compliance

  • Establish quality standards and ensure appropriate unit, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing.

  • Ensure adherence to secure coding practices, data protection requirements, and applicable company policies.

  • Oversee defect management, production incident resolution, root-cause analysis, and preventive measures.

  • Maintain technical documentation, system architecture records, and software release documentation.

6. Stakeholder and Resource Management

  • Collaborate with management and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

  • Prepare development plans, progress reports, resource forecasts, and technical recommendations.

  • Manage development capacity, project priorities, and delivery dependencies.

  • Communicate project status, risks, and technical concerns to senior management.

Qualifications and Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of seven (7) years of experience managing software development teams, including responsibility for team performance, project delivery, and technical execution.

  • Demonstrated experience managing the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirements gathering through deployment and maintenance.

  • Proven experience in real-time data systems, event-driven architectures, data integration, or other systems requiring timely and reliable data processing.

  • Must possess an industry-recognized software development or Agile methodology certification, such as Certified ScrumMaster (CSM),

  • Certified Software Development Professional (CSDP), or an equivalent recognized certification.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum practices, software engineering principles, quality assurance, and release management.

  • Experience with source control, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and modern software development tools.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, and people-management skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects, competing priorities, and cross-functional teams effectively.


Core Competencies

  • Software Engineering Leadership

  • Agile and Scrum Management S

  • DLC Governance and Process Improvement

  • Real-Time Data Systems Management

  • Technical Problem-Solving

  • Quality Assurance and Risk Management

  • Strategic Planning and Resource Allocation

  • Stakeholder Management and Communication

  • Team Development and Performance Management

title: Data Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data systems that power analytics, reporting, and business intelligence.


You will work closely with software engineers, analysts, and stakeholders to transform raw data into reliable, production-ready datasets and dashboards.

Key ResponsibilitiesData Pipeline & ETL Development

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines

  • Develop ETL/ELT processes for structured and unstructured data

  • Automate workflows for ingestion and transformation

  • Ensure reliability and performance of processing jobs

Database & Data Modeling

  • Integrate multiple data sources into unified datasets

Data Quality & Testing

  • Troubleshoot inconsistencies and anomalies

  • Maintain accuracy, integrity, and availability of data

Business Intelligence & Power BI

  • Develop production-ready datasets for reporting

  • Optimize model performance and refresh behavior

  • Support reporting and analytics requirements

Architecture & Deployment

  • Monitor pipeline and dataset performance

Security & Compliance

  • Implement governance, access control, and privacy safeguards

Documentation & Collaboration

  • Document data flows, schemas, and transformations

  • Communicate data health and performance to stakeholders

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams

Agile & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in sprint ceremonies

  • Propose architecture and workflow improvements

  • Contribute to reviews and knowledge sharing

Qualifications (Required)

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related field

  • 2–4+ years Data Engineering experience

  • Strong SQL and data transformation skills

  • Experience working with large datasets

  • Experience with big data environments

title: IT Support
description:
Position Title: Executive / Senior Executive (IT Support)

Department: IT Support


PURPOSE:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented IT Support Specialist to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing comprehensive hardware and software support to end users, ensuring efficient resolution of technical issues, and maintaining our IT infrastructure.

Our IT Support is responsible for providing proactive, hands-on IT support to all employees and ensuring that technical issues are resolved effectively and efficiently.

This position requires a strong sense of ownership. The successful candidate must be willing to investigate problems, apply their own technical knowledge, identify practical solutions, and follow through until issues are resolved.

This is not a passive coordination role. The IT Support Executive is expected to be the first person who actively troubleshoots and attempts to resolve issues locally. Escalation to Regional IT or external vendors should be used when additional expertise, authorization, or system-level support is genuinely required.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide proactive and professional IT support to all employees.

  • Take full ownership of IT issues from the time they are reported until they are resolved or properly escalated.

  • Actively investigate and troubleshoot hardware, software, network, system, and user-related issues.

  • Use technical knowledge, available tools, documentation, and logical problem-solving skills to identify solutions before escalating issues.

  • Avoid unnecessary escalation of issues that can reasonably be resolved locally.

  • Escalate complex issues to Regional IT or external vendors only after appropriate troubleshooting has been completed.

  • Provide clear information when escalating issues, including the problem, troubleshooting already performed, findings, and recommended next steps.

  • Follow up on escalated issues and remain responsible for communication with the end user until final resolution.

  • Respond to and resolve IT support tickets within agreed timelines and service levels.

  • Communicate proactively with employees regarding the status, expected next steps, and resolution of their IT issues.

  • Provide first- and second-level support for desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, mobile devices, applications, operating systems, and other IT equipment.

  • Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot PCs, laptops, printers, multi-function devices, smartphones, and related peripherals.

  • Install and support Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365, business applications, and standard company software.

  • Support user accounts, passwords, permissions, Active Directory, Group Policy, and other basic access-management activities.

  • Troubleshoot LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet connectivity, and other common network-related issues.

  • Prepare, image, configure, test, deploy, upgrade, and maintain end-user computers and IT devices.

  • Support new employee onboarding by preparing devices, accounts, system access, and required software.

  • Support employee offboarding by collecting IT equipment and coordinating the removal or disabling of system access.

  • Maintain accurate IT asset records, including equipment assignment, transfer, replacement, repair, and disposal.

  • Manage IT inventory and ensure company IT assets are properly controlled.

  • Coordinate with vendors for repairs, maintenance, warranty claims, procurement, and technical support when necessary.

  • Assist with IT security activities, including endpoint security, antivirus monitoring, user access review, and security reporting.

  • Maintain accurate records of incidents, troubleshooting activities, solutions, and recurring problems.

  • Create and maintain user guides, troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures, and technical documentation.

  • Identify recurring IT problems and recommend permanent solutions or process improvements.

  • Support IT projects and other technology-related activities as assigned.


WORKING STYLE AND EXPECTATIONS

The successful candidate must demonstrate a proactive, accountable, and solution-oriented working style.

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native (100% Remote) - Worldwide
description:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But that’s just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.

We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!

Responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.

You will:

- Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
- Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
- Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
- Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
- Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality

Requirements

  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga

  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.

  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.

  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.

  • Experience working with a remote team

  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.

  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: Director, Global Technology - Core
description:
Why This Role Matters

Core is the foundation the rest of Expeditors builds on: the servers, networks, databases, cloud landing zones, collaboration platforms, messaging systems, endpoints, and delivery pipelines that every other technology team and employee depends on. The governing principle is not negotiable: protect the enterprise and accelerate value delivery.

As Director, Core, you will lead a global organization through its transition from administration to engineering, from centralized decisions to distributed ownership, and from technology-shaped estates to products with named customers and measurable outcomes. Success is measured not only by keeping the lights on, but by how far you advance that transformation while maintaining operational excellence.

Team and Technology

You will lead approximately 140 people across Corporate Headquarters, Spokane, and the Global Capability Center in Chennai through Senior Managers, Technical Product Managers, and Architects. The organization spans Private and Public Cloud Infrastructure, Developer Experience, User and Endpoint Systems, and data center facilities.

Core delivers hybrid multi-cloud management, developer experience, core back-office enablement, and workplace and endpoint experience products. You will partner closely with Cybersecurity, Geographic Global Technology, Site Reliability Engineering, Technical Product Management, Architects, procurement, vendor management, and Legal while overseeing infrastructure, cloud, licensing, and technology provider relationships.

What Success Looks Like

  • Every capability can name its customers, expected outcomes, and meaningful measures.
  • The domain is presented through data-driven roadmaps, commitments, and operational health.
  • Infrastructure as Code adoption expands while manual production work is materially reduced.
  • Reliability practices and Cybersecurity controls are delivered through shared metrics and engineering practices.
  • Leadership bench strength, technical leadership, and strategic partnerships continue to deepen globally.

Key Areas of Impact

Coaching for Growth

  • Coach against the career grid, run skip-level feedback, and calibrate expectations with peer Directors so that standards are consistently applied across locations.
  • Develop managers, architects, and engineers while building succession plans and leadership growth across the global organization.

Delivering on Commitments

  • Own organizational commitments, lead capacity planning, manage departmental budgets across capital and operating expenditure, and ensure investments deliver measurable value.
  • Prioritize freight-impacting work, manage operational and delivery risk, and maintain accountability for roadmap execution, operational health, and sustainable delivery.

Hiring and Retaining Excellence

  • Fill critical leadership positions, strengthen product management and engineering capability, and hire leaders who combine domain expertise with software development experience.
  • Build a culture grounded in respect, trust, support, succession planning, and long-term organizational capability.

Technical Depth and Delivery

  • Lead the transition toward Infrastructure as Code, automation, and pipeline-based delivery while establishing standards for reproducible environments and operational excellence.
  • Be accountable for technical decisions across the organization and champion AI-assisted engineering tooling, automation, testing, reliability, and security practices.

Architectural Scale

  • Participate in design decisions involving virtualization strategy, database modernization, hybrid reference architecture, observability, and on-premises AI.
  • Govern through paved roads, architecture decision records, inner-source contribution, and enterprise-wide architectural ownership and standards.

Team Collaboration Scale

  • Reduce coordination overhead, strengthen cross-location partnerships, and sustain the trust-based operating model that enables autonomous teams and shared ownership.
  • Partner with Cybersecurity, Site Reliability Engineering, Geographic Global Technology, and regional teams to deliver outcomes across organizational boundaries.

Influence and Advocacy

  • Represent the domain through roadmap, capacity, commitment, and operational-health data while making Core’s work visible across the organization.
  • Model the co-founder mindset, advocate for customer-focused outcomes, and influence technology strategy across stakeholders and leadership forums.

Scope of Vision

  • Carry a one-to-three-year vision across cloud and modernization, legacy retirement, capability ownership transitions, and long-term technology investments.
  • Maintain alignment from provider technology through product and program roadmaps while translating strategic direction into executable plans.

Scale of Business Understanding and Impact

  • Define customers, expected outcomes, and success measures for every capability while improving the experience of employees, technical staff, customers, and governance functions.
  • Establish the strategic posture for critical infrastructure providers, manage multiple cost centers, and steward cloud commitments, platform investments, and third-party risk.
  • Set the strategic posture for the providers behind critical infrastructure, working with procurement, vendor management, Cybersecurity and Legal so that renewal terms, exit options and third-party risk are settled ahead of the compelling event rather than during it.

This position is on-site and will reside in the greater Seattle, WA. area at one of the following locations depending on availability. Candidates must be local or willing to relocate. Relocation assistance is not offered for this position.

  • Downtown Seattle
  • Federal Way
  • Lynnwood
  • Bellevue (Factoria)

Qualifications for Success

Required

  • Substantial experience leading a technology organization of comparable scale, managing managers and senior individual contributors across multiple disciplines.
  • Experience leading infrastructure or platform teams through a transition toward engineering practice, including Infrastructure as Code, automation, and pipeline-based delivery.
  • Technical credibility across infrastructure and platform domains sufficient to participate in architectural decisions and establish technical standards.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across regions and time zones while enabling local ownership and decision-making.

  • Working fluency with agile delivery at scale and the ability to evolve practices to improve outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with Cybersecurity as a peer and delivering controls through engineering practices.
  • Experience with Agentic AI development processes and practices.

Preferred

  • Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments where private infrastructure and multiple public clouds operate under a single model.
  • Experience establishing product management discipline within infrastructure organizations, including customer definition, roadmaps, and outcome measures.
  • Experience with site reliability engineering practices, service management platforms, and enterprise observability.
  • Experience working in regulated environments and control frameworks, including financial-reporting controls over technology.
  • Experience in logistics, transportation, or other operationally intensive industries where system availability has immediate business consequences.

Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not transfer or sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (such as an H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

description:
Schedule: Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

SUMMARY:

To provide instruction, observe and evaluate a child's performance while creating a classroom environment that encourages learning and builds positive relationships with the children, families, and staff. When requested, will be responsible for referrals and eligibility evaluations after referral. Presents and interprets evaluations to parents at conferences. Conducts evaluations once qualified.

  • Conducts developmental screenings as scheduled or requested.

Classroom Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Directly supervises, engages with, and teaches all children in classrooms throughout the day.

title: Unit Director, Neurological Intensive Care Unit
description:
Job Description:

The Unit Director (Nurse Manager) is responsible for the 24-hour planning, organizing, directing and controlling all operations of the Neuro ICU and participates actively in decision making related to departmental functions. Reporting to the Patient Care Director, the Unit Director provides consistent clinical leadership and nursing practice oversight for the unit.

Functional areas of oversight include the 8/11 Neurological Intensive Care Unit (Neuro ICU) and its support of the Rapid Transfer Unit (RTU). Ensures the quality, safety and cost-effectiveness of patient care. Serves as a role model for professional nursing practice. Responsible for the administration of personnel, fiscal and material resources on a 24-hour basis, including approximately 140 staff and a $20M operating budget. Assists with the development and implementation of new programs and policies. Direct reports include Assistant Unit Directors, clinical nurses and support staff.

Regulatory Accreditation Standards: Ensures that compliance and accreditation standards are met in all areas of responsibility. Develops and maintains departmental policies and procedures and complies with all applicable regulatory standards. Ensures adherence to The Joint Commission Comprehensive Stroke Center requirements and builds a solid auditing process to sustain certification.

Leadership: Fosters a work environment that supports teamwork, open communication and engagement across the organization. Promotes shared governance and a shared voice in nursing practice. Leads recruitment, performance management and staff development, and mentors Assistant Unit Directors and nurse leaders with succession planning in mind. Partners with Labor Relations and Human Resources on employee and contract issues. Manages staffing, patient flow, productivity and supplies within budgetary specifications. Other duties as assigned.

Strategic Performance Improvement: Maintains the Neuro ICU's reputation for high-quality, service-oriented care through evidence-based practice that aligns with UCSF values. Leads quality improvement in patient outcomes, patient experience and cost savings, and partners with IT on patient care information systems.

Strategic Growth: Collaborates with physician leadership and inter-professional teams to expand and enhance neuroscience critical care services, including rapid transfer capacity and research in patient care areas. Partners with leaders across services to coordinate care for all patient populations.

Department Overview :

The Neurological Intensive Care unit (Neuro ICU / NICU) is one of the largest and most sophisticated neurological intensive care units in the nation. It is a fast-paced, highly specialized unit providing exceptional quality care to critically ill adults with a wide array of neurological disorders, including those who undergo a variety of complex surgical procedures, interventional treatments and advance research treatment modalities.

The Neuro ICU cares for the most complex patients with neurological disorders including patients with subarachnoid hemorrhages, intracerebral hemorrhages, simple aneurysms and complicated multiple aneurysms, arteriovenous malformations, acute ischemic strokes, brain tumors, seizure disorders and spinal disorders. The unit offers a variety of advanced neurological monitoring techniques and innovative interventions that allow for the best possible outcome for the patients. Patient care is driven by a multifaceted approach geared towards the highest quality of individualized care.

UCSF is a designated Comprehensive Stroke Center accredited by The Joint Commission recognizing the neurological teams’ exceptional efforts in the care of stroke patients.

The Neuro ICU is composed of dedicated, astute critical care nurses committed to the pursuit of excellence in the neurosciences utilizing an evidence-based approach that encompasses patient and family participation.

The Neuro ICU also supports the Rapid Transfer Unit (RTU) for the University Hospital. This allows for time sensitive transfer center patients to rapidly be admitted to UCSF for immediate medical intervention.

Professional growth and development is the foundation of the unit culture and philosophy. Neuro ICU strongly supports nurses by providing them with the necessary resources and skills to be successful in this extraordinary environment. Nurses keep abreast with the current neurological trends in care through participation in advanced Neuro classes and conferences.

The Neuro ICU staff also actively participate in many quality improvement projects, innovative research, and community collaborative efforts.
