title: Entune: Agentic AI & Data Science Engineer
description:
Bouw AI-systemen die echte gebouwen slimmer en duurzamer maken

Bij Entune bouwen we software die gebouwen realtime slimmer, efficiënt en duurzamer maakt. Onze technologie verzamelt en analyseert enorme hoeveelheden gebouwdata uit sensoren, installaties en IoT-systemen om gebouwen autonoom te optimaliseren.

Daarbij speelt AI en geavanceerde data science een cruciale rol.

We zoeken daarom een Agentic AI & Data Science Engineer. Iemand die enthousiast wordt van LLM’s en Agentic AI, maar die óôk de diepe statistische en wiskundige kennis heeft om complexe voorspellende en optimalisatiemodellen te bouwen op basis van onze tijdreeksdata. Bij Entune geloven we dat echte AI-impact pas ontstaat wanneer geavanceerde data science en autonome agenten samenkomen op een sterke, schaalbare softwarefundering.

Je ontwikkelt dus niet alleen de 'breinen' (de data science modellen), maar helpt ook mee om deze via autonome workflows (Agentic AI) en robuuste data pipelines operationeel te maken in de praktijk. Voor onze klanten, medewerkers en agents.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Agentic AI & Data Science Engineer werk je aan de volgende generatie intelligente software voor slimme gebouwen.

Je ontwikkelt Agentic AI workflows die gebouwen helpen autonoom beslissingen te nemen, energieverbruik te optimaliseren en installaties slimmer aan te sturen. Tegelijkertijd bouw je mee aan de software laag die deze AI-systemen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en bruikbaar maakt.

Je werkt dus op het snijvlak van:

  • Data Science & Modeling (Forecasting, optimalisatie, statistiek)

  • AI Engineering (Agentic AI, LLM orchestration, RAG)

  • Data Pipelines & Backend (Realtime datastromen, Python, API's)

  • IoT & Gebouwdata (Tijdreeksen, sensordata)

Concreet ga je onder andere:

  • Voorspellende modellen (forecasting) en optimalisatiealgoritmes ontwerpen en trainen op basis van sensor- en meterdata.

  • Agentic AI workflows ontwerpen en ontwikkelen

  • Werken met LLM’s en AI-integraties

  • Generatieve AI en traditionele machine learning technieken effectief met elkaar combineren.

  • APIs en services ontwikkelen voor de integratie tussen AI-modellen en gebouwsystemen.

  • Software ontwikkelen die AI-systemen operationeel ondersteunt

  • Werken aan de schaalbaarheid, performance en betrouwbaarheid van de operationele modellen.

  • Meedenken over de lange-termijn data- en AI-strategie van Entune.

Waarom deze rol anders is:

Veel AI-vacatures draaien vooral om prototypes, losse modellen of experimentele toepassingen. Bij Entune bouw je modellen en agenten die daadwerkelijk operationeel worden ingezet in fysieke gebouwen. Dat betekent dat jouw code en algoritmes direct impact hebben op de CO2-reductie en het energieverbruik van echte objecten.


We zoeken geen pure "prompt engineer" of een data scientist die alleen in notebooks werkt. We zoeken een engineer die wiskundige diepgang combineert met de drang om systemen écht te laten werken en direct waarde genereert voor Entune en zijn klanten.

Tech stack

Je hoeft niet alles al te beheersen, maar ervaring met een deel van onderstaande technologieën helpt:

  • Data Science & ML: MPC, XGBoost, Linear programming, Gradient Descent Algorithms, Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn).

  • AI & Automation: LLMs, Agentic frameworks (bijv. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI), RAG-architecturen.

  • Backend & Data: SQL, REST APIs, Dataprocessing pipelines

Wat we zoeken

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in een kwantitatieve richting (bijv. Kunstmatige Intelligentie, Data Science, Informatica, Econometrie, of vergelijkbaar;

  • Drie tot vijf jaar ervaring met het bouwen en in productie nemen van machine learning- of data science modellen (met name forecasting en optimalisatie);

  • Interesse in Agentic AI, LLM’s en intelligente systemen;

  • Bereidheid om naast AI ook reguliere software te bouwen en onderhouden;

  • Sterke programmeervaardigheden in Python en ervaring met moderne softwareontwikkeling (version control, testing, clean code);

  • Je houdt van ownership en technische verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Je werkt graag in een omgeving waar snel gebouwd en geëxperimenteerd wordt;

  • Goede beheersing van Nederlands en Engels.

Wat je krijgt

  • Werken aan AI en data science met echte, tastbare duurzame impact;

  • Veel technische vrijheid, autonomie en directe invloed op het product en de architectuur;

  • Een klein, technisch sterk en gedreven team in Eindhoven;

  • Veel ruimte voor innovatie, R&D en experimenteren met de nieuwste AI-technologieën;

  • Hybride werken;

  • Laptop van de zaak;

  • 26 vakantiedagen;

  • Pensioenregeling met 60% werkgeversbijdrage;

  • Kilometervergoeding.

Werken bij Entune

Entune ontwikkelt intelligente software voor slimme gebouwen. We combineren software engineering, AI en gebouwtechnologie om gebouwen efficiënt, comfortabeler en duurzamer te maken. We bouwen veel zelf, werken snel en geven engineers veel verantwoordelijkheid. Geen logge corporate omgeving, maar een technisch gedreven team waar ideeën snel werkelijkheid worden.

title: Infrastructure Engineer II
description:
Position:

Infrastructure Engineer II

Job Code:

Business Unit:

Corporate Shared Services / IT

FLSA Status:

Exempt

Reports to:

VP, Infrastructure

Supervisory Role:

No

Location:

Anaheim, CA

Salary Range:

Yes

About The Change Company

We take our mission to bank the underbanked seriously, fairly and responsibly. We bring digital-first banking, lending, and financial services to underserved communities, transforming the financial landscape.

We are a diverse, inclusive, and entrepreneurial organization that values collaboration, innovation, and customer focus. Our experienced leadership team drives growth and long-term success while serving tens of thousands of customers through responsible lending and banking solutions.

We have an experienced leadership team who have served in various fintech, banking and lending industries. We are a Community Development Financial Institution (CDFI) serving 50,000+ borrowers with over $10 Billion in loans since our CDFI certification.

Join us in building modern, data-driven platforms that power financial inclusion and innovation.

About the Role

The Infrastructure Engineer II reports directly to the VP, Infrastructure and shares day-to-day ownership of the platform our lending business runs on: our Cato Networks SASE fabric and Cisco and Meraki campus network, our identity estate across Okta SSO, Entra ID, and Active Directory, our co-located data center and virtualization footprint, and the controls that protect borrower non-public personal information (NPI).

This is a hands-on individual contributor role on a small team. You will own defined areas outright and run changes end to end — design, validation, rollback plan, and documentation — while the VP and senior engineers set overall architecture and review the higher-risk work. We are looking for someone who has already operated production infrastructure, brings an automation-first instinct, and has the judgment to know which changes need a second pair of eyes in a regulated, examined environment.

Essential Job Duties / Responsibilities

Network Infrastructure

  • Own day-to-day operation of the Cato Networks SASE platform — site and socket health, internet and firewall access policy, ZTNA rules for remote users, and traffic and bandwidth analysis — and design and implement policy changes with peer review.
  • Own configuration and lifecycle of Cisco and Meraki switching across the colocation facility and corporate offices: VLAN and trunk design, stacking, PoE, port security, firmware currency, and routing changes (BGP, OSPF, and inter-VLAN) including planning, validation, and rollback.
  • Own the Meraki wireless environment end to end — site surveys and access point placement, SSID and RADIUS design, channel and power tuning, client troubleshooting, and firmware lifecycle.
  • Own DNS, DHCP, and IPAM as authoritative records and manage the certificate lifecycle; troubleshoot at the packet level using Cato and Meraki analytics alongside switch-level captures.
  • Manage carrier circuits, cross-connects, last-mile providers, and bandwidth capacity planning; drive carrier escalations to resolution and evaluate circuit changes against cost and redundancy.

Voice and Collaboration

  • Own the Vonage cloud VoIP platform — user and extension provisioning, call flow and IVR design, ring groups, voicemail, device lifecycle for desk phones and softphones, and E911 record accuracy.
  • Diagnose call quality end to end across LAN QoS, Cato WAN policy, and carrier-side issues, and drive Vonage support cases through to root cause.

Identity, Single Sign-On, and Directory Services

  • Own Okta administration — application assignments, group and app rules, sign-on and MFA policies, Okta Verify, and lifecycle rules for joiners, movers, and leavers — and improve those rules rather than only executing them.
  • Lead SSO onboarding for new applications end to end: SAML and OIDC integration, attribute mapping, SCIM or just-in-time provisioning, pilot testing, cutover, and documentation, working directly with application owners and vendors.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID alongside Okta — user and group lifecycle, role and license assignment, and the federation between the two — and keep entitlements consistent across both.
  • Own on-premises Active Directory and the integrations that depend on it: organizational unit and group policy design, DNS, domain controller health and patching, the Okta AD agent, Entra Connect, and service account governance.
  • Design and tune MFA and Conditional Access policy across Okta and Entra, balancing risk against user friction, and investigate authentication failures and suspicious sign-ins using Okta system logs and Entra sign-in logs.
  • Automate identity operations with PowerShell and the Okta API — bulk provisioning, entitlement reporting, license reclamation, and access review data pulls — using the Microsoft Graph, Exchange Online, and Active Directory modules on the Microsoft side.

Co-located Data Center and Virtualization

  • Own capacity and lifecycle in the colocation facility: rack elevations, A/B power and PDU load, cooling headroom, structured cabling, cross-connects, and hardware refresh planning, and coordinate smart-hands and maintenance windows with the facility.
  • Administer VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V in parallel — cluster and datastore configuration within established standards, virtual machine provisioning and right-sizing, host firmware and patching, SAN/NAS storage, and capacity forecasting.
  • Own backup operations in Druva: policy and retention configuration, job health, failure remediation, restore testing, and documented recovery of files, virtual machines, and applications.
  • Own VMware replication to the recovery site — replication configuration against RPO targets, health and lag monitoring, remediation, and planning and executing scheduled failover tests with written results.
  • Maintain out-of-band access (console servers, iDRAC/iLO) and author recovery runbooks another engineer can follow.

Cyber Security

  • Apply and enforce least-privilege and zero-trust principles, harden systems to CIS Benchmarks, and own segmentation between production, corporate, vendor, and NPI zones in Cato policy and on the switch fabric.
  • Run vulnerability management for your areas end to end — authenticated scanning, severity-based patch SLAs, remediation tracking, and documented risk acceptances with compensating controls.
  • Investigate EDR, SIEM, and Cato security alerts — IPS, anti-malware, and DNS and URL filtering — tune detections to cut false positives, and take an active role in incident response through containment, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Own privileged access, service account hygiene, secrets rotation, and periodic access reviews across the infrastructure estate.
  • Maintain encryption in transit and at rest, TLS and certificate standards, and email authentication with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.

Automation and Scripting

  • Automate repetitive server, network, and identity administration with PowerShell — take work that is done by hand today and turn it into something repeatable and documented.
  • Build and maintain a shared library of reusable PowerShell scripts and modules for provisioning, reporting, and health checks, with parameters, error handling, and logging rather than one-off snippets.
  • Write and maintain Ansible playbooks for server and appliance configuration, and automate configuration backup and compliance checking for Cisco and Meraki devices.
  • Help set scripting standards for the team — naming, structure, comments, and change records — so the next engineer can pick up and run what you wrote.

Operations, Support, and Compliance

  • Take a full share of the on-call rotation as primary responder, and plan and execute after-hours change windows with validation steps and a tested rollback plan.
  • Own monitoring in LogicMonitor — coverage as the environment changes, threshold and escalation design, dashboard quality, and continuous reduction of alert noise.
  • Resolve infrastructure tickets escalated from the help desk, and keep network diagrams, IP plans, asset inventory, and runbooks current.
  • Implement and evidence infrastructure controls under the GLBA Safeguards Rule, SOC 2, and applicable investor and state requirements.
  • Act as a technical contributor during internal audit, external audit, investor and warehouse lender reviews, and regulatory examinations — producing evidence and explaining the controls in your areas.
  • Take part in business continuity and disaster recovery testing and help keep the technology portions of those plans current.
  • Support and mentor junior engineers and help desk staff — review their changes, take their escalations, and write down what you know instead of keeping it in your head.
  • Complete special tasks as assigned by manager as needed.
  • Regular on-site attendance.

We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

Physical Demands

Working Conditions

title: Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer (Microsoft Fabric) | Vast dienstverband | Duurzame klimaattechnologie

Help Nederland verduurzamen met data van duizenden installaties in het veld. Voor een organisatie die zich richt op duurzame oplossingen voor verwarming, koeling en ventilatie, zijn wij op zoek naar een Data Engineer die deze data vertaalt naar waardevolle inzichten voor de organisatie, compliance en productontwikkeling. Daarnaast help je mee aan de ontwikkeling van een toekomstbestendig dataplatform binnen Microsoft Fabric.

Het betreft een vaste functie voor 32–40 uur per week in de regio Rotterdam, met maar liefst 40 vrije dagen per jaar en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Je komt terecht op de afdeling die de klimaatoplossingen van de organisatie slimmer en beter verbonden maakt. Deze afdeling houdt zich bezig met alles van embedded software en cloudplatformen tot apps, monitoring en datagedreven diensten. Als Data Engineer speel je een centrale rol binnen deze datagedreven dienstverlening.

Je ontsluit en modelleert data uit verschillende bronsystemen binnen Microsoft Fabric. Daarnaast ontwerp, ontwikkel en beheer je schaalbare dataoplossingen en datastromen die bijdragen aan de datagedreven ambities van de organisatie.

Met Power BI vertaal je monitoring- en installatiegegevens naar dashboards, analyses en rapportages die worden gebruikt voor compliance, zakelijke besluitvorming en productverbeteringen. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met verschillende stakeholders om hun informatiebehoeften te vertalen naar praktische, datagedreven oplossingen.

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever voor 32–40 uur per week in de regio Rotterdam.

Daarnaast ontvang je 27 vakantiedagen en 13 ATV-dagen (in totaal 40 vrije dagen) en krijg je volop mogelijkheden om jezelf zowel persoonlijk als professioneel verder te ontwikkelen.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Informatica, Data Science, Software Engineering, Technische Bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare richting.
  • Je hebt minimaal enkele jaren werkervaring als Data Engineer, BI Engineer of in een vergelijkbare datafunctie.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare praktijkervaring met Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, SQL en Python.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen van schaalbare dataoplossingen en het ontwikkelen van ETL/ELT-processen waarbij data uit verschillende bronsystemen wordt geïntegreerd.
  • Je bent analytisch sterk en kunt complexe data en inzichten op een begrijpelijke manier uitleggen aan verschillende stakeholders.
  • Je bent op zoek naar een vaste baan. Deze functie staat niet open voor freelancers of zzp'ers.

Sinds 2000 bieden wij professionele oplossingen aan organisaties, variërend van innovatieve techstart-ups tot internationale marktleiders. Vanuit onze kantoren in Amsterdam en Londen hebben wij een uitgebreid nationaal en internationaal netwerk opgebouwd van gespecialiseerde professionals in loondienst en zelfstandige consultants.

Onze passie ligt bij het verbinden van de juiste expertise aan uitdagende projecten. Door de jaren heen hebben wij meer dan 2.500 vacatures en opdrachten succesvol ingevuld. Tegenwoordig zijn er via ons voortdurend meer dan 250 professionals actief op uiteenlopende projecten, waarbij wij talent uit 14 verschillende landen hebben geworven en begeleid bij hun internationale verhuizing.

Onze kracht ligt in de manier waarop wij mensen zien en behandelen. Persoonlijke aandacht, betrokkenheid en duurzame relaties vormen de basis van onze aanpak en blijven ook in de toekomst centraal staan in onze strategie.

title: Land Surveyor
description:
Basic Purpose
Responsible for all aspects of land surveying to include pre-construction and as-built land surveying, earthwork and volumetric calculations, field note reduction, balancing of level runs, completes boundary and sectionalized land breakdown. Performs interpreting, understanding and retracing land/legal descriptions and interpretation of descriptor calls; prepares Parcel Maps and Record of Surveys and other duties as assigned.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Interprets, reviews and reduces survey field data for incorporation into new and ongoing projects including standard survey data as well as scanned data, photogrammetry and point clouds. Calculates and prepares field survey data and notes on pre-construction projects and provides technical survey expertise to construction and design personnel as well as immediate co-workers. (30%)

Prepares, reviews and approves Parcel Maps and Record of Surveys and ensures compliance with law as defined by NRS 265 and 278. (10%)

Understands property boundaries and sectionalized land breakdown and applies this understanding into accurate boundary resolution. (10%)

Serves as troubleshooting liaison for both engineering plans and survey field notes. (10%)

Prepares calculations and other related work for existing and future facilities based on engineering plans. (10%)

Assumes the responsibility of providing direction, oversight and coordination of responsibilities in the absence of the leader. (10%)

Serves as liaison for department with various projects and in meetings on a regular basis. (10%)

Interfaces with consulting engineering land surveying firms and internal customers. (10%)

Ensures all compliance aspects of position are known and followed; understands and complies with all policies, codes and regulations applicable to position and company.

Performs related duties as assigned.

Essential Education, Skills, and Environment
EAC/ABET-accredited bachelor’s degree or a Board approved equivalent and eight years of survey experience.

Candidates that do not possess a degree must have a minimum of 12 years of related work experience as a Land Technician or similar capacity.

Registration as a Professional Land Surveyor in the State of Nevada is required or must be obtained within twelve (12) months of hire date.

Specialized Knowledge and Skills
Demonstrated knowledge of:
NRS 265 and 278 laws, surveying methods, calculations, earthwork, volumetric, and engineering practices.

Demonstrated skills such as:
Analytical, interpersonal and communication.

Interpreting construction engineering plans, mapping, and in establishing positive relationships with internal and external customers.

Equipment and Applications
PCs, word processing, spreadsheet and database software.

Work Environment and Physical Demands
General office environment. No special physical demands required. Some travel may be required.

Depending on qualifications of applicants, this position may be filled at a lower level.

Note: Immigration Sponsorship
At this time, we're not considering applicants that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but is NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. For more information regarding work visas, please visit www.uscis.gov.

title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
Salary: ₱70,000 – ₱85,000 per month

About the Role

Are you a versatile developer who thrives at the intersection of data science, software engineering, and cloud deployment? We are looking for a hands-on AI/ML Engineer who can take an idea from initial concept all the way to production.

In this role, you won't just build algorithms in isolation—you will design, train, test, and seamlessly integrate machine learning models into our core systems. You’ll serve as the bridge between raw data and impactful product features, delivering scalable, end-to-end AI solutions that directly drive our business forward.


Key Responsibilities

Data & Model Development

  • Collect, clean, and preprocess diverse datasets for training and testing.

  • Design, build, and optimize machine learning models using both classical ML and deep learning techniques.

  • Train, tune, and validate models against real-world performance metrics.

  • Conduct thorough testing, benchmarking, and error analysis to ensure quality.

System Integration

  • Develop robust APIs and backend services to connect ML models into our main product platform.

  • Partner with frontend and backend developers to embed user-facing AI functionalities.

  • Optimize models for efficient inference, low latency, and production scalability.

MLOps & Deployment

  • Package and deploy models reliably using Docker, FastAPI, or cloud ML services.

  • Set up continuous monitoring tools for model accuracy, data drift, and latency.

  • Maintain strict version control for models, code, and data pipelines.

Collaboration & Strategy

  • Partner with Product Managers to translate business objectives into functional technical requirements.

  • Maintain clear technical documentation for model architectures, datasets, and pipeline decisions.

  • Communicate technical results and insights clearly to non-technical team members and leadership.


What We’re Looking For

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, AI/ML, or a related field.

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience in applied machine learning or AI engineering in Fintech or Healthcare

  • Core Tech Stack: Strong proficiency in Python and core frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Scikit-learn.

  • API Development: Proven experience building and deploying APIs (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, or Node.js).

  • Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with major cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Data Engineering: Practical knowledge of ETL pipelines, data versioning, and labeling workflows.

  • ML Foundations: Deep understanding of model evaluation metrics, validation techniques, and hyperparameter tuning.

Nice-to-Haves / Bonus Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, or orchestration tools like LangChain.

  • Experience working with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, FAISS, Milvus).

  • Basic frontend knowledge (React, Vue) for rapid prototyping and internal tools.


What We Offer

  • End-to-End Ownership: The freedom to own AI solutions across the entire lifecycle, from ideation to production deployment.

  • Technical Autonomy: Real authority over design choices, tooling, and technical implementation.

  • Direct Impact: Build features that directly shape key business initiatives and user experiences.

  • Growth & Culture: A collaborative, continuous-learning environment supported by flexible hybrid work arrangements.

title: Utilization Review Representative
description:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Utilization Review Specialist is responsible for conducting and coordinating utilization review activities to support appropriate, medically necessary, and cost-effective patient care. This position reviews clinical documentation, monitors authorization and review requirements, coordinates with clinical staff and external stakeholders, and supports compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and payer requirements. The Specialist works collaboratively with the treatment team and other departments to promote timely reviews, accurate documentation, continuity of care, and effective utilization of services.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct timely utilization reviews in accordance with applicable payer requirements, organizational policies, and established procedures.
  • Review clinical records and supporting documentation for completeness, accuracy, and alignment with medical-necessity and authorization criteria.
  • Prepare, submit, and track clinical documentation and authorization requests; follow up on pending reviews, requests for additional information, and payer determinations.
  • Coordinate with clinical staff, providers, insurers, patients, and other relevant parties to support timely reviews and continuity of care.
  • Communicate review outcomes, authorization status, documentation needs, and applicable deadlines to appropriate members of the care team.
  • Maintain accurate, organized, and timely records of utilization review activities, communications, authorizations, and related decisions.
  • Identify potential barriers, delays, documentation gaps, or utilization concerns and escalate them to the appropriate supervisor or clinical leader.
  • Monitor review timelines and outstanding items to help ensure required reviews and follow-up activities are completed within established deadlines.
  • Assist with compiling data, preparing reports, and identifying trends related to utilization review activity, authorization outcomes, and process performance.
  • Support the implementation and consistent application of utilization review policies, procedures, and process improvements.
  • Maintain confidentiality and handle patient information in accordance with organizational requirements and applicable privacy laws and regulations.
  • Participate in meetings, training, audits, and quality-improvement activities related to utilization review, as assigned.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience in utilization review, behavioral health, healthcare administration, case management, or a related field preferred.
  • Knowledge of clinical documentation, medical-necessity review processes, authorization workflows, and payer requirements preferred.
  • Ability to review and interpret clinical information and identify missing documentation or items requiring follow-up.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively with clinical teams and external stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize multiple cases, deadlines, and follow-up requirements.
  • Proficiency with electronic health records, utilization review systems, and standard office software.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or equivalent required. Additional education in healthcare, behavioral health, nursing, social services, or a related field is preferred. Relevant utilization review or healthcare experience may be considered in place of additional education, consistent with organizational requirements.

WORK ENVIRONMENT AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

This position primarily performs administrative and computer-based work and requires regular communication with internal and external stakeholders. The employee must be able to use electronic systems, review records, and manage time-sensitive assignments. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

ROLE SCOPE

This is an individual-contributor position and does not include formal team-lead or supervisory responsibilities. The Specialist is expected to manage assigned utilization review work independently, collaborate with the care team, and escalate complex issues or decisions requiring supervisory or clinical leadership review.

Acknowledgment
I acknowledge that I have reviewed this job description and understand the general duties and responsibilities of the position. This document is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, and responsibilities may be changed as business needs require.

title: Mid- Level Game Capture Artist (Unity / Unreal)
description:
At Keywords Studios, we turn our passion for games, technology, and interactive storytelling into world-class support for the creators who shape the industry. Since 1998, we’ve grown into a global network of 70+ studios, partnering with the biggest names in gaming across every stage of development — from early concept to launch and live operations.

Our goal is simple: to be the go-to global platform for technical and creative services in the video games industry. We help teams stay agile, scale quickly, and focus on building unforgettable player experiences. With deep expertise across our industry-leading service lines and a worldwide team of specialists, we work side by side with our clients as their trusted partner, providing the talent, technology, and reach needed to bring great games to life.

Role overview

Digital Media Management (DMM), a Keywords Studios company, is a leading full-service digital agency, content studio and incubator specialising in social-first, “always-entertaining” marketing. DMM works with movie studios, television networks, game developers & publishers, streaming services and consumer brands to create groundbreaking social media campaigns via fan activations, innovative content creation, results-driven paid media planning, and strategic influencer-brand partnerships.

We're looking for a Game Capture Artist to join our award-winning team. You'll stage, shoot and scrutinise in-engine shots across specialised development builds to create the best content possible for our clients.

Our client list and fast growth come from a culture of no-waffle and a strong creative focus. The successful applicant will need to live those values and hit the ground running without heavy hand holding.

Key responsibilities:

  • Create high-quality in-engine capture using game development builds and Unity projects. This means setting up cameras, staging scenes and characters, and rendering high-resolution, high-frame-rate footage through the Unity Recorder and, where needed, Unreal's Movie Render Queue
  • Meet capture deadlines, which can sometimes be very tight, and manage your own time efficiently
  • Keep a sharp eye on quality, pushing lighting, post-processing, resolution and detail levels to get the best possible image from each build
  • Select and stage shots that meet the brief, telling a story through capture and showing off each game and its features in the best possible light
  • Fully understand the latest build and project version of each game, and be the main point of contact for all game and engine updates
  • Edit captured footage in After Effects and Premiere Pro, using editing techniques to make it as exciting as possible
  • Build and maintain reusable capture setups, such as camera rigs, Timeline sequences and lighting presets, to speed up future work
  • Gather high-quality assets (characters, environments, UI, renders) and export them from the engine when needed

Requirements

  • A passionate gamer with a broad appreciation of mobile, PC and console titles
  • A willingness to learn each game and its project setup inside out, and to stay hands-on with it every day
  • Someone who can adapt to game development builds and Unity projects that are always changing, including version updates, new scenes and shifting assets
  • An understanding of game trends and how games are marketed across the gaming landscape
  • Creative problem solving: finding ways around bugs, broken scenes and build issues to get the shot
  • A keen eye for composition, camera movement, lighting and framing
  • An eagerness to develop in-engine cinematography techniques and creative storytelling skills
  • A collaborator who can work efficiently with creative, editorial and client-side development teams
  • Strong proficiency in Unity (essential), including Cinemachine, Timeline, the Unity Recorder and working across URP/HDRP render pipelines
  • Working knowledge of Unreal Engine, including Sequencer, Movie Render Queue and cine cameras (highly desirable)
  • Previous experience in a game capture, in-engine cinematics or trailer production role (essential)
  • Knowledge of Adobe After Effects and Premiere Pro
  • PC proficient, with experience capturing from both PC and mobile builds (Android/iOS)

What do we offer?

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

We aim to keep the process transparent and supportive at every step. We appreciate your interest in the role and look forward to getting to know you better throughout the process.

Our recruitment process is fully online and remote. We value each application and review every candidate individually. Our recruitment team will get back to you as soon as they can to inform you about the status of your candidacy. If you're interested in joining our team, we highly encourage you to apply.

Location: Uvalde Memorial Hospital – Uvalde, Texas – IN PERSON

Make a Difference Every Day

At Uvalde Memorial Hospital, every detail matters when it comes to delivering exceptional patient care — including the accuracy and integrity of our medical records. We are looking for a dedicated Medical Records Coder who is passionate about precision, compliance, and supporting the healthcare team behind the scenes.

In this role, you will play an essential part in ensuring that diagnoses and procedures are accurately translated into medical codes that support patient care documentation, hospital operations, and billing processes. Your work helps maintain the integrity of our medical records while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations.

This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be part of a mission-driven healthcare team where your expertise helps keep our hospital running smoothly and efficiently.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain coding accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Comfort using Microsoft Office, Outlook, and electronic medical record systems.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

  • You’ll be part of a collaborative healthcare team dedicated to serving our community.
  • Your work directly supports patient care and hospital operations.
  • Opportunities for professional development and certification growth.
  • Competitive pay and a comprehensive benefits package.
  • A supportive workplace culture where your contributions are valued.

Ready to Join Our Team?

If you are detail-oriented, motivated by accuracy, and passionate about supporting healthcare from behind the scenes, we would love to meet you.

title: Referral Intake Specialist

Join Donor Network of Arizona and help save and heal lives through organ and tissue donation. As a Referral Intake Specialist, you will play a critical role in the organ donation process by evaluating referrals, assessing donor suitability, and collaborating with healthcare professionals to maximize donation opportunities across Arizona.

This is a remote position; however, candidates must reside within the state of Arizona.

The Referral Intake Specialist role is responsible for maximizing the organ referral and evaluation process in collaboration with the Referral Optimization Charge (ROC), Advisor on Call (AOC), Organ Recovery Coordinator (ORC), Organ Donation Coordinator (ODC), Donor Legacy Advocate (DLA), hospital staff, physicians, and medical director as needed.

  • Communicates with appropriate professional staff and reviews the patient’s medical record for consideration of donation options.

  • Collaborates with internal staff to manage all open referrals, including daily follow up, optimizing referral outcomes and processes
  • Provides basic education to hospital staff about the donation process, plan for continuity of care and progress of referral.
  • May need to facilitate a family conversation regarding donation when this is an immediate need. This includes collaborating with hospital staff to determine appropriate timing for family counseling and conversation.

At ALLCPR, we are committed to elevating community health and safety standards nationwide. We operate at more than 200 locations across the United States, providing American Heart Association Basic Life Support courses, American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED and Basic Life Support courses, and related CPR and life-saving training programs.

With an annual training volume of more than 80,000 participants, ALLCPR stands for the belief that all of us should learn CPR. It is our mission to ensure that everyone has the knowledge and skills to save lives.

Our Work Environment Includes

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

Note: The Instructor Trainer's teaching methods and content must comply with American Red Cross requirements.

License / Certification

  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Certification, r.25 — Required if you are looking for an instructor role
  • American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor Trainer Certification, r.25 — Required﻿ ﻿if you are looking for an instructor trainer role
  • American Red Cross BLS Instructor Trainer Certification — Preferred
  • American Heart Association BLS Instructor Certification — Preferred
  • Other equivalent Instructor Trainer certifications may be considered where an approved bridging pathway is available; we can provide bridging guidance.

Teaching Equipment

The Instructor Trainer must own at least 3 manikin sets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare for American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses.
  • Deliver instructor-level training sessions to individuals or groups.
  • Demonstrate proper CPR/AED techniques that comply with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.
  • Monitor and evaluate candidate progress to ensure proficiency.
  • Complete and submit course records in accordance with American Red Cross requirements.
  • Ensure training materials are up-to-date and comply with relevant program requirements.
  • Participate in ongoing professional development to stay current with CPR and AED training best practices.
  • Provide excellent customer service to clients and candidates.

Requirements

  • Current American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor certification.
  • Strong knowledge of CPR and AED techniques and best practices.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to provide constructive feedback to candidates.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

title: Sr. Hardware Engineer
description:
Your Impact

As a Sr. Hardware Engineer within the Transformers Value Stream, you will aid in driving new technology initiatives and performing Qualitrol’s NPD and Sustaining initiatives. The position requires a highly motivated, team oriented professional with the right mix of experience and skills. They will work on multiple projects using internal and external resources to deliver quality products that meet our customers' needs. Involved in all facets of development starting from requirements specification, validation, verification, and deployment. Responsible for product quality and reliability along with feature completion. This individual will embody Ralliant’s principles of leading by example, communicating openly, enabling, and inspiring extraordinary teams, excelling with partners, acting conclusively with high integrity, and collaborating efficiently to delight customers.

In this role, you will use SAFe Agile development Methods and an AI-first Scrum Framework to deliver critical, customer facing, monitoring systems, sensors and solutions for Utilities and Industrial customers. You will be expected to possess a thorough understanding of electrical design principles of analog and digital circuits.

Here’s where you’ll demonstrate your proficiencies:

  • Support guidance into the entire product implementation cycle including requirements analysis, high level and detailed design (including PCBA layout), implementation, testing, integration, documentation, compliance certification and introduction to production in coordination with architecture team.

  • Support advanced technology initiatives to develop next generation sensors and sensing platforms and improvements in products sustaining activities.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Hardware Engineer to join our dynamic R&D team. This role is pivotal in driving the development of next-generation sensing and monitoring solutions for industrial and utility applications. The ideal candidate will bring a strong foundation in analog/digital circuit design, embedded systems, and communication protocols, with a passion for developing robust, field-ready hardware platforms.

Skills & Experience

The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate the following skills and experience:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or similar.
  • 5+ years of experience in hardware design for embedded systems.
  • Experience and motivation to use and drive adoption of AI tools
  • Proficiency in analog and digital circuit design, including low-noise signal paths and power management.
  • Strong understanding of industrial communication protocols (e.g., Modbus RTU/TCP, LoRa, RS-485) with experience in integration into new and existing hardware platforms.
  • Familiarity with sensor integration, including temperature, humidity, pressure, and optical sensors.
  • Experience with schematic capture and PCB layout tools, Altium Designer preferred.
  • Experience with Agile and Scrum framework.
  • Knowledge and understanding of the fundamentals of fluid dynamics, thermal dynamics, computational fluid simulation using Ansys, Solid Works or similar would be an advantage.
  • Experience with firmware-hardware co-design and debugging embedded systems.
  • Knowledge of designing for compliance (EMC, safety), compliance testing, and product certification processes.
  • Experience working with global manufacturing partners and contract manufacturers.
  • Strong technical documentation and communication skills.

Cyberdivisionen i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse har ansvaret for at drive, vedligeholde og udvikle Forsvarets IT samt understøtte digitaliseringen på tværs af Forsvarsministeriets koncern.

Du bliver en del af DeMars Business Intelligence-sektionen, som består af 6 fastansatte medarbejdere og derudover eksterne IT-konsulenter.

Vi arbejder i opgaveorienterede teams, hvor medarbejderne har stor indflydelse på, hvordan opgaverne løses og prioriteres. Vi lægger vægt på faglighed, videndeling og et stærkt samarbejde på tværs.

Om stillingen
Hjørnestenen i vores BI-landskab er en Enterprise Data Warehouse-løsning, baseret på SAP BW/4HANA, mens frontend blandt andet håndteres gennem SAP Business Objects. Vi anvender desuden Celonis og arbejder med nye muligheder inden for analytics.

Forsvaret er samtidig på en rejse mod SAP S/4HANA, som vil få betydning for vores fremtidige data- og BI-landskab.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • Udvikle og vedligeholde vores SAP-baserede BI-løsninger
  • Arbejde med backend, data og tekniske løsninger
  • Planlægge og gennemføre udviklingsopgaver og projekter
  • Bidrage til arkitektur, dokumentation og teknisk governance
  • Rådgive, samarbejde og dele viden med kolleger og leverandører.

Du får ansvar for egne opgaver og projekter og mulighed for, at være med til at sætte den teknologiske retning.

Om dig
Vi forestiller os, at du har en videregående uddannelse inden for eksempelvis IT, teknologi, økonomi, HR eller et andet relevant område.

Det vigtigste er ikke, hvad din uddannelse hedder, eller om du kan alle vores teknologier fra starten. Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • Har en god teknisk og analytisk forståelse
  • Arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret
  • Er nysgerrig og motiveret for at lære nyt
  • Kan omsætte komplekse problemstillinger til brugbare løsninger
  • Trives med ansvar og samarbejde.

Erfaring med SAP BI, BW/4HANA, Business Objects, SAP Analytics, Celonis, AI, machine learning eller generel BI er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Dertil vil det være en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du tidligere har deltaget i en SAP-transformations proces. Det vigtigste er dit drive for at lære og omsætte ny viden til praksis.

Du skal kunne formulere dig på dansk i skrift og tale, samt kunne læse og forstå teknisk engelsk.

Ansættelsesvilkår

Er du akademiker ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende overenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og en række akademikerorganisationer for akademikere i staten (Akademikeroverenskomsten).

Hvis du har en kontoruddannelse eller en anden relevant uddannelse ansættes du i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende Fællesoverenskomst mellem Finansministeriet og Offentligt Ansattes Organisationer – Det Statslige Område (OAO-S-fællesoverenskomsten) og organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere.

Afhængigt af dine kvalifikationer og kompetencer, er der mulighed for forhandling af tillæg. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pensionsordning.

Arbejdsstedet er i Ballerup.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriets område er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Du skal bl.a. kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde sikkerhedsgodkendelsen under hele ansættelsesforholdet.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Kontakt og ansøgning
Hvis du vil høre mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte sektionschef Jens Roselio Nordahn på telefon 2422 5248.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent Mia Backhausen på telefon 3266 5574.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 27. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt løbende.
Stillingen er til besættelse den 1. januar 2027.

Du søger stillingen via linket, og vi beder dig vedhæfte ansøgning, CV og kopi af uddannelsesbevis. Vær opmærksom på, at bilag skal tilføjes i PDF-format.

I Forsvarsministeriets organisation tror vi på, at mangfoldighed optimerer opgaveløsningen. Derfor opfordrer vi alle interesserede uanset baggrund til at søge stillingen.

Om Cyberdivisionen
Cyberdivisionen er Forsvarsministeriets samlede it-organisation og er forankret i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (FMI). Divisionen har ansvaret for at sikre stabil og sikker it-drift samt understøtte digitalisering på tværs af hele koncernen – både nationalt og internationalt.

Cyberdivisionen arbejder med alt fra drift og support af it-systemer til udvikling af digitale løsninger og styrkelse af cyber- og informationssikkerhed. Samtidig spiller divisionen en central rolle i at beskytte Forsvarets systemer og data mod digitale trusler og sikre, at it-understøttelsen fungerer – også i krise- og krigssituationer.

title: Video Generation Evaluation Platform Intern
description:
Responsibilities

  1. Contribute to the internal evaluation framework, including evaluation dimensions, scoring criteria, and evaluation-set design and iteration. Coverage includes prompt following, subject/style consistency, motion plausibility, temporal coherence, artifacts and deformation, start–end frame control, camera controllability, and visual quality.
  2. Run evaluations on mainstream text-to-video, image-to-video, start–end frame, and reference-to-video models; complete subjective scoring, issue logging, and representative case collection.
  3. Perform root-cause analysis of model failures and produce evaluation conclusions that can inform algorithm optimization and product decisions, including model applicability boundaries and risk points.
  4. Support engineering delivery of the evaluation platform, including evaluation task scripts, data processing, result aggregation, workflow automation, and platform features such as task management, comparison views, and reporting.
  5. Expand evaluation prompts and datasets based on real business scenarios, so results can support model selection and production readiness decisions.
  6. Track new models and capabilities in video generation and assess whether they should be added to the internal evaluation scope.

Requirements

  1. Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s program or above; class of 2027 / 2028 preferred. Majors in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Digital Media, Film/Television, or related fields.
  2. Solid engineering ability. Familiar with Python / TypeScript; able to independently write scripts for data processing, batch evaluation jobs, and result statistics. Experience with web apps, internal tools, or full-stack development is a plus.
  3. Product sense: able to define evaluation goals from business scenarios, distinguish model-capability issues from product-usability issues, and turn subjective judgment into executable criteria and priorities.
  4. Hands-on experience with mainstream video generation tools. Familiar with at least one of Kling, Jimeng, Wan, Sora, Runway, LTX, Pika, etc., and able to articulate differences across models.
  5. Strong visual judgment: able to identify and clearly describe issues in consistency, motion, composition, lighting, and rhythm.
  6. Rigorous, clear communicator; able to independently drive an evaluation workstream or a platform module.
  7. On-site 5 days per week; internship of at least 3 months; longer availability preferred.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with internal tools, data dashboards, evaluation pipelines, or simple full-stack projects.
  2. Background in video editing, storyboarding, or visual language; familiarity with CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, etc.
  3. Experience building evaluation sets, data annotation, GSB / MOS, or model comparison experiments.
  4. Familiarity with prompt engineering or workflows such as ComfyUI, or a complete AI video portfolio.

Compensation & Growth

Internship stipend is commensurate with skills and attendance. Outstanding interns will be considered for full-time conversion.

Application materials: resume; a brief note on your experience with video generation models, or relevant work / evaluation notes; personal project descriptions (if any).

title: Mechanical Test Engineer
description:

Founded in 2023, Mach Industries is a rapidly growing defense technology company focused on developing next-generation autonomous defense platforms. With a workforce of approximately 350 employees, we operate with startup agility and ambition.

Our vision is to redefine the future of warfare through cutting-edge manufacturing, innovation at speed, and unwavering focus on national security. We are dedicated to solving the next generation of warfare with lethal systems that deter kinetic conflict and protect global security.

The Role

Mach Industries is seeking a Test Engineer to build, instrument, and test mechanical and electro-mechnical systems. In this hands-on role, you’ll work closely with mechanical, avionics, mechanisms, and flight sciences teams to develop test solutions, execute experiments, analyze results, and rapidly iterate designs.

You will support development across a product’s lifecycle, from component, coupon, or subscale testing to systems and vehicle level qualification. You will also help expand Mach’s test capabilities by developing test fixtures, instrumentation, automation, and lab infrastructure.

At Mach Industries, we are redefining the future of defense through advanced, scalable platforms. As a Test Engineer, you will play a key role in prototyping and refining mechanical systems, and optimizing designs for performance, survivability, and scalability. Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team, you’ll help shape the next wave of defense technologies, from concept to deployment.

  • Support prototyping build and test efforts in conjunction with mechanical teams for design iteration

  • Develop testing capability through hardware procurement and lab automation as well as setting test standards, guidelines, and best practices.

title: Industry Contracts Officer
description:
Job Summary:

Industry Contracts Officer uses skills as a seasoned, experienced intellectual property/ technology licensing / transfer professional with a full understanding of industry practices and organization policies and procedures; resolves a wide range of issues. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions.

The Industry Contracts Division (ICD) of the Office of Sponsored Research (OSR) is responsible for negotiating and signing all industry research contracts between UCSF and Industry Sponsors. This includes complex clinical trial agreements, challenging material transfers agreements (incoming materials of all types and outgoing clinical specimen or data), sponsored research agreements, grants, data transferuse agreements, business associate agreements, fellowships and confidentiality agreements .

The Industry Contracts Officer (ICO) is responsible for the review, negotiation and execution of all industry sponsored research agreements. The incumbent determines the nature and scope of the relationship of UCSF investigators to industry sponsors, assesses the likelihood of downstream intellectual property, and develops the business terms of the research project. Other duties include developing subject matter expertise in specific areas, and participating in problem-solving and formulation of strategies and policies around the incumbent's areas of expertise, in collaboration with ICD leadership, other units on campus (CGA, GBC, RMS, Procurement, GC, COi, IRB, UDAR, RDO, DOM) and UCOP, as appropriate . The incumbent may also be asked to lead cross­functional teams of professionals in complex alliances or transactions.

Department Overview:

The Office of Sponsored Research is an advocate for all researchers at UCSF and provides them with comprehensive pre-award services. The OSR, a $23M operation, is comprised of eleven shared service teams, including 151 Proposal and Grants Specialist and Officers, Contract and Award Specialists and Officers, Associates, and Assistant Team Managers and Team Managers supporting 2000+ faculty, and is responsible for all pre-award grant activity for the campus.

title: DevSecOps Engineer (Online Gaming)
description:
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Integrate automated security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA, container and image scanning) into CI/CD pipelines, enforcing security gates before deployment.

  • Define and maintain security-as-code and policy-as-code controls, including infrastructure as code (IaC) scanning for cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Harden container and orchestration platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes, enforcing least-privilege access, image signing, and runtime security controls.

  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates through centralized secrets management, eliminating hard-coded credentials across pipelines and services.

  • Monitor, triage, and prioritize vulnerabilities across code, dependencies, images, and infrastructure, driving remediation with development teams against defined SLAs.

  • Automate security baseline enforcement and compliance evidence collection across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Collaborate with development teams to embed secure coding practices, threat modeling, and security requirements early in the development cycle.

  • Support incident response and post-incident reviews for security events affecting pipelines, infrastructure, and workloads, driving root-cause remediation.

  • Continuously improve security tooling coverage and accuracy, reducing false positives and mean time to remediate.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation to support production systems.


KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS/KEY SUCCESS FACTORS

  • Percentage of CI/CD pipelines with enforced security gates (SAST/DAST/SCA coverage).

  • Mean time to remediate (MTTR) critical and high-severity vulnerabilities.

  • Reduction in vulnerabilities reaching production.

  • Compliance with security baselines across cloud and on-premises environments.

  • Secrets management coverage, with zero hard-coded credentials in code and pipelines.


QUALIFICATIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience: 3+ years in a DevSecOps, DevOps, or security engineering role, ideally supporting high-availability, real-time platforms such as online gaming.

  • Skills & Knowledge: Proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions), security scanning tools (SonarQube, Snyk, Trivy, OWASP ZAP), containerization/orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), infrastructure as code (Terraform), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP), secrets management (HashiCorp Vault), and scripting (Python, Bash).

  • Certifications (good to have): Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), AWS Certified Security – Specialty, GIAC Cloud Security Automation (GCSA), or CISSP preferred.

title: Maintenance E&I Technician  1st shift
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Title: Maintenance E&I Technician

Supervisor’s Title: Maintenance Manager

Department: Maintenance

Location: 4447 Carolina ave, Richmond, VA 23222

About TemperPack

TemperPack is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia, with additional manufacturing facilities in Las Vegas, Nevada, and Lansing, Michigan. Founded in 2015, we design and manufacture innovative sustainable packaging solutions for cold chain shipping across food and beverages, life sciences, pet and vet, and wine as well as protective packaging for all industries. Our plant-based products give customers high-performance alternatives to EPS form and single-use plastics, developed and proven in Proving Ground, our ISTA®-certified thermal transport lab, and manufactured at three ISO 9001:2015-certified facilities.

In 2026, we became a Certified B Corporation™, joining a global community of companies independently verified to meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, accountability, and transparency. This certification reflects our mission to build packaging solutions that customers and end consumers feel great about using. If that mission resonates, we'd love to have you on our team.

Essential Job Functions:

  • Install, maintain, and repair industrial control systems and power distribution systems including electric motors, motor control devices, and variable speed drives.
  • Responsible for preventative maintenance and calibrations for all electrical, instrumentation, and process equipment.
  • Maintain instrumentation including analytical, flow, pressure, and level transmitters.
  • Maintain accurate equipment files such as maintenance and inventory logs, manuals, blueprints, and program revision archives.
  • Operate and perform maintenance of hand tools, light, and heavy equipment.
  • Read and understand manuals, blueprints, and schematics.
  • Responsible for installing equipment, servicing it, troubleshooting problems and making repairs when necessary.
  • Responsible for installing and maintaining electrical circuits, repairing motors and generators, fixing robotics and programming controllers.
  • Responsible for carrying out equipment isolation, planned and unplanned maintenance, inspections, fault diagnosis, calibration and testing electrical equipment, instrumentation, and control systems.
  • Understands how to program and troubleshoot PLC’s.
  • Clearly understands LOTO.
  • Must be able to perform preventative maintenance on a wide variety of electrical systems, equipment, and components including but limited to, transformers, switchgear, bus bars, high and low voltage motors and panel wiring.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • High-level efficiency of hand tools, power tools, drill presses, grinders, etc.
  • Knowledge of safe working practices with rotating and high voltage machinery.
  • General understanding of OSHA requirements including lock-out/tag-out, confined spaces, SDS, etc.
  • Working knowledge of motor control circuits.
  • Understand local, state, and national electrical codes.
  • Ability to disassemble and assemble gearboxes and pumps.
  • Ability to identify and measure critical tolerances or dimensions.
  • Ability to know when gearboxes and pumps need alignment.
  • Ability to work cohesively with other team members, and to contribute positively to the work environment.

title: Historic Preservation Specialist
description:
Conservation Technician/Historic Preservation Specialist

Terracon is seeking a Conservation Technician/Historic Preservation Specialist to join the growing Historic Preservation Team in our Jacksonville, Florida office. This is a full-time position with a diverse team of professionals in our Environmental Planning Division. The position will entail participation in a range of activities related to the assessment and treatment of historic resources by assisting the Senior Preservationist in architectural and material conservation, historic preservation, and architectural history projects and related tasks, as necessary. The Conservation Technician/Historic Preservation Specialist will support the team in aspects of hands-on treatment, documentation, administrative tasks, reporting, lab organization, and other duties as assigned.

The successful candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary team including archaeologists, architectural historians, historians, conservationists, environmental scientists, engineers, and preservation planners. The qualified candidate must be able to write at a professional level and present ideas in a well-planned and comprehensive manner. The preferred candidate will have strong technical writing capabilities and enjoy a variety of working conditions ranging from field efforts to office data analysis, and reporting.

This opportunity is for a self-motivated individual with effective communication and practical skills to excel in a team environment.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Completed an undergraduate degree program in Conservation, Architectural History, Historic Preservation, Preservation Planning, History, or related discipline or have four (4) years of experience working in a technical position focused on conservation, restoration, cultural resource management, or related discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to assist with the condition assessment, conservation, and restoration of historic materials, objects, and structures.
  • Ability to draft professional-quality documentation, consultation letters, and email is required.
  • The candidate must be able to work independently or as a team and be able to handle a stressful work environment.
  • The candidate should possess strong written communication, computer, and customer service skills, including Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, and Google Earth to generate technical reports, correspondence, review documentation, and perform archival research.
  • Preference is given to individuals who have education and experience to meet the Secretary of the Interior’s Professional Qualifications Standards and who have prior experience consulting with State Historic Preservation Offices.
  • Understanding of National Historic Preservation Act (NHPA), Environmental Laws, Historic Preservation Laws, the Secretary of the Interior’s Standards for the Treatment of Historic Properties, and a variety of compliance-based procedures is preferred.
  • Ability to multi-task and service multiple clients.
  • Good interpersonal, communication, analytical, and research skills.
  • Applicant must be a U.S. Citizen to apply for this position.
  • Applicant must pass a background fingerprint/security check.
  • Applicant must provide two forms of ID: such as a VALID Driver License, Social Security Card, Birth Certificate, Passport, etc. (Expired forms of identification will not be accepted)
  • Must be available to travel out of town for work projects for up to two weeks at a time.

Preferred

  • Project level review for compliance with the Secretary of the Interior’s Standards.
  • A master’s degree from an accredited school in Historic Preservation, or similar field.

  • The ability to identify and evaluate historic resources for historical significance and integrity.
  • The ability to write property descriptions, historical narratives, significance statements, assist with preservation and conservation treatment plans, and National Register justifications.

title: Life Coach - Hammond - FT
description:
The Excel Center – Northern Indiana is a high-quality, free, public high school for adult learners 18 and older. We provide coursework toward completing the required credits for students to earn an Indiana Core 40 diploma (not a TASC/GED/HSE program). Our students benefit from a structured learning environment with direct/ face-to-face instruction, an accelerated format, small classes and individualized attention that meets the unique needs of adult learners. All students are assigned a life coach providing academic and personal counseling to support students pursuing their goals. Our staff have a significant impact on the lives of students seeking a second chance to change their lives. The Excel Center also requires students to earn industry-recognized certificates and/or dual credit college courses. We are seeking a dynamic and innovative team to assist in this endeavor.

Summary

Life Coaches are integral staff members in The Excel Center. Their primary role is to promote continued student engagement in the Excel Center and to serve as a student advocate and counselor. Each life coach is responsible for a caseload of students, typically ranging from 65-80 students. To support student learning and productivity, life coaches build relationships with students and provide resources to remove barriers from their educational progress. Effective life coaches understand how to triage their caseloads by managing their core responsibilities while also being responsive to student crises as they arise. Life coaches report to the Lead Life Coach.

This role demonstrates behaviors consistent with our Mission, Vision, and Values, on behalf of Goodwill Industries of Michiana, Inc.

Duties

The core responsibilities of life coaches fall under the following primary umbrellas:

Building Relationships with Students

  • Provides support, work closely, and maintains open communication with leadership, staff, teachers and students to support student success.
  • Attend all team and professional development meetings and special events including scheduled open houses, testing sessions, recruitment events, fairs, and orientations.
  • Becomes part of a reliable alliance to ensure student engagement.

Academic Counseling and Tracking Student Data

  • Manages and monitors students’ information to ensure academic progress.
  • Assist in developing the overall class schedule each term.
  • Develop individual student class schedules.
  • Direct students toward the path that leads to graduation, using appropriate resources such as credit tracking form
  • Maintains confidential information; tracks student data in student information system and/or Excel.

Guide Students in Overcoming Obstacles and Problem Solving

  • Initiate and maintain contact with key community partners (community agencies, educational institutions, and employers) to extend the support services provided to students.
  • Identify and connect students to community resources to remove barriers and support academic and/or personal goals.
  • Distribute and track public transportation passes.

Additional duties

  • Execute recruitment strategies to attract prospective students through outreach and events.
  • Must be accessible and present for school events (e.g. Open Houses, Recruitment events, fairs, iExcel orientation, etc.).
  • Participate in administrative leadership meetings.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Java Backend Developer
company: Nederlands Instituut voor Beeld en Geluid
description:
De ICT afdeling, team Victorie bij Beeld & Geluid, houdt toezicht op de volledige IT-infrastructuur. Dit varieert van het interactieve museum tot een state-of-the-art media assetmanagement- en archiveringssysteem dat alle content van de Nederlandse publieke omroepen duurzaam bewaart en beschikbaar stelt. Ook de digitalisering straat, met high-end filmscanning- en editing apparatuur, valt onder onze verantwoordelijkheid.

Als Backend Developers, speel je een cruciale rol in het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en implementeren van backend-oplossingen voor onze applicaties. Je bent niet alleen medeverantwoordelijk voor het schrijven van hoogwaardige code, maar ook voor het optimaliseren van de infrastructuur en het stroomlijnen van het ontwikkelproces.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn in de eerste plaats een van de grootste en meest vooruitstrevende media-archieven ter wereld. We bewaren diverse soorten media, zoals radio- en televisieprogramma’s, video(games), geschreven pers, politieke prenten, podcasts, websites en objecten. Als betrouwbaar media-instituut bewaren we onze dagelijks groeiende mediacollectie als erfgoed voor de eeuwigheid en brengen we deze collectie tot leven.

Maar we zijn meer dan een archief! We zijn ook een verrassende, inspirerende, creatieve en toegankelijke ontmoetingsplek voor iedereen. Van individuele bezoekers tot professionele mediamakers; iedereen is welkom en verbinden zit in ons dna. We organiseren talloze publieksactiviteiten, debatten en lezingen voor jong en oud. Scholen bieden we een breed pakket aan workshops en we stimuleren academisch en journalistiek onderzoek.

Met zo’n 500 bevlogen collega’s, waarin we onze zeer waardevolle vrijwilligers en stagiairs natuurlijk meetellen, dragen we iedere dag vanuit ons veelkleurige pand in Hilversum bij aan een open, vrije, inclusieve en mediawijze samenleving.

  • Je hebt minstens 5 jaar aantoonbare ervaring met Java 17, Spring (Boot), Hibernate, Elasticsearch, SQL, IntelliJ IDEA, TDD;
  • Je bent aantoonbaar in staat om vanaf scratch een oplossing voor uiteenlopende problemen te ontwerpen;
  • Je bent geïnteresseerd in DevOps-methodologieën;
  • We vinden het een grote pre wanneer je Scrum ervaring hebt;
  • Je bent bekend met cloudplatforms zoals (AWS/Azure/) en containerisatie (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Je beschikt over een groot probleemoplossend vermogen en je hebt aandacht voor details bij het schrijven van code en het implementeren van oplossingen;
  • Je hebt uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en je bent een teamspeler;

Ons aanbod

Je eerste contract is een jaarcontract. Als we blij zijn met elkaar verlengen we met veel plezier, tot het einde van het project. Het bruto maandsalaris (op fulltime basis) is minimaal € 4.445,43 en maximaal € 6.350,65 (schaal 11 CAO Beeld & Geluid).

Hoe leuk werken bij Beeld & Geluid ook is, we hechten ook veel waarde aan vrije tijd. Per jaar heb je daarom maar liefst 25 vakantiedagen en 24 atv-dagen (op fulltime basis). Krijg je die niet op? Dan kun je ook je vakantiedagen inzetten voor andere leuke dingen, zoals de aanschaf van een (elektrische) fiets, laptop of het verwezenlijken van een droomreis. Hiervoor maken we gebruik van een cafetariamodel.

Wij geloven dat de échte magie op de werkvloer ontstaat: dáár gebeurt het! Daarom ontmoeten we elkaar graag op kantoor en is het uitgangspunt dat je minimaal 50% van je tijd op kantoor werkt. Natuurlijk kijken we altijd met een schuin oog naar de dynamiek van je functie en je persoonlijke omstandigheden: maatwerk is altijd bespreekbaar, net zoals een vaste thuiswerkdag per week. Je ontvangt een onkostenvergoeding voor thuiswerken en voor woon-werkverkeer, afhankelijk vanuit waar je werkt!
