title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
The Full Stack Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, high-performance, and secure web applications. The role requires strong software engineering fundamentals and experience delivering digital and AI-enabled products. Engineers must work in an agile, DevOps-driven environment, contributing to the development, deployment, and scaling of these products while ensuring high software quality, maintainability, security, and continuous improvement.
﻿﻿Key Responsibilities:
  • Take full ownership of end-to-end application development, integrating frontend, backend, cloud infrastructure, and AI services.
  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant web applications.
  • Implement modern frontend architectures, ensuring reusability, scalability, and security.
  • Develop backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, security, and observability.
  • Ensure adequate automated test coverage and proactively fix bugs and defects.
  • Optimize CI/CD deployment strategies, ensuring seamless and automated releases.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and cloud deployments using DevOps best practices.
  • Ensure application security, including authentication, authorization, API security, and frontend security best practices.
  • Own the delivery, enhancement, and scaling of AI-enabled products in production.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve application performance and developer productivity.
EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS NEEDED:
Full Stack Development:
  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
  • Experience with Git and modern branching workflows.
  • Strong proficiency in both frontend and backend development.
  • Experience delivering production-ready web applications and digital products across the full lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, and production support.
Frontend Technologies:
  • JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Frontend frameworks such as React.js and/or Next.js.
  • Experience building responsive and user-centric web applications.
  • Familiarity with UI component libraries such as Material-UI or Tailwind CSS.
Backend Technologies:
  • Node.js (Express.js, NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI, Flask, Django).
  • Strong experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with GraphQL and WebSockets.
  • Caching (e.g. Redis), API rate limiting, and scalability patterns (horizontal scaling, load balancing).
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems and third-party platforms.
AI Application Development:
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered features in production, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool or function calling, and agent workflows.
  • Experience implementing guardrails and evaluating LLM output quality.
  • Proficient in using AI coding assistants with sound engineering discipline.
DevOps, Cloud, and Infrastructure:
  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and architectures.
  • Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker.
  • Familiarity with application monitoring and observability tools.
Security Best Practices:
  • Awareness of LLM-specific risks such as prompt injection and sensitive data leakage (e.g. OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications).
  • Experience implementing authentication and authorisation mechanisms (OAuth, JWT).
  • Knowledge of API security and secure coding practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud security concepts and OWASP Top 10.
Software Quality & Testing:
  • Experience with unit and integration testing.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving production issues.
Bonus Experience (Added Advantage):
  • Experience delivering projects within the Singapore Government or Public Service sector.
  • Familiarity with government security, governance, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or other enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience developing AI agents, copilots, chatbots, or workflow automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms.

title: Dietitian
description:

Full-time | Monday–Friday

Culinesse is seeking a Registered Dietitian to join the Culinesse team at Messiah Lifeways, where your clinical expertise and collaborative spirit will help enrich the lives of residents across the community.

  • Reimbursement for Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics dues, state licensure fees, and CDR renewal

About Culinesse

Culinesse is a forward-thinking boutique dining services company dedicated to elevating retirement community living through highly personalized resident and guest experiences. Our name draws from the Latin culina—“of the kitchen”—and esse—“essential nature.” That idea guides how we work: with transparency, purpose, respect for the environment, and a belief that authentic food can nourish the whole person. title: Solutions Consultant
description:

We build with tomorrow in mind, transforming ideas into action and empowering our customers to succeed in a world of constant change. We make big happen for our customers.

We are a business driven by our values and have these at the centre of everything we do. Our BigHanders are dedicated to building a culture where We Win Together, We Love to Learn, We Do the Right Thing, We Own It and We Find the Fun.

Throughout the buying process, you will assist in defining ROI, business benefits, and the overall impact of our solutions, positioning our products as the ideal choice to meet customer needs.

Partnering closely with the sales team, you will conduct impactful product demonstrations that showcase the unique value of our solutions and address customer-specific business needs. Additionally, you will facilitate a seamless handover of project requirements and customer expectations to the delivery team, ensuring continuity and customer satisfaction post-sale. Your efforts will directly contribute to our mission of delivering exceptional value to our customers and driving sustainable growth for the company.

What you’ll do
Sales Enablement

Technical

OurDEI Commitment

title: Strategic Finance Lead
description:
BearCom is the largest distributor of wireless voice, data, and video solutions in North America, and North America's largest two-way radio channel partner for Motorola, with more than 40 years of industry leadership, partnerships with leading manufacturers including JVC Kenwood and Avigilon, and a network of 75+ branches across North America.

As part of the BearCom family, Stone Security brings deep expertise in security integration, backed by partnerships with leading OEMs including Axis, Milestone, and LenelS2, and delivering top-notch services and products built on a foundation of excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Together, BearCom and Stone Security deliver communication, technology, and security solutions that help organizations operate safely, efficiently, and effectively – offering customers scalable solutions and employees the platform to build meaningful, high-impact careers.

JOB DESCRIPTION

BearCom is entering its next phase of value creation and, as a result, the company is investing in its finance infrastructure and seeking a high-caliber, analytically minded leader to join the corporate FP&A function in a newly created highly strategic role.

This position sits at the centre of the investment thesis – partnering directly with the private equity sponsor, CFO, and executive team to build long-range models, deliver investor-grade insights, and help shape the financial narrative presented to lenders and the Board. The hire will centralize and professionalize core financial analysis, reducing reliance on sponsor bandwidth while elevating the sophistication of decision-making across the enterprise.

This is a mandate that extends well beyond traditional planning and reporting. It is ideally suited to an intellectually curious finance athlete looking to transition from advisory or investing into a true operating environment where their work will directly influence strategy and enterprise value.

The Role

The Strategic Finance Lead will serve as a senior analytical finance resource responsible for owning the company's forward-looking financial framework and supporting critical strategic initiatives. This individual will operate as a key thought partner to leadership, translating operational strategy into financial outcomes and ensuring the business maintains sponsor-grade rigor across planning, reporting, and analysis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain the integrated operating and financial model, including budget, forecast, and long-range planning.
  • Ensure accuracy and consistency across key metrics such as operating drivers, EBITDA, cash flow, leverage, and covenant performance.
  • Establish a single source of truth for forward-looking financial analysis.
  • Lead preparation of monthly and quarterly lender and investor reporting packages.
  • Support covenant calculations, liquidity forecasting, variance analysis, and ad-hoc financing requests.
  • Partner with the CFO to develop board-level materials highlighting performance, outlook, and key risks/opportunities.
  • Provide analytical leadership across major operational initiatives, including pricing strategy, cost optimization, growth investments, restructuring, and integration efforts.
  • Evaluate ROI, downside/upside scenarios, and execution trade-offs for senior leadership and the Board.
  • Collaborate with functional leaders to translate business initiatives into measurable financial outcomes.
  • Act as a day-to-day analytical interface with the private equity sponsor.
  • Support M&A, divestitures, financings, refinancings, and other strategic transactions.
  • Assist in preparing diligence materials, transaction models, and data rooms.
  • Build and enhance data infrastructure to support strategic finance decision-making, including ownership of key datasets, data integrity, and automation of reporting workflows.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards (e.g., Power BI) to deliver real-time visibility on KPIs, performance trends, and operational drivers across the business.
  • Partner cross-functionally to translate raw data into actionable insights, supporting pricing, unit economics, and operational efficiency initiatives.

title: Product Manager
description:
The Linedata Capitalstream Product Manager is responsible for managing Capitalstream product capabilities throughout the product lifecycle from initial concept and market research through requirements definition, product design and collaboration with engineering, to deliver product plans on time and with quality. This role combines lending domain expertise with enterprise software product management. The Product Manager works closely with sales, marketing, professional services and support to ensure revenue and customer satisfaction goals are met while ensuring product investments support the company’s overall strategy and goals.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities

Product strategy, discovery, and planning

· Understands customer and market needs, market trends and competitive offerings based on previous experience, customer engagement, sales and marketing feedback, and market research.

· Translates customer and market insights into clearly defined product opportunities

· Provides input to the Capitalstream product roadmap aligned with company strategy, customer value, and commercial objectives.

· Utilizes structured prioritization to evaluate opportunities based on business value, customer impact, risk, dependencies, and delivery effort.

Requirements definition, solution design, and product specifications

· Leads customer interviews, discovery sessions, and cross-functional requirements workshops.

· Translates business needs into clear product requirements, functional specifications, user stories, and testing strategies.

· Maintains traceability between business objectives, requirements, functional specifications, and testing results.

· Collaborates with engineering to evaluate solution options, balancing usability, feasibility, effort, maintainability, and consistency.

· Validates requirements, functional specifications and early builds with stakeholders.

Stakeholder collaboration

· Builds customer and cross-functional relationships; obtains stakeholder alignment on objectives, requirements, solutions, and priorities.

· Serves as the product owner throughout the product lifecycle, providing support and guidance to development and quality assurance teams.

· Partners with professional services, account management and support to identify implementation and support challenges as input to product plans.

Product enablement and commercial support

· Provides product training, documentation, release notes, and implementation guidance.

· Supports sales and marketing with clear capability descriptions and value propositions.

· Contributes to product budgeting, forecasting, and investment decisions.

· Develops and supports alliances with key systems and content providers, integrators, and leading technology companies to facilitate comprehensive product solutions.

· Maintains market and technical knowledge by reviewing professional publications; establishing professional networks; participating in professional associations.

Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree (MBA preferred)

· 10+ years in Financial Services, preferably related to Commercial Lending, Risk or Underwriting

· 10+ years of experience working with Business Lending or Consumer Lending solutions

· 5+ years of experience as an enterprise software Product Manager for a Fintech

· 5+ years of experience with Agile methodologies and tools such as Jira.

· Deep knowledge of the lending lifecycle, including origination, underwriting, credit assessment and approval, pricing, collateral, documentation and funding.

· Proven experience managing the full product lifecycle, translating customer and market needs into product capabilities

The Instructor will teach American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED courses and train students through the American Red Cross.﻿

The Instructor Trainer will be responsible for teaching American Red Cross First Aid/CPR/AED Instructor courses, training instructor candidates to become certified American Red Cross instructors.

The Instructor Trainer will prepare for training sessions, demonstrate proper techniques, and evaluate candidates' performance to ensure they have achieved proficiency.

The Instructor Trainer will work in various settings, including offices, schools, community centers, hospitals, and other locations.

  • Provide feedback to candidates to help them improve their performance.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to prepare and deliver effective training sessions.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • High school diploma or equivalent.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to stand for extended periods.
  • Must be able to lift and carry training equipment, up to 50 pounds.
  • Must be able to demonstrate proper CPR and AED techniques.

Working Conditions

  • Work may be performed in various settings, including schools, community centers, hospitals, and corporate offices.

title: Principal Solution Delivery Manager (RTE)
description:
We are seeking a Principal Solution Delivery Manager to serve as a Release Train Engineer (RTE) within the Workplace Solutions Agile Release Trains (ARTs). This role is a senior-level project management position responsible for leading large, complex initiatives in a Scaled Agile (SAFe) environment. You will ensure strong alignment, coordination, and predictable outcomes across multiple teams while driving both successful delivery and continuous improvement in how work flows through the system.

As an RTE for Workplace Solutions, you will lead mission-critical programs that span five or more teams and multiple business and technology partners. You will be accountable for end-to-end planning and execution, including managing scope, dependencies, risks, timelines, and delivery outcomes. You will guide ART-level planning and execution, ensuring work is aligned to strategic priorities and delivered in a way that balances speed, quality, and value. This role requires strong project and program management discipline combined with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic, Agile environment.

This role is classified as remote; however, periodic in-person attendance will be required at times for activities such as quarterly or project planning, training, or other business-critical meetings.

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary (Levels have variable responsibilities and qualifications)
      • I/S Principal Solution Delivery Manager: $130,000 - $140,000, plus 15% annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead large, complex initiatives within the Workplace Solution ART, serving as a Release Train Engineer for an Agile Release Train or program supporting five or more stable teams.
  • Own end-to-end delivery planning and execution across run, grow, and transform work, ensuring alignment to strategic objectives.
  • Partner closely with Product Management, Technology Leadership, and business stakeholders to identify outcomes, manage dependencies, and mitigate risks.
  • Drive delivery predictability through strong planning, transparency, and proactive issue and risk management.
  • Tailor delivery and execution practices to fit the complexity of the work, avoiding one-size-fits-all approaches and serving as the process expert for applicable approaches including PMBOK, Scrum, predictive, hybrid, XP, and Kanban.
  • Facilitate large-scale planning, ART optimization, critical path planning sessions, and other critical collaboration discussions, as needed.
  • Use data and real-world insights to identify improvement opportunities and increase flow, throughput, and value delivery.
  • Serve as delivery system thought leader through coaching, facilitation, and hands-on support across teams and leaders.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts across the ART and broader delivery ecosystem.
  • Promote a culture of diversity and inclusion, value different ideas and opinions, and listen courageously, remaining curious in all that you do.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • 5+ years of experience leading complex programs with an annual internal labor cost exceeding $5 million, successfully managing dependencies and delivery across 5+ Agile teams, along with 5-10 years of combined project and/or program management experience in increasingly progressive technology roles.
  • Ability to obtain PMP + RTE or SPC (SAFe Program Consultant) + Kanban certification within 18 months of hire. Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development and Agile maturity.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Related field of study (Business Administration/Management Information Systems) or equivalent internal experience.
  • Ability to analyze large datasets with multiple abstract and concrete variables, drawing actionable insights to optimize program performance. Demonstrated expertise in risk management, problem-solving, and influencing key stakeholders to drive outcomes.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams, advocating for change, and fostering a culture of continuous learning and adaptability. Strong coaching skills to empower teams and individuals, creating an environment of trust, collaboration, and innovation.
  • Excellent critical thinking and influencing skills. An ability to collaborate across disciplines and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Demonstrated professional agility in planning, monitoring, managing scope and dependencies, resourcing, ensuring quality, maintaining communication, managing risk, and controlling costs.
  • Ability to use data-driven analysis to recommend improvements to ART (Agile Release Train)/area performance and large-scale delivery.
  • Able to work remotely with access to a high-speed internet connection and located in the United States or Puerto Rico.

PREFERRED:

  • Experience serving as a Release Train Engineer, Solution Train Engineer, or equivalent large-scale delivery leadership role
  • Deep experience with group insurance products, including expertise in customer needs, business processes, value streams, and supporting systems and technologies
  • Strong understanding of group insurance benefit administration platforms, their roles in the market, and how they integrate with insurance carriers to support seamless delivery and client satisfaction
  • Insight into group insurance customers and operational dynamics, enabling strategic decision-making and solution design that meets evolving market and client demands, including maintaining up-to-date knowledge of the project management of emerging technologies, including API integration and modern system architectures and experience project managing the integration of new digital tools with legacy backend systems.
  • Advanced Agile certifications such as C.S.M. (Certified Scrum Master), PMI-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner), or Certified DevOps Practitioner.
  • Additional SAFe certifications (SA, SSM, SP) to support scaled Agile and continuous delivery initiatives.
  • Continuing professional education (20 hours annually) and/or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Management Information Systems, or related fields.

title: FCS-Solution Focused Meeting Facilitator
company: FOUR OAKS FAMILY AND CHILDRENS SERVICES
description:
Solution Focused Meeting Facilitator

Bring People Together. Empower Families. Create Lasting Change.

Are you a natural communicator who enjoys bringing people together, finding solutions, and helping families move forward?

At Four Oaks, we believe every family has strengths, every voice deserves to be heard, and every challenge is an opportunity for positive change. We're looking for a compassionate, organized, and motivated Solution Focused Meeting Facilitator who is passionate about helping children, youth, and families build brighter futures!

As a Solution Focused Meeting Facilitator, you'll play an important role in guiding meaningful conversations, bringing families and support teams together, and helping identify solutions that promote stability, independence, and long-term success.

This isn't just about leading meetings. It's about creating opportunities for families to be heard, supported, and empowered to take the next step forward!

What You'll Do

Every meeting is an opportunity to build connections, encourage collaboration, and make a meaningful difference! In this role, you will:

  • Bring People Together: Coordinate and facilitate Solution Focused Meetings (SFMs) and Youth Transition Decision Making (YTDM) meetings that encourage collaboration and family-driven solutions.

  • Empower Families and Youth: Create a welcoming, respectful environment where families and youth feel comfortable sharing their strengths, concerns, and goals.

  • Turn Conversations into Action: Guide productive discussions that help families identify challenges, develop solutions, and create meaningful plans for moving forward.

  • Prepare for Success: Engage families, youth, and team members before meetings to ensure everyone understands the process and is ready to participate.

  • Build Strong Partnerships: Collaborate with HHS workers, Family Centered Services (FCS) providers, and other professionals to ensure coordinated communication and support.

  • Connect Families to Resources: Help identify community services, interventions, and support systems that promote stability and long-term self-sufficiency.

  • Navigate Challenges with Confidence: Remain calm, professional, and solution-focused when facilitating difficult conversations or responding to crisis situations.

  • Keep Things Organized: Coordinate meeting schedules, maintain accurate documentation, and ensure services meet agency and contractual requirements.

  • Grow Your Expertise: Complete required training in Solution Based Casework (SBC), Solution Focused Meeting facilitation, and Youth Transition Decision Making to effectively guide families through the process.

  • Be Flexible and Team-Oriented: Work collaboratively with team members and provide services outside traditional business hours when needed to accommodate families and youth.

Why You'll Love Working at Four Oaks

We're more than a team. We're a family!

At Four Oaks, we understand that supporting children and families takes dedication, compassion, and teamwork. That's why we're committed to creating a workplace where employees feel valued, supported, and encouraged to grow.

Here's what you can look forward to:

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance – Benefits to support your health and well-being.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Helping you prepare for your future.

  • Competitive Wages – Compensation that recognizes your important work.

  • Growth & Advancement Opportunities – Develop new skills and explore opportunities to advance your career.

  • Excellent Paid Leave Package – Because maintaining a healthy work/life balance matters.

  • 7 Paid Holidays – Additional time to recharge.

  • Educational Discounts – Opportunities to support your continued learning.

  • Fitness Center Discounts – Resources to encourage your health and wellness.

  • Business Casual Work Environment – A comfortable and professional workplace.

  • Supportive Team Culture – Work alongside passionate individuals who believe in making a difference.

Your Voice Can Help Families Find Their Way Forward!

Sometimes, the most meaningful change begins with a conversation.

Whether you're helping a family identify their strengths, guiding a youth through an important transition, or bringing a team together to develop a plan, your ability to listen, connect, and lead can make a lasting impact.

At Four Oaks, you'll have the opportunity to help turn difficult conversations into positive steps forward and empower families to build stronger futures.

If you're passionate about helping others, skilled at bringing people together, and ready to make a difference, we want to hear from you!

Be the Connection. Inspire Solutions. Join Four Oaks!

Apply today and help empower families, one conversation at a time!

title: Air Export Operations Agent
description:

The Air Export Agent is responsible for the end-to-end execution of international air export shipments while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, financial accuracy, and exceptional customer service. title: Senior Service Designer, Data Programme
description:
GovTech is the lead agency driving Singapore’s Smart Nation initiatives and public sector digital transformation. As the Centre of Excellence for Infocomm Technology and Smart Systems (ICT & SS), GovTech develops the Singapore Government’s capabilities in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence, Application Development, Smart City Technology, Digital Infrastructure, and Cybersecurity.

At GovTech, we offer you a purposeful career to make lives better where we empower our people to master their craft through robust learning and development opportunities all year round.

Play a part in Singapore’s vision to build a Smart Nation and embark on your meaningful journey to build tech for public good. Join us to advance our mission and shape your future with us today!

Learn more about GovTech at tech.gov.sg.

[What you will be working on]

Government data is only useful if people can find it, trust it, and act on it. This role exists to make that possible.
The mission of GovTech's Data Programme is to deliver fit-for-purpose data assets and services for policy making, service delivery and operations across Whole of Government. The programme creates value through enablement, reducing friction for agencies so they can move faster and make better decisions in their work with existing government datasets.

You will be the service design lead across four interconnected technical initiatives:

  1. Standardised Data Platform
  2. Unified Frontend / DataHive
  3. Unified Serving Backbone
  4. Observability & Governance Infrastructure

About the Role

This is not a single-product role. You will be designing across a complex ecosystem, connecting agencies, public officers, data engineers, and policy teams, and making that ecosystem legible, navigable, and trustworthy for everyone who depends on it.

Responsibilities

  • Map and Design the End-to-End Service Experience: Define how agencies onboard and request data access, how public officers discover and use data products, and how governance and compliance touchpoints are surfaced throughout the journey.
  • Design for Human-AI Interaction: Design handoff points between automated data pipelines and human decision-makers, including agentic data workflows, confidence indicators, fallback states, and trust architecture across agency boundaries.
  • Translate Complexity into Clarity: Distil complex technical infrastructure into service journeys that non-technical stakeholders can understand, navigate, and act on.
  • Identify Failure Modes: Design for edge cases, error states, and the moments when the system does not behave as expected, before they reach users.
  • Collaborate and Influence: Work as a peer with product managers, data engineers, architects, and policy leads, co-shaping programme direction rather than executing downstream.
  • Define and Track Outcomes: Measure improvements in how agencies and public officers experience the data ecosystem, not just delivery of artefacts.
  • Establish Shared Patterns: Create reusable service patterns and interaction standards that scale across the programme and inform future data initiatives.

What it is like working here
We build products that serve a variety of agency users, who use them to solve highly meaningful problems pertinent to our society, from transportation, to education, to healthcare. The public sector is full of opportunities where even the simplest software can have a big impact on people’s lives. We are here to improve how we live as a society through what we can offer as a government.

You will thrive here if

  • You see the whole programme as one design problem, not a collection of separate products.
  • You treat failure modes, edge cases, and error states as real design problems, not afterthoughts.
  • You are as comfortable in a technical architecture discussion as you are running a research session with a public officer.
  • You can hold ambiguity long enough to design something useful, and you know when to stop exploring and start deciding.

[What we are looking for]

  • 5+ years of experience in service design, product design, or UX, with meaningful time spent on complex, multi-stakeholder systems rather than single-product work.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating systems thinking at scale, including service blueprints, journey maps, or ecosystem maps that show how you made something complex navigable.
  • Experience designing for AI-powered products or services, including prompt interfaces, streaming responses, error and fallback states, confidence indicators, or human-AI handoff points.
  • Cross-functional credibility, with a track record of working as a peer with engineering, product, data, and policy teams.
  • Strong research skills, including the ability to select appropriate methods, synthesise findings across diverse stakeholder groups, and translate insights into programme-level decisions.
  • Clear, confident communication with senior stakeholders, including the ability to present design rationale to technical leads and government leaders.
  • You may come from a product design, UX, or service design background. What matters is systems thinking at scale.

Nice to have

  • Experience with data governance, data platforms, or data infrastructure products.
  • Familiarity with conversational interfaces, agentic systems, or AI product design patterns.
  • Experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, or AI product development workflows.
  • Experience designing for government, enterprise SaaS, or highly regulated environments.

What We Offer:

GovTech is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values diverse voices and perspectives, as we believe it is key to innovation.

Our employee benefits are based on a total rewards approach, offering a holistic and market-competitive suite of perks.

We champion flexible work arrangements (subject to your job role) and trust you to manage your time to deliver your best.

Learn more about life inside GovTech at go.gov.sg/GovTechCareers.

Stay connected with us on social media at go.gov.sg/ConnectWithGovTech

title: Director, Pharmacy - Drug Quality Program
description:
Your Role

The Clinical Pharmacy Programs team within the Pharmacy Strategy & Operations department is a team of pharmacy professionals responsible for defining and executing strategies to address clinical quality and affordability of prescription medications used by Blue Shield of California (BSC) members. The Director, Pharmacist - Drug Quality Program, will report to the Senior Director, Clinical Pharmacy Programs. In this role, you will be responsible for performance on quality measures that address medication-related safety, health outcomes, and member experience related to accessing needed prescription drugs.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. We are looking for leaders that are energized by creative and critical thinking, building and sustaining high-performing teams, getting results the right way, and fostering continuous learning.

Your Work
In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with enterprise business partners to continuously improve upon the strategy to address drug related quality and member experience measures, including Part D measures in the Medicare Star Ratings system, and those that apply for non-Medicare members
  • Oversee assessment of factors that impact quality performance and health outcomes using a results- and data-driven approach; monitor and report on program performance to enterprise stakeholders and executives
  • Oversee a multi-lever, multi-channel roadmap and workplan of programs, initiatives, and tactics that are aligned to BSC’s clinical strategy, that meet enterprise quality and member experience goals, and that comply with regulatory and accreditation requirements
  • Drive technology and vendor capabilities that improve operational efficiencies and enable program performance at the highest levels
  • Network with industry leaders to identify best practices and innovations that improve outcomes for BSC members
  • Lead according to BSC leadership behaviors and implement action plans that support employee engagement and high performing teams across the business unit and for your team
  • Serve as a key leadership stakeholder in Pharmacy operations, benefit & formulary design, and drug utilization management

Your Knowledge and Experience

  • Requires Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an accredited school of pharmacy in the U.S.
  • Requires a current active and unrestricted California Registered Pharmacist (RPH) license
  • Requires 10 years of prior relevant experience
  • Requires 6 years of prior people management experience with direct responsibility for supervising, coaching, and evaluating direct reports
  • Knowledge of national and California state quality rating systems; and applicable state, federal, and quality accreditation standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Advanced clinical pharmacy practice and experience in managed care or health plan pharmacy business functions
  • Advanced proficiency in data analytics, including use of pharmacy claims data, and designing key performance metrics
  • Advanced proficiency in computer skills including but not limited to Microsoft applications

Hybrid

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

title: AI Researcher
description:
About Us

BLT was founded in July 2011 and officially listed on the STAR Market of the Shanghai Stock Exchange on July 22, 2019. It operates subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Germany and the United States. As a national high-tech enterprise, BLT owns high-level research platforms including the National Enterprise Technology Center. As of the end of December 2025, the company employs 3,531 staff, among whom R&D personnel account for approximately 19.48%. It has filed 738 independent patents related to metal additive manufacturing technology.

BLT (Hong Kong) Technology Co., Limited is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Xi’an BLT Additive Manufacturing Co., Ltd. Located in Hong Kong Science Park, it mainly engages in R&D of additive manufacturing and research on cutting-edge application technologies.

Job Overview

This position serves as an AI Researcher for Additive Manufacturing. Its core mission is to systematically identify scenarios in metal 3D printing that can be optimized via AI, develop algorithmic models for metal 3D printing, and lead the R&D of machine learning algorithms integrating physical data and physics-based simulation. Leveraging AI algorithmic models, the role aims to improve printing precision, yield, throughput and equipment scalability, realize industrial applications of AI manufacturing, and continuously strengthen the competitiveness of the company’s 3D printing technologies and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Design and develop machine learning models for metal 3D printing workflows, and build hybrid modeling frameworks combining first-principles physical rules and data-driven learning.
  2. Take charge of designing predictive and closed-loop control learning models for metal printing systems. Based on multi-modal in-situ sensor big data, explore correlations between process parameters, equipment status, part geometry and thermal/mechanical forming quality.
  3. Develop automated supervised learning algorithms for printing processes, identify quality control points, explore relationships between process signals and part quality & performance, and establish algorithmic control models based on process signals.
  4. Embed machine learning models into physics-based simulation, digital twin and real-time autonomous closed-loop control systems; develop learning solutions for equipment health monitoring, anomaly detection and fault diagnosis, and deploy them effectively to industrial production scenarios.
  5. Establish parametric printing algorithm models for diverse metal 3D printing industries and products to realize printing parameter optimization and automation, as well as expand new industrial application scenarios for 3D printing equipment.
  6. Industrial data and intelligent asset accumulation: Build standardized additive manufacturing process knowledge bases and knowledge graphs based on corporate process documents, experimental data and production cases; collaborate with SLM software and process databases to complete data cleansing and feature sorting, construct automated process development workflows, and accumulate reusable industrial AI application assets.

Job RequirementsMandatory Requirements

  1. Doctorate or above with over 5 years of applied machine learning research experience, majoring in machine learning, applied mathematics, physics, robotics, control or other related disciplines.
  2. Solid expertise in machine learning for physical system modeling and control.
  3. Proficiency in basic programming languages such as Python.
  4. Strong capabilities in cleansing, analyzing and aggregating complex industrial data, and aligning industrial data pipelines with manufacturing workflows.
  5. Strong passion and career ambition for empowering manufacturing with AI and intelligent manufacturing, and willingness to devote long-term efforts to industrial AI innovation.
  6. Possess a valid Hong Kong work visa and capable of using English as a working language.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Experience as a Product Manager; able to conduct cross-departmental communication and collaboration with product-oriented thinking, and drive demand collection, analysis, development and deployment of algorithmic models.
  2. Educational background or practical work experience in materials science or mechanical engineering.
  3. Experience in autonomous robotics, model predictive control, or reinforcement learning for physical systems.

What We Offer

  1. A leading research platform for additive manufacturing, with industry-leading full-scenario metal 3D printing solutions covering powder materials, equipment, software applications and printing services.
  2. Full-industry-chain perspective, internal high-quality resource support, international industrial vision, and an exploratory independent research environment.
  3. Competitive compensation and benefits packages; salary can be reviewed on a case-by-case basis for outstanding candidates.
  4. Comprehensive training and learning opportunities to quickly master core industry expertise.

title: Associate, Valuations (Remote, NY, US)
description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

About Apogem Capital

Apogem is a leading private markets solutions provider with decades of experience focused on the middle market. With approximately $44 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025, Apogem partners with institutional investors to deliver disciplined underwriting, strategic capital deployment and long-term value creation.

Apogem Capital operates within the New York Life Investment Management platform of companies, supported by the financial strength and long-term stability of a Fortune 100 mutual organization.

With offices in New York, Chicago and Richmond, Apogem Capital is a leading alternatives investor, with decades of experience investing in the middle market and approximately $41 billion in assets under management. By offering a full range of capital solutions, Apogem delivers innovative solutions to private equity sponsors and portfolio companies while generating access to highly sought-after opportunities for our clients. At Apogem Capital, we pride ourselves on attracting and retaining the best talent by offering a collaborative culture, opportunities for career development and growth, and competitive benefits.

Analyst / Associate Role

Join a high-quality, growing alternative investment management firm as a member of the Valuation Team. This role provides exposure to the valuation of a diverse portfolio of private market investments. The role will also contribute to the continued development of the team’s valuation processes, technology, and analytical capabilities.

This is an opportunity to work closely with senior professionals across the firm and gain a broad understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies and portfolio companies. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop meaningful expertise in private market valuations, with a clear path for continued professional growth and advancement within the organization.

Key Areas of Responsibility

  • Valuation Analysis and Governance
    • Perform valuation analyses of private investments across Apogem’s investment strategies.
    • Support the review and validation of third-party valuation marks, including analysis of methodologies, assumptions, and market inputs.
    • Assist with the preparation of quarterly valuation committee materials and supporting analyses.
    • Maintain clear and well-documented support for valuation conclusions.
  • Third Party Valuation Provider Oversight
    • Assist with the oversight of third-party valuation providers, including coordinating data requests, reviewing valuation deliverables, and tracking open items.
    • Review third-party valuations for consistency with established methodologies, policies, and procedures.
    • Identify and escalate valuation issues or discrepancies to senior team members.
  • Valuation Process and Technology Enhancement
    • Leverage technology and data tools to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of the valuation process.
    • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve data quality, and streamline reporting.
    • Support the development and implementation of enhancements to valuation processes and procedures.
  • Performance Reporting and Portfolio Monitoring
    • Partner with investment teams to collect, validate, and maintain quarterly portfolio company financial and operating data.
    • Monitor portfolio company performance and identify trends or changes relevant to investment valuations.
    • Prepare recurring and ad hoc portfolio performance reporting for internal stakeholders.
  • Financial Analysis and Modeling
    • Perform financial analysis, valuation modeling, sensitivity analyses, and other ad hoc analyses across the firm’s investment portfolios.
    • Analyze financial and operating information to identify trends, variances, and factors impacting investment valuations.
    • Support senior team members on valuation-related projects and analyses.
  • Collaboration & Professional Development
    • Develop strong working relationships with investment teams, finance, fund accounting, operations, and other internal stakeholders.
    • Develop a strong understanding of Apogem’s investment strategies, portfolio companies, and underlying investment structures.
    • Build foundational expertise in private market valuation methodologies, financial modeling, and relevant accounting and valuation guidance.
    • Stay informed on market developments and trends relevant to the valuation of private investments.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Mathematics, or another quantitative or analytical discipline.
  • At least 2–5 years of experience in valuation, portfolio management/support, transaction advisory, or a related role.
  • Experience with Private Credit, Private Equity, or other alternative investment strategies.
  • Experience working with third-party valuation providers and/or external auditors.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including financial modeling and data analysis.
  • Experience with portfolio monitoring and/or investment management systems, such as iLevel, Chronograph, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into concise, accurate, and actionable insights.
  • Demonstrated resourcefulness, initiative, and an entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a highly team-oriented environment.

description:
In-Home Youth Counselor – Empower Youth. Strengthen Families. Change Lives.

More Than a Job. A Chance to Make a Difference Where It Matters Most!

Are you passionate about helping young people overcome challenges, make positive choices, and build brighter futures? Do you enjoy mentoring youth, supporting families, and being a positive influence in your community?

Four Oaks is looking for a compassionate, motivated, and dedicated In-Home Youth Counselor to join our team serving Des Moines County and northern Lee County!

As an In-Home Youth Counselor, you'll work directly with youth involved with Juvenile Court Services (JCS) who are transitioning back into their communities from residential treatment or the State Training School, or who may be at risk of entering these placements.

You'll play an important role in helping youth develop positive behaviors, strengthen decision-making skills, and build healthier relationships while providing guidance and support to their families.

At Four Oaks, we believe every young person deserves the opportunity to succeed, and sometimes all it takes is someone who believes in their potential!

What You'll Do

Mentor Youth. Build Connections. Inspire Positive Change.

  • Make a Lasting Impact: Provide individualized support, supervision, and mentoring to youth as they navigate challenges and work toward positive outcomes.

  • Meet Youth Where They Are: Work directly with youth and families in their homes and communities, building trusting relationships and providing consistent encouragement.

  • Create a Plan for Success: Collaborate with youth, families, referral sources, and placement agencies to develop and implement individualized Situational Plans and Family Support Plans.

  • Be a Positive Role Model: Help youth develop accountability, responsibility, problem-solving skills, and healthier decision-making habits.

  • Turn Challenges into Opportunities: Use everyday situations to teach positive behaviors, emotional regulation, and effective coping strategies.

  • Promote Accountability: Help youth understand and follow the expectations of their supervision or probation agreements while encouraging personal growth.

  • Support Behavioral Growth: Utilize Thinking Errors and Anger Controls models to help youth recognize behavior patterns, manage emotions, and make positive choices.

  • Strengthen Family Relationships: Provide mentoring, guidance, and ongoing communication to help families support their youth's progress.

  • Stay Connected: Maintain regular telephone and face-to-face contact with youth and families to monitor progress, address concerns, and celebrate successes.

  • Work Together for Better Outcomes: Collaborate with Juvenile Court Services, schools, community partners, and referring professionals to coordinate services and support.

  • Monitor Progress: Assess youth behavior, identify risk factors and strengths, and adjust interventions based on individual needs and team feedback.

  • Communicate with Purpose: Provide timely updates, written reports, and testimony when required regarding youth progress, behavior, and supervision.

Why Your Work Matters

Every Young Person Deserves a Second Chance and Someone Who Believes in Them!

For youth navigating the juvenile justice system, having the right guidance and support can make a lasting difference.

As an In-Home Youth Counselor, you'll help youth:

  • Build confidence and develop healthier decision-making skills.

  • Strengthen relationships with family members and positive community supports.

  • Learn accountability and understand the impact of their choices.

  • Develop emotional regulation and problem-solving skills.

  • Successfully transition back into their homes and communities.

  • Work toward greater stability and reduce the risk of future placement.

Your work helps youth recognize their potential, overcome obstacles, and take meaningful steps toward a brighter future.

Why Choose Four Oaks?

Because the Work You Do Matters, and So Do You!

At Four Oaks, we believe in supporting the professionals who dedicate their careers to helping children and families succeed.

We value compassion, teamwork, professional growth, and creating an environment where employees feel supported, appreciated, and empowered to make a difference.

As part of the Four Oaks team, you'll have the opportunity to:

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Help youth and families create positive, lasting changes in their lives.

  • Build Your Career: Gain valuable experience in juvenile justice, youth development, family support, and community-based services.

  • Work with a Purpose: Be part of a mission-driven organization committed to strengthening children, families, and communities.

  • Grow Professionally: Develop your skills through collaboration, training, and opportunities for career advancement.

  • Be Part of a Supportive Team: Work alongside dedicated professionals who share your passion for helping youth succeed.

Ready to Make a Difference in a Young Person's Life?

If you're compassionate, patient, resourceful, and passionate about helping youth overcome challenges and reach their potential, we want to hear from you!

At Four Oaks, you're not just providing supervision and support. You're helping young people build confidence, take accountability for their choices, and create opportunities for a better tomorrow.

Apply Today and Become a Four Oaks Difference Maker!

title: Software & Data Engineer
description:
VitalFluid's machines are already generating valuable data every day.

The next step isn't collecting more data. It's using that data to improve performance, predict issues before they happen and make the machines increasingly intelligent.

We're looking for a Software & Data Engineer who wants to take ownership of the platform behind this journey.

You'll work with Azure, Python, machine data and machine learning to improve uptime, develop predictive maintenance capabilities and help shape the future intelligence of the product.

Your role

Some days you'll improve cloud infrastructure, data pipelines or Grafana dashboards. Other days you'll analyse sensor data, maintain machine learning models or investigate why a machine behaves differently in the field.

Your focus:

  • Own and improve the Azure-based data platform;
  • Build reliable software and data solutions;
  • Develop and maintain predictive maintenance models;
  • Improve uptime, reliability and machine performance;
  • Help define the future roadmap for machine intelligence.

What we’re looking for

We’re looking for an engineer with a solid software foundation and a genuine interest in Data Science.

You don’t need to arrive as a specialist in every technology on the list. You do need to be curious, comfortable taking ownership and motivated to understand what the data means in the context of a real machine.

You probably bring:

  • Professional experience developing software in Python;
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure;
  • An understanding of Data Science and machine-learning workflows, including developing and deploying models;
  • Familiarity with modern software delivery practices such as Git, CI/CD, automated testing and Docker;
  • Experience working with databases, data pipelines or cloud-based backend systems;
  • An analytical approach to solving problems and investigating root causes;
  • The ability to work independently while collaborating with engineers from different disciplines;
  • A continuous-improvement mindset and the motivation to keep developing both the platform and your own skills.

Why VitalFluid

Many software and data roles are several steps removed from the product they influence. This one isn’t.

The software you build will help engineers understand machines operating in the real world. The dashboards you improve can help a service specialist diagnose a problem remotely. The models you deploy can identify changing machine behaviour before it becomes a failure.

You’ll join at a point where the foundation exists, but the future direction is still open. You’ll have the freedom to improve the architecture, introduce new tools, build prototypes and help decide how intelligence becomes part of VitalFluid’s products.

Few early-career software and data roles offer this combination of technical breadth, ownership and visible product impact

title: Functional Family Specialist

description:
Functional Family Specialist – Strengthen Families. Inspire Change.

More Than a Job. A Chance to Transform Lives and Build Stronger Families!

Are you passionate about helping families overcome challenges, strengthen relationships, and create lasting positive change? Do you enjoy working directly with families, building meaningful connections, and making a difference where it matters most?

Four Oaks is looking for a compassionate, motivated, and dedicated Functional Family Specialist to join our team!

As a Functional Family Specialist, you'll work directly with families throughout Iowa's 2nd Judicial District, providing home-based services using the Functional Family Therapy (FFT) model.

You'll play an important role in helping families improve communication, strengthen relationships, navigate challenges, and develop the skills needed to create healthier, more supportive home environments.

At Four Oaks, we believe every family has the potential to grow and succeed, and you'll help make that possible!

What You'll Do

Strengthen Relationships. Empower Families. Create Lasting Change.

  • Make a Meaningful Impact: Provide individualized, home-based family therapy services to families with adolescents ages 10–18, helping them work through challenges and build stronger relationships.

  • Meet Families Where They Are: Conduct a minimum of one-hour weekly family therapy sessions in the home, creating opportunities for meaningful engagement and progress.

  • Use an Evidence-Based Approach: Apply the Functional Family Therapy (FFT) model to assess family interactions, identify strengths and challenges, and develop effective interventions.

  • Build Lasting Connections: Establish trusting relationships with families while helping them improve communication, problem-solving, and positive family interactions.

  • Guide Families Toward Success: Manage a caseload of approximately 10–15 families, providing individualized services over an 8–26 week period.

  • Track Meaningful Progress: Assess family needs, implement treatment interventions, monitor progress toward goals, and adjust strategies to support successful outcomes.

  • Connect Families with Resources: Assist with community resource planning and connect families with services that promote stability and long-term success.

  • Collaborate for Better Outcomes: Work closely with schools, healthcare professionals, referring workers, and community partners to coordinate services and support families.

  • Support Successful Transitions: Participate in case planning, permanency planning, discharge coordination, and required documentation.

  • Provide Flexibility That Matters: Maintain a flexible schedule to meet with families at times that work best for their needs.

Why Your Work Matters

Stronger Families. Healthier Relationships. Brighter Futures.

Every family faces challenges, but having the right support can make all the difference.

As a Functional Family Specialist, you'll help families:

  • Strengthen communication and build healthier relationships.

  • Develop effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.

  • Recognize their strengths and build on positive family connections.

  • Navigate behavioral and emotional challenges.

  • Improve family stability and create supportive home environments.

  • Build the skills and confidence needed for lasting success.

Your work helps families move forward together, creating positive changes that can last well beyond the time you work with them.

Why Choose Four Oaks?

Because Supporting Families Starts with Supporting You!

At Four Oaks, we believe that making a difference shouldn't come at the expense of your own well-being. We value teamwork, professional growth, flexibility, and maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

We are committed to creating a supportive environment where employees can grow professionally while doing work that truly matters.

Here's what we offer:

  • Flexible Work Schedule – Flexibility to coordinate services around family availability while supporting work-life balance.

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance – Benefits to support you and your family.

  • 401(k) Retirement Plan – Helping you prepare for your future.

  • Generous Paid Leave Package – Time to recharge and focus on what matters most.

  • 7 Paid Holidays

  • Career Growth & Advancement Opportunities – Continue developing your skills and building your career with Four Oaks.

  • Business Casual Work Environment

  • Educational Discounts

  • Fitness Center Discounts

  • Supportive, Team-Oriented Workplace

Ready to Help Families Create Lasting Change?

If you're compassionate, resourceful, and passionate about helping adolescents and families build stronger relationships and brighter futures, we want to hear from you!

At Four Oaks, you're not just providing family therapy services. You're helping families overcome challenges, discover their strengths, and create meaningful, lasting change.

Apply Today and Become a Four Oaks Difference Maker!

title: Data Engineer

Hanab

HammondCare is a provider of The Aged Care Volunteer Visitors Scheme funded by the Australian Government and is established to promote links between elderly people and volunteers in their local community.
