I Weibel varetager vi alle led i produkternes tilblivelse – lige fra udvikling til produktion og salg. Derfor har Weibel også et højt sikkerhedsniveau, som der konstant arbejdes på at vedligeholde og forbedre.

Vi søger en engageret Information Security Analyst til et 12-måneders barselsvikariat fra 1. december 2026 til 1. december 2027. Du behøver ikke være ekspert på alle områder fra start. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, struktureret og motiveret for at lære. Rollen spænder fra praktiske og operationelle sikkerhedsopgaver til compliance, kontroller og vedligeholdelse af procedurer.

Alsidig hverdag med mulighed for læring og udvikling

Som Information Security Analyst i Weibel, bliver du en del af Internal Security teamet, hvor du vil bidrage til den daglige håndtering og udvikling af sikkerheden på tværs af organisationen.

Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med erfarne kollegaer og få mulighed for at opbygge bred erfaring inden for cybersikkerhed, operationel sikkerhed, governance og compliance. Du bidrager til udviklingen af sikkerhedsprocedurer, understøtter kolleger i sikkerhedsspørgsmål og får en central rolle i vores arbejde med sårbarheder og teknisk eksponering.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Bidrage til at reducere angrebsfladen og skabe overblik over teknisk eksponering
  • Understøtte håndtering og opfølgning på sikkerhedshændelser samt udføre praktiske sikkerhedsopgaver, herunder sikkerhedsmonitorering via CCTV
  • Bidrage til at drive vores proces for sårbarhedshåndtering, herunder prioritering, opfølgning hos systemejere og håndtering af undtagelser
  • Følge relevante cybertrusler og sårbarheder og bidrage til at omsætte dem til konkrete anbefalinger og sikkerhedstiltag
  • Understøtte identitets- og adgangsstyring, herunder adgangspolitikker og MFA
  • Bidrage til sikkerhed omkring eksterne konsulenter samt awareness aktiviteter
  • Udføre og dokumentere sikkerhedskontroller samt følge op på identificerede afvigelser
  • Understøtte compliance med bl.a. NIS2 og ISO27001 samt udvikling og vedligeholdelse af sikkerhedsprocedurer

Om dig

Du har måske en baggrund inden for IT, cyber- eller informationssikkerhed, compliance eller lignende. Det vigtigste er ikke, at du allerede kan det hele, men at du har et godt sikkerhedsfagligt fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har en grundlæggende forståelse for cybersikkerhed og almindelige angrebsmetoder
  • Arbejder struktureret og er god til at dokumentere og følge op
  • Trives med en kombination af praktiske, tekniske og administrative sikkerhedsopgaver
  • Er nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dig ind i nye teknologier og sikkerhedsproblemstillinger
  • Kan samarbejde på tværs af organisationen og kommunikere sikkerhed forståeligt til forskellige målgrupper
  • Har en pragmatisk tilgang, tager ansvar og følger dine opgaver til dørs
  • Kan håndtere følsomme oplysninger professionelt og med den nødvendige diskretion

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, at du har erfaring med sårbarhedshåndtering, sikkerhedskontroller eller standarder som ISO27001, NIST eller CIS.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende rolle i en højteknologisk virksomhed med en stor samfundsmæssig betydning
  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer bredt inden for cyber- og informationssikkerhed
  • Praktisk erfaring med både operationel sikkerhed, compliance og procedurer
  • Tæt samarbejde med erfarne kolleger og gode muligheder for faglig sparring
  • En alsidig hverdag med stor kontaktflade på tværs af organisationen

Du vil blive en del af Internal Security og referere til Head of Internal Security.

Dit primære arbejdssted vil være på Weibels hovedkontor i Allerød.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Søg venligst jobbet via vores hjemmeside.

Ansøgningsfristen er den 2. november 2026.

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning og afholder samtaler løbende. Derfor anbefaler vi, at du søger hurtigst muligt, da stillingen besættes, når vi finder det rette match.

Vær opmærksom på, at ansættelse forudsætter en ren straffeattest og en PET sikkerhedsgodkendelse.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Bliv en del af en dansk virksomhed

Weibel Scientific A/S er en danskejet ingeniørvirksomhed i kraftig vækst. Vi udvikler og producerer højteknologiske radarer til brug i bl.a. rumforskning, flyindustri, forsvar samt beskyttelse af kritisk infrastruktur. Vi er verdensførende inden for udvikling af Doppler-radarer og har siden vores etablering i 1977 leveret flere end 4.500 state-of-the art radarer til mere end 40 lande.

Vores hovedkvarter ligger i Allerød og beskæftiger knap 600 medarbejdere.

I Weibel kan du se frem til et spændende og udfordrende job i en dynamisk og fremtidsorienteret virksomhed med in-house produktion og højteknologisk udvikling.

Læs også meget mere om os på vores hjemmeside.

title: Postdoctoral Associate - Center for Climate and Environmental Health
description:
Position Summary:

The Center for Climate and Environmental Health (CCEH) at Rice University invites applications for a Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in the field of Climate Change, Environment, and Health. This mentored fellowship provides advanced research training and professional development in preparation for independent academic, research, or industry careers.

This program operates in association with FORECAST—an interdisciplinary project with Baylor College of Medicine and UT Health funded by the Burroughs Wellcome Foundation that investigates how climate change alters human-environment interactions and impacts community health. The call is open to anyone working on issues related to climate and environmental health across disciplines. Through interdisciplinary teams of faculty, postdocs, graduate students, and undergraduate students, CCEH aims to build new research, education, and communication initiatives that are collaborative and multidisciplinary. Applicants whose research, teaching, and/or outreach align with CCEH research areas are encouraged to apply. Priority areas include:

  • Climate & Environmental Impact Science
  • Environmental Epidemiology
  • Environmental Storytelling & Communication
  • Climate & Health Education and Pedagogy
  • Sociological & Cultural Impact Assessments
  • Community Health Monitoring


Workplace Requirements:

On campus position: This position is exclusively on-site, necessitating all duties to be performed in-person in Houston, Texas. Per Rice policy 440, work arrangements may be subject to change.

Exempt (salaried) positions under FLSA are not eligible for overtime.

This position is funded by a grant, soft and/or restricted funds. Continued employment is contingent on the renewal of funding.

Training & Appointment Terms:

  • On-campus Residency: The fellow will pursue mentored research training in-person at Rice University in Houston, Texas.
  • Stipend Support: The fellow will receive a stipend consistent with institutional guidelines for postdoctoral training appointments.
  • Non-Employee Appointment: This fellowship is a stipend-supported training appointment and does not constitute employment with the institution. Fellows are not eligible for employee benefits. However, fellows may elect to purchase health insurance coverage at the same rates offered to employees, subject to institutional policy and eligibility requirements.
  • Funding: This fellowship is supported by external training funds (Burroughs Wellcome Foundation / FORECAST project). Continuation of the appointment is contingent upon satisfactory training progress and the availability of funds.


Essential Functions / Core Fellowship Activities:

  • Develops and executes an individualized research training plan in the area of climate and environmental health in collaboration with the CCEH faculty mentor(s).
  • Conducts independent scholarly research focusing on how climate or environmental shifts impact human health, societal structures, or public health literacy as part of advanced postdoctoral training.
  • Engages in interdisciplinary collaboration across faculty, postdocs, graduate students, and undergraduate students to build new research, education, and communication initiatives.
  • Collects, analyzes, and interprets research data to build expertise in advanced methodologies.
  • Participates in grant-writing workshops and may develop proposals as part of professional training.
  • Receives mentored experience in supervising or advising junior trainees (graduate and undergraduate students).
  • Prepares and submits manuscripts to peer-reviewed journals and presents research findings at scientific meetings.
  • Receives training in research design, experimental methods, and emerging technologies relevant to the field.
  • Participates in seminars, workshops, and other academic activities that enhance professional growth.
  • Performs all other duties as assigned.


Minimum Requirements and Skills:

  • Ph.D. (or terminal degree) in any relevant field across the natural sciences and engineering, humanities, social sciences, arts, architecture, public health, or computational sciences (must be conferred prior to the start of the fellowship).
  • Demonstrated research and/or teaching focus on how climate or environmental shifts impact human health, societal structures, or public health literacy.
  • Strong collaborative agility and a commitment to working alongside scholars from disparate fields (e.g., partnering medical virologists with writers and artists).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, as well as oral presentation skills for the dissemination of scholarly work.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills to balance independent research goals.
  • Advanced knowledge of modern research methods, data collection, and analytical techniques relevant to the discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to draft scholarly papers for submission to high-impact journals.
  • Ability to flourish in a collaborative, multidisciplinary environment.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to pursue research objectives independently under the guidance of a faculty mentor.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Alignment with one or more CCEH target research areas: Climate & Environmental Impact Science, Environmental Epidemiology, Environmental Storytelling & Communication, Climate & Health Education and Pedagogy, Sociological & Cultural Impact Assessments, or Community Health Monitoring.
  • Leadership, research, teaching, and outreach experience focused on interdisciplinary climate-health problems.


Rice University HR | Benefits:

Rice Mission and Values: Mission and Values | Rice University

Rice University is committed to ensuring Equal Employment Opportunity and welcoming the fullness of diversity into our candidate pools. Rice considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national or ethnic origin, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status. Rice also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified persons with disabilities. If an applicant requires a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, please get in touch with Rice University’s Human Resources Office via email at facstaffada@rice.edu for support.

If you have any additional questions, please email us at jobs@rice.edu.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer E-commerce
description:
As a Full Stack Developer, you’ll play a key role in shaping a new e-commerce platform for the Postcode Lottery. You’ll take technical ownership of complex backend and frontend services, contribute to architectural decisions, and help build a scalable, experience-driven commerce platform that supports multiple countries and propositions.
Are you a skilled Full Stack Developer with a passion for making a difference? Join our team and contribute to developing and enhancing applications for our lottery systems. Your work will directly support numerous charities, making a positive impact every day. If you’re looking for a role where your technical expertise meets meaningful work, we want to hear from you! And every day at work, you’ll be doing your part for all the charities we support.

Ben Malik Tchamalam, Group Tech: “After joining the lotteries, I've introduced metrics and observability for our microservices, significantly enhancing our system's transparency and reliability. This experience has not only honed my skills in Java development but also expanded my expertise in infrastructure and DevOps practices. I'm excited to continue leveraging this blend of development and operational knowledge to drive innovation and efficiency within our team.”

What you’ll do:

  • You will be responsible for building and implementing an e-commerce platform, working across both frontend and backend to deliver scalable, experience-driven solutions. Experience with enterprise e-commerce platforms such as Shopware and Commercetools is a plus.
  • You are part of a cross-functional team that collaborates closely with other engineering teams and departments to deliver seamless end-to-end customer journeys.
  • You will provide technical leadership in the implementation of the e-commerce platform and guide the team throughout the process.

You’d describe yourself as follows:

  • 5+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer, working with Typescript and Next.js in a professional environment; certification is a plus.
  • Experience working in e-commerce or digital commerce environments, with a strong understanding of scalable online platforms and customer journeys, and the ability to contribute to the transformation of a transactional e-commerce landscape into a scalable, experience-driven platform.
  • Experience with the following will also be an advantage: Next.js, design systems, NPM, Tailwind, SASS, Jest, Storybook, functional programming, front end build tooling, front end frameworks, AWS, cloud infrastructure, monitoring.
  • Good knowledge of solutions such as Spring, GITlab and Postgres/AWS RDS.
  • A monthly salary indication between €5.000,- and €7.000,- based on a 40-hour week and flexible working hours.

Join us

We believe an inclusive organisation is the ideal breeding ground for creativity, collaboration and innovation. Employee solidarity is important to us, too. Each of us has a part to play in that – we are the organisation, after all. We strive to make everyone feel at home. That means keeping an open mind and paying attention to each other’s welfare.

The Postcode Lottery Group is a marketing-driven international non-profit organisation. We operate lotteries to raise funds for a fairer, greener and healthier world. Our players win with their neighbours and generate money for charities together – it’s a win‑win!

Since the start of the Lotteries in 1989, we have raised over €15 billion for thousands of good causes. Together with our players and 1,500 fellow team members in Great Britain, the Netherlands, Sweden, Germany and Norway, you'll be helping to create a better world every day. This is what we call: The Power of Postcodes.

title: Social- og sundhedsassistent eller social-og sundhedshjælper til dag- og aftenvagt søges til Fremtidens plejehjem
description:
Vil du være med til at skabe en hverdag for beboerne, præget at omsorg og kvalitet? Vil du sammen med dine kollegaer være en aktiv medspiller i at skabe stærke faglige arbejdsfællesskaber, og har du lyst til at blive en del af en arbejdsplads, der er i gang med en spændende udvikling - så er det dig, vi leder efter.

Fremtidens Plejehjem er et somatisk plejehjem, hvor der bor 75 beboere. Det ligger i skønne omgivelser ved Limfjorden tæt på Limfjordsbroen.

Vi er ansat ca. 85 medarbejdere med forskellig faglig baggrund, vi arbejder ud fra. Vi uddanner social- og sundhedsassistenter og social- og sundhedshjælpere, og vi har omkring 25 elever om året, der bliver en del af fællesskabet.

Du bliver tilknyttet en etage og et team, men vi hjælper hinanden på tværs i huset for at lykkedes sammen.

På plejehjemmet er der et aktivt beboer-og pårørenderåd. Det vægtes højt, at der er et godt samarbejde med beboere og pårørende i hverdagen.

Vi har en aktivitetsgruppe og ca. 20 frivillige i huset. De gør alle et stort arbejde sammen med personalet for at skabe nogle gode stunder med forskellige aktiviteter for beboerne.

Lidt om stillingen:
  • Du skal være uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper eller social- og sundhedsassistent med autorisation.
  • Det er en stor fordel, hvis du har kendskab til CURA som dokumentationsredskab
  • Stillingen er i udgangspunktet på 37 timer/ugen i fortrinsvis dag- eller aftenvagt.

Forventet ansættelse vil være fra november eller efter aftale.

Særlige hovedopgaver:
  • Løse opgaver, der ligger indenfor eget kompetenceområde
  • Aktiv deltagelse i tværfagligt samarbejde
  • Bidrage med høj faglighed i helhedsplejen
Faglige kompetencer:
  • Du udviser høj faglighed samt interesse for pleje- og omsorgsopgaver
  • Du kan arbejde med den rehabiliterende tilgang i samarbejde med beboerne og deres pårørende og dine kollegaer.
  • Du er fortrolig med brug af CURA, som dokumentationsredskab.
Personlige kompetencer:
  • Du er en positiv person med et smittende humør
  • At du har en god kommunikation hvor du ser muligheder I stedet for begrænsninger og har en positive dialog med kolleger
  • Du er god til at indgå i relation med mange forskellige mennesker
  • Du bliver opfattet af andre, som en imødekommende og fleksibel person
  • Du er dedikeret, initiativrig og har flair for at se muligheder frem for begrænsninger

Arbejdsstedets adresse: Carl Klitgaards Vej 5, 9400, Nørresundby

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til, at kontakte Mette Sommer på tlf. 99 82 53 51 eller mail: mette.sommer.andersen@aalborg.dk.

Du er meget velkommen til at ringe og aftale en tid til at komme og se Fremtidens Plejehjem, møde kommende kollegaer og mærke den gode stemning i huset. 😊

Vi holder løbende samtaler.

Ansøgningsfrist er d. 30. november 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår:

Efter gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Forud for endelig ansættelse skal der foreligge en straffeattest og indhentes referencer.

Send ansøgning:

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder - Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.

Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

title: Administrator
description:
Job Summary:

Kavli IFN is seeking a detail-oriented, highly organized Administrator with a strong background in scientific communication to support the planning, coordination, implementation, and management of events and functions. These activities may include symposiums, conferences, community-building, and program initiatives.

The Administrator will leverage extensive experience in developing, writing, editing, and managing content for websites and other communication platforms. The role will also be responsible for developing and implementing effective scientific communication strategies that enhance the Institute’s visibility and engagement with its audiences.

In addition, the successful candidate will oversee the Institute’s operational and financial management, ensuring that administrative processes, events, communications, and financial activities are executed efficiently and effectively.

Department of Physiology is a thriving Basic Science department with 14 Core Faculty and approximately 215 staff and lab personnel (including HHMI). The Kavli Institute for Fundamental Neuroscience resides in the Department of Physiology. The Kavli Institute for Fundamental Neuroscience (Kavli IFN) is a central organizing force for neuroscience research at UCSF and our partner institutions. Kavli IFN is building bridges to colleagues in complementary fields both within UCSF and across UCSF and the Bay Area National Laboratories. Our goal is to help create and support new, cross-disciplinary teams of scientists and engineers to tackle the most challenging questions of neuroscience—elucidating the fundamental underpinnings of the brain and its adaptive capacities—while developing the technologies needed to address these questions.

title: AI Engineer

- Full-stack collaboration experience (e.g. React)

title: Production Technician – New Product Introduction (NPI)
description:
About Gallagher

At Gallagher, we protect what matters most. From securing some of the world's highest-security environments to helping farmers manage their operations more efficiently, our technology solutions are trusted globally.

Our global headquarters and manufacturing site are based in Hamilton, New Zealand, with a people-first culture that extends across our global operations, reaching over 160 countries, and offering exciting world-class career pathways. Our manufacturing and engineering teams are critical to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality products and this role plays a key part in that mission.

Bring new products to life. Improve processes. Make an impact.

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced production operator who enjoys problem-solving, improving processes and getting involved in more than just day-to-day manufacturing? This could be your opportunity to take the next step.

We're looking for a motivated and experienced manufacturing professional to join our New Product Introduction (NPI) team, playing an important role in turning innovative product designs into efficient, practical manufacturing processes.

Reporting to the NPI Supervisor, you'll work closely with R&D, Engineering and Manufacturing teams to trial new products, develop assembly processes and ensure everything is ready for a successful transition into production.

This is a hands-on opportunity to build on your manufacturing experience, contribute to continuous improvement and play a key role in bringing Gallagher's next generation of products to life.

What You'll Do

  • Work closely with R&D and Engineering teams to develop practical, efficient manufacturing and assembly processes for new products.

  • Set up and conduct product trials, testing and refining processes before products move into full production.

  • Identify manufacturing challenges and opportunities for improvement, working collaboratively to implement effective solutions.

  • Develop and maintain clear production documentation, including work instructions, assembly procedures and process standards.

  • Support the successful introduction of new products into manufacturing, ensuring production teams have the tools, processes and knowledge they need.

  • Provide hands-on training and support to production operators on new and updated processes.

  • Champion continuous improvement, Lean Manufacturing principles, quality and workplace safety.

  • Collaborate with Production, Planning and Stores teams to support smooth product launches and efficient manufacturing operations.

What You'll Bring

  • At least 5 years' experience working in a manufacturing or production environment.

  • A strong understanding of manufacturing processes, assembly operations and production environments.

  • Experience creating or maintaining technical documentation, work instructions or standard operating procedures.

  • Experience delivering or supporting training within a manufacturing environment.

  • An understanding of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles.

  • Strong attention to detail, with a practical approach to identifying and solving problems.

  • Confidence working independently, taking initiative and managing competing priorities.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships across different teams.

  • Intermediate Microsoft Office skills, with experience using ERP or manufacturing systems being an advantage.

  • A positive, adaptable and proactive attitude, with a commitment to safety, quality and teamwork.

What We Offer

  • Ongoing training, development and career progression opportunities.

  • Competitive remuneration, KiwiSaver contributions, and annual bonus opportunities.

  • Life & Disability Insurance.

  • Boost App membership and Gallagher staff discounts.

  • A supportive team culture with team events, recognition programmes, and opportunities to make a real impact.

If you're an experienced manufacturing professional who enjoys getting hands-on, solving problems and finding better ways of doing things, this could be your opportunity to play an important role in bringing Gallagher's next generation of products to life.

We'd love to hear from you.

Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the role may be filled before the closing date.

title: Service Delivery Manager
description:
Maintenance Manager

Responsibilities

  • Manage maintenance services for large-scale of government project, key customers' networks, data centers, and application software. This involves monitoring, troubleshooting, and collaborating with relevant parties to keep everything running smoothly.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding maintenance - related issues. Provide regular reports on maintenance activities and system performance to clients. Gather clients' feedback and translate it into actionable improvement plans.

  • Engage with project governance on project performance and change management matters

  • Set and uphold maintenance service quality standards. Regularly review service quality and take steps to improve it.

  • Analyze maintenance data to find areas for enhancement and cost - saving. Plan and carry out preventive maintenance activities.

  • Leverage your experience in service process management to optimize maintenance procedures. Standardize work processes, improve efficiency, and ensure seamless handovers between different stages of maintenance tasks.

Job Requirements:

  • A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.

title: TMO (4677)
description:
Job Summary: The Tufting Machine Operator (TMO) is responsible for the overall operation and performance of the tufting machine to which they are assigned. This includes machine setup, monitoring, routine maintenance, and quality control of finished products. The operator must demonstrate strong attention to detail, adherence to safety protocols, and the ability to work effectively within a team environment.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • To oversee creelers and ensure the creel is loaded with the correct yarn and is being tied correctly
  • To oversee their menders to ensure the turf is being properly inspected and mended
  • To ensure all paperwork (roll tags, creel out tags, and production orders) is filled out correctly
  • To run the machine, this entails threading needles, fixing pull-downs, changing blades and hooks, and changing backing when needed
  • The above-referenced individual is responsible for all of the above and anything else deemed necessary by Management
  • Get a work order from the supervisor
  • After the machine is set up and tied in, a weight check needs to be done and signed off on the work order
  • Make sure yarn lots are correct
  • First tufted roll should be laid out on the floor for inspection- Work order needs to be signed off by QC or supervisor
  • Other quality checks: Streaks throughout the width of the roll, streaks from texture, dark line/band, light line/band, low line, shag line, crossed end on A/B Thread up.
  • Make sure you have enough backing to run the roll
  • Need to manage the creel to make sure yarn is in the creel and cut back if needed.
  • Check all roll sizes
  • When near the end of a work order, know what your next work order is to determine what status is on yarn – weather yarn will stay on the machine or strip the creel.

  • Turn in work order to supervisor
  • Question anything that seems incorrect with the supervisor
  • Always stop the machine if anything seems unsafe

Responsible for additional duties and accountabilities that will be assigned as needed.

Coordinates victim services programs which include providing advocacy services to victims of crime, developing and administering program services, providing education to the community and professional groups, assist attorneys with victim/witness contacts and meetings, and grant coordination and management including monitoring the annual budget.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Provides advocacy services to victims.

    • Advises victims of their rights, court hearings, court procedures and decisions in accordance with Minn. Stat. 611A and other applicable statutes. Maintains communications with victims to provide accurate and timely information regarding their cases.
    • Assists victims with restitution and/or reparations process, prosecution process and victim impact statements.
    • Responds to emergency requests for victims.

Answers questions from attorneys and follows up on inquiries regarding victim or witnesses. Schedules appointments, phone conferences, and meetings with victims and witnesses as requested by the assigned attorney or as initiated by the victim or witness.

    • Provides training and education services to the community and professional groups.
    • Assesses the training needs of the community and professional groups and develops and presents training materials.
    • Promotes community awareness of victimization issues by writing articles, press releases, public service announcements and presentations to local community and civic groups.

    • Communicates with the media as directed by the County Attorney.
    • Researches, prepares and presents continuing education topics to county employees, law enforcement, other service providers and the community as directed.
    • Develops brochures and other information addressing general victims’ rights including available resources and services.
    • Develops and administers victims assistance program services.
    • Prepares grant applications and administers programs funded by Federal, State and private sources.
    • Completes reports required by funding sources.
    • Develops and communicates policies and procedures for program operation and protocols.
    • Remains current with victim rights legislative changes and notifies County Attorney staff of changes.
    • Develops and maintains legal documents and reports on database system.

    • Performs other duties as necessary.

title: Housing Monitor (8904)
description:
Schedule/Hours: Monday-Friday, 6:00 pm - 11:30 pm with possible weekends

This position is responsible for:

  • Accepts and processes residents staying in shelter overnight; monitors the activity of residents on an assigned shift ensuring safety, security and compliance to house rules; maintains accurate and complete records and logs containing pertinent information; ensures that shelter is maintained in a neat and proper order.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensures that all rooms are in proper order before and after arrival of residents; checks fire equipment and ensures proper working order.
  • Checks clients into the shelter; prepares and monitors client intake cards; determines if client has been prepaid by sponsor or credit; prepares resident roster and maintains resident property records.
  • Distributes towels, linens, and personal hygiene items; secures and distributes client medications as required.
  • Monitors the activities of the shelter residents ensuring safety and compliance with house rules; checks the security of all windows and doors; monitors cameras and makes periodic rounds of entire facility; records any unique situations occurring on assigned shift.
  • Responds to emergencies in a calm manner and initiates appropriate corrective actions in accordance with established policies and procedures.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:

  • Ability to meet attendance requirements.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate the English language.
  • Ability to respond to emergency situations quickly and calmly while maintaining control and initiating the proper corrective action.
  • Ability to perform combinations of sitting, standing, and walking on a frequent change basis. Distance of travel is usually within the same building.
  • Limited amount of physical effort required associated with walking, standing, lifting and carrying light objects (less than 25 lbs.) 5-10% of work time.
  • Work requires performance of duties in social services environment where exposure to communicable and infectious diseases are possible.

Employee Benefits:

  • Life insurance
  • PTO
  • Aflac Polices
  • Retirement

title: AMHS Technician
description:
The AMHS Installation Technician installs AMHS equipment and performs non-licensed installation support (mounting, routing, cable management, connectorized hookups, and verification) in a semiconductor environment. This is not a licensed electrician role. Electrical distribution work, final terminations, and energization are performed by qualified electricians.

Pay: $36.56 per hour plus fringe

The pay listed is the hourly range or the hourly rate for this position. A specific offer will vary based on applicant’s experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data.

Benefit Information:

ABM offers a comprehensive benefits package. For information about ABM’s benefits, visit ABM

Team Member Benefits | ABM Employee Benefits | Front Line Team Members | (Programa de Beneficios de ABM)

Scope Boundaries:
This role does not perform:

  • NEC-governed electrical work independently (feeders/branch circuits, breakers, panel modifications)
  • Live/energized work or troubleshooting
  • Final terminations in switchgear/MCCs/panelboards

Key Responsibilities

  • Install AMHS components per OEM/project drawings (supports/strut, brackets, guarding, frames, modules); align/level and torque to spec.
  • Install cable supports and routing hardware (tray/wireway/supports) as directed; route/dress OEM control/comm/fiber/sensor cables to spec.
  • Perform OEM plug-in equipment connections and directed connections under supervision; prep/label cables for the electrician's final termination.
  • Provide support during commissioning readiness checks by assisting with point-to-point verification, de-energized continuity checks, and labeling validation; document findings/redlines per foreman/OEM direction.
  • Maintain cleanroom/ESD compliance and follow site safety requirements (LOTO, elevated work, lift rules).
  • Support/coach junior installers; coordinate staging and sequencing with the team.
  • 3 plus; years in automation/material handling/tool install or industrial electromechanical assembly (semiconductor preferred).
  • Can read, install drawings/layouts, and follow OEM instructions.
  • Comfortable with lifts/ladders, overhead work, and strict safety/cleanliness requirements.
  • OSHA 10/30 and lift/fall protection certifications preferred.
  • Must pass background check and drug screening.

What We Offer

  • Competitive hourly wage
  • On-the-job training and mentorship
  • Overtime opportunities
  • Career advancement within ABM’s national network
